english: Heavy summer storms arrive fast. Dig channels along the slope (swales) and small ponds before the rains start in August or September, so the water soaks in instead of running off. Make tanks big: at least 50 litres for every square metre of roof that drains into them. Dig dams long and narrow — about 3 times longer than wide — on gentle slopes.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkqwithela zemvula yasehlotyeni ezinamandla zifika ngokukhawuleza. Yemba imisele ecaleni kwethambeka (imisele yokugcina amanzi) namachibi amancinci phambi kokuba imvula iqale ngeyeThupha okanye eyoMsintsi, ukuze amanzi angene emhlabeni endaweni yokuba aphalale. Yenza iitanki zibe nkulu: ubuncinane iilitha ezingama-50 kwimitha yesikwere nganye yophahla ethululela amanzi kuzo. Yemba amadama amade namxinwa — malunga nokuphindwe kathathu ubude kunobubanzi — kumathambeka athambileyo.

english: Summer brings short, heavy thunderstorms. On every slope, dig channels that follow the land gently downhill (about a 1m drop for every 1,000m across) to spread the water instead of letting it rush away. Winters are dry, so storing water matters. As a rule: 1 square metre of roof catches about 1 litre of water for every 1mm of rain.
isixhosa_draft: Ihlobo lizisa iindudumo ezimfutshane nezinemvula enkulu. Kwithambeka ngalinye, yemba imisele ehla kancinci ilandela umhlaba (malunga nokwehla kwe-1m kwi-1,000m nganye enqumlayo) ukuze isasaze amanzi endaweni yokuba ahambe ngamandla. Ubusika bomile, ngoko ukugcina amanzi kubalulekile. Njengomgaqo: imitha yesikwere e-1 yophahla iqokelela malunga nelitha e-1 yamanzi kwi-1mm nganye yemvula.

english: Rain falls only in winter, so do earthworks in late autumn (March to May), before the rain comes. Small banks along the contour and shallow mulched basins work well. Size your water tanks carefully — summer (December to February) is dry. Reused household water (greywater) is fine for food-growing areas, but never for the natural Fynbos — it is too rich in nutrients for it.
isixhosa_draft: Imvula ina ebusika kuphela, ngoko yenza imisebenzi yokwemba umhlaba ekupheleni kwekwindla (eyoKwindla ukuya kuCanzibe), phambi kokuba kufike imvula. Iindonga ezincinci zomhlaba ezilandela imigca yokuphakama kunye nemingxuma engenzulwanga egqunywe ngengca yokugquma zisebenza kakuhle. Linganisa ubukhulu beetanki zakho zamanzi ngononophelo — ihlobo (eyoMnga ukuya kweyoMdumba) lomile. Amanzi asendlwini asele esetyenzisiwe (greywater) alungile kwiindawo zokulima ukutya, kodwa ungaze uwasebenzise kwiFynbos yendalo — anezondlo ezininzi kakhulu kuyo.

english: On slopes facing west, shade netting can catch water from fog. Build a small raised rim around each plant to trap every drop of rain where it falls. Reusing household water (greywater) is worth doing here. Every 100mm of rain matters — even a small roof tank is valuable.
isixhosa_draft: Kumathambeka ajonge ngasentshona, umnatha womthunzi unokubamba amanzi enkungu. Yakha umphetho omncinci ophakamileyo ngeenxa zonke zesityalo ngasinye ukuze ubambe onke amathontsi emvula apho awela khona. Ukusebenzisa kwakhona amanzi asendlwini (greywater) kufanelekile ukwenziwa apha. I-100mm nganye yemvula ibalulekile — nditsho netanki encinci yophahla ixabisekile.

english: Shade netting can catch water from fog in the air. Design channels to catch sudden flash floods safely. Store water underground, where it stays cool and does not evaporate. Plant trees as windbreaks — they reduce evaporation and give shade before you plant crops.
isixhosa_draft: Umnatha womthunzi unokubamba amanzi enkungu esemoyeni. Yila imisele ukuze ibambe ngokukhuselekileyo izikhukula ezifika ngequbuliso. Gcina amanzi phantsi komhlaba, apho ahlala apholile kwaye engapheli ngumphunga. Tyala imithi njengezithintelo zomoya — inciphisa ukuphela kwamanzi ngumphunga kwaye inike umthunzi phambi kokuba utyale izityalo.

english: Rain falls in both winter and summer. Use shallow channels and banks along the contour. A food forest based on Spekboom copes well with drought and uses water efficiently. Small tanks with gravity-fed drip irrigation work well. On clay soil, take care not to waterlog plants.
isixhosa_draft: Imvula ina ebusika nasehlotyeni. Sebenzisa imisele engenzulwanga neendonga zomhlaba ezilandela imigca yokuphakama. Ihlathi lokutya elisekelwe kwi-Spekboom liyakwazi ukumelana nembalela kwaye lisebenzisa amanzi ngobulumko. Iitanki ezincinci ezinokunkcenkceshela ngamathontsi okuqhutywa ngumxhuzulane zisebenza kakuhle. Kumhlaba odongwe, lumka ukuba izityalo zingami emanzini.

english: Rain is heavy, so managing floods matters more than collecting water. Use shallow channels to slow water down on steep slopes. Raised beds stop plants sitting in water. Channels along the contour also help prevent landslides on clay soil. Run downpipes from your roof into underground tanks.
isixhosa_draft: Imvula inkulu, ngoko ukulawula izikhukula kubaluleke ngaphezu kokuqokelela amanzi. Sebenzisa imisele engenzulwanga ukucothisa amanzi kumathambeka athe nkqo. Iibhedi eziphakamileyo zithintela izityalo ukuba zihlale emanzini. Imisele elandela imigca yokuphakama ikwanceda ukuthintela ukudilika komhlaba kumhlaba odongwe. Yenza imibhobho yamanzi asuka eluphahleni ingene kwiitanki ezingaphantsi komhlaba.

english: Grazing animals often compact this soil hard. Loosen it below the surface before digging channels or ponds. Plant oats or vetch as a winter cover crop to protect and feed the soil. The soil is usually mildly acidic (pH 5.5–6.5) — add agricultural lime if it is more acidic than that. Build up organic matter with compost and biochar.
isixhosa_draft: Izilwanyana ezityayo zihlala ziwuxinzelela lo mhlaba ube lukhuni. Wuxegise ngaphantsi komphezulu phambi kokwemba imisele okanye amachibi. Tyala i-oats okanye i-vetch njengesityalo sokugquma sasebusika ukukhusela nokondla umhlaba. Umhlaba uhlala une-asidi encinci (pH 5.5–6.5) — yongeza ikalika yezolimo ukuba une-asidi engaphezu koko. Yongeza izinto ezibolayo emhlabeni ngomgquba ne-biochar.

english: Cover the soil with stones rather than organic mulch — it is cheaper and works well here. Only add compost to the food-growing area. Succulent plants need soil that drains well, not soil that holds water. For food beds, add biochar and gypsum. Worm farms are a good way to make a strong liquid fertiliser.
isixhosa_draft: Gquma umhlaba ngamatye kunokuba usebenzise ingca yokugquma ebolayo — kuyatshiphu kwaye kusebenza kakuhle apha. Yongeza umgquba kuphela kwindawo yokulima ukutya. Izityalo ezigcina amanzi emagqabini (succulents) zifuna umhlaba ophumisa amanzi kakuhle, hayi umhlaba ogcina amanzi. Kwiibhedi zokutya, yongeza i-biochar ne-gypsum. Iifama zemibungu ziyindlela elungileyo yokwenza isichumisi esingamanzi esinamandla.

english: A hard, cemented layer (calcrete) often sits under the topsoil and may need breaking up with a chisel plough so roots can grow down. Add gypsum rather than lime — the soil is already alkaline. Biochar in the soil helps it hold onto water. Bitter Aloe grows well here and can be sold.
isixhosa_draft: Umaleko oqinileyo onjengesamente (calcrete) uhlala uphantsi komphezulu womhlaba kwaye unokufuna ukuqhekezwa ngekhuba elikhethekileyo (chisel plough) ukuze iingcambu zikhule zisiya ezantsi. Yongeza i-gypsum kunekalika — umhlaba sele une-alkali. I-biochar emhlabeni iwunceda ugcine amanzi. Ikhala elikrakra (Bitter Aloe) likhula kakuhle apha kwaye linokuthengiswa.

english: Any organic matter here is valuable — use manure from goats or camels. Plant shade trees first, before any food crops. In low-lying areas, only plant salt-tolerant species. Raised sandy beds with a wick (a strip of absorbent material drawing water up) work well for vegetables.
isixhosa_draft: Nayiphi na into ebolayo apha ixabisekile — sebenzisa ubulongwe beebhokhwe okanye beenkamela. Tyala imithi yomthunzi kuqala, phambi kwazo naziphi na izityalo zokutya. Kwiindawo eziphantsi, tyala kuphela iintlobo ezikwaziyo ukumelana netyuwa. Iibhedi zentlabathi eziphakamileyo ezinentambo (umcu wento efunxa amanzi uwatsalela phezulu) zisebenza kakuhle kwimifuno.

english: Spekboom is the key plant here: you can eat it, it stores a lot of carbon, and it copes well with drought. To restore damaged land, plant cuttings of Spekboom directly — no need to grow them in a nursery first. Clay soil needs good air flow, so use raised beds for vegetables.
isixhosa_draft: I-Spekboom sesona sityalo sibalulekileyo apha: ungayitya, igcina ikhabhoni eninzi, kwaye iyakwazi ukumelana nembalela. Ukubuyisela umhlaba owonakeleyo, tyala ngqo iziqwenga ezisikiweyo ze-Spekboom — akukho mfuneko yokuqala uzikhulise kwinkulisa. Umhlaba odongwe ufuna umoya ohamba kakuhle, ngoko sebenzisa iibhedi eziphakamileyo kwimifuno.

english: The soil is acidic and nutrients wash out quickly. Add lime to raise the pH to about 6.5. Cover the soil with mulch and plant cover crops to stop nutrients washing away. A mix of biochar and compost (terra preta) greatly improves how much food you can grow. Coffee, avocado, banana and sugar cane all grow well here.
isixhosa_draft: Umhlaba une-asidi kwaye izondlo zihlanjwa ngokukhawuleza. Yongeza ikalika ukunyusa i-pH ibe malunga ne-6.5. Gquma umhlaba ngengca yokugquma kwaye utyale izityalo zokugquma ukuze uthintele izondlo ukuba zihlanjwe. Umxube we-biochar nomgquba (terra preta) uphucula kakhulu isixa sokutya onokusilima. Ikofu, iavokhado, ibhanana nommoba zonke zikhula kakuhle apha.

isixhosa_draft: Izilawuli nezaziso zokwabelana kweli phepha zisesiXhosa. Eminye imizobo, izilumkiso zemeko yedatha nephaneli yeenkcukacha zomfama zisaboniswa ngesiNgesi; amagama, amanani nobungqina obuchwetyezwe ngabantu ziboniswa njengoko zigciniwe.

isixhosa_draft: Indawo zokugcina ezifakiweyo, ufikelelo lwamanzi oluthembekileyo, amanzi aqokelelweyo nelanga elisebenzayo.

isixhosa_draft: Indawo yakho efakwe emephini, ukugcina okucwangcisiweyo nemvula yesizini.

isixhosa_draft: Susa izityalo zeetumato ezigqibile ukuvelisa phambi kokuba isifo sisasazeke.

english: Sow spinach and carrots in well-composted beds
isixhosa_draft: Tyala isipinatshi neminqathe kwimibhede efakwe umgquba kakuhle.

english: Protect tender seedlings from frost with shade cloth or row cover
isixhosa_draft: Khusela izithole ezithambileyo kwiqabaka ngelaphu lesithunzi okanye ngesigquma semitya.

english: Water only when soil is dry — overwatering in winter causes root rot
isixhosa_draft: Nkcenkceshela kuphela xa umhlaba womile — ukunkcenkceshela kakhulu ebusika kubangela ukubola kweengcambu.

english: Check stored pumpkins and sweet potatoes for rot
isixhosa_draft: Hlola amathanga nebhatata ezigciniweyo ukuba ziyabola na.

english: Prepare spring beds — dig in compost before the heat arrives
isixhosa_draft: Lungisa imibhede yentwasahlobo — mba umgquba emhlabeni phambi kokuba kufike ubushushu.

english: Remove frost cloth as days warm — let sun strengthen seedlings
isixhosa_draft: Susa ilaphu lokukhusela iqabaka njengoko iintsuku zifudumala — yeka ilanga lomeleze izithole.

english: Water daily in the morning — evening watering invites fungal disease
isixhosa_draft: Nkcenkceshela imihla ngemihla ekuseni — ukunkcenkceshela ngokuhlwa kuzisa izifo zokungunda.

english: April is the best time to plant garlic in most of South Africa. Use healthy large cloves from disease-free stock. Spinach germinates well now — thin seedlings to 15 cm apart for big leaves. Cooler nights mean less pest pressure: advantage yours.
isixhosa_draft: U-Epreli lelona xesha lilungileyo lokutyala igalikhi kuninzi lwaseMzantsi Afrika. Sebenzisa amaqhekeza makhulu asempilweni asuka kwimbewu engenazifo. Isipinatshi sihluma kakuhle ngoku — yenza izithole zibe ne-15 cm phakathi kwazo ukuze amagqabi abe makhulu. Ubusuku obupholileyo bunciphisa uxinzelelo lwezinambuzane: loo nto ikuncedile.

english: Succession sow spinach every 3 weeks from May through July for a continuous harvest window. Carrots sown now will be ready by August. Autumn is also the ideal time to improve soil — dig in mature compost now and the earthworms will do the rest over winter.
isixhosa_draft: Tyala isipinatshi ngokulandelelana rhoqo emva kweeveki ezi-3 ukusuka kuMeyi ukuya kuJulayi ukuze ube nesivuno esiqhubekayo. Iminqathe etyalwe ngoku iya kuba ilungile ngo-Agasti. Ukwindla lelona xesha lilungileyo lokuphucula umhlaba — mba umgquba ovuthiweyo emhlabeni ngoku, iintshulube ziya kwenza okunye ebusika.

english: June is the coldest month in the Highveld. In frost-prone areas, protect spinach seedlings overnight with fleece or dry grass. On the coast and in the Cape, June is actually ideal growing weather — focus there on maximising yields before spring heat arrives.
isixhosa_draft: UJuni yeyona nyanga ibandayo kwiHighveld. Kwiindawo ezineqabaka, khusela izithole zesipinatshi ebusuku ngelaphu elikhuselayo okanye ngengca eyomileyo. Ngaselwandle nase-Cape, uJuni ngokwenene yimozulu elungileyo yokukhula — apho gxila ekwandiseni isivuno phambi kokuba kufike ubushushu bentwasahlobo.

english: July is the deepest point of the growing pause. Use the time well: source good tomato, bean, and maize seed now while it is plentiful and cheap. Mid-July, start tomato seeds indoors in trays if you have a warm spot — they will be ready to transplant by September.
isixhosa_draft: UJulayi lixesha elinzulu lokuphumla kokukhula. Lisebenzise kakuhle: fumana imbewu elungileyo yeetumato, yeembotyi neyombona ngoku ngoxa ininzi kwaye ithengiswa ngexabiso eliphantsi. Phakathi kukaJulayi, qala imbewu yeetumato ngaphakathi endlini kwiitreyi ukuba unendawo efudumeleyo — ziya kuba zilungele ukutyalwa kwakhona ngoSeptemba.

english: August signals transition. Sow tomato seeds indoors now — 6 to 8 weeks before your last frost gives transplants a running start. In frost-free coastal regions you can direct-sow tomatoes in the ground by late August. Begin loosening winter-compacted soil in every bed.
isixhosa_draft: U-Agasti ubonisa utshintsho. Tyala imbewu yeetumato ngaphakathi endlini ngoku — iiveki ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-8 phambi kweqabaka lakho lokugqibela kunika izithole isiqalo esihle. Kwimimandla yonxweme engenaqabaka ungatyala iitumato ngqo emhlabeni ekupheleni kuka-Agasti. Qala ukuthambisa umhlaba owenziwe waqina bubusika kwimibhede nganye.

english: Storage was nearly full, so photos on the oldest entries were removed. The notes are kept.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yokugcina yayisondele ukuzala, ngoko iifoto zezona zinto zindala ezibhaliweyo zisusiwe. Amanqaku agciniwe.

english: Storage is full — this entry could not be saved. Delete an old entry and try again.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yokugcina izele — oku kubhaliweyo akukwazanga ukugcinwa. Cima okudala okubhaliweyo uze uzame kwakhona.

english: Could not start the tour. Please allow session storage.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhenketho alukwazanga ukuqala. Nceda uvumele indawo yokugcina yeseshoni.

english: Compare harvests, sales and expenses in Charts. Open invoices, choose Saved and open an existing invoice to find Share PDF and Print. See how the farmer keeps a digital record; you do not need to send anything to a buyer.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa izivuno, intengiso neendleko kwiTshathi. Vula ii-invoyisi, khetha Kugciniwe uze uvule i-invoyisi esele ikhona ukufumana Yabelana nge-PDF kunye Shicilela. Jonga indlela umfama agcina ngayo irekhodi ledijithali; akunyanzelekanga ukuba uthumele nantoni na kumthengi.

english: The example workspace could not start. Please allow session storage and try again.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yomzekelo yokusebenza ayikwazanga ukuqala. Nceda uvumele indawo yokugcina yeseshoni uze uzame kwakhona.

english: Please allow session storage to open this tour.
isixhosa_draft: Nceda uvumele indawo yokugcina yeseshoni ukuvula olu khenketho.

english: Choose at least one month when this food is in store.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ubuncinane inyanga enye apho oku kutya kugciniwe.

english: Add products to the plan to record their production and food in store.
isixhosa_draft: Yongeza iimveliso kwisicwangciso ukuze ubhale imveliso yazo nokutya okugciniweyo.

english: Fresh harvest, food in store and recorded preserved food.
isixhosa_draft: Isivuno esitsha, ukutya okugciniweyo nokutya okugciniweyo okubhaliweyo.

english: Food in store follows each crop’s sourced storage conditions. Freezing, drying, fermentation and other processing enter only through dated stock records. A harvest does not automatically create preserved food.
isixhosa_draft: Ukutya okugciniweyo kulandela iimeko zokugcina ezinomthombo zesityalo ngasinye. Ukuqandisa, ukomisa, ukufermenta nolunye uqhutyo kungena kuphela ngeerekhodi zokugcina ezinemihla. Isivuno asenzi ngokwaso ukutya okugciniweyo.

english: No kept-food records are supplied. Their availability is unknown. This graph uses only the marked harvest and sourced crop-storage windows.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho rekhodi zokutya okugciniweyo ezinikeziweyo. Ukufumaneka kwazo akwaziwa. Le grafu isebenzisa kuphela amaxesha esivuno aphawulweyo namaxesha okugcina izityalo anomthombo.

english: Weights recorded as present in each month. Stored, dried, frozen, fermented and processed foods are stocks; they are not a second harvest.
isixhosa_draft: Ubunzima obubhalwe njengobukhoyo kwinyanga nganye. Ukutya okugciniweyo, okomisiweyo, okuqandisiweyo, okufermentiweyo nokuqhutywe kuyigcino; ayisosivuno sesibini.

english: Device storage could not be changed. Try again.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yokugcina yesixhobo ayikwazanga ukutshintshwa. Zama kwakhona.

english: Save your worksheet before changing cases. A facilitator can collect your paper or oral explanation as well as your calculations. The self-check is practice feedback; it is not a submitted or accredited assessment.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iphepha lakho lomsebenzi phambi kokutshintsha amakesi. Umququzeleli angaqokelela inkcazo yakho ebhaliweyo okanye ethethiweyo kunye nezibalo zakho. Ukuzihlola kukuziqhelisa kuphela; akuluvavanyo olungeniswayo okanye olwamkelweyo.

english: Ask a facilitator or learning partner to review your explanations as well as the figures. They should give a specific correction and then ask you to demonstrate it on a fresh case.
isixhosa_draft: Cela umququzeleli okanye iqabane lokufunda ukuba liphonononge iinkcazo zakho kunye namanani. Kufuneka banike ulungiso oluthile baze bakucele ukuba ulubonise kwikesi entsha.

english: Model a simple soil, water or seed observation using local materials after checking the method and site; pause if the action is unsafe.
isixhosa_draft: Bonisa into elula yokujonga umhlaba, amanzi okanye imbewu usebenzisa izinto zasekuhlaleni emva kokukhangela indlela nendawo; yima ukuba isenzo asikhuselekanga.

english: Identify the local language to use, the exact English source when a translation is a draft, materials, access support and a stop point for unsafe or unverified advice.
isixhosa_draft: Chonga ulwimi lwasekuhlaleni oluza kusetyenziswa, umthombo wesiNgesi ngqo xa ukuguqulelwa kuyidrafti, izixhobo, inkxaso yokufikelela nenqanaba lokuyeka kwicebiso elingakhuselekanga okanye elingaqinisekiswanga.

english: Pauses unsafe or unverified farming advice and identifies the next source or practitioner check.
isixhosa_draft: Iyayeka icebiso lokulima elingakhuselekanga okanye elingaqinisekiswanga, ichonge umthombo olandelayo okanye ukukhangelwa yingcali.

english: Trace a boundary on a satellite view of the real farm, then lay out beds, water systems, earthworks and structures directly on that ground — not a generic template.
isixhosa_draft: Zoba umda kumbono wesathelayithi wefama yokwenyani, uze ucwangcise imibhede, iinkqubo zamanzi, imisebenzi yomhlaba nezakhiwo ngqo kuloo mhlaba — hayi ithempleyithi eqhelekileyo.

english: Every plant on offer in farm design is a real, sourced species — indigenous fruit trees, exotic fruit and nut trees, shrubs, groundcovers and climbers — each with its own water need, mature size and use.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo ngasinye esikhoyo kuyilo lwefama luhlobo lwenene, olunomthombo — imithi yeziqhamo yesiNtu, imithi yeziqhamo neyamantongomane eziphuma phesheya, amatyholo, izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba nezikhwelayo — ngasinye sinesidingo saso samanzi, ubukhulu bokuvuthwa nokusetyenziswa.

english: Ten modules, 33 lessons, covering permaculture ethics, reading the landscape, water harvesting, soil health, seeds, plant guilds, food forests, livestock and market gardening — each lesson with a short quiz.
isixhosa_draft: Iimodyuli ezilishumi, izifundo ezingama-33, ezigubungela imigaqo yokuziphatha ye-permaculture, ukufunda umhlaba ojikelezileyo, ukuqokelela amanzi, impilo yomhlaba, imbewu, amaqela ezityalo, amahlathi okutya, imfuyo nogadi lokuthengisa — isifundo ngasinye sinekhwizi emfutshane.

english: ImbewuField home screen showing the farm’s weather forecast, a heat warning, and the next suggested step
isixhosa_draft: Isikrini sekhaya se-ImbewuField sibonisa uqikelelo lwemozulu yefama, isilumkiso sobushushu nenyathelo elilandelayo elicetywayo

english: Today’s weather, a heat warning, and what to do next on this farm.
isixhosa_draft: Imozulu yanamhlanje, isilumkiso sobushushu, noko kufuneka kwenziwe okulandelayo kule fama.

english: AI-generated site report showing rainfall, soil texture, frost risk and elevation, plus the site’s mapped land parcels
isixhosa_draft: Ingxelo yendawo eveliswe yi-AI ebonisa imvula, ubume bomhlaba, umngcipheko weqabaka nokuphakama, kunye neziqwenga zomhlaba zendawo ezibekwe kwimephu

english: Rainfall, soil, frost risk and elevation for the exact site — plus its mapped land parcels.
isixhosa_draft: Imvula, umhlaba, umngcipheko weqabaka nokuphakama kwindawo echanekileyo — kunye neziqwenga zomhlaba zayo ezibekwe kwimephu.

english: Produce photos travel with the harvest record they belong to, so a reviewer sees the crop as well as the figure.
isixhosa_draft: Iifoto zemveliso zihamba nerekhodi yesivuno ezizezaso, ukuze umphononongi abone isityalo kunye nenani.

english: ImbewuField is a Progressive Web App — no app store, no download size. Open it once and add it to the home screen, and it opens like any other app from then on.
isixhosa_draft: I-ImbewuField yi-Progressive Web App — akukho stoko ye-app, akukho bukhulu bokukhuphela. Yivule kube kanye uyongeze kwiskrini sekhaya, kwaye ivuleka njengayo nayiphi enye i-app emva koko.

english: Lima marked where each zone would work well. Tap a zone, then draw it yourself.
isixhosa_draft: ULima uphawule apho indawo nganye ingasebenza kakuhle khona. Cofa indawo, uze uyizobe ngokwakho.

english: Is clean drinking water always available?
isixhosa_draft: Ngaba amanzi acocekileyo okusela akhoyo rhoqo?

english: Secure reliable clean drinking water before buying more birds.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa amanzi acocekileyo okusela athembekileyo phambi kokuthenga ezinye iintaka.

english: Every breed needs clean drinking water, suitable feed and protected housing.
isixhosa_draft: Uhlobo ngalunye luneemfuno zamanzi acocekileyo okusela, ukutya okufanelekileyo nendawo yokuhlala ekhuselekileyo.

english: You reported frost. Check winter shelter and chick warmth with a local adviser.
isixhosa_draft: Uxele iqabaka. Jonga indawo yokukhusela ebusika nokufudumala kwamantshontsho nomcebisi wasekuhlaleni.

english: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
isixhosa_draft: Amanzi okulima ayinqongophele. Jonga amanzi okusela ngokwahlukileyo; amanzi egadi akaqinisekisi ukubakho kwamanzi akhuselekileyo eenkukhu.

english: An egg-and-meat option. It outperformed the other indigenous breeds for eggs in a managed ARC trial; those results do not predict this farm.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhetho lwamaqanda nenyama. Lwadlula ezinye iindidi zomthonyama ngamaqanda kuvavanyo olulawulwayo lwe-ARC; ezo ziphumo azibikeli okuya kwenzeka kule fama.

english: An ARC-conserved indigenous option for eggs and meat; check local stock and care needs.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhetho lwendidi yomthonyama egcinwe yi-ARC lwamaqanda nenyama; jonga imfuyo yasekuhlaleni neemfuno zokunakekela.

english: An indigenous option described across diverse South African climates; confirm suitability with local advice.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhetho lwendidi yomthonyama echazwe kwiimozulu ezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika; qinisekisa ukufaneleka ngecebiso lasekuhlaleni.

english: Consider only after checking reliable feed, drinking water, housing, health care and managed lighting. Breed and supplier still need local confirmation.
isixhosa_draft: Cinga ngayo kuphela emva kokujonga ukutya okuthembekileyo, amanzi okusela, indawo yokuhlala, unyango lwempilo nokukhanya okulawulwayo. Uhlobo nomthengisi kusafuna ukuqinisekiswa apha ekuhlaleni.

english: Planned crops to check for frost
Frost has been observed here in {months}. Check frost-tender crops against these observations.
isixhosa_draft: Iqabaka libonwe apha ngo-{months}. Jonga izityalo ezibuthathaka kwiqabaka ngokuthelekisa nezi zinto zibonwe.

english: Frost has been observed here; months not recorded. Check frost-tender crops against these observations.
isixhosa_draft: Iqabaka libonwe apha; iinyanga azibhalwanga. Jonga izityalo ezibuthathaka kwiqabaka ngokuthelekisa nezi zinto zibonwe.

english: Farmer reports no observed frost. This observation does not establish that future winters will be frost-free.
isixhosa_draft: Umfama uxela ukuba akukho qabaka libonwe. Oku akuqinisekisi ukuba ubusika obuzayo buya kuba bungenaqabaka.

english: Local frost observations are not recorded. Satellite monthly averages cannot establish first and last frost dates.
isixhosa_draft: Oko kubonwe ngeqabaka apha ekuhlaleni akubhalwanga. Imilinganiselo yenyanga yesathelayithi ayinakuqinisekisa imihla yeqabaka lokuqala neyokugqibela.

english: These planned crops will hold ground in months when frost has been observed here. Confirm local protection or change the planting before relying on these dates.
isixhosa_draft: Ezi zityalo zicwangcisiweyo ziya kuhlala emhlabeni kwiinyanga apho iqabaka libonwe khona apha. Qinisekisa ukukhuselwa kwasekuhlaleni okanye utshintshe ukutyala phambi kokuba uthembele kule mihla.

english: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Fermentation controls, a tested processing recipe and the amount held are not supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuAgasti ukuya kuOkthobha 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Ulawulo lokufermenta, iresiphi yokulungisa eyavavanywayo nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

english: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried nuts in shell; no harvest from these example trees is claimed. Storage conditions, kernel weight and the amount held are not supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuAgasti ukuya kuOkthobha 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Ngamandongomane aqanjiweyo ethengiweyo okanye athwalwayo asegobolondweni; akukho sivuno sivela kwiimithi zomzekelo esicelwayo. Iimeko zokugcina, ubunzima bentliziyo yeqokobhe nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

english: Inspect every colony regularly for signs of notifiable bee disease and Cape-bee (Capensis) infection.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola yonke ikholoni rhoqo ukuze ubone iimpawu zesifo seenyosi ekufuneka sinikwe ingxelo kunye nosulelo lwe-Cape-bee (Capensis).

english: Keep written records of colonies, apiary locations, diseases, disease-control measures and colony losses with their reasons.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iirekhodi ezibhaliweyo zeekholoni, iindawo zeenyosi, izifo, amanyathelo okulawula izifo nokulahleka kweekholoni kunye nezizathu zako.

english: Report any suspected notifiable disease (American foulbrood is listed); officials can order an infected colony destroyed.
isixhosa_draft: Xela naliphi na ukrokrelo lwesifo ekufuneka sinikwe ingxelo (i-American foulbrood ibhalwe kuluhlu); amagosa angayalela ukuba ikholoni esulelekileyo itshatyalaliswe.

english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: state Veterinary Services enforce isolation and movement restrictions.
isixhosa_draft: I-Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) sisifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act: iiNkonzo zoGqirha bezilwanyana zikarhulumente ziqinisekisa ukwahlulwa nokunqandwa kokuhamba.

english: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, as part of the national bovine brucellosis control scheme under the Animal Diseases Act.
isixhosa_draft: Naliphi na ukukhutshwa kwesisu okukrokrelwayo okanye okuqinisekisiweyo okunxulumene ne-brucellosis kwiinkomo kufuneka kuxelwe kwiofisi yoGqirha wezilwanyana kaRhulumente, njengenxalenye yenkqubo yesizwe yokulawula i-bovine brucellosis phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act.

english: An owner or manager whose animals are, or may be, infected with a controlled animal disease must report it to the state veterinary director immediately.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini okanye umphathi onezilwanyana ezisulelekileyo, okanye ezinokusuleleka, sisifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo kufuneka axele ngoko nangoko kuMlawuli woGqirha bezilwanyana kaRhulumente.

english: Newcastle disease and notifiable avian influenza are on the state list of controlled and notifiable animal diseases.
isixhosa_draft: I-Newcastle disease ne-avian influenza ekufuneka kuxelwe ikho kuluhlu lukarhulumente lwezifo zezilwanyana ezilawulwayo nezifuna ukuxelwa.

english: Scavenging village chickens grow more slowly than commercially-farmed birds and are more vulnerable to disease, parasites and predators.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkukhu zasezilalini ezikrwelayo zikhula ngokucotha kunamanye iintaka ezifuyiweyo ngorhwebo kwaye zibuthathaka ngakumbi kwizifo, kwii-parasayithi nakwizilwanyana ezizingelayo.

english: Watch flocks for sudden deaths, ruffled feathers, swollen wattles/combs or a sudden drop in egg production - these are signs of avian influenza and should be reported at once.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela imihlambi ukuba inokufa ngequbuliso, iintsiba ezixukuxekileyo, ii-wattle/ii-comb ezivuvukileyo okanye ukwehla ngequbuliso kwemveliso yamaqanda - ezi ziimpawu ze-avian influenza kwaye kufuneka zixelwe ngoko nangoko.

english: Keep ducks away from wild birds and open water/feed that attracts them, and control visitors' access to duck housing, to reduce avian-influenza risk.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iidada kude neentaka zasendle namanzi avulekileyo/ukutya okuzitsalayo, kwaye ulawule ukufikelela kwabagxeleli endlwini yeedada, ukunciphisa umngcipheko we-avian influenza.

english: Ducks are birds/poultry, so an outbreak of avian influenza in a duck flock is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act and must be reported to the state vet immediately.
isixhosa_draft: Iidada ziintaka/iinkukhu zasekhaya, ngoko ukuqhambuka kwe-avian influenza kumhlambi weedada sisifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act kwaye kufuneka kuxelwe ngoko nangoko kugqirha wezilwanyana karhulumente.

english: The indigenous Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) is not a listed invasive species and may be farmed without an alien-species permit; the faster-growing Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) is.
isixhosa_draft: I-Mozambique Tilapia yomthonyama (O. mossambicus) ayiyiyo indidi ephazamisayo ebhalwe kuluhlu kwaye inokufuywa ngaphandle kwemvume yendidi yangaphandle; i-Nile Tilapia ekhula ngokukhawuleza (O. niloticus) iyiyo.

english: An owner must not let a goat stay in a dirty or parasite-infested condition, and must get veterinary or other treatment for a sick, injured or diseased animal when able to.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini akufuneki avumele ibhokhwe ihlale ingcolile okanye inee-parasayithi, kwaye kufuneka afumane unyango lukagqirha wezilwanyana okanye olunye lwesilwanyana esigulayo, esenzakeleyo okanye esinesifo xa enako.

english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: veterinary services enforce isolation and movement restrictions, and a suspected case must be reported.
isixhosa_draft: I-Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) sisifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act: iinkonzo zoogqirha bezilwanyana ziqinisekisa ukwahlulwa nokunqandwa kokuhamba, kwaye ityala elikrokrelwayo kufuneka lixelwe.

english: The 2016 government goat manual distinguishes indigenous, Boer, Savanna and Kalahari Red meat-purpose stock from milk/fibre breeds, with breeding objectives and individual birth, weaning, weight and sale records. Uncontrolled communal mating can produce births at any time; that does not establish meat or weaned-kid availability all year. Choose stock for the local system and record survival and product stage before forecasting quantities.
isixhosa_draft: Incwadana karhulumente yeebhokhwe ka-2016 ihlula imfuyo yenyama yomthonyama, iBoer, iSavanna neKalahari Red kwiindidi zobisi/zentsontelo, kunye neenjongo zokwenzalana neerekhodi zomntu ngamnye zokuzalwa, ukuyekiswa ebeleni, ubunzima nentengiso. Ukwenzalana okungalawulwanga kwasekuhlaleni kunokuvelisa ukuzalwa nangaliphi na ixesha; oko akumisi ukubakho kwenyama okanye kwamathole ayekisiweyo ebeleni unyaka wonke. Khetha imfuyo efanelekileyo kwinkqubo yasekuhlaleni kwaye ubhale ukusinda nenqanaba lemveliso phambi kokuqikelela ubungakanani.

english: A goat may only be slaughtered for sale at a registered abattoir under the Meat Safety Act; slaughtering it for the farmer's own consumption, or for cultural/religious purposes (including ceremonial slaughter, common with indigenous goats), is exempt from that rule, but that meat may not then be sold.
isixhosa_draft: Ibhokhwe inokuhlatywa ukuze ithengiswe kuphela kwi-abattoir ebhalisiweyo phantsi kwe-Meat Safety Act; ukuyihlaba ukusetyenziswa komfama ngokwakhe, okanye ngeenjongo zenkcubeko/zonqulo (kuquka ukuhlaba kwemisitho, okuqhelekileyo kwiibhokhwe zomthonyama), akunyanzelwanga kulo mgaqo, kodwa loo nyama ayinakuthengiswa emva koko.

english: ARC Table 1 lists pregnant sows at 10–18 L drinking water/day and lactating sows at 18–23 L/day. These are breeding-sow stages, not one amount for every pig. Farrowing care separates sow cooling from piglet warmth; outdoor systems need locally adapted hardy stock, shade and shelter. Confirm stage, reliable clean water, feed and housing locally. The manual supplies no verified edible kg per breeding sow for this plan.
isixhosa_draft: Itheyibhile 1 ye-ARC idwelisa iimazi zehagu ezikhulelweyo ngeelitha ezili-10–18 zamanzi okusela ngosuku neemazi ezivelisa ubisi ngeelitha ezili-18–23 ngosuku. La ngamanqanaba eemazi zokwenzalana, hayi ubungakanani obunye beehagu zonke. Ukunakekela ukuzala kwahlula ukupholisa imazi nokufudumala kwamathole ehagu; iinkqubo zangaphandle zifuna imfuyo eqinileyo eziqhelaniswe nendawo, umthunzi nendawo yokukhusela. Qinisekisa inqanaba, amanzi acocekileyo athembekileyo, ukutya nendawo yokuhlala apha ekuhlaleni. Incwadana ayinikezeli ii-kg zenyama ezityiwayo eziqinisekisiweyo kwimazi nganye yokwenzalana kolu cwangciso.

english: African swine fever (ASF) is listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act; warthogs and Ornithodorus ticks are carriers/vectors.
isixhosa_draft: I-African swine fever (ASF) ibhalwe njengesifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo esinxulumene neehagu phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act; ii-warthog nee-Ornithodorus tick zizithwali/zizithuthi.

english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is also listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act.
isixhosa_draft: I-Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) nayo ibhalwe njengesifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo esinxulumene neehagu phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act.

english: Electric prodders, sticks or goads may not be used on sheep.
isixhosa_draft: Izixhobo zombane zokutyhala, iintonga okanye izixhobo zokukhuthaza azinakusetyenziswa kwigusha.

english: Livestock must be given water and fed as soon as they reach their night camp or final destination.
isixhosa_draft: Imfuyo kufuneka inikwe amanzi kwaye itye ngokukhawuleza xa ifikile kwinkampu yobusuku okanye kwindawo yokugqibela.

english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act; Veterinary Services enforce isolation and movement restrictions.
isixhosa_draft: I-Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) sisifo sezilwanyana esilawulwayo phantsi kwe-Animal Diseases Act; iinkonzo zoogqirha bezilwanyana ziqinisekisa ukwahlulwa nokunqandwa kokuhamba.

english: Sheep scab is a controlled disease by law: a suspected or positive case must be reported to the State Veterinarian immediately.
isixhosa_draft: I-Sheep scab sisifo esilawulwayo ngokomthetho: ityala elikrokrelwayo okanye eliqinisekisiweyo kufuneka lixelwe kuGqirha wezilwanyana kaRhulumente ngoko nangoko.

english: A sheep-scab treatment plan should be in place: the disease carries a high economic and welfare cost.
isixhosa_draft: Kufuneka kubekho isicwangciso sonyango lwe-sheep scab: esi sifo sinexabiso eliphezulu lezoqoqosho nelokunakekelwa.

english: Despite foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in South Africa, wool exports continue under the inactivation clause of the OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health) rules.
isixhosa_draft: Nangona kukho i-foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) eMzantsi Afrika, ukuthunyelwa kweboya ngaphandle kuyaqhubeka phantsi komgaqo wokuyenza intsholongwane ingasebenzi (inactivation) we-OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health).

english: Free-range/scavenging village chickens, KwaZulu-Natal: dry (40.43) vs wet (49.91) environment, difference not significant ('NS'). A managed-system ARC Irene trial of named indigenous breeds (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) reports far higher counts, now separately verified and retained in productionReferences; managed conditions cannot replace this village range.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkukhu zasezilalini ezikrwelayo/ezikhululekileyo, KwaZulu-Natal: indawo eyomileyo (40.43) vs emanzi (49.91), umahluko awubalulekanga ('NS'). Uvavanyo lwe-ARC Irene lenkqubo elawulwayo lweendidi zomthonyama ezibizwa ngamagama (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) lubika amanani aphezulu kakhulu, ngoku aqinisekiswe ngokwahlukileyo kwaye agcinwe kwi-productionReferences; iimeko ezilawulwayo azinakubuyisela indawo yokukrwela yasezilalini.

english: ARC identifies Tommy Atkins and Kent among more heat/sunburn-tolerant options; Sensation and Keitt are more susceptible. Confirm local harvest dates before choosing a succession.
isixhosa_draft: I-ARC ichonga i-Tommy Atkins ne-Kent phakathi kwezinye ezinyamezela ubushushu/ukutshiswa yilanga ngakumbi; i-Sensation ne-Keitt ziphantsi koku ngakumbi. Qinisekisa imihla yokuvuna yasekuhlaleni phambi kokukhetha ulandelelwano.

english: About years 4–5 in the KZN horticultural guide. Context is frost-free warm, humid subtropical production areas; cultivar, propagation age and field establishment are not specified. This is a first-crop reference, not a guaranteed local quantity or full-bearing age.
isixhosa_draft: Malunga neminyaka yesi-4–5 kwisikhokelo sezolimo seziqhamo se-KZN. Imeko yeendawo zemveliso ezishushu, ezingenaqabaka, ezinomswakama ze-subtropical; indidi, ubudala bokuphindaphindwa nokuqala kwesityalo entsimini aziqinisekisiwe. Esi sisalathiso sesivuno sokuqala, hayi isixa esiqinisekileyo sasekuhlaleni okanye ubudala bokuthwala ngokupheleleyo.

english: Allow for slow growth, frost sensitivity and roots that exploit rock crevices.
isixhosa_draft: Vumela ukukhula ngokucothayo, ukuba buthathaka kwiqabaka nengcambu ezifikelela kwimiqantsa yamatye.

english: Ask a local botanical nursery to confirm the plant's identity and suitable provenance; no primary named cultivar or exact frost threshold was verified.
isixhosa_draft: Cela inethsari yezityalo zendalo yasekuhlaleni iqinisekise ukuchongwa kwesityalo nemvelaphi efanelekileyo; akukho ndidi ithiyiweyo iphambili okanye umlinganiselo oqinisekileyo weqabaka oqinisekisiweyo.

english: Ask an indigenous nursery for exact species and local material. No regional high-yield food cultivar is verified.
isixhosa_draft: Cela inethsari yezityalo zomthonyama udidi oluchanekileyo nezinto zasekuhlaleni. Akukho ndidi yokutya enesivuno esiphezulu yengingqi eqinisekisiweyo.

english: Ask an indigenous nursery for exact species, local provenance and sex information; no quantified food-yield cultivar is established.
isixhosa_draft: Cela inethsari yezityalo zomthonyama udidi oluchanekileyo, imvelaphi yasekuhlaleni nolwazi ngesini; akukho ndidi enesivuno sokutya esilinganiselweyo esiqinisekisiweyo.

english: Assumed planting variety: Sunrise Solo, subject to a frost-free, drained growing position. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Uhlobo lokutyala olucingelwayo: Sunrise Solo, ngokuxhomekeke kwindawo yokukhula engenaqabaka, ephuma kakuhle amanzi. Qinisekisa iinyanga zayo zasekuhlaleni zokuvuna; ikhalenda isebenzisa isalathiso sengingqi esinelebheli apho sifunyenwe khona.

english: Assumed planting variety: Tommy Atkins, subject to local flowering and frost checks. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Uhlobo lokutyala olucingelwayo: Tommy Atkins, ngokuxhomekeke kuhlolo lasekuhlaleni lokuqhakaza neqabaka. Qinisekisa iinyanga zayo zasekuhlaleni zokuvuna; ikhalenda isebenzisa isalathiso sengingqi esinelebheli apho sifunyenwe khona.

english: Assumes light frost; check severity locally.
isixhosa_draft: Ucinga iqabaka elincinci; hlola ubukhulu balo apha ekuhlaleni.

english: Avoid frost and waterlogging. Honey Gold needs male and female plants; Sunrise Solo is hermaphrodite.
isixhosa_draft: Phepha iqabaka namanzi emi. I-Honey Gold idinga izityalo ezisisilisa nezisisifazane; i-Sunrise Solo yi-hermaphrodite.

english: Best in summer-rain areas with little frost; protect young trees in colder sites.
isixhosa_draft: Yeyona ilungileyo kwiindawo zemvula yasehlotyeni ezinqabaka kancinci; khusela imithi emincinci kwiindawo ezibandayo.

english: Buying advice: for egg production, request vaccinated point-of-lay pullets from a layer supplier, with age, feeding and vaccination records.
isixhosa_draft: Isiluleko sokuthenga: kwimveliso yamaqanda, cela izikhukhukazi ezincinci ezikufutshane nokubeka ezigonyiweyo kumthengisi weenkukhu zamaqanda, kunye neerekhodi zobudala, zokutya nezokugonya.

english: Buying advice: match breed/stock to the product, local feed, climate and care capacity; confirm with a local livestock or beekeeping adviser.
isixhosa_draft: Isiluleko sokuthenga: hlanganisa uhlobo/imfuyo nemveliso, ukutya kwasekuhlaleni, imozulu kunye nesakhono sokunakekela; qinisekisa nomcebisi wemfuyo okanye wokufuya iinyosi wasekuhlaleni.

english: Check frost, drainage and flowering-season disease pressure. Heat and sunburn sensitivity differ between cultivars.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola iqabaka, ukuphuma kwamanzi noxinzelelo lwezifo ngexesha lokuqhakaza. Ukuba buthathaka kubushushu nasekutshisweni yilanga kuyahluka phakathi kweendidi.

english: Check fruit maturity and post-harvest handling. Sunburn, cracking and rot vary by cultivar.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola ukuvuthwa kweziqhamo nokuphathwa emva kokuvuna. Ukutshiswa yilanga, ukuqhawuka nokubola kuyahluka ngokweendidi.

english: Check local frost and water. Food processing needs a suitable method and explicit kept-stock records.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola iqabaka namanzi asekuhlaleni. Ukusetyenzwa kokutya kudinga indlela efanelekileyo neerekhodi ezicacileyo zesitokhwe esigcinwayo.

english: Check measured winter chilling, spring frost, drainage and rain near picking. The older KZN guide regarded commercial suitability there as still under trial; a broad climate-zone label does not replace current local advice.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola ukubanda kobusika okulinganisiweyo, iqabaka lentwasahlobo, ukuphuma kwamanzi nemvula kufutshane nokuvunwa. Isikhokelo esidala se-KZN sasibona ukufaneleka kwezorhwebo apho kusengovavanywa; igama lommandla wemozulu ngokubanzi alithatheli indawo yecebiso lasekuhlaleni langoku.

english: Choose a cool growing season and fertile, well-drained soil. Heat reduces bud quality and freezing can damage buds.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ixesha lokukhula elibandayo nomhlaba ohlumileyo, ophuma kakuhle amanzi. Ubushushu buyehlisa umgangatho weentyatyambo ezingekavuleki kwaye iqabaka linokuzonakalisa.

english: Choose a sunny, well-drained growing position, protect establishment and plan pruning for leaf harvest.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha indawo yokukhula enelanga, ephuma kakuhle amanzi, khusela ukuqala kwesityalo kwaye ucwangcise ukunqunyulwa kwemfuno yokuvuna amagqabi.

english: Cold-area check: these subtropical references do not establish suitability here. Confirm a frost-protected position before buying.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuhlolwa kwindawo ebandayo: ezi zalathiso ze-subtropical aziqinisekisi ukufaneleka apha. Qinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo kwiqabaka phambi kokuthenga.

english: Collect eggs frequently, keep nest litter clean and dry, and handle/store eggs carefully for household use or sale.
isixhosa_draft: Qokelela amaqanda rhoqo, gcina ingca yeendawo zokubeka icocekile nomileyo, kwaye uwaphathe/uwagcine amaqanda ngenyameko ukuze asetyenziswe ekhaya okanye athengiswe.

english: Confirm Rhoicissus digitata; other wild-grape species have different descriptions and cannot supply its dates.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa i-Rhoicissus digitata; ezinye iindidi zewayini yasendle zinamabali ahlukeneyo kwaye azinakunika imihla yayo.

english: Confirm cultivar-specific chilling and spring frost risk. Mean winter temperature is not a chill-hour measurement.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa ubushushu obuthile bendidi kunye nomngcipheko weqabaka lentwasahlobo. Ubushushu obumndilili bobusika alulilinganiselo leeyure zobanda.

english: Confirm exact species with a qualified indigenous nursery. Do not substitute genus-level berry claims for identification.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa udidi oluchanekileyo kunye nenethsari yezityalo zomthonyama efanelekileyo. Ungathathi indawo yokuchongwa ngezibango ezibanzi zeberry zalo lonke uhlobo (genus).

english: Confirm the exact species and intended hedge use with a local indigenous nursery.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa udidi oluchanekileyo nokusetyenziswa kothango okujoliswe kuko kwinethsari yezityalo zomthonyama yasekuhlaleni.

english: Confirm the exact species and local provenance; the SANBI assessment places it on stony fynbos/karroid slopes of the Northern and Western Cape.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa udidi oluchanekileyo nemvelaphi yasekuhlaleni; uhlolo lwe-SANBI lusibeka kwiithambeka ezinamatye ze-fynbos/karroid zoMntla neNtshona Koloni.

english: Confirm the exact species and male/female stock with an indigenous nursery. Keep landscape use separate from an unverified household food process.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa udidi oluchanekileyo nesitokhwe esisisilisa/sisisifazane kwinethsari yezityalo zomthonyama. Gcina ukusetyenziswa kwemeko-bume kwahlukile kwinkqubo yokutya kwekhaya engaqinisekiswanga.

english: Confirm the exact species with a local indigenous-plant nursery; no tested regional cultivar or quantified yield selection is established.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa udidi oluchanekileyo kwinethsari yezityalo zomthonyama yasekuhlaleni; akukho ndidi yengingqi evavanyiweyo okanye ukhetho lwesivuno olulinganisiweyo olufunyenweyo.

english: Dried-fruit flour is a documented traditional end use, not a supplied safe storage duration. October–March is flowering.
isixhosa_draft: Umgubo weziqhamo ezomisiweyo yindlela yemveli ebhaliweyo yokusetyenziswa, hayi ixesha lokugcina elikhuselekileyo elinikeziweyo. U-Okthobha–Matshi lixesha lokuqhakaza.

english: Food is the berry; the same SANBI account reports poisonous tuberous roots. September–June describes berry occurrence, not a measured ripe-picking interval.
isixhosa_draft: Ukutya yiberry; umthombo ofanayo we-SANBI uxela ukuba iingcambu ezinjengetiyubha zinetyhefu. USeptemba–Juni uchaza ukubakho kweberry, hayi ixesha elilinganisiweyo lokuvuna ezivuthiweyo.

english: For eggs with dependable feed and water, consider commercial layers. For eggs and meat, Potchefstroom Koekoek is a dual-purpose option; Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck are other ARC-conserved choices. Confirm supplier vaccination, age and care requirements.
isixhosa_draft: Kwamaqanda ngokutya namanzi athembekileyo, cinga ngeenkukhu zorhwebo ezibeka amaqanda. Kwamaqanda nenyama, i-Potchefstroom Koekoek yindlela enenjongo ezimbini; i-Venda, i-Ovambo ne-Naked Neck ziikhetho ezinye ezigcinwe yi-ARC. Qinisekisa ukugonywa komthengisi, ubudala neemfuno zenkathalo.

english: Frost sensitivity and drainage constrain the site. Year-round planting at Hluhluwe is a planting reference, not an all-year household picking window; cooler sites use warmer planting months.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba buthathaka kwiqabaka nokuphuma kwamanzi kuthintela indawo. Ukutyala unyaka wonke eHluhluwe sisalathiso sokutyala, hayi ifestile yonyaka wonke yokuvuna ekhaya; iindawo ezibandayo zisebenzisa iinyanga ezishushu zokutyala.

english: Frost- and drought-hardy; establishment care still matters.
isixhosa_draft: Inyamezela iqabaka nembalela; kodwa inkathalo yokuqala isabalulekile.

english: Frost-free forest reference; confirm a fruiting female and pollen source.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sehlathi elingenaqabaka; qinisekisa isitokhwe esiqhamayo esisisifazane nomthombo womungu wentyatyambo.

english: Frost-free regional reference; male and female trees are separate.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sengingqi engenaqabaka; imithi esisisilisa nesisisifazane ihlukile.

english: Full sun and well-drained ground; a waterwise Cape groundcover. Flowering dates are not picking dates.
isixhosa_draft: Ilanga elipheleleyo nomhlaba ophuma kakuhle amanzi; isigubungelo seKapa esonga amanzi. Imihla yokuqhakaza ayiyo mihla yokuvuna.

english: Government guidance identifies pods, severe-frost exclusion, irrigation in arid areas and variation between seedling trees. It recommends grafted material and pollen provision; not every tree has the same crop.
isixhosa_draft: Isikhokelo sikarhulumente sichonga ama-pod, ukukhutshwa ngenxa yeqabaka elinzima, ukunkcenkceshela kwiindawo ezomileyo nokwahluka phakathi kwemithi evela embewini. Sincoma izinto ezidityanisiweyo (grafted) kunye nokubonelelwa ngomungu wentyatyambo; hayi yonke imithi inesityalo esifanayo.

english: Grafted mango stock in the KZN guide generally begins bearing after 3–4 years. Context is frost-free tropical/warm subtropical production with low humidity at flowering, including dry Zululand, Valley Bushveld and Lowveld. The text distinguishes grafted stock from seed-raised Peach/Sabre; do not apply this age to an unrecorded seedling or infer yearly kg.
isixhosa_draft: Isitokhwe semango edityanisiweyo kwisikhokelo se-KZN sihlala siqala ukuthwala emva kweminyaka emi-3–4. Imeko yimveliso engenaqabaka eshushu/ye-subtropical eshushu enomswakama ophantsi ngexesha lokuqhakaza, kubandakanya iZululand eyomileyo, iValley Bushveld neLowveld. Umbhalo uhlula isitokhwe esidityanisiweyo kwi-Peach/Sabre ekhuliswe embewini; ungasebenzisi obu budala kwisityalo esivela embewini esingabhalwanga okanye uqikelele ii-kg zonyaka.

english: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
isixhosa_draft: Isitokhwe esidityanisiweyo sihlala siqala ukuthwala malunga neminyaka emi-3–4 kwaye sinokuqhubeka sivelisa iminyaka engama-20 okanye ngaphezulu phantsi kweemeko zesikhokelo. Imithi ekhuliswe embewini yimeko eyahlukileyo yezinto zokutyala. Iqabaka, iimeko zokuqhakaza kwentwasahlobo emanzi, indidi nokuqala kwesityalo entsimini kufuneka kuhlolwe; ubomi obude abuyiyo ijika lesivuno ngobudala.

english: Historical food use concerns the fatty berry coating, not a generic fresh sweet berry. No validated household extraction method, recovered food yield or storage life is established. Source coating/oil percentages are not assigned as processing conversion factors.
isixhosa_draft: Ukusetyenziswa kokutya kwakudala kubhekisa kwigubungela le-berry elineoli, hayi i-berry emnandi eqhelekileyo entsha. Akukho ndlela iqinisekisiweyo yokukhupha yasekhaya, isivuno sokutya esibuyisiweyo okanye ubomi bokugcina obuqinisekisiweyo. Iipesenti zegubungelo/zeoli zomthombo azabelwanga njengezinto zokuguqula ukusetyenzwa.

english: Imperial has a December reference at Robertson. This is a local trial candidate, not advice for frost-free coastal KZN.
isixhosa_draft: I-Imperial inesalathiso sika-Disemba eRobertson. Ngumgqatswa wovavanyo lwasekuhlaleni, hayi isiluleko sonxweme lwe-KZN olungenaqabaka.

english: KZN advice describes Vaccinium species and lists rabbiteye cultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue and Climax. This reference is not specific to southern highbush blueberries.
isixhosa_draft: Icebiso le-KZN lichaza iindidi ze-Vaccinium kwaye lidwelisa iindidi ze-rabbiteye i-Tifblue, i-Beckyblue ne-Climax. Esi sisalathiso asikhethekanga kwii-blueberry ze-southern highbush.

english: Keep roots well drained; water matters during flowering.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iingcambu zikhutshwa kakuhle amanzi; amanzi abalulekile ngexesha lokuqhakaza.

english: Match cultivation to this arid-land tree and well-drained conditions.
isixhosa_draft: Hambelanisa ukulima nalo mthi wommandla owomileyo neemeko zokuphuma kakuhle kwamanzi.

english: Match the cultivar to table olives or oil. Check drainage, irrigation and winter conditions; humid summer rainfall can bring disease problems.
isixhosa_draft: Hambelanisa indidi ne-olive zetafile okanye neoli. Hlola ukuphuma kwamanzi, unkcenkceshelo neemeko zasebusika; imvula yasehlotyeni enomswakama inokuzisa iingxaki zezifo.

english: Match the cultivar to the microclimate; avoid hard frost and poorly drained ground.
isixhosa_draft: Hambelanisa indidi nemozulu encinci yendawo; phepha iqabaka elinzima nomhlaba ongaphumiyo kakuhle amanzi.

english: Match the plant to well-drained coastal sandy conditions and its seasonal growth.
isixhosa_draft: Hambelanisa isityalo neemeko zesanti yonxweme ephuma kakuhle amanzi nokukhula kwaso kwexesha.

english: Match the selected duration type and sowing date to local frost, rainfall and water availability; the trials retain their own conditions.

english: Yield points use the conservative end of published commercial KZN benchmarks where that crop is listed. They compare plans; they do not predict this household's harvest. The warm/light-frost windows, spacing and duration use the official tables where those tables cover the crop; catalog fallbacks and other regional patterns still need local confirmation. Bed occupancy uses the upper published maturity/picking endpoint so two crops are not booked onto the same ground, but the source says these times are approximate and assume optimum conditions; actual crops may mature later. Every later sowing or transplant is conditional on observing that the previous crop is finished and the bed is clear. The app does not split a crop-cycle total into invented monthly kilograms. Auto-suggest only ranks crops with verified yield, duration and field-spacing support. A family plan starts from a supported diverse mix; an exact crop list becomes a strict whitelist. It requires irrigation because intensive succession without a farm water plan is not defensible. Its packing is a transparent heuristic, not proof of a global maximum or of a physical row layout. Commercial ranking is fresh weight per crop cycle; it is not profit, nutrition or evidence of buyer demand.
