Ukuthathwa kombhede kusebenzisa isiphelo esiphezulu sokuvuthwa/sokuvunwa esipapashiweyo ukuze izityalo ezibini zingabhukishwa kumhlaba omnye, kodwa umthombo uthi la maxesha ngqikelelo kwaye ucinga iimeko ezilungileyo; izityalo zokwenyani zinokuvuthwa kamva. Yonke ihlwayelo okanye ukutshintshela kwexesha elilandelayo kuxhomekeke ekuqwalaseleni ukuba isityalo esandulelayo sigqityiwe kwaye umbhede ucocekile. I-app ayahlulahluli inani lomjikelo wesityalo libe ziikhilogram zenyanga eziqanjiweyo. Cebisa ngokuzenzekelayo ibeka kuphela izityalo ezinesivuno, ixesha nokuxhaswa kwebanga lentsimi eziqinisekisiweyo. Isicwangciso sosapho siqala kumxube owahlukileyo oxhaswayo; uluhlu lwezityalo ngqo lube luluhlu olungqongqo. Sifuna unkcenkceshelo kuba ukulandelelana okuxineneyo ngaphandle kwesicwangciso samanzi efama akukhuselekanga. Indlela yaso yokuxinezela yindlela ebonakalayo yokuqikelela, hayi ubungqina bobuninzi obuphezulu jikelele okanye bohlengahlengiso lwemitya yangempela. Ukubekwa kwezityalo kwezorhwebo kusekelwe kubunzima obutsha kumjikelo wesityalo; ayiyo nzuzo, ukondleka okanye ubungqina bemfuno yabathengi.

english: Planning guide only — sow windows are general. Adjust to your local rainfall, frost dates and microclimate.
isixhosa_draft: Isikhokelo sokucwangcisa kuphela — amaxesha okuhlwayela ngamanani ngokubanzi. Lungelelanisa nemvula yalapha ekuhlaleni, imihla yeqabaka nemozulu encinci.

english: Does the report about water crossing the eastern yard establish levels or an earthworks design?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ingxelo yamanzi anqumla igceke elisempuma iqinisekisa imiphakamo okanye uyilo lomsebenzi womhlaba?

english: For your own work, check the site name and account as well as the record. A similar name is not enough to identify the right item.
isixhosa_draft: Kumsebenzi wakho, khangela igama lendawo ne-akhawunti kunye nerekhodi. Igama elifanayo alwanelanga ukuchonga into echanekileyo.

english: Look at the displayed sun, wind, fire and water information. Read the source and missing-data notes. Some information is modelled or regional context, rather than a measurement on your land.
isixhosa_draft: Jonga ulwazi olubonisiweyo lwelanga, umoya, umlilo namanzi. Funda amanqaku omthombo nawolwazi olulahlekileyo. Ulwazi oluthile lwenziwe ngemodeli okanye lunxulumene nommandla, hayi umlinganiselo womhlaba wakho.
Amanzi → Imisebenzi yomhlaba → Imimandla → Ukutyala → Izakhiwo

english: A tank or bed icon comes with starting dimensions. Check the real design requirements before keeping those values. A drawn earthwork is not a surveyed or approved construction instruction.
isixhosa_draft: Icon yetanki okanye yebhedi iza nobungakanani bokuqala. Khangela iimfuno zokwenyani zoyilo phambi kokugcina ezo xabiso. Umsebenzi womhlaba ozotyiweyo awuyomyalelo wokwakha olinganisiweyo okanye ovunyiweyo.

english: Use Undo to restore the practice edit. Check both the position and the dimensions. Redo repeats an undone edit; it is not a second copy. Fit map to view helps you see the whole site again.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa u-Buyisela ukubuyisela utshintsho lokuziqhelisa. Khangela zombini indawo nemilinganiselo. U-Redo uphinda utshintsho olubuyiselweyo; asiyikopi yesibini. U-Fit map to view ukunceda ubone indawo yonke kwakhona.

english: You can move an item deliberately and restore it without accidentally changing its dimensions.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuhambisa into ngabom uze uyibuyisele ngaphandle kokutshintsha imilinganiselo yayo ngengozi.

english: Review → Inspect the map → Read Saved or any warning
isixhosa_draft: Phonononga → Hlola imephu → Funda okuthi Kugciniwe okanye nayiphi na isilumkiso

english: The app saves edits as you work. Read the header. If it says NOT saved or reports full storage, retain a copy and resolve the warning before leaving. Saved confirms the device save; it does not by itself prove the same version has reached another device.
isixhosa_draft: I-app igcina utshintsho njengoko usebenza. Funda intloko yephepha. Ukuba ithi AKUGCINWANGA (NOT saved) okanye ibika ukuba indawo yokugcina igcwele, gcina ikopi uze uxazulule isilumkiso phambi kokuhamba. U-Kugciniwe uqinisekisa ukugcina kwisixhobo; wodwa awubonisi ukuba inguqulo enye ifikile kwesinye isixhobo.

english: Correct. Restore the original dimensions first. Zoom in and distinguish the body from the resize handles before trying again.
isixhosa_draft: Ichanekile. Buyisela imilinganiselo yoqobo kuqala. Khulisa uze wahlule umzimba kwiziphatho zokutshintsha ubungakanani phambi kokuzama kwakhona.

english: Independent practice: in the sample farm, identify an existing feature and a proposed item. Move one bed, explain what changed, and restore it with Undo. Draw a Design Map, download one selected sheet and find its title and legend in the file.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: kwifama yomzekelo, chonga into ekhoyo nento ecetywayo. Hambisa ibhedi enye, uchaze oko kutshintshileyo, uze uyibuyisele nge-Buyisela. Zoba Imephu yoyilo, ukhuphele iphepha elinye elikhethiweyo uze ufumane isihloko nentsingiselo yalo kwifayile.

english: Sow month → How much of the bed? → Read the warnings
isixhosa_draft: Inyanga yokuhlwayela → Ingakanani umbhede? → Funda izilumkiso

english: Read overlap and unverified-timing messages. A warning is a reason to review the plan, even when the screen still lets you save. Do not assume two crop bars mean both fit.
isixhosa_draft: Funda imiyalezo yokugqagqana nexesha elingaqinisekisiweyo. Isilumkiso sisizathu sokuphonononga isicwangciso, nokuba isikrini sikuvumela ukuba ugcine. Ungacingi ukuba iibha zezityalo ezimbini zithetha ukuba zombini ziyangena.

english: The plan saves on this device as you work. Read any Not saving warning and keep a copy while resolving it. A closed editor does not prove a cloud backup exists.
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso sigcinwa kwesi sixhobo njengoko usebenza. Funda nayiphi na isilumkiso esithi Not saving uze ugcine ikopi ngoxa usilungisa. Umhleli ovaliweyo awubonisi ukuba kukho ikopi yogcino kwilifu.

english: Tasks describes planned work. Availability shows fresh-picking windows and storage only where conditions are provided. Neither proves you have harvested or stored food. Field utilization concerns planned occupation of the mapped space.
isixhosa_draft: Imisebenzi ichaza umsebenzi ocwangcisiweyo. Ukufumaneka kubonisa iifestile zokukha ezitsha nogcino kuphela apho iimeko zinikezelwe. Akukho kubo kuqinisekisa ukuba uvuniwe okanye ugcinile ukutya. Ukusetyenziswa kwentsimi kunxulumene nokuhlala okucwangcisiweyo kwendawo emepiweyo.

english: Independent practice: follow the sample design into its crop plan, identify one bed’s area and open one planting. Explain its status, month and area share. Change one planned month, save and reopen it, then restore it with Undo.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: landela uyilo lomzekelo ukuya kwisicwangciso sawo sezityalo, uchonge indawo yebhedi enye uze uvule ukutyala okunye. Chaza imeko yako, inyanga nesabelo sendawo. Tshintsha inyanga enye ecwangcisiweyo, ugcine uze uvule kwakhona, uze uyibuyisele nge-Buyisela.

english: The chart calculates kept as picked minus sold. It does not separately record food eaten at home, gifts, storage, seed, feed or loss. Keep those destinations in a supporting notebook if you need to explain them.
isixhosa_draft: Itshathi ibala oko kusele njengoko kuvuniwe kuthatyathwe okuthengisiweyo. Ayirekhodi ngokwahlukeneyo ukutya okutyiwe ekhaya, izipho, ukugcinwa, imbewu, ukutya kwemfuyo okanye ilahleko. Gcina ezo ndawo ziya kuzo kwincwadi exhasayo ukuba ufuna ukuzichaza.

english: On a phone, the summary at the top says this month. Read the period beside each lower card as well. Check the labels again after changing screen size or reopening the page.
isixhosa_draft: Kwifowuni, isishwankathelo esingaphezulu sithi le nyanga. Funda ixesha ecaleni kwekhadi ngalinye elingezantsi. Khangela iileyibhile kwakhona emva kokutshintsha ubungakanani besikrini okanye ukuvula iphepha kwakhona.

english: Read any Check warning before adding totals. A possible duplicate needs investigation against its source. If there are no rows, check the period and saved records before concluding that nothing happened.
isixhosa_draft: Funda nayiphi na isilumkiso se-Check phambi kokongeza izixa. Ikopi enokwenzeka ifuna uphando ngokuchasene nomthombo wayo. Ukuba akukho miqolo, khangela ixesha neerekhodi ezigciniweyo phambi kokugqiba ukuba akukho nto yenzekileyo.

english: You can trace a row, explain its date and units, and identify any warning.
isixhosa_draft: Unokulandela umqolo, uchaze umhla neeyunithi zawo uchonge nawuphi na isilumkiso.

english: Choose Save and read the result. If the app says Not saved or reports a storage problem, keep the report open and retain a copy while you resolve it.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-Gcina uze ufunde isiphumo. Ukuba i-app ithi Not saved okanye ibika ingxaki yogcino, gcina ingxelo ivuliwe ugcine ikopi ngoxa uyixazulula.

english: Start while connected, with enough data, battery and free storage. Use the same normal browser or installed app that you will take with you. Stay signed in for your own coursework.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngoxa uqhagamshelekile, unedatha eyaneleyo, ibhetri nendawo yokugcina engenanto. Sebenzisa isikhangeli esiqhelekileyo okanye i-app efakiweyo ofuna ukuhamba nayo. Hlala ungenile kumsebenzi wakho wekhosi.

english: Read the download size before starting. Standard uses less data where a higher-quality version is offered. Choose what suits your connection and storage.
isixhosa_draft: Funda ubungakanani bokukhuphela phambi kokuqala. U-Standard usebenzisa idatha encinci apho inguqulo yomgangatho ophezulu inikezelwa khona. Khetha oko kuhambelana noqhagamshelwano lwakho nendawo yokugcina.

english: If the page, picture or voice fails, reconnect and check the download and device storage. Resolve the gap before travelling. Repeat this check when you change devices or find that saved files are missing.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba iphepha, umfanekiso okanye ilizwi lisilele, qhagamshela kwakhona ukhangele ukukhuphela nendawo yokugcina yesixhobo. Xazulula isikhewu phambi kokuhamba. Phinda olu khangelo xa utshintsha izixhobo okanye ufumana ukuba iifayile ezigciniweyo ziyalahleka.

english: Use the same device and normal browser. Clearing site data removes downloads and can remove unsent work. Low storage can also cause the browser to clear saved files. Keep original evidence and check readiness again before your next visit.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa isixhobo esinye nesikhangeli esiqhelekileyo. Ukucima idatha yesayithi kususa okukhutshelweyo kwaye kunokususa umsebenzi ongathunyelwanga. Indawo yokugcina encinci nayo inokubangela ukuba isikhangeli sicime iifayile ezigciniweyo. Gcina ubungqina boqobo uze ukhangele ukulungela kwakhona phambi kotyelelo olulandelayo.

english: WALK-A records the route and carried containers as seen. TALK-A records the resident's rain account as reported. The learner does not turn that account into a measured contour or flood depth. Further investigation becomes an action in the evidence register.
isixhosa_draft: I-WALK-A irekhoda indlela neengqayi ezithwalwayo njengoko zabonwa. I-TALK-A irekhoda ingxelo yemvula yomhlali njengoko ibikiwe. Umfundi akayiguquli loo ngxelo ibe ngumgca wokuphakama olinganisiweyo okanye ubunzulu bokukhukula. Uphando oluqhubekayo lube sisenzo kwiregistri yobungqina.

english:
A base map shows the place before the proposed changes. It helps everyone discuss the same site. Show the existing buildings, access routes, water points, growing areas and other features that matter to the brief. Mark north when you have checked it, and keep the source of the boundary visible.

A first sketch may help you understand relationships. Label it “not to scale” if that is what it is. Before using a plan to judge fit, check the measurements and use a consistent scale. Keep units with dimensions. Measure relevant widths and distances safely, and record whether a value was measured, taken from a source or estimated. A precise-looking line is not proof of a precise measurement.

Keep the existing map and the proposal separate. A transparent sheet over paper, a saved copy or a clearly labelled proposal layer lets you try ideas while preserving what is actually there. Do not silently shift the house, path or boundary to make an idea fit. A traced satellite picture can be a starting reference; it does not by itself establish legal ownership or a surveyed boundary.

Give the map a title, date or revision, legend and source notes. Use words as well as colour so a printed or colour-blind reader can distinguish existing features, proposed changes and uncertain information. Leave enough space for labels to be read.
isixhosa_draft:
Imephu esisiseko ibonisa indawo phambi kotshintsho olucetywayo. Inceda wonke umntu axoxe ngendawo enye. Bonisa izakhiwo ezikhoyo, iindlela zofikelelo, iindawo zamanzi, iindawo zokutyala nezinye iimpawu ezibalulekileyo kwisishwankathelo. Phawula umntla xa uwuhloliwe, uze ugcine umthombo womda ubonakala.

Umzobo wokuqala unokukunceda uqonde unxulumano. Wubize “ongekho kwisikali” ukuba injalo. Phambi kokusebenzisa isicwangciso ukugweba ukungena, khangela imilinganiselo uze usebenzise isikali esihambelanayo. Gcina iiyunithi kunye nemilinganiselo. Linganisa ububanzi neendawo ezifanelekileyo ngokukhuselekileyo, urekhode ukuba ixabiso lalinganiswa, lathathwa kumthombo okanye laqikelelwa. Umgca obonakala ucacile awubobungqina bomlinganiselo ochanekileyo.

Gcina imephu esele ikho nesiphakamiso sahlukile. Ishiti esobala ngaphezu kwephepha, ikopi egciniweyo okanye ungqimba lwesiphakamiso olunamagama acacileyo likuvumela uzame iingcamango ugcine oko kukhoyo ngokwenene. Musa ukutshintsha ngokuthe cwaka indlu, indlela okanye umda ukwenza ingcamango ingene. Umfanekiso wesathelayithi ozotyiweyo unokuba sisalathiso sokuqala; ayisekanga yodwa ubunini ngokwasemthethweni okanye umda olinganisiweyo.

Nika imephu isihloko, umhla okanye uhlaziyo, intsingiselo namanqaku omthombo. Sebenzisa amagama nombala ukuze umfundi wokushicilela okanye ongaboni mibala wahlule iimpawu ezikhoyo, utshintsho olucetywayo nolwazi olungaqinisekanga. Shiya indawo eyaneleyo ukuze iileyibhile zifundeke.

english: The busy-yard learner keeps the used route clear on every concept. They mark the eastern water report for further investigation rather than drawing a trench. They ask about the reliability and suitability of the existing supply before promising a larger garden.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi wegceke elixakekileyo ugcina indlela esetyenzisiweyo icacile kuyo yonke ingcamango. Uphawula ingxelo yamanzi asempuma ukuze iphandwe kwakhona kunokuzoba umsele. Ubuza ngokuthembeka nokufaneleka kokubakho kwamanzi okusele kukho phambi kokuthembisa igadi enkulu.

english: The busy yard already connects the home, water point and growing patch through a carrying route. Before adding another system, the learner asks whether the current care journey can be improved. BRIEF-A excludes animals from this phase, so livestock are not added to complete a decorative cycle.
isixhosa_draft: Igceke elixakekileyo lisele lidibanisa ikhaya, indawo yamanzi nendawo yokutyala ngendlela yokuthwala. Phambi kokongeza enye inkqubo, umfundi ubuza ukuba ingaba uhambo lonophelo lwangoku lunokuphuculwa. I-BRIEF-A ayibandakanyi zilwanyana kweli nqanaba, ngoko imfuyo ayongezwa ukugqiba isangqa sokuhombisa.

english: A learner has drawn one beautiful arrangement. What can they compare it with to decide whether it answers the brief well?
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi uzobe ulungiselelo olunye oluhle. Angalithelekisa nantoni ukuze agqibe ukuba liyiphendula kakuhle na isishwankathelo?

english: On a measured practice site supplied by the facilitator, reconcile the written dimensions, units and scaled drawing. Point to the information that establishes fit. On your own design, mark any proposal still awaiting measurement or technical dimensions. Do not conduct unsafe or specialist surveying as an unsupervised course task.
isixhosa_draft: Kwindawo yokuziqhelisa enemilinganiselo enikezelwe ngumququzeleli, vumelanisa imilinganiselo ebhaliweyo, iiyunithi nomzobo osikaliweyo. Khomba ulwazi olusekayo ukuba iyangena. Kuyilo lwakho, phawula nasiphi na isiphakamiso esisalindele ukulinganisa okanye imilinganiselo yobugcisa. Musa ukwenza ukulinganisa umhlaba okungakhuselekanga okanye okukhethekileyo kwabantu abaqeqeshiweyo njengomsebenzi wekhosi ngaphandle kokongamelwa.

english: Does the presence of a Water or Earthworks tool mean any placement it accepts is suitable?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukubakho kwesixhobo sika-Water okanye Earthworks kuthetha ukuba nayiphi indawo ayamkelayo ifanelekile?

english:
A plan communicates decisions. Give it a clear title, revision and purpose. Show orientation, scale status, units, legend and sources. Distinguish existing features from proposed changes and unresolved information using labels or patterns as well as colour. Keep labels near the correct features without covering essential details.

Separate information when a single sheet becomes crowded. A base map, analysis overlay, proposal and phase sheet can tell different parts of the same story. Keep feature names and references consistent between them. The cost record and care plan should refer to the same items shown on the map.

Inspect the actual export at the size it will be used. Can someone read it on a phone or printed sheet? Are labels clipped? Does the legend describe things that are really present? Does decorative artwork hide a path or imply features that were never recorded? Correct the output and check again.
isixhosa_draft:
Isicwangciso sixela izigqibo. Sinike isihloko esicacileyo, uhlaziyo nenjongo. Bonisa ulwalathiso, imeko yesikali, iiyunithi, intsingiselo nemithombo. Wahlula iimpawu ezikhoyo kutshintsho olucetywayo nolwazi olungaxazululwanga usebenzisa iileyibhile okanye iipatheni kunye nombala. Gcina iileyibhile kufutshane neempawu ezichanekileyo ungagquli iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo.

Wahlula ulwazi xa iphepha elinye lixineneyo. Imephu esisiseko, ishiti yohlalutyo, isiphakamiso nephepha lenqanaba zinokubalisa amacandelo ahlukeneyo ebali elinye. Gcina amagama neencwadi zobungqina ziguquguquki phakathi kwazo. Irekhodi leendleko nesicwangciso sonophelo kufuneka zibhekisele kwizinto ezifanayo ezibonakala kwimephu.

Hlola into ethunyelwe ngaphandle ngokwenyani ngobungakanani eza kusetyenziswa ngabo. Ingaba umntu angayifunda kwifowuni okanye kwiphepha elishicilelweyo? Ingaba iileyibhile ziqhekekile? Ingaba intsingiselo ichaza izinto ezikhoyo ngokwenene? Ingaba umzobo wokuhombisa ufihla indlela okanye ubonisa iimpawu ezingazange zirekhodwe? Lungisa isiphumo uphinde ukhangele.

english:
A phase is a manageable part of the work. Its place in the sequence depends on what must be ready first. Start with the design decision, then list its prerequisites: permission, measurements, advice, suitable materials, resources, access and the people who will care for it.

Distinguish investigating from implementing. Obtaining a quotation does not commit you to buying. Marking a proposed area for discussion does not authorise digging. A design may have useful information-gathering steps even while construction is on hold.

Choose a first phase that answers the household brief and fits the resources actually agreed. Keep access and existing useful systems working during the change. Describe what would make the phase ready to begin, what would stop it and how you will check its result. Do not begin every component simply because all of them appear in the final vision.
isixhosa_draft:
Inqanaba yinxalenye enokulawulwa yomsebenzi. Indawo yalo ekulandeleni ixhomekeke koko kufuneka kube kulungile kuqala. Qala ngesigqibo soyilo, uze ubhale izinto ezifunekayo kuqala: imvume, imilinganiselo, ingcebiso, izixhobo ezifanelekileyo, izixhobo, ufikelelo nabantu abaza kuyinyamekela.

Wahlula ukuphanda ekuphunyezweni. Ukufumana ixabiso elicetyiswayo akukubophi ekuthengeni. Ukuphawula indawo ecetywayo yengxoxo akunikezi mvume yokumba. Uyilo lunokuba namanyathelo aluncedo okuqokelela ulwazi nokuba ukwakha kumiswe.

Khetha inqanaba lokuqala eliphendula isishwankathelo sekhaya lize lingene kwizixhobo ezivunyelweneyo ngokwenene. Gcina ufikelelo neenkqubo ezisebenzayo ezikhoyo zisebenza ngexesha lotshintsho. Chaza oko kuya kwenza inqanaba likulungele ukuqala, oko kuya kulimisa nendlela oya kujonga ngayo isiphumo salo. Musa ukuqalisa zonke izinto nje kuba zonke zivela kumbono wokugqibela.

english:
Revision is part of design. Keep the previous version, identify the new evidence and explain which decision changes. Check the connected records as well as the drawing. Moving a feature may change access, quantities, costs, water needs or care. A revised map with an old budget can tell a misleading story.

Agree the revised scope with the people affected. Separate work that can proceed from work still needing evidence or advice. Give the person taking over the current plan, source notes, implementation sequence, care responsibilities and unresolved actions. Make the information available in a format they can use without your presence.

Use feedback to plan another attempt where a skill is not yet demonstrated. Finishing the course pages, attending sessions or exporting a map are different from demonstrating the whole design process. Record the actual evidence behind the assessment, and do not turn a course completion label into unsupported specialist authority.
isixhosa_draft:
Ukuhlaziya yinxalenye yoyilo. Gcina inguqulo yangaphambili, chonga ubungqina obutsha uze uchaze ukuba sesiphi isigqibo sitshintshayo. Khangela iirekhodi ezidibeneyo kwanomzobo. Ukuhambisa impawu kunokutshintsha ufikelelo, ubungakanani, iindleko, iimfuno zamanzi okanye unonophelo. Imephu ehlaziyiweyo enebhajethi endala inokubalisa ibali eliphosisayo.

Vumelana ngobubanzi obuhlaziyiweyo nabantu abachaphazelekayo. Wahlula umsebenzi onokuqhubeka kumsebenzi osafuna ubungqina okanye ingcebiso. Nika umntu othatha isicwangciso sangoku, amanqaku omthombo, ulandelelo lokuphunyezwa, uxanduva lonophelo nezenzo ezingaxazululwanga. Yenza ulwazi lufumaneke ngefomati anokuyisebenzisa ngaphandle kobukho bakho.

Sebenzisa impendulo ukucwangcisa ukuzama okunye apho isakhono singekabonisiwe. Ukugqiba amaphepha ekhosi, ukuya kwiiseshoni okanye ukuthumela imephu ngaphandle kwahlukile ekubonisweni kwenkqubo yonke yoyilo. Rekhoda ubungqina bokwenyani ngasemva kovavanyo, ungawuguquli ileyibhile yokugqitywa kwekhosi ibe lugunyazo lobugcisa obungaxhaswanga.

english:
**BRIEF-A — household discussion.** The household wants vegetables for meals, a route that stays usable between the home and gate, and care work that can fit existing commitments. It does not want animals added in this first phase. The person who usually carries water asks to be included in siting decisions. Another household member needs a route without obstructions. The household agrees to explore options in its existing yard, but that agreement is not a verified boundary survey or permission for work beyond the yard.

**WALK-A — initial visit.** A used route crosses the yard between the home and gate. The existing growing patch lies beside that route. A water point is beside the home. Containers are carried from it to the patch. The eastern part of the yard is shaded during this visit. These observations say nothing yet about the full seasonal shade pattern, water pressure, available volume, water quality or production potential.

**TALK-A — reported history.** A resident says water has crossed the eastern part during heavy rain. No rain is falling on the first visit. Record the resident's experience as reported information, with consent; do not replace it with an invented slope arrow or present it as a measured flood level.

**MAP-A — first sketch.** It locates the home, gate, used route, water point, existing patch and the area mentioned in TALK-A relative to each other. It is labelled “not to scale; boundary, north and dimensions need checking”. No compass direction is derived from an unverified photograph. The supplied statement that part of the yard is eastern is a case description, not a direction the learner has measured.

**RESOURCES-A — current limits.** Available care time, reliable water supply, soil conditions, material quantities and costs are not yet recorded. No other person's labour or money is promised. No neighbour's land, water route or access is available merely because it appears on a picture.
isixhosa_draft:
**BRIEF-A — ingxoxo yekhaya.** Ikhaya lifuna imifuno yokutya, indlela eyayihlala isetyenziswa phakathi kwekhaya nesango, nomsebenzi wonophelo olunokungena kwizibophelelo ezikhoyo. Alifuni zilwanyana zongezwe kweli nqanaba lokuqala. Umntu othwala amanzi rhoqo ucela ukubandakanywa kwizigqibo zokubeka. Elinye ilungu lekhaya lidinga indlela engenazithintelo. Ikhaya livuma ukuphonononga iinketho kwigceke lalo eselikhona, kodwa olo vumelwano aluluphando oluqinisekisiweyo lomda okanye imvume yomsebenzi ongaphaya kwegceke.

**WALK-A — utyelelo lokuqala.** Indlela esetyenzisiweyo inqumla igceke phakathi kwekhaya nesango. Indawo yokutyala esele ikho ilele ecaleni kwaloo ndlela. Indawo yamanzi ikufutshane nekhaya. Iingqayi ziyathwalwa zisuka kuyo ziye kwindawo yokutyala. Inxalenye esempuma yegceke inomthunzi ngexesha lolu tyelelo. Oku kujonga akuthethi nto okwangoku ngepateni epheleleyo yomthunzi wexesha lonyaka, uxinzelelo lwamanzi, ivolumu ekhoyo, umgangatho wamanzi okanye amandla emveliso.

**TALK-A — imbali ebikiweyo.** Umhlali uthi amanzi anqumle inxalenye esempuma ngexesha lemvula enkulu. Akukho mvula ena kutyelelo lokuqala. Rekhoda amava omhlali njengolwazi olubikiweyo, ngemvume; musa ukuwatshintsha ngotolo lweethambeka eliyilisiweyo okanye uwabonise njengomgangatho wokukhukula olinganisiweyo.

**MAP-A — umzobo wokuqala.** Ubeka ikhaya, isango, indlela esetyenzisiweyo, indawo yamanzi, indawo yokutyala esele ikho nendawo ekhankanywe kwi-TALK-A ngokunxulumene enye nenye. Iphawulwe “ayikho kwisikali; umda, umntla nemilinganiselo zifuna ukukhangelwa”. Akukho ulwalathiso lwekhampasi olufunyenwe kwifoto engaqinisekiswanga. Ingxelo enikeziweyo yokuba inxalenye yegceke isempuma yindlela yokuchaza ityala, hayi ulwalathiso umfundi alulinganisileyo.

**RESOURCES-A — imida yangoku.** Ixesha lonophelo elikhoyo, ukubakho kwamanzi okuthembekileyo, iimeko zomhlaba, ubungakanani bezixhobo neendleko azikarekhodwa. Akukho msebenzi wanye umntu okanye imali ethenjisiweyo. Akukho mhlaba womelwane, indlela yamanzi okanye ufikelelo olukhoyo nje kuba luvela kumfanekiso.

english:
### D1 — what is the task?

The brief prioritises food, usable access and manageable care. Adding a pond or animals is not a stated need. The facilitator asks the people doing the work what they can maintain and what must remain clear. The learner records missing resource information instead of assigning an imaginary budget.

On the first map the growing patch is an existing feature. An idea for a new patch belongs on a proposal overlay. The learner does not erase the used route because it interrupts the picture. The family report about rain is kept beside its source; it is not changed into an observed event.

### D2 — what do the facts mean?

The daily watering journey makes convenient access worth investigating. It does not prove that the closest possible location is suitable. The shade snapshot needs further seasonal evidence, and the reported water route needs examination before considering an intervention.

The learner writes: “Can we improve care of the existing patch while keeping the route usable?” This is a design question. “Build a swale through the eastern yard” would jump past the missing terrain, water, suitability and permission evidence.

For the next safe visit, the learner asks the household to show how people move through the space. They arrange further shade observations and ask who can help assess the reported water problem. They do not enter dangerous runoff to obtain a photograph. They keep all three options open: improve the existing patch, consider another suitable location, or defer expansion until resources are known.
isixhosa_draft:
### D1 — ngowuphi umsebenzi?

Isishwankathelo sibeka phambili ukutya, ufikelelo olusebenzayo nonophelo oluphathekayo. Ukongeza ichibi okanye izilwanyana asisiyo mfuno ebikiweyo. Umququzeleli ubuza abantu abenza umsebenzi ukuba banokugcina ntoni nokuba yintoni ekufuneka ihlale icacile. Umfundi urekhoda ulwazi lwezixhobo olulahlekileyo endaweni yokunika ibhajethi eyilisiweyo.

Kwimephu yokuqala indawo yokutyala yimpawu esele ikho. Ingcamango yendawo entsha yokutyala ikwishiti yesiphakamiso. Umfundi akayicimi indlela esetyenzisiweyo ngenxa yokuba iphazamisa umfanekiso. Ingxelo yosapho ngemvula igcinwa ecaleni komthombo wayo; ayiguqulwa ibe siganeko esijongiweyo.

### D2 — zithetha ntoni iinyani?

Uhambo lwemihla ngemihla lokunisela lwenza ufikelelo olunethezekileyo lufanele ukuphandwa. Aluboniswa ukuba indawo ekufutshane kakhulu ifaneleke. Umfanekiso womthunzi udinga ubungqina bexesha lonyaka obungakumbi, kwaye indlela yamanzi ebikiweyo ifuna ukuhlolwa phambi kokuqwalasela ungenelelo.

Umfundi uyabhala: “Ingaba sinokuphucula unonophelo lwendawo esele ikho ngoxa sigcina indlela isebenza?” Ngumbuzo woyilo. “Yakha umsele kwigceke elisempuma” lingatsiba ubungqina bomhlaba, amanzi, ukufaneleka nemvume elahlekileyo.

Kutyelelo oluzayo olukhuselekileyo, umfundi ucela ikhaya libonise indlela abantu abahamba ngayo kwindawo. Bacwangcisa ukujonga umthunzi okungakumbi baze babuze ukuba ngubani onokunceda ukuvavanya ingxaki yamanzi ebikiweyo. Abangeni kwindawo enamanzi eyingozi ukuze bafumane ifoto. Bagcina zontathu iinketho zivulekile: ukuphucula indawo esele ikho, ukuqwalasela enye indawo efanelekileyo, okanye ukubambezela ukwandisa de izixhobo zaziwe.

english: Read [Record and check a harvest](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/harvest). The current form records kilograms and the date of entry, not a backdated picking date. The chart's “kept” is picked minus logged sold quantities; it cannot identify home use, gifts, storage or loss separately. In this workbook, 24 kg picked minus 15 kg delivered is 9 kg; that happens to equal closing stock because the 4 kg opening stock and 4 kg other outflows offset. It is a coincidence, not a general stock formula or an expected app chart result. The current invoice link adds kilogram sale evidence when an invoice is paid in full, so unpaid and partly paid deliveries do not map directly to this workbook. Use its destination records to explain the movement; do not mark an invoice paid just to force the chart to match.
isixhosa_draft: Funda [Rekhoda uze ukhangele isivuno](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/harvest). Ifom yangoku irekhoda iikhilogram nomhla wokufaka irekhodi, hayi umhla wokuvuna obuyiselwe umva. “Okusele” kwitshathi kuvunwe kuthatyathwe ubungakanani obuthengisiweyo obubhaliweyo; ayinakuchonga ukusetyenziswa kwekhaya, izipho, ugcino okanye ilahleko ngokwahlukeneyo. Kolu ncwadi lomsebenzi, i-24 kg evuniweyo kuthatyathwe i-15 kg ehanjisiweyo yi-9 kg; oko kuyafana nesitokhwe sokuvala ngethamsanqa kuba i-4 kg yesitokhwe sokuqala ne-4 kg yezinye iindlela zokuphuma zirhoxisana. Ngumvumelwano wethamsanqa, hayi ifomula yesitokhwe jikelele okanye isiphumo setshathi ye-app elindelekileyo. Ikhonkco le-invoyisi langoku lilongeza ubungqina bentengiso yekhilogram xa i-invoyisi ihlawulwa yonke, ngoko ukuhanjiswa okungahlawulwanga nokuhlawulwe ngenxalenye akuhambelani ngokuthe ngqo noku. Sebenzisa iirekhodi zayo zendawo eya kuyo ukuchaza intshukumo; musa ukuphawula i-invoyisi ihlawuliwe nje ukunyanzela itshathi ukuba ihambelane.

english:
The carrot exercise has R220.00 of assigned paid costs and 40 kg of marketable produce. That is R5.50 per marketable kg for those included costs. With the separate R100.00 family-time comparison, the total becomes R320.00, or R8.00 per marketable kg. These are two labelled views of one budget, not two bills to add.

If only 32 kg is expected to sell, recovering that same R320.00 entirely through those sales requires R10.00 per kg sold. This is a **sales-recovery planning target**, not the accounting cost of each item sold or a promise that a buyer will pay it. The other 8 kg is not automatically lost or household food; investigate its destination and value. Do not write off closing stock simply because it has not sold. Missing land, equipment, administration, finance and tax information means full profit is still unknown.

Umsebenzi weminqathe unee-R220.00 zeendleko ezihlawulwe ezabelweyo kunye ne-40 kg yemveliso ethengisekayo. Leyo yi-R5.50 nge-kg ethengisekayo nganye kuzo ezo ndleko zibandakanyiweyo. Xa ungeza uthelekiso lwexesha losapho olwahlukileyo lwe-R100.00, isixa esipheleleyo siba yi-R320.00, okanye i-R8.00 nge-kg ethengisekayo nganye. Ezi yimibono emibini ephawulwe ngamagama yebhajethi enye, hayi iibhili ezimbini ekufuneka zidityaniswe.

Ukuba i-32 kg kuphela elindeleke ukuba ithengiswe, ukubuyisela loo R320.00 ifanayo ngokupheleleyo ngezo ntengiso kufuna i-R10.00 nge-kg ethengisiweyo. Le yi-**njongo yocwangciso yokubuyisa iintengiso**, hayi indleko yeeakhawunti yento nganye ethengisiweyo okanye isithembiso sokuba umthengi uya kuhlawula oko. Ezinye ii-8 kg azilahleki ngokuzenzekelayo okanye azingokutya kwasekhaya; phanda indawo eziya kuyo nexabiso lazo. Musa ukucima isitokhwe sokuvala nje kuba singathengiswanga. Ulwazi olulahlekileyo ngomhlaba, izixhobo, ulawulo, imali nerhafu lithetha ukuba inzuzo epheleleyo isengaziwa.

english:
B01 supplies included fixed costs of R105.00 per practice cycle and variable costs of R7.50 per pack. Each pack is 1 kg and sells for R12.00. For this model only, every pack prepared is sold, price and variable cost stay constant, and fixed costs stay unchanged up to the stated capacity of 30 packs. It is not a forecast derived from the carrot harvest.

Contribution per pack is R12.00 minus R7.50 = R4.50. R105.00 divided by R4.50 is 23 and one-third packs. Whole packs require rounding **up** to 24. Verify on either side: at 23 packs the model is R1.50 short; at 24 it has R3.00 left after its included costs. Call that the model surplus, not full farm profit. This model does not account for prepared-but-unsold packs, waste, changing rates, bad debts or omitted costs. A real plan with those features needs them added explicitly.
isixhosa_draft:
I-B01 inika iindleko ezibandakanyiweyo ezingatshintshiyo ze-R105.00 kumjikelo wokuziqhelisa neendleko eziguqukayo ze-R7.50 kwipakethe nganye. Ipakethe nganye yi-1 kg kwaye ithengiswa nge-R12.00. Kulo mzekelo kuphela, yonke ipakethe elungisiweyo iyathengiswa, ixabiso neendleko eziguqukayo zihlala zingatshintshi, kwaye iindleko ezingatshintshiyo zihlala zingatshintshanga ukuya kumthamo ochaziweyo wamapakethe angama-30. Asingoqikelelo olufunyenwe kwisivuno seminqathe.

Igalelo kwipakethe nganye yi-R12.00 kuthatyathwe i-R7.50 = i-R4.50. I-R105.00 yahlulwe nge-R4.50 yamapakethe angama-23 nesithathu. Amapakethe aphelele afuna ukujikeleza **ukuya phezulu** ukuya kuma-24. Qinisekisa macala omabini: kumapakethe angama-23 imodeli ilahlekelwa yi-R1.50; kuma-24 ine-R3.00 eseleyo emva kweendleko zayo ezibandakanyiweyo. Yibize isixa esisele kwimodeli, hayi inzuzo epheleleyo yefama. Le modeli ayibandakanyi amapakethe alungisiweyo angathengiswanga, inkunkuma, amaxabiso atshintshayo, amatyala amabi okanye iindleko ezishiyiweyo. Isicwangciso sokwenyani esinezo zinto sifuna ukuzongeza ngokucacileyo.

english: For an answer of 23 packs, ask the learner to multiply 23 by R4.50 and compare with R105.00. For “25% margin”, ask “25% of which amount?” For a missing variable cost treated as zero, restore the blank source card and ask what evidence is missing. For “profit”, have the learner name an excluded cost and relabel the result.
isixhosa_draft: Kwimpendulo yamapakethe angama-23, cela umfundi aphindaphinde u-23 nge-R4.50 athelekise ne-R105.00. Kwi-“nzuzo”, cela umfundi abize indleko ekhutshiweyo aphinde alibize ngokutsha isiphumo.

english:
Bring a calculator, paper, date cards and counters. Read one card aloud at a time. Learners may point, move cards, explain aloud or ask a partner to write. Use the timeline for demonstration, then hide its answers for independent practice. Do not require anyone to share private household accounts, customer names or bank details.

All dates, amounts, working hours and offers are **invented classroom inputs**. January-March 2027 is a practice horizon, not a recommended South African growing season. Activities A and B have no specified crop, area or yield. Do not infer one. This is a new exercise, not a continuation of F1-F3 balances. The opening cash tin has R120.00 and the bank R180.00, both assumed available, with no restrictions or fees in the supplied model. The separate opening amounts owed are R120.00 by a customer and R80.00 to a supplier. Neither is opening cash.

A negative projected balance means the proposed sequence cannot be paid from the specified available funds. It is a warning to revise the plan or establish an appropriate, evidenced funding arrangement. It is not cash that exists, an approved overdraft or permission to miss a bill. Later balances describe an **unfunded projection**, not evidence that the intervening transactions could happen. Exact shortfall amounts are model results, not recommended loans or contingency reserves.
isixhosa_draft:
Zisa ikhalkyuleyitha, iphepha, amakhadi emihla neekhawunta. Funda ikhadi elinye ngexesha ngokuvakalayo. Abafundi bangakhomba, bahambise amakhadi, bachaze ngokuvakalayo okanye bacele ozifundela naye ukuba abhale. Sebenzisa umgca wexesha kumboniso, emva koko ufihle iimpendulo zawo ekuziqhelisweni okuzimeleyo. Musa ukunyanzela mntu ukuba abelane ngeeakhawunti zekhaya zangasese, amagama abathengi okanye iinkcukacha zebhanki.

Yonke imihla, izixa, iiyure zokusebenza neenikelo ziingeniso **eziyilisiweyo zeklasi**. UJanuwari–Matshi 2027 lixesha lokuziqhelisa, hayi isizini yokutyala ecetyiswayo yaseMzantsi Afrika. Imisebenzi A kunye no-B ayinasityalo, ndawo okanye isivuno esichaziweyo. Musa ukucinga nesinye. Lo msebenzi omtsha, hayi ukuqhubeka kweebhalansi ze-F1-F3. Ithini yemali yokuqala inayo i-R120.00 nebhanki i-R180.00, zozibini kucingwa ukuba ziyafumaneka, ngaphandle kwemiqobo okanye iindleko kwimodeli enikeziweyo. Izixa ezahlukileyo zokuqala ezisafunekayo yi-R120.00 ekufuneka ihlawulwe ngumthengi kunye ne-R80.00 ekufuneka ihlawulwe kumthengisi. Akukho nanye yimali yokuqala.

Ibhalansi eqikelelwayo engaphantsi kwe-zero ithetha ukuba ulandelelwano olucetywayo alunakuhlawulwa ngemali ekhoyo echaziweyo. Lilumkiso lokuhlaziya isicwangciso okanye ukuseka ulungiselelo olufanelekileyo lwenkxaso-mali ngobungqina. Ayiyo mali ekhoyo, i-overdraft evunyiweyo okanye imvume yokungahlawuli ibhili. Iibhalansi zamva zichaza **uqikelelo olungaxhaswanga**, hayi ubungqina bokuba imisebenzi eyayiphakathi ibinokwenzeka. Izixa ezichanekileyo zokunqongophala ziziphumo zemodeli, hayi iimboleko ezicetyiswayo okanye ingxowa-mali yongxamiseko.

english: Lay out all source cards by date, keeping the refundable deposit distinct. Check the included operator, transport, fuel or other operating inputs, cleaning, repair, storage, return terms, insurance and downtime arrangements in an actual offer. In this synthetic comparison the stated package assumptions are complete for the shown cash movements; they do not establish complete economic costs. None of the three totals proves full profitability or a lifetime winner.
isixhosa_draft: Beka onke amakhadi omthombo ngomhla, ugcina idiphozithi ebuyiswayo yahlukile. Khangela umqhubi, ukuthuthwa, ipetroli okanye ezinye izinto zokusebenza ezibandakanyiweyo, ukucoca, ukulungisa, ukugcina, imiqathango yokubuya, i-inshorensi namalungiselelo exesha lokungasebenzi kwisicelo sokwenyani. Kuthelekiso olu lwenziwe, iingcinga zepakethe ezichaziweyo ziphelele kwiintshukumo zemali ezibonisiweyo; azisekanga iindleko ezipheleleyo zoqoqosho. Akukho nanye kwezi zixa zintathu eqinisekisa inzuzo epheleleyo okanye ophumelela ubomi bonke.

english: If loan receipts become sales revenue, link the money to its repayment obligation. If a fee is charged twice, trace whether it was withheld, paid separately or already included. If the learner chooses the unknown offer by its apparent total, restore the missing field. Collect a blank or approved redacted quote and list questions. Keep original terms and dates. Do not apply for credit, choose a lender, enter private identity details or transfer money as a lesson exercise.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba iirisithi zemboleko ziba yingeniso yeentengiso, nxulumanisa imali nesibophelelo sayo sokubuyisela. Ukuba intlawulo ibizwa kabini, landela ukuba yabanjwa, yahlawulwa ngokwahlukeneyo okanye yayisele iqukiwe. Ukuba umfundi ukhetha isicelo esingaziwayo ngesixa saso esibonakalayo, buyisela indawo elahlekileyo. Qokelela isicelo esingenanto okanye esivunyiweyo esicinyiweyo ubhale imibuzo. Gcina imiqathango yoqobo nemihla. Musa ukufaka isicelo sekhredithi, ukukhetha umbolekisi, ukufaka iinkcukacha zesazisi zangasese okanye ukuhambisa imali njengomsebenzi wesifundo.

english:
Place A01 across the January–February boundary. Work was completed in January at the agreed R80 charge. The invoice is dated February and the amount is unpaid at January end. Under this model, January includes the R80 cost and liability, while January cash does not change. Retain both documents and dates. Now place F01: cash leaves in January, but the whole storage service is for February. January includes a R120 prepayment asset, not a January storage cost. A real contract may need different treatment; this case supplies the timing and rights explicitly.

Show the stock bridge: opening R300 + purchases R400 − goods supplied R350 = R350 before the closing check. C01 supports a R50 loss and R300 remaining. This is a reviewed reconciliation, not an instruction to label every unexplained difference as theft or spoilage. Ask for evidence before choosing a cause or accounting treatment. Show the equipment bridge: opening R600 + purchase R300 − supplied period depreciation R60 = R840. The charge spreads cost in this model but is not a new payment and is not a tax allowance.
isixhosa_draft:
Beka i-A01 phakathi komda kaJanuwari–Februwari. Umsebenzi wagqitywa kuJanuwari ngentlawulo evunyelweneyo ye-R80. I-invoyisi inomhla kaFebruwari kwaye isixa asihlawulwanga ekupheleni kukaJanuwari. Phantsi kwale modeli, uJanuwari uquka indleko ye-R80 netyala, ngoxa imali engqo kaJanuwari ingatshintshi. Gcina amaxwebhu omabini nemihla. Ngoku beka i-F01: imali iphuma ngoJanuwari, kodwa yonke inkonzo yokugcina ngeyoFebruwari. UJanuwari uquka impahla yentlawulo yangaphambili ye-R120, hayi indleko yokugcina kaJanuwari. Ikontraka yokwenyani isenokufuna unyango olwahlukileyo; eli tyala linika ixesha namalungelo ngokucacileyo.

Bonisa ibhulorho yesitokhwe: ukuvula i-R300 + ukuthenga i-R400 − iimpahla ezinikezelweyo i-R350 = i-R350 phambi kokukhangela kokuvala. I-C01 ixhasa ilahleko ye-R50 ne-R300 esele. Oku kuvumelanisa okuhloliweyo, hayi umyalelo wokubiza yonke imahluko engachazwanga ngokuba kuyaba okanye konakele. Cela ubungqina phambi kokukhetha isizathu okanye unyango lweeakhawunti. Bonisa ibhulorho yezixhobo: ukuvula i-R600 + ukuthenga i-R300 − ukuncipha kwexabiso lexesha elinikeziweyo i-R60 = i-R840. Intlawulo isasaza indleko kule modeli kodwa asiyontlawulo intsha kwaye asiyo mvume yerhafu.

english:
Use an invented pack, not a learner's private identifiers. Put an opening balance list, source documents, account statements, stock check, equipment and debt schedules, and unresolved items behind a one-page index. Give each a reference and period. Reconcile the index against the summaries. Mark missing items visibly. Keep actuals separate from forecasts. Do not ask learners to send private financial documents to a public class or to an unverified adviser.

Open the current official SARS pages in the source notes. Show how to record the page title, URL, date checked and the exact question. For example: which business form and registrations apply; what records are required; which retention conditions apply; whether an invoice has the required particulars for the relevant supply; and whether electronic storage arrangements meet the applicable requirements. This is an evidence-finding exercise, not a conclusion that a particular learner must register or can discard records. Retain source documents while questions remain unresolved. Do not teach a universal destruction date from a short web table.

Sebenzisa ipakethe eyilisiweyo, hayi izazisi zangasese zomfundi. Beka uluhlu lweebhalansi zokuvula, amaxwebhu omthombo, izitetimenti ze-akhawunti, ukukhangela isitokhwe, uluhlu lwezixhobo nolwetyala, nezinto ezingaxazululwanga emva kwenkcazo yephepha elinye. Nika nganye isalathiso nexesha. Vumelanisa inkcazo neziqwenga zesishwankathelo. Phawula izinto ezilahlekileyo ngokubonakalayo. Gcina iinyani zokwenyani zahlukile koqikelelo. Musa ukucela abafundi ukuba bathumele amaxwebhu emali angasese kwiklasi yesidlangalala okanye kumcebisi ongaqinisekiswanga.

Vula amaphepha asemthethweni angoku e-SARS kumanqaku omthombo. Bonisa indlela yokurekhoda isihloko sephepha, i-URL, umhla ohloliweyo nombuzo ochanekileyo. Umzekelo: yiyiphi ifom yebhizinisi nokubhaliswa okusebenzayo; zeziphi iirekhodi ezifunekayo; yiyiphi imiqathango yokugcina esebenzayo; ingaba i-invoyisi inazo iinkcukacha ezifunekayo kule nkonzo ifanelekileyo; nokuba amalungiselelo okugcina ngombane ahlangabezana neemfuno ezisebenzayo. Lo msebenzi wokufumana ubungqina, hayi isigqibo sokuba umfundi othile kufuneka abhalise okanye angalahla iirekhodi. Gcina amaxwebhu omthombo ngoxa imibuzo ingaxazululwanga. Musa ukufundisa umhla jikelele wokutshabalalisa kwitafile emfutshane yewebhu.

english:

No VAT or income-tax calculation is included. Equipment classification, depreciation and stock-loss treatment are supplied assumptions, not policies to copy into real accounts.

english: Grain maize for mielie meal. Direct-sow in a mapped staple plot once frost risk has passed; use several adjacent rows for wind pollination. The 140-day calendar hold is conservative — confirm cultivar maturity before harvest.
isixhosa_draft: I-maize yeenkozo yokwenza impuphu yombona. Yihlwayele ngqo kwisiza sesityalo esiyisiseko esikwimephu xa umngcipheko weqabaka uphelile; sebenzisa imiqolo emininzi elandelelanayo ukuze umungu wentyatyambo uthwalwe ngumoya. Ixesha lekhalenda leentsuku ezili-140 libekwe ngokulumkileyo — qinisekisa ukuvuthwa kohlobo lwesityalo phambi kokuvuna.

english: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
isixhosa_draft: Tyala emva kokuba ingozi yeqabaka idlulile: kuNovemba ukuya phakathi kukaJanyuwari kwiindawo ezineqabaka, okanye kuMatshi-Epreli kwiindawo ezingenaqabaka. Shiya iipodi zimthuphe zize zome phambi kokuzixobula nokuzigcina.

english: Fully dried grain (12-15% moisture), clean sealed containers, cool and dry, with bruchid/weevil control (e.g. edible-oil admix at 5ml/kg, or storage in-pod).
isixhosa_draft: Iinkozo ezomileyo kakuhle (12-15% yomswakama), izikhongozeli ezihlambulukileyo ezivaliweyo, kwindawo epholileyo nenomileyo, kunye nolawulo lwe-bruchid/weevil (umzekelo ukuxuba ioli yokupheka ngo-5ml/kg, okanye ukugcina kweepodi).

english: Cut-and-come-again leafy brassica: pick outer leaves and the plant keeps producing, and light frost sweetens the flavour. It does not handle extreme heat — in hot areas prefer late-summer and autumn sowings. No South African kale yield has ever been published, so the kilogram estimate here comes from Kenyan and United States extension figures trimmed for a hand-watered bed — treat it as a planning slot, not a promise.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo se-brassica esinamagqabi esivunwa rhoqo: khetha amagqabi angaphandle kwaye isityalo siqhubeka sivelisa, kwaye iqabaka elincinci lenza incasa ibe mnandi. Asinyamezeli ubushushu obugqithisileyo — kwiindawo ezishushu khetha ukuhlwayela ekupheleni kwehlobo nasekwindla. Akukho sivuno se-kale soMzantsi Afrika esakha sashicilelwa, ngoko uqikelelo lweekhilogram apha luvela kwiinkcukacha zoncedo lwezolimo zaseKenya nezaseUnited States ezinqunyulwe ibhedi enkcenkceshelwa ngesandla — luthathe njengendawo yokucwangcisa, hayi isithembiso.

english: Firm the soil well at transplanting to help heads form tightly.
isixhosa_draft: Cinezela umhlaba kakuhle xa utshintshela izithole ukuze uncede iintloko zenze ngokuqinileyo.

english: Direct-sow only — carrots don't transplant well. Keep the bed loose and stone-free.
isixhosa_draft: Hlwayela ngqo kuphela — i-carrots azitshintsheleki kakuhle. Gcina ibhedi ithambile ingenamatye.

english: Field-dried (cured, necks fully dry) bulbs held at ambient temperature in well-ventilated trays/racks.
isixhosa_draft: Iibhalbhu ezomisiweyo entsimini (ziphilisiwe, izintamo zomile ngokupheleleyo) zigcinwe kubushushu bendawo kwiitreyi/kwiirakhi ezifumana umoya kakuhle.

english: Grown from rooted slips, not seed — plant into ridged soil for easy digging later.
isixhosa_draft: Ikhuliswa ngeziqu ezinengcambu (slips), hayi ngembewu — tyala emhlabeni owenziwe imiqolo ephakanyisiweyo ukuze kube lula ukumba kamva.

english: Only mature, undamaged roots; cured 30-32°C/85-90% RH for 4-7 days, then stored with minimal handling as cool as achievable (source optimum 13°C) at ~85-90% RH. The sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) is the main storage threat.
isixhosa_draft: Ngeengcambu ezivuthiweyo nezingonakalanga kuphela; ziphilisiwe (cured) kwi-30-32°C/85-90% RH iintsuku ezi-4-7, emva koko zigcinwe zibanjwa kancinci kangangoko, zipholile kangangoko kunokwenzeka (eyona nto ilungileyo yomthombo yi-13°C) kwi~85-90% RH. I-sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) yeyona ngozi iphambili ekugcinweni.

english: Propagate from whole tubers or corm cuttings. Needs consistently moist soil and warm, frost-free conditions.
isixhosa_draft: Zandisa ngeethyubhu ezipheleleyo okanye ngeziqwenga zekhomu. Idinga umhlaba omanzi rhoqo kunye neemeko ezifudumeleyo ezingenaqabaka.

english: Cool, dry, well-ventilated storage at ambient 25-30°C — traditionally heaped corms under shade or covered with straw/plantain leaves.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yokugcina epholileyo, eyomileyo, efumana umoya kakuhle kubushushu bendawo obuyi-25-30°C — ngokwesiko iikomu zihlanganiswa ngaphantsi komthunzi okanye zigutyungelwe ngotshani/ngamagqabi e-plantain.

english: This stand is the audited irrigated geometry. Groundnuts need sandy, well-drained soil and a long frost-free growing season.
isixhosa_draft: Olu lungiselelo lwezityalo yigeometri ehloliwe kwiimeko zokunkcenkceshelwa. I-groundnuts zifuna umhlaba oneentlabathi nodlulisa amanzi kakuhle kunye nexesha elide lokukhula elingenaqabaka.

english: Well-cured bulbs (dried several weeks, dark/dry/ventilated), then kept unrefrigerated in a cool, dry, dark, well-ventilated place (e.g. mesh bags).
isixhosa_draft: Iibhalbhu eziphilisiwe kakuhle (zomiswe iiveki ezininzi, ebumnyameni/zomile/zifumana umoya), emva koko zigcinwe zingekho efrijini kwindawo epholileyo, eyomileyo, emnyama, efumana umoya kakuhle (umzekelo iingxowa ze-mesh).

english: The classic 'grows through winter' legume — sow in autumn, it stands through frost and pods in spring.
isixhosa_draft: I-legume eyaziwayo "ekhula ebusika" — hlwayela ekwindla, imi ngeqabaka yaye yenza iipodi entwasahlobo.

english: Cool-weather Brassica root — direct-sow only and thin early so the roots can swell. Same botanical family as cabbage, kale and broccoli, so don't plan turnips straight after (or before) another brassica in the same bed. Young leaves are a traditional edible green — pick sparingly; the yield figure covers roots only.
isixhosa_draft: Ingcambu ye-Brassica yexesha elipholileyo — hlwayela ngqo kuphela uze uhlutha kwangoko ukuze iingcambu zivuvuke. Ngusapho olunye lwezityalo ne-cabbage, i-kale ne-broccoli, ngoko musa ukucwangcisa i-turnips ngqo emva (okanye ngaphambi) kwenye i-brassica kwibhedi enye. Amagqabi amancinci ngumfuno oqhelekileyo wemveli — khetha kancinci; inani lesivuno liquka iingcambu kuphela.

english: DAFF: leaves picked about every two weeks once harvesting starts, continuing until frost ends the crop.
isixhosa_draft: I-DAFF: amagqabi akhethwa malunga nayo yonke iveki ezimbini xa ukuvuna sele kuqalile, kuqhubeke kude kube iqabaka liphelise isityalo.

english: A cole crop like cabbage and broccoli — same rotation family, so avoid following one straight after another in the same bed. DAFF states cauliflower survives to about 0°C once established, so it is not flagged frost-tender here, but young transplants still want protection from a hard frost snap.
isixhosa_draft: I-cole crop efana ne-cabbage ne-broccoli — ngusapho olunye lokujikeleza, ngoko ungalandelisi enye ngqo emva kwenye kwibhedi enye. I-DAFF ithi i-cauliflower iyaphila ukuya kuma-0°C xa sele izinzile, ngoko ayiphawulwanga njengethambileyo kwiqabaka apha, kodwa izithole ezitshintshelweyo ezincinci zisafuna ukukhuselwa kwiqabaka elinzima.

english: A drought-tolerant grain crop, more heat- and dry-tolerant than maize. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting May harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here. No named SA cultivars were found.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo seenkozo esinyamezela imbalela, esinyamezela ubushushu nokoma ngaphezu kwe-maize. Ukuhlwayela kukaDisemba kushiyiwe kwi-planner yale katalogu kuba isivuno esiza kuvela kuMeyi siya kudibana neqabaka — kusenokwenzeka ukuba kusebenze ngokukhuselwa kweqabaka kwasekuhlaleni, kodwa akucwangciswa ngokuzenzekelayo apha. Akukho ndidi ziqanjwe ngamagama zaseMzantsi Afrika zifunyenweyo.

english: A nitrogen-fixing legume grain crop grown for dry beans, not green pods. DAFF never states a frost sensitivity for soybean, so it is not flagged frost-tender here — but it is a warm-season crop and these sow months are already timed for that.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo seenkozo esi-legume esibambe i-nitrogen, esityalelwa iimbotyi ezomileyo, hayi iipodi eziluhlaza. I-DAFF ayikhange ichaze ukuba i-soybean ithambile kwiqabaka, ngoko ayiphawulwanga njengethambileyo kwiqabaka apha — kodwa sisityalo sexesha elifudumeleyo kwaye ezi nyanga zokuhlwayela sele zihlelwe ngoko.

english: Solanaceae family, same as tomatoes, peppers, chilli and potato — keep this rotation family together when planning beds. Frost-tender: raise as transplants and set out only once frost risk has passed.
isixhosa_draft: Usapho lwe-Solanaceae, olufanayo ne-tomatoes, i-peppers, i-chilli ne-potato — gcina olu sapho lokujikeleza lukunye xa ucwangcisa iibhedi. Ithambile kwiqabaka: yikhulise njengezithole ezitshintshelwayo uze uzitshintshele kuphela xa umngcipheko weqabaka uphelile.

english: Cucurbitaceae family, same as pumpkin, butternut, cucumber and watermelon — avoid repeating this family in the same bed. Frost-tender vine crop; no Western Cape sowing calendar was found even though it is a known WC crop, so treat that as a local-confirmation item.
isixhosa_draft: Usapho lwe-Cucurbitaceae, olufanayo ne-pumpkin, i-butternut, i-cucumber ne-watermelon — ungaphindi olu sapho kwibhedi enye. Isityalo esikhwelayo esithambileyo kwiqabaka; akukho khalenda yokuhlwayela ye-Western Cape efunyenweyo nangona sisityalo esaziwayo se-Western Cape, ngoko oko kuthathwe njengento eyimfuneko yokuqinisekiswa ekuhlaleni.

english: A fast-cropping Cucurbitaceae vine picked young and often — same rotation family as pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber and watermelon. Frost-tender; no Western Cape calendar sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo esikhwelayo se-Cucurbitaceae esivelisa ngokukhawuleza, esivunwa sisencinci rhoqo — usapho olunye lokujikeleza ne-pumpkin, i-gem-squash, i-cucumber ne-watermelon. Sithambile kwiqabaka; akukho khalenda ye-Western Cape efunyenweyo.

english: Cucurbitaceae melon vine. A January sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo se-melon esikhwelayo se-Cucurbitaceae. Ukuhlwayela kukaJanyuwari kushiyiwe kwi-planner yale katalogu kuba isivuno siza kudibana neqabaka — kusenokwenzeka ukuba kusebenze ngokukhuselwa kweqabaka kwasekuhlaleni, kodwa akucwangciswa ngokuzenzekelayo apha.

english: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
isixhosa_draft: Ikhuliswa kwaye idliwa njengemifuno emitsha, ngokungafaniyo ne-maize yentsimi — iqela lokutya elibhalwe kwifayile yesityalo ngokwalo yimifuno eqhamayo, hayi iinkozo eziyisiseko, ngoko igcinwe apho endaweni yokudityaniswa ne-maize nangona ilolu hlobo lufanayo. Ithambile kwiqabaka njenge-maize.

english: An indigenous nitrogen-fixing legume grown for its underground dry seed pods (a groundnut relative, not a true bean). The yield figure is dry seed, the low end of genotype averages across seven South African trial sites. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost.
isixhosa_draft: I-legume yemveli ebambe i-nitrogen etyalelwa iipodi zayo zembewu eyomileyo ezingaphantsi komhlaba (isihlobo se-groundnut, hayi imbotyi yokwenyani). Inani lesivuno yimbewu eyomileyo, esona siphelo sisezantsi samanani aphakathi e-genotype kwiindawo zovavanyo ezisixhenxe zaseMzantsi Afrika. Ukuhlwayela kukaDisemba kushiyiwe kwi-planner yale katalogu kuba isivuno siza kudibana neqabaka.

english: An oilseed grain crop grown for dry seed. Frost sensitivity is taken from ECOCROP (DAFF's own guide does not mention frost), and only a November sowing is auto-scheduled here — December and January sowings are left off this catalog's planner because their harvest would run into frost. No named SA cultivars were found.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo seenkozo zeoli esityalelwa imbewu eyomileyo. Ukuthamba kweqabaka kuthathwe kwi-ECOCROP (isikhokelo se-DAFF ngokwaso asikhankanyi iqabaka), kwaye ukuhlwayela kukaNovemba kuphela kucwangciswa ngokuzenzekelayo apha — ukuhlwayela kukaDisemba nokukaJanyuwari kushiyiwe kwi-planner yale katalogu kuba isivuno sabo siza kudibana neqabaka. Akukho ndidi ziqanjwe ngamagama zaseMzantsi Afrika zifunyenweyo.

english: An indigenous leafy green (Cleome gynandra), its own botanical family (not a Brassica despite the resemblance). DAFF states no South African cultivars have been developed yet and no yield figures are known, so it stays manual. Days-to-harvest is counted from seedling emergence in the source, not from sowing — treat the range as approximate.
isixhosa_draft: Imifuno enamagqabi yemveli (Cleome gynandra), usapho lwayo lwezityalo lodwa (hayi i-Brassica nangona kunjalo ukufana). I-DAFF ithi akukho ndidi zaseMzantsi Afrika ziphuhliswe okwangoku kwaye akukho manani esivuno aziwayo, ngoko sihlala sisebenza ngesandla. Iintsuku ukuya ekuvuneni zibalwa ukusuka ekuvumbukeni kwesithole emthonjeni, hayi ukusuka ekuhlwayeleni — thatha uluhlu njengolulinganiselweyo.

english: An indigenous leafy green (Solanum retroflexum, umsobo/nightshade) grown for its leaves, picked young — the ripe berries of some related Solanum species are toxic, so only follow a trusted local source for which parts are eaten. DAFF: sensitive to frost. No South African cultivars or yield figures were found, so it stays manual.
isixhosa_draft: Imifuno enamagqabi yemveli (Solanum retroflexum, umsobo/nightshade) etyalelwa amagqabi ayo, ekhethwa isencinci — amaqunube avuthiweyo ezinye iintlobo ezihlobene ze-Solanum anetyhefu, ngoko landela kuphela umthombo osekuhlaleni othembekileyo ngokuphathelele izahlulo ezidliwayo. I-DAFF: ithambile kwiqabaka. Akukho ndidi zaseMzantsi Afrika okanye amanani esivuno afunyenweyo, ngoko sihlala sisebenza ngesandla.

english: A fast-growing biomass/soil-conditioning and grazing cover crop grown to full flowering, not for a food harvest — not counted in kitchen harvest totals. Same botanical family as radish and cabbage, so plan rotation accordingly. Not frost-tender itself, but is killed by the first hard frost or by herbicide, which is the usual way it is terminated.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo sokugquma esikhula ngokukhawuleza sobunzima bezityalo (biomass)/sokulungisa umhlaba nokudlisa, esikhuliswa kude kube kuqhakaze ngokupheleleyo, hayi ukuvuna ukutya — asibalwa kwizixa zesivuno sekitshini. Ngusapho olunye lwezityalo ne-radish ne-cabbage, ngoko cwangcisa ukujikeleza ngokufanelekileyo. Asithambile kwiqabaka ngokwaso, kodwa siyabulawa liqabaka lokuqala elinzima okanye yi-herbicide, eyona ndlela eqhelekileyo yokusiphelisa.

english: Reconcile means compare and explain. Count the cash. Read the wallet statement. Match deliveries, sales, payments and receipts by their references. Check the dates and units as well as the totals. When you find a mistake, keep the original reference and write what changed and why. If you cannot explain a difference yet, say so. Do not add a guessed entry just to make the totals agree.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuvumelanisa kuthetha ukuthelekisa nokuchaza. Bala imali engqo. Funda ingxelo yesikhwama. Qhelanisa ukuhanjiswa, iintengiso, iintlawulo neerisithi ngezalathiso zazo. Jonga imihla neeyunithi kunye neesixa ezipheleleyo. Xa ufumanisa impazamo, gcina isalathiso sokuqala ubhale oko kutshintshileyo nesizathu. Ukuba awukakwazi ukuchaza umahluko, yitsho oko. Musa ukongeza irekhodi eliqikelelwayo ukwenzela ukuba izixa zivumelane.

isixhosa_draft: Asikwazanga ukufunda irisithi — zama ifoto ecace ngakumbi, irisithi ilele tyaba, kukho ukukhanya okwaneleyo.

english: Shape the ground: swales and berms along the contour, terraces and banks on the steep parts. Turn Contours on to see the lines to follow.
isixhosa_draft: Bumba umhlaba: imisele neendonga zomhlaba zilandela umgca wokuphakama, amanyathelo omhlaba neendonga kwiindawo ezithambeke kakhulu. Vula imigca yokuphakama ukuze ubone imigca omawuyilandele.

english: Exact Canvas is free and instant, and draws every label, legend and line at full sheet resolution. AI Polished saves that exact master first, then spends one paid AI render painting the map artwork — your boundary, labels, legend, title block, north arrow and scale bar are drawn back on top by the app afterwards, never by the model. Neither choice ever changes your canvas design.

Ipolishwe yi-AI iqala igcine loo mephu ichanekileyo eyintloko, emva koko isebenzise umzobo omnye we-AI ohlawulelwayo ukupeyinta umzobo wemephu — umda wakho, iileyibhile, isitshixo, ibhloko yesihloko, utolo lomntla nomgca wesikali zizotywa kwakhona ngaphezulu yi-app emva koko, azize zizotywe yimodeli. Akukho nokuba lunye ukhetho oluya kuze lutshintshe uyilo lwakho lwekhanvasi.

english: Storms are rare and unpredictable, so catch water everywhere you can. Build small curved banks just above each plant. Catch runoff from farm roads into shallow basins. Underground water tanks help you get through dry spells — try to capture every drop of rain that falls.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkqwithela azifane zibekho kwaye azilindeleki, ngoko bamba amanzi kuyo yonke indawo onako. Yakha iindonga ezincinci ezigobileyo ngentla nje kwesityalo ngasinye. Bamba amanzi aphalala ezindleleni zefama uwangenise kwimingxuma engenzulwanga. Iitanki zamanzi ezingaphantsi komhlaba zikunceda ugqithe kumaxesha embalela — zama ukugcina onke amathontsi emvula ewayo.

english: Do not add compost, lime or phosphorus to natural Fynbos areas — it kills the plants, which are adapted to poor soil. Grow food separately, on soil brought in from elsewhere. Mulch food beds with Fynbos plant material. Cape reeds help hold the banks of water channels in place naturally.

Lima ukutya ngokwahlukileyo, kumhlaba oziswe uvela kwenye indawo. Gquma iibhedi zokutya ngezinto zezityalo zeFynbos. Iingcongolo zaseKapa zinceda ukubamba iindonga zemisele yamanzi ngendlela yendalo.

english: The government sheep manual describes controlled breeding at Mara Research Station, Limpopo: June–July mating and November–December lambing to match rain and grass. english: Semi-arid/extensive-veld range (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) used as the primary value; the same sentence's 8 kg/year figure is for a different system (sheep grazing CULTIVATED pastures) and is deliberately excluded from the range rather than averaged in. A Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) Dohne Merino Extensive enterprise budget (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) separately reports total flock wool sold as 4439.64 kg from a flock of '1 519' Smallstock Units, i.e. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - not used as the primary value because the source does not state that 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 sheep (SSU is a standardised stock-class weighting, not a literal head count), so converting it to kg/sheep would require an unstated conversion factor. A separate NWGA/Mandela Initiative paper on the Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program reports a Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' for communal Eastern Cape flocks - not merged into the primary value because that table is explicitly for '6-month old lambs' (a different life stage from a mature sheep's full annual clip), consistent with the rule against mixing figures across life stages; kept here only as EC-communal context: commercial-ram-sired lambs at 6 months averaged 2.8 kg, communal-ram-sired lambs 2.4 kg, a +16% difference.

Isabelo sikarhulumente weNtshona Koloni (Elsenburg) se-Dohne Merino Extensive (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) sinika ngokwahlukileyo iboya elithengisiweyo lomhlambi lingama-4439.64 kg ukusuka kumhlambi we-'1 519' Smallstock Units, oko kukuthi 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg ngeSmallstock Unit/ngonyaka - ayisetyenziswanga njengexabiso eliphambili kuba umthombo awuchazi ukuba 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 igusha (i-SSU yinkcazo ephakathi yodidi lwezilwanyana, hayi ukubalwa kwentloko kokwenyani), ngoko ukuyiguqulela ibe yi-kg/igusha kuya kufuna into yokuguqula engachazwanga. Iphepha elahlukileyo le-NWGA/Mandela Initiative malunga neNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweGusha zeBoya zaseMpuma Koloni zasekuhlaleni libika i-Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' kwimihlambi yasekuhlaleni yaseMpuma Koloni - ayidityaniswanga kwixabiso eliphambili kuba itheyibhile ikuchaza ngokucacileyo ukuba ngu '6-month old lambs' (inqanaba lobomi elahlukileyo kwigusha ekhulileyo ephela unyaka) ngokuhambelana nomgaqo wokungaxuxi amanani aphakathi kwamanqanaba obomi; igcinwe apha njengomxholo we-EC-communal kuphela: amatakane azalwe ziinkunzi zorhwebo kwiinyanga ezi-6 aphakathi ne-2.8 kg, amatakane azalwe ziinkunzi zasekuhlaleni i-2.4 kg, umahluko we-+16%.

isixhosa_draft: Isiphakamiso somgquba, imeko yesigaba/yeendleko zaso nerekhodi yonophelo lwaso zonke ziyatshintshela ekubambezelweni. Inguqulo yangaphambili nesizathu zihlala zibonakala.

english: Return to the list and reopen that same invoice. Compare the details with your note. A request for another copy is not a new sale.
isixhosa_draft: Buyela kuluhlu uvule kwakhona i-invoyisi enye leyo. Thelekisa iinkcukacha nenqaku lakho. Isicelo sekopi enye ayiyontengiso intsha.

isixhosa_draft: Imenyu → Ngaphandle kwe-intanethi nokumanyanisa ibonisa umgca wemisebenzi yasentsimini. Okuthi Ngaphandle kwe-intanethi okanye inani elilindileyo ecaleni kwemenyu nako kunokuyivula. Incwadi yemali inenkqubo yayo yokumanyanisa: umgca wemisebenzi yasentsimini ongenanto awuqinisekisi ukuba zonke ii-invoyisi okanye iintengiso zigcinwe kwiseva.

english: Complete invoice documents and original money-book receipt photos stay on their original device. A linked sale appearing elsewhere does not prove the full invoice or photo is there.
isixhosa_draft: Amaxwebhu e-invoyisi aphelele nemifanekiso yoqobo yeerisithi zencwadi yemali ihlala kwisixhobo sayo soqobo. Intengiso exhunyiweyo ebonakala kwenye indawo ayiqinisekisi ukuba i-invoyisi epheleleyo okanye ifoto ikhona.

english: Keep your source records and checked document copies. Follow the invoice guide to preview a PDF before sharing. Downloading a copy does not send it to a buyer.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iirekhodi zakho zomthombo neekopi zamaxwebhu ezihloliweyo. Landela umhlahlandlela we-invoyisi ukujonga i-PDF kuqala phambi kokuyabelana. Ukukhuphela ikopi akuthumeli kumthengi.

english: Yes. Reopen the same item and resolve its message. An empty fieldwork queue alone does not confirm the separate money book.
isixhosa_draft: Ewe. Vula kwakhona into enye uze uxazulule umyalezo wayo. Umgca wemisebenzi yasentsimini ongenanto wodwa awuqinisekisi incwadi yemali eyahlukileyo.

english: For an independent try, enter the sample farm, find a different existing invoice, note its reference, leave the list and reopen it. Explain the workspace and payment status to a partner. Finish with Exit tour; do not send the document.
isixhosa_draft: Kuzama okuzimeleyo, ngena kwifama yomzekelo, ufumane enye i-invoyisi ekhoyo, uphawule isalathiso sayo, ushiye uluhlu uze uyivule kwakhona. Chazela ozifundela naye indawo yokusebenza nemeko yentlawulo. Gqiba nge-Phuma ekhenketweni; ungayithumeli ixwebhu.

english: Locate me uses the device location if you choose to allow it. It is useful only when you are at the intended site. You can use search and the map without granting location access.
isixhosa_draft: U-Ndifumane usebenzisa indawo yesixhobo ukuba ukhetha ukuyivumela. Iluncedo kuphela xa ukwindawo oyifunayo. Ungasebenzisa ukukhangela nemephu ngaphandle kokunika imvume yokufumana indawo.

english: Check the area and units used in a forecast. Planned harvests are estimates, not proof of what was picked or sold. Use the harvest, expense and invoice guides for actual records.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela indawo neeyunithi ezisetyenziswe kuqikelelo. Izivuno ezicwangcisiweyo ziqikelelo, ayingobungqina boko kuvuniweyo okanye kuthengisiweyo. Sebenzisa imihlahlandlela yesivuno, indleko ne-invoyisi kwiirekhodi zokwenyani.

english: A kilogram benchmark or Plan-cycle value is a comparison based on the entered plan and its stated assumptions. It is not actual yield, monthly cash received or complete profit. Open What the planner can prove and read the sources and gaps.
isixhosa_draft: Umlinganiselo wekhilogram okanye ixabiso le-Plan-cycle luthelekiso olusekelwe kwisicwangciso esifakiweyo neengcinga zaso ezichaziweyo. Asisivuno sokwenyani, imali yenyanga efunyenweyo okanye inzuzo epheleleyo. Vula u-Oko isicwangciso sinokukubonisa ufunde imithombo namanqaku asweleyo.

english: Record actual picked quantities, sales and costs in My Records as the work happens. Keep original dates and evidence. Use those records to review the plan, rather than treating a forecast as food picked or money received.
isixhosa_draft: Rekhoda izixa ezivuniweyo ngokwenene, iintengiso neendleko kwiirekhodi zam njengoko umsebenzi wenzeka. Gcina imihla yoqobo nobungqina. Sebenzisa ezo rekhodi ukuphonononga isicwangciso, endaweni yokuthatha uqikelelo njengokutya okuvuniweyo okanye imali efunyenweyo.

english: Record it as a sale instead
A planned harvest is not a sale or proof of payment. Record those events from their own evidence.

english: Choose Picked to record produce harvested. Sold records sales and Spent records costs. Picking food does not by itself mean a buyer paid you.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-Kuvuniwe ukurekhoda imveliso evuniweyo. U-Kuthengisiwe urekhoda iintengiso kwaye u-Iindleko urekhoda iindleko. Ukuvuna ukutya akuthethi ukuba umthengi ukuhlawulile.

isixhosa_draft: Ukuthengiswa okungakumbi kunokuvunwa kunokuthetha ukuba irekhodi lesivuno lilahlekile okanye intengiso evela kwisivuno sangaphambili. Phanda imihla neerekhodi; ungatshintshi ubunzima nje ukuze itshathi ibonakale icocekile.

isixhosa_draft: Ukuba uxwebhu lugcinwe kwesi sixhobo kodwa incwadi yentengiso yezityalo isafuna ukuhlaziywa, qhagamshela kwakhona uze ulandele umyalezo kwi-invoyisi enye leyo. Ukwenza olunye uxwebhu asiyondlela ekhuselekileyo yokuzama kwakhona.

english: Paid invoices contribute income to My Records; paid kilogram lines can create linked crop-sale records. Other units retain their quantities. An unpaid invoice is not cash received.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-invoyisi ezihlawuliweyo zinegalelo kwingeniso kwiirekhodi zam; imiqolo ye-kilogram ehlawuliweyo inokwenza iirekhodi zentengiso yezityalo ezixhunyiweyo. Eminye imiyunithi igcina ubungakanani bayo. I-invoyisi engahlawulwanga ayiyo mali efunyenweyo.

english: Follow the record back to Sold
For a paid invoice, check the amount in Sold and reopen its invoice link. Do not manually add its income again because a linked crop record also exists.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo, khangela isixa kwa-Kuthengisiwe uze uvule kwakhona ikhonkco layo le-invoyisi. Ungayongezi ngesandla ingeniso yayo kuba irekhodi lesityalo elinxulumeneyo likhona.

english: When an unpaid invoice is later paid in full, open that existing invoice or its Review payment button, check the receipt date and save the update. Keep the same invoice number.
isixhosa_draft: Xa i-invoyisi engahlawulwanga ihlawulwa kamva yonke, vula leyo i-invoyisi ikhoyo okanye iqhosha layo elithi Phonononga intlawulo, khangela umhla wokufumana ugcine uhlaziyo. Gcina inombolo ye-invoyisi enye.

english: To send another copy, reopen the saved invoice and check Share PDF or Print. Downloading a copy does not send it to a customer. Review the destination yourself before sending.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuthumela enye ikopi, vula kwakhona i-invoyisi egciniweyo ukhangele u-Yabelana nge-PDF okanye u-Shicilela. Ukukhuphela ikopi akuyithumeli kumthengi. Hlola indawo eya kuyo wena phambi kokuthumela.

english: You can trace the sale, payment and document without creating a duplicate.
isixhosa_draft: Unokulandela intengiso, intlawulo noxwebhu ngaphandle kokwenza ikopi ephindiweyo.

english: Only part of the payment has arrived.
The invoice is for R120.00. The buyer pays R40.00. What should you do?
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi ingeye-R120.00. Umthengi uhlawula i-R40.00. Ufanele wenze ntoni?

english: Mark the invoice paid in full
R80.00 is still owed. Paid in full would misstate the payment; this screen does not track a partial balance.
isixhosa_draft: I-R80.00 isafuneka. Ukuthi ihlawuliwe yonke kuya kuxela ngokungachanekanga intlawulo; esi sikrini asilandeli ibhalansi enxalenye.

english: Keep a separate payment record and leave full payment unconfirmed
isixhosa_draft: Gcina irekhodi lentlawulo eyahlukileyo uze ushiye intlawulo epheleleyo ingaqinisekiswanga

english: Yes. Link the R40.00 evidence to the invoice and keep R80.00 outstanding in a checked supporting record. Do not create a second produce sale.
isixhosa_draft: Ewe. Nxulumanisa ubungqina be-R40.00 ne-invoyisi uze ugcine i-R80.00 isafuneka kwirekhodi exhasayo ehloliweyo. Musa ukwenza intengiso yesibini yemveliso.

english: The payment settles part of the existing sale. It does not describe another delivery of produce.
isixhosa_draft: Intlawulo ihlawula inxalenye yentengiso ekhoyo. Ayichazi okunye ukuhanjiswa kwemveliso.

english: The invoice document is saved on this device. A synchronised crop-sale row is not a backup of every document detail. Retain the source and a checked copy.
isixhosa_draft: Uxwebhu lwe-invoyisi lugcinwe kwesi sixhobo. Umqolo wentengiso yezityalo omanyaniswe awulogcino lazo zonke iinkcukacha zoxwebhu. Gcina umthombo nekopi ehloliweyo.

english: A saved invoice or payment status does not by itself prove receipt, full profit or tax compliance. For deposits, adjustments or disputed amounts, keep a checked supporting balance record and get bookkeeping help.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi egciniweyo okanye imeko yentlawulo ayiqinisekisi yodwa ukufunyanwa, inzuzo epheleleyo okanye ukuthobela irhafu. Kwiidiphozithi, izilungiso okanye izixa ezibuzwayo, gcina irekhodi lebhalansi exhasayo ehloliweyo uze ufune uncedo lokugcina iincwadi.

english: Find your sale before adding another
isixhosa_draft: Fumana intengiso yakho phambi kokongeza enye

english: Open Sold in your current workspace. Reopen an existing record when there is one.
isixhosa_draft: Vula u-Kuthengisiwe kwindawo yakho yokusebenzela yangoku. Vula kwakhona irekhodi elikhoyo xa likhona.

english: Keep the cost and its evidence together.
Record what you paid, check the cents and reopen the cost with its supporting receipt.
isixhosa_draft: Rekhoda oko ukuhlawulileyo, khangela iisenti uze uvule kwakhona indleko nerisithi yayo exhasayo.

english: Illustration of a grower considering costs with a notebook, calculator and produce at a homestead table
isixhosa_draft: Umfanekiso womtyali ecinga ngeendleko enencwadi yokubhala, ikhalkyuleyitha nemveliso etafileni yomzi

english: Check the source before saving a cost · illustrated example
isixhosa_draft: Khangela umthombo phambi kokugcina indleko · umzekelo ongumfanekiso

english: Bring the receipt or payment record
Have the item, amount paid and supplier ready. Keep the original payment date. This form records today’s entry date and has no date picker yet.
isixhosa_draft: Yiba nento, isixa ohlawule ngaso nomthengisi bekulungele. Gcina umhla woqobo wentlawulo. Le fom irekhoda umhla wengeniso yanamhlanje kwaye ayinayo into yokukhetha umhla okwangoku.

english: For practice, open the sample tour, choose Record the work and the sale, then Try it now. Choose Spent. Use sample details in a group lesson.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa, vula ukhenketho lomzekelo, ukhethe u-Rekhoda umsebenzi nentengiso, emva koko u-Zama ngoku. Khetha u-Iindleko. Sebenzisa iinkcukacha zomzekelo kwisifundo seqela.

english: Check the book before adding a cost
My Records → Spent → Log a cost
Look for the cost in Spent first. If it already exists, use Edit on that row to correct it. Do not add another copy of the same payment.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela indleko kuqala kwa-Iindleko. Ukuba sele ikho, sebenzisa u-Hlela kuloo mqolo ukuyilungisa. Musa ukongeza enye ikopi yentlawulo enye.

english: For a new cost, choose Log a cost. The form is headed Money you paid out.
isixhosa_draft: Kwindleko entsha, khetha u-Bhala iindleko. Ifom inesihloko esithi Imali oyihlawulileyo.

english: You know whether to add a new payment or edit an existing cost.
isixhosa_draft: Uyazi ukuba wongeze intlawulo entsha okanye uhlele indleko ekhoyo.

english: Copy the amount and describe the cost
Write what the payment was for and enter the full amount, including cents. Compare it with the receipt or checked payment evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuba intlawulo yayiyantoni uze ufake isixa esipheleleyo, kuquka iisenti. Sithelekise nerisithi okanye ubungqina bentlawulo obuhloliweyo.

english: Keep the original date in your source record when entering an older cost. The app places this entry in the month you type it.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina umhla woqobo kwirekhodi yakho yomthombo xa ufaka indleko endala. I-app ibeka le ngeniso kwinyanga oyiteyipha.

english: Assign the cost only when you know
Growing area for this entry → Crop this cost was for
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yokulima yale nto ibhaliweyo → Isityalo ezenzelwe sona ezi ndleko

english: Choose the growing area only when the cost belongs to it. Shared by beds and staple plots is available for a genuinely shared cost; Unassigned leaves it unallocated.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha indawo yokulima kuphela xa indleko ingeyayo. U-Imibhede neziza ezisisiseko zombini ukhona kwindleko eyabelwanayo ngokwenene; U-Ayabelwanga uyishiya ingabelwanga.
