english: Only fill Crop this cost was for when the payment was just for that crop. Leave it blank for a whole-garden cost. Do not invent a split to make a crop appear more profitable.
isixhosa_draft: Gcwalisa u-Isityalo ezenzelwe sona ezi ndleko kuphela xa intlawulo yayisesi sityalo kuphela. Shiya ingenanto kwindleko yegadi yonke. Musa ukuyila ukwahlulwa ukwenza isityalo sibonakale sinenzuzo engakumbi.

english: Any growing-area or crop assignment is supported by what the payment actually covered.
isixhosa_draft: Naluphi na ukwabelwa kwindawo yokulima okanye isityalo kuxhaswa yinto eyayigubungelwe yintlawulo ngokwenene.

english: A receipt photo is optional. You can attach it and fill in the cost yourself. Check that the important details are readable.
isixhosa_draft: Ifoto yerisithi ayinyanzelekanga. Ungayiqhotyoshelela uzalise indleko ngokwakho. Khangela ukuba iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo ziyafundeka.

english: The original receipt photo stays on this device. A cost appearing elsewhere does not mean its original photo is available there too.
isixhosa_draft: Ifoto yerisithi yoqobo ihlala kwesi sixhobo. Indleko ebonakala kwenye indawo ayithethi ukuba ifoto yayo yoqobo ikhona nakweloo ndawo.

english: Log cost → Spent → Edit or View slip
isixhosa_draft: Bhala iindleko → Iindleko → Hlela okanye Jonga irisithi

english: Choose Log cost and read the save result. Find that same cost in Spent and compare its amount with your evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-Bhala iindleko uze ufunde isiphumo sokugcina. Fumana loo ndleko enye kwa-Iindleko uthelekise isixa sayo nobungqina bakho.

english: If a receipt is unavailable, keep the original and check the device where you saved it. Do not create another cost simply to retry a photo or a queued save.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba irisithi ayikho, gcina eyoqobo ukhangele isixhobo apho uyigcine khona. Musa ukwenza enye indleko nje ukuzama kwakhona ifoto okanye ukugcina okulindileyo.

english: You can find the cost again, verify its cents and identify where the original evidence is kept.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuyifumana kwakhona indleko, uqinisekise iisenti zayo uchonge apho ubungqina boqobo bugcinwa khona.

english: Save both amounts as separate costs
That would risk counting the same payment twice. Resolve the difference on the one cost.
isixhosa_draft: Oko kuya kubeka emngciphekweni wokubala intlawulo enye kabini. Xazulula umahluko kwindleko enye.

english: Spent records payments, but the app cannot know which costs you have not entered. Sales minus recorded costs does not establish full profit when information is missing.
isixhosa_draft: U-Iindleko urekhoda iintlawulo, kodwa i-app ayinakwazi ukuba zeziphi iindleko ongazifakanga. Iintengiso kuthatyathwe iindleko ezirekhodiweyo azibonisi inzuzo epheleleyo xa ulwazi lulahlekile.

english: Keep original dates and evidence. Equipment, borrowing and household money need distinct treatment when preparing full accounts; use the finance workbook and your bookkeeper rather than treating every cash movement as a crop cost.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina imihla nobungqina boqobo. Izixhobo, imboleko nemali yekhaya zidinga unyango oluhlukeneyo xa kulungiswa iiakhawunti ezipheleleyo; sebenzisa incwadi yomsebenzi yeMali yefama kunye nomgcini wakho wezincwadi endaweni yokuthatha yonke intshukumo yemali njengendleko yesityalo.

english: Open Spent in your current workspace. Find an existing entry first, or add the payment once from its source record.
isixhosa_draft: Vula u-Iindleko kwindawo yakho yokusebenzela yangoku. Fumana ingeniso ekhoyo kuqala, okanye yongeza intlawulo kanye kwirekhodi yayo yomthombo.

english: Make an invoice. Keep the sale together.
Create an invoice, check payment and find the saved document again.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza i-invoyisi, khangela intlawulo uze ufumane uxwebhu olugciniweyo kwakhona.

english: Bring the buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price and dates. Check payment evidence before choosing paid. For practice, open the sample tour and choose Record the work and the sale.
isixhosa_draft: Zisa umthengi, imveliso, ubungakanani, iyunithi, ixabiso elivunyelweneyo nemihla. Khangela ubungqina bentlawulo phambi kokukhetha ehlawuliweyo. Ukuziqhelisa, vula ukhenketho lomzekelo uze ukhethe u-Rekhoda umsebenzi nentengiso.

english: Use sample details in a group lesson. Keep real customer and banking details private.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa iinkcukacha zomzekelo kwisifundo seqela. Gcina iinkcukacha zabathengi zokwenyani nezebhanki zingasese.

english: My Records → Invoice → Saved or New invoice
isixhosa_draft: Iirekhodi zam → I-invoyisi → Ezigciniweyo okanye I-invoyisi entsha

english: If the invoice already exists, open Saved and choose that document. A buyer asking for another copy does not mean another sale.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba i-invoyisi sele ikho, vula u-Ezigciniweyo uze ukhethe loo xwebhu. Umthengi ocela enye ikopi akathethi ukuba kukho enye intengiso.

english: For a new document, read “What are you recording?” Choose A new invoice, Produce already sold, or An invoice already written on paper.
isixhosa_draft: Kuxwebhu olutsha, funda u-“Ubhala ntoni?” Khetha u-I-invoyisi entsha, u-Imveliso esele ithengisiwe, okanye u-I-invoyisi esele ibhalwe ephepheni.

english: For a past sale or paper copy, answer whether the sale is already in My Records. If it is, link the exact available recorded sale. Keep the original paper reference and issue date.
isixhosa_draft: Kwintengiso yangaphambili okanye ikopi yephepha, phendula ukuba intengiso sele ikwiirekhodi zam na. Ukuba injalo, nxulumanisa intengiso erekhodiweyo echanekileyo ekhoyo. Gcina isalathiso sephepha soqobo nomhla wokukhutshwa.

english: You can explain whether this is a new sale, an existing sale or another copy of a document.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchaza ukuba le yintengiso entsha, intengiso ekhoyo okanye enye ikopi yoxwebhu.

english: Check the buyer, units and price
Bill to → Line items → Payment due
Check your seller details and choose the correct buyer. For each line, check the product, Quantity, Unit and Price each. Use Add line item for another product.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela iinkcukacha zakho njengomthengisi uze ukhethe umthengi ofanelekileyo. Kumgca ngamnye, khangela imveliso, Ubungakanani, Iyunithi neXabiso lento nganye. Sebenzisa u-Yongeza umgca kwenye imveliso.

english: Use the price you agreed with the buyer. A suggested guide price is not an agreement. Kilograms, bags and bunches are different units; do not change the unit without checking the quantity and price.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa ixabiso eniyivumelene nomthengi. Ixabiso lesikhokelo elicetyisiweyo asiyisivumelwano. Iikhilogram, iingxowa nezixha ziyunithi ezahlukeneyo; ungayitshintshi iyunithi ngaphandle kokukhangela ubungakanani nexabiso.

english: Check the issue date, payment terms and any buyer reference. Compare the preview with your source record before saving.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela umhla wokukhutshwa, iimeko zentlawulo nesalathiso somthengi. Thelekisa ukujonga kwangaphambili nerekhodi lakho lomthombo phambi kokugcina.

english: The buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price and total match the source record.
isixhosa_draft: Umthengi, imveliso, ubungakanani, iyunithi, ixabiso elivunyelweneyo nesixa esipheleleyo zihambelana nerekhodi lomthombo.

english: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba umthengi uhlawulile? → Intlawulo ifunyenwe ngomhla

english: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment is still due. Choose Yes — paid in full only after the full payment has been received and checked.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha Hayi okwangoku — intlawulo isalindiwe xa intlawulo isafuneka. Khetha Ewe — ihlawulwe yonke kuphela emva kokuba intlawulo epheleleyo ifunyenwe yaza yahlolwa.

english: For a paid invoice, check Payment received on and the payment method. The payment date can be different from the invoice issue date.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo, khangela Intlawulo ifunyenwe ngomhla nendlela yokuhlawula. Umhla wentlawulo ungahluka kumhla wokukhutshwa kwe-invoyisi.

english: A deposit is not payment in full. This screen does not track partial balances. Keep a checked supporting record of deposits and amounts still owed; do not mark the whole invoice paid to represent a deposit.
isixhosa_draft: Idiphozithi ayiyontlawulo epheleleyo. Esi sikrini asilandeli iibhalansi ezinxalenye. Gcina irekhodi elixhasayo elihloliweyo lamadiphozithi nezixa ezisafunekayo; ungayiphawuli yonke i-invoyisi njengehlawuliweyo ukumela idiphozithi.

english: The payment status and receipt date describe what actually happened.
isixhosa_draft: Imeko yentlawulo nomhla wokufumana zichaza oko kwenzeke ngokwenene.

english: Save invoice → Saved → Open the same invoice
isixhosa_draft: Gcina i-invoyisi → Ezigciniweyo → Vula i-invoyisi enye

english: Choose Save invoice and read the result. Then open Saved, find the same invoice and check it again.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-Gcina i-invoyisi uze ufunde isiphumo. Emva koko vula u-Ezigciniweyo, ufumane i-invoyisi enye uze uyihlole kwakhona.

english: If the app says the document is saved on this device but the crop sale book still needs an update, reconnect and follow that message. Do not create another invoice as a retry.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba i-app ithi uxwebhu lugcinwe kwesi sixhobo kodwa incwadi yentengiso yezityalo isafuna ukuhlaziywa, qhagamshela kwakhona uze ulandele loo myalezo. Musa ukwenza enye i-invoyisi njengokuzama kwakhona.

english: Paid invoice kilogram lines can appear in My Records. Other units keep their original quantities; the app does not guess their weight. Check for the linked record before entering another sale.
isixhosa_draft: Imiqolo ye-kilogram ye-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo inokubonakala kwiirekhodi zam. Eminye imiyunithi igcina ubungakanani bayo boqobo; i-app ayiqikeleli ubunzima bayo. Khangela irekhodi elixhunyiweyo phambi kokufaka enye intengiso.

english: You can reopen the invoice and identify any save or synchronisation message that still needs attention.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuvula kwakhona i-invoyisi uchonge nawuphi na umyalezo wokugcina okanye wokumanyanisa osafuna ingqalelo.

english: Saved invoice → Share PDF or Print
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi egciniweyo → Yabelana nge-PDF okanye Shicilela

english: On the saved invoice, choose Share PDF or Print. Check the buyer, reference, dates, line items, total, payment status and payment details in the output.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-invoyisi egciniweyo, khetha u-Yabelana nge-PDF okanye u-Shicilela. Khangela umthengi, isalathiso, imihla, imiqolo, isixa esipheleleyo, imeko yentlawulo neenkcukacha zentlawulo kwisiphumo.

english: Downloading a PDF does not mean the buyer received it. Choose the intended recipient yourself when you are ready to send a real invoice.
isixhosa_draft: Ukukhuphela i-PDF akuthetha ukuba umthengi uyifumene. Khetha wena umamkeli ohlosiweyo xa ukulungele ukuthumela i-invoyisi yokwenyani.

english: When an unpaid invoice is later paid in full, reopen that same invoice or use Review payment. Check the actual receipt date and save the update.
isixhosa_draft: Xa i-invoyisi engahlawulwanga ihlawulwa kamva yonke, vula kwakhona leyo i-invoyisi enye okanye usebenzise u-Phonononga intlawulo. Khangela umhla wokwenyani wokufumana ugcine uhlaziyo.

english: You have the right document for the right buyer, and have not recorded the sale twice.
isixhosa_draft: Unoxwebhu olufanelekileyo lomthengi ofanelekileyo, kwaye awuyirekhodanga intengiso kabini.

english: You already saved the invoice yesterday. What should you do?
isixhosa_draft: Sele uyigcine i-invoyisi izolo. Ufanele wenze ntoni?

english: Create a new sale and invoice
That would risk counting the sale again. The buyer needs another copy of the existing document.
isixhosa_draft: Oko kuya kubeka emngciphekweni wokubala intengiso kwakhona. Umthengi udinga enye ikopi yoxwebhu olukhoyo.

english: Yes. Reopen the same invoice, check it and use Share PDF or Print. Another copy is not another sale.
isixhosa_draft: Ewe. Vula kwakhona i-invoyisi enye, uyihlole uze usebenzise u-Yabelana nge-PDF okanye u-Shicilela. Enye ikopi ayiyontengiso yesibini.

english: Mark an unpaid invoice as paid
A request for a copy is not evidence of payment. Check the payment separately and keep its status accurate.
isixhosa_draft: Isicelo sekopi asiyobungqina bentlawulo. Khangela intlawulo ngokwahlukeneyo uze uyigcine imeko ichanekile.

english: Invoices are saved on this device. Do not assume the complete document is available on another device because a linked sale has synchronised. Keep the source record and a checked copy.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-invoyisi zigcinwa kwesi sixhobo. Musa ukucinga ukuba uxwebhu olupheleleyo lufumaneka kwesinye isixhobo kuba intengiso exhunyiweyo imanyaniswe. Gcina irekhodi lomthombo nekopi ehloliweyo.

english: The VAT/tax-number field prints a reference; it does not calculate VAT or establish that the document meets tax-invoice requirements. Check current SARS guidance with your bookkeeper.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yenombolo ye-VAT/yerhafu ishicilela isalathiso; ayibali i-VAT okanye ayiseki ukuba uxwebhu luhlangabezana neemfuno ze-invoyisi yerhafu. Khangela isikhokelo sangoku se-SARS nomgcini wakho wezincwadi.

english: Open Invoice when you are ready to work in your current workspace. Check whether the sale or invoice already exists before adding anything.
isixhosa_draft: Vula u-I-invoyisi xa ulungele ukusebenza kwindawo yakho yokusebenzela yangoku. Khangela ukuba intengiso okanye i-invoyisi sele ikho phambi kokongeza nantoni na.

english: Bring paper and past sales into the app
Keep the old paper. Record the sale once.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iphepha elidala. Rekhoda intengiso kanye.

english: Bring an earlier sale into the app with its original evidence, date and reference.
isixhosa_draft: Zisa intengiso yangaphambili kwi-app nobungqina bayo boqobo, umhla nesalathiso.

english: Have the paper and payment evidence ready
Bring the original reference, issue date, buyer, goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. Check whether payment arrived and on which date. Do not guess missing details.
isixhosa_draft: Zisa isalathiso soqobo, umhla wokukhutshwa, umthengi, iimpahla, ubungakanani, iiyunithi neemaxabiso ezivunyelweneyo. Khangela ukuba intlawulo ifikile na nangomphi umhla. Musa ukuqikelela iinkcukacha ezilahlekileyo.

english: For practice, use the sample tour → Record the work and the sale → Try it now. Use a clearly marked fictional example. Sample changes reset on a full reload.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa, sebenzisa ukhenketho lomzekelo → Rekhoda umsebenzi nentengiso → Zama ngoku. Sebenzisa umzekelo oqanjiweyo ophawulwe ngokucacileyo. Utshintsho lomzekelo lucinywa xa uphinda ulayishe iphepha lonke.

english: Look for the sale before entering it
Check both Sold and Saved. Match the reference, buyer, date, goods and amount. A paper copy and an app entry can describe the same sale.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela zombini u-Kuthengisiwe no-Ezigciniweyo. Thelekisa isalathiso, umthengi, umhla, iimpahla nesixa. Ikopi yephepha nengeniso ye-app zinokuchaza intengiso enye.

english: If an invoice already exists, reopen it from Saved or its View link. Do not create a new sale because the buyer wants another copy.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba i-invoyisi sele ikho, yivule kwakhona kwa-Ezigciniweyo okanye kwikhonkco layo elithi Jonga. Musa ukwenza intengiso entsha kuba umthengi efuna enye ikopi.

english: You know whether the sale and an invoice are already recorded.
isixhosa_draft: Uyazi ukuba intengiso ne-invoyisi sele zirekhodiwe na.

english: Sold → Past sale / paper invoice → What are you recording?
isixhosa_draft: Kuthengisiwe → Intengiso edlulileyo / i-invoyisi yephepha → Ubhala ntoni?

english: Choose An invoice already written on paper to copy an existing paper invoice. Choose Produce already sold when you are documenting an earlier sale without that paper invoice.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha I-invoyisi esele ibhalwe ephepheni ukukopa i-invoyisi ekhoyo yephepha. Khetha Imveliso esele ithengisiwe xa ubhala intengiso yangaphambili ngaphandle kwaloo i-invoyisi yephepha.

english: Answer Is this sale already in My Records? Choose Yes — link the existing sale if it is recorded. Choose No — record it with this invoice only after checking that it is absent.
isixhosa_draft: Phendula Ingaba le ntengiso sele ikwiIirekhodi Zam? Khetha Ewe — nxulumanisa intengiso ekhoyo ukuba irekhodiwe. Khetha Hayi — yibhale ngale invoyisi kuphela emva kokuqinisekisa ukuba ayikho.

english: Choose the entry type and existing-sale answer before filling the rest. Changing these choices starts a fresh form, so check all the details again.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha uhlobo lwengeniso nempendulo yentengiso ekhoyo phambi kokuzalisa okunye. Ukutshintsha ezi zikhetho kuqala ifom entsha, ngoko khangela zonke iinkcukacha kwakhona.

english: Link only the exact recorded sale
Yes — link the existing sale → Recorded sale
isixhosa_draft: Ewe — nxulumanisa intengiso ekhoyo → Intengiso ebhaliweyo

english: Select the exact available sale in kilograms. Read its crop, weight, amount, buyer and date. Its recorded crop, kilograms, total and payment date stay together.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha intengiso echanekileyo ekhoyo ngeekhilogram. Funda isityalo sayo, ubunzima, isixa, umthengi nomhla. Isityalo sayo esirekhodiweyo, iikhilogram, isixa esipheleleyo nomhla wentlawulo zihlala kunye.

english: An empty list is not proof that the sale never happened. It may already have an invoice or may not be an eligible kilogram record. Check Saved and your original evidence. Never pick a similar sale as a substitute.
isixhosa_draft: Uluhlu olungenanto aluyobungqina bokuba intengiso ayizange yenzeke. Inokuba sele inayo i-invoyisi okanye ingeyiyo irekhodi ye-kilogram efanelekileyo. Khangela u-Ezigciniweyo nobungqina bakho boqobo. Musa ukukhetha intengiso efanayo endaweni yayo.

english: If the app says the invoice is on another device, reopen it there. A linked sale can synchronise without copying the full invoice document. Connect to the internet before linking a real existing sale.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba i-app ithi i-invoyisi ikwesinye isixhobo, yivule apho. Intengiso exhunyiweyo inokumanyaniswa ngaphandle kokukopa uxwebhu lwe-invoyisi epheleleyo. Qhagamshela kwi-intanethi phambi kokunxulumanisa intengiso ekhoyo yokwenyani.

english: Original paper invoice reference → Invoice issue date → Line items
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso se-invoyisi yephepha yokuqala → Umhla wokukhutshwa kwe-invoyisi → Imigca yezinto

english: For a paper copy, enter the original paper number and date. The app gives its copy an app invoice number too. Keep both references; the buyer’s order reference is a separate field.
isixhosa_draft: Kwikopi yephepha, faka inombolo nomhla woqobo wephepha. I-app inika ikopi yayo nenombolo ye-invoyisi ye-app. Gcina zombini izalathiso; isalathiso se-odolo yomthengi sisiqendu esahlukileyo.

english: Check the date in the document preview before saving. Copy the goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. A suggested price is not the price on your paper.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela umhla kujongo loxwebhu phambi kokugcina. Kopa iimpahla, ubungakanani, iiyunithi neemaxabiso ezivunyelweneyo. Ixabiso elicetyisiweyo asilo ixabiso elikwiphepha lakho.

english: Record what actually happened to payment
Choose Yes — paid in full only when full payment is supported by checked evidence. Use its actual receipt date and method. An old invoice date does not prove the buyer paid that day.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha Ewe — ihlawulwe yonke kuphela xa intlawulo epheleleyo ixhaswa bubungqina obuhloliweyo. Sebenzisa umhla wokwenyani wokufumana nendlela. Umhla omdala we-invoyisi awubonisi ukuba umthengi uhlawule ngaloo mini.

english: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment remains due. This app does not keep an instalment ledger. Keep deposits and the remaining balance separately; do not mark a deposit as full payment.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha Hayi okwangoku — intlawulo isalindiwe xa intlawulo isafuneka. Le app ayigcini incwadi yeentlawulo ezinxalenye. Gcina amadiphozithi nebhalansi esele ngokwahlukeneyo; ungayiphawuli idiphozithi njengentlawulo epheleleyo.

english: For a linked recorded sale, preserve its recorded paid status and payment date. If they disagree with your evidence, resolve the original record instead of making a duplicate.
isixhosa_draft: Kwintengiso erekhodiweyo exhunyiweyo, gcina imeko yayo yentlawulo erekhodiweyo nomhla wentlawulo. Ukuba ahambelani nobungqina bakho, xazulula irekhodi loqobo endaweni yokwenza ikopi ephindiweyo.

english: The invoice date and payment date each describe their own event.
isixhosa_draft: Umhla we-invoyisi nomhla wentlawulo zichaza isiganeko sazo ngasinye.

english: Save once and read the result. Find the same invoice again and compare the paper reference, issue date, buyer, units, total and payment status.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina kanye uze ufunde isiphumo. Fumana i-invoyisi enye kwakhona uze uthelekise isalathiso sephepha, umhla wokukhutshwa, umthengi, iiyunithi, isixa esipheleleyo nemeko yentlawulo.

english: A saved invoice’s issue date is locked. Check it before saving; keep the original evidence and seek help with that record if it is wrong. Do not add another sale as a correction.
isixhosa_draft: Umhla wokukhutshwa we-invoyisi egciniweyo uvaliwe. Wukhangele phambi kokugcina; gcina ubungqina boqobo ufune uncedo kwiirekhodi eziphosakeleyo. Musa ukongeza enye intengiso njengolungiso.

english: If the message says the crop sale book still needs updating, reconnect and save the same invoice again. Keep the paper even after the app copy is saved.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umyalezo uthi incwadi yentengiso yezityalo isafuna ukuhlaziywa, qhagamshela kwakhona uze ugcine i-invoyisi enye kwakhona. Gcina iphepha nokuba ikopi ye-app sele igciniwe.

english: You can connect one source sale to its app document without counting its income twice.
isixhosa_draft: Unokunxulumanisa intengiso enye yomthombo noxwebhu lwayo lwe-app ngaphandle kokubala ingeniso yayo kabini.

english: The old sale is already recorded.
Your paper describes a sale already in My Records. What should you do first?
isixhosa_draft: Iphepha lakho lichaza intengiso sele ikwiirekhodi zam. Ufanele wenze ntoni kuqala?

english: Enter a second sale with today’s date
That can duplicate income and change the story of when it happened. Find the existing record first.
isixhosa_draft: Oko kunokuphinda ingeniso kwaye kutshintshe ibali lexesha eyenzeke ngalo. Fumana irekhodi elikhoyo kuqala.

english: Reopen its invoice, or link the exact eligible sale
isixhosa_draft: Vula kwakhona i-invoyisi yayo, okanye nxulumanisa intengiso echanekileyo efanelekileyo

english: Yes. Match the source first. If an invoice exists, reopen it; otherwise use the supported existing-sale link.
isixhosa_draft: Ewe. Qala ngokuthelekisa umthombo. Ukuba i-invoyisi ikhona, yivule kwakhona; ngaphandle koko sebenzisa unxulumano lwentengiso ekhoyo oluxhaswayo.

english: Link another sale with a similar amount
A similar amount does not establish the same sale. Keep the evidence and resolve the missing match.
isixhosa_draft: Isixa esifanayo asiseki ukuba yintengiso enye. Gcina ubungqina uxazulule ukungahambelani okulahlekileyo.

english: An app copy does not replace missing source evidence. It does not convert units, establish tax compliance or repair an incorrect old record by itself.
isixhosa_draft: Ikopi ye-app ayithathi ndawo yobungqina bomthombo obulahlekileyo. Ayiguquli iiyunithi, ayiseki ukuthotyelwa kwerhafu okanye ayilungisi irekhodi elidala eliphosakeleyo yodwa.

english: Independent practice: find one existing sample invoice and identify its issue date and payment status. Explain which entry route you would use for a paper copy and when you must stop to check a possible duplicate.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: fumana i-invoyisi enye yomzekelo ekhoyo uchonge umhla wokukhutshwa nemeko yentlawulo. Chaza ukuba yiyiphi indlela yengeniso oya kuyisebenzisa kwikopi yephepha nokuba kufuneka umise nini ukukhangela ikopi ephindiweyo enokubakho.

english: Look for the existing sale before opening a past-sale or paper-copy form. Use the sample workspace until you can explain your choice.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela intengiso ekhoyo phambi kokuvula ifom yentengiso yangaphambili okanye yekopi yephepha. Sebenzisa indawo yomzekelo ide ukwazi ukuchaza ukhetho lwakho.

english: Review payment and share the right invoice
isixhosa_draft: Phonononga intlawulo uze wabelane nge-invoyisi echanekileyo

english: Check payment. Send the right copy.
Update the existing invoice from checked payment evidence and inspect the document before sharing.
isixhosa_draft: Hlaziya i-invoyisi ekhoyo ngobungqina bentlawulo obuhloliweyo uze uhlole uxwebhu phambi kokuyabelana.

english: Bring the invoice reference and payment evidence
Have the buyer, invoice number and payment evidence ready. A buyer asking for a copy is not proof of payment.
isixhosa_draft: Yiba nomthengi, inombolo ye-invoyisi nobungqina bentlawulo bukulungele. Isicelo somthengi sekopi asiyobungqina bentlawulo.

english: Practise in the sample tour. Keep real banking and customer details private. A practice export ends with checking the copy; do not send it to a real customer.
isixhosa_draft: Ziqhelise kukhenketho lomzekelo. Gcina iinkcukacha zebhanki nezabathengi zokwenyani zingasese. Ukuthumela ngaphandle kokuziqhelisa kugqitywa ngokukhangela ikopi; ungayithumeli kumthengi wokwenyani.

english: Invoice → Saved → Invoice number or Review payment
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi → Ezigciniweyo → Inombolo ye-invoyisi okanye Phonononga intlawulo

english: Find the existing invoice by number, buyer, issue date and total. Choose its row or Review payment to open it.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana i-invoyisi ekhoyo ngenombolo, umthengi, umhla wokukhutshwa nesixa esipheleleyo. Khetha umqolo wayo okanye u-Phonononga intlawulo ukuyivula.

english: Check that you are editing that invoice. Do not start New invoice to record payment for goods already invoiced.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela ukuba uhlela leyo i-invoyisi. Musa ukuqala u-I-invoyisi entsha ukurekhoda intlawulo yempahla esele inikwe i-invoyisi.

english: The document and buyer match the payment you are investigating.
Compare the payment record with the invoice
Check that the money was actually received and belongs to this invoice. Compare the amount and reference with your checked payment record.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela ukuba imali ifunyenwe ngokwenene kwaye ingeyale i-invoyisi. Thelekisa isixa nesalathiso nerekhodi lakho lentlawulo elihloliweyo.

english: A promise, payment request or screenshot that you have not verified is not enough to say paid in full. Resolve differences before changing the status.
isixhosa_draft: Isithembiso, isicelo sentlawulo okanye umfanekiso wesikrini ongawuqinisekisanga alwaneli ukuthi ihlawuliwe yonke. Xazulula iyantlukwano phambi kokutshintsha imeko.

english: This screen supports paid in full or unpaid. For a deposit or instalment, keep the amounts, dates and balance in a separate supporting record. Do not mark the whole invoice paid.
isixhosa_draft: Esi sikrini sixhasa ihlawuliwe yonke okanye ayihlawulwanga. Kwidiphozithi okanye intlawulo ngenxalenye, gcina izixa, imihla nebhalansi kwirekhodi exhasayo eyahlukileyo. Musa ukuphawula yonke i-invoyisi njengehlawuliweyo.

english: You can explain why the evidence supports full payment, or what remains unresolved.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchaza ukuba kutheni ubungqina buxhasa intlawulo epheleleyo, okanye yintoni esengaxazululwanga.

english: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on → Payment method → Save invoice
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba umthengi uhlawulile? → Intlawulo ifunyenwe ngomhla → Indlela yokuhlawula → Gcina i-invoyisi

english: Once full payment is checked, choose Yes — paid in full. Check Payment received on and choose the method when known. Keep the original issue date.
isixhosa_draft: Intlawulo epheleleyo isakuhlolwa, khetha Ewe — ihlawulwe yonke. Khangela Intlawulo ifunyenwe ngomhla uze ukhethe indlela xa ikwaziwa. Gcina umhla woqobo wokukhutshwa.

english: Save and read the result. Reopen the same invoice from Saved. Check the paid status, receipt date and method. The invoice number should stay the same.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina uze ufunde isiphumo. Vula kwakhona i-invoyisi enye kwa-Ezigciniweyo. Khangela imeko yentlawulo, umhla wokufumana nendlela. Inombolo ye-invoyisi kufuneka ihlale injalo.

english: A sale linked from an existing record keeps its recorded payment details together. If these need correction, resolve that original record rather than making a new invoice.
isixhosa_draft: Intengiso exhunyiweyo kwirekhodi ekhoyo igcina iinkcukacha zayo zentlawulo erekhodiweyo zihlala kunye. Ukuba ezi zifuna ulungiso, xazulula leyo rekhodi yoqobo endaweni yokwenza i-invoyisi entsha.

english: One invoice now carries the checked payment, with no extra sale added.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi enye ngoku iphethe intlawulo ehloliweyo, ngaphandle kokongeza ntengiso ongezelelweyo.

english: My Records → Sold → View the related invoice
isixhosa_draft: Iirekhodi zam → Kuthengisiwe → Jonga i-invoyisi enxulumeneyo

english: Check the related invoice and amount in Sold. Paid invoice income is included in the money book. Do not enter another quick sale for the same payment.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela i-invoyisi enxulumeneyo nesixa kwa-Kuthengisiwe. Ingeniso ye-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo ibandakanyiwe kwincwadi yemali. Musa ukufaka enye intengiso ekhawulezileyo yentlawulo enye.

english: Kilogram lines can provide crop-sale evidence. Bunches and bags keep their own units; the app does not guess their kilograms. Read the units beside the amount.
isixhosa_draft: Imiqolo ye-kilogram inokunika ubungqina bentengiso yezityalo. Izixha neengxowa zigcina iiyunithi zazo; i-app ayiqikeleli iikhilogram zazo. Funda iiyunithi ecaleni kwesixa.

english: If the invoice is saved on this device but its crop sale book update is pending, reconnect and save that same invoice again. Keep the source evidence while resolving the message.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba i-invoyisi igcinwe kwesi sixhobo kodwa uhlaziyo lwayo lwencwadi yentengiso yezityalo lulindile, qhagamshela kwakhona uze ugcine leyo i-invoyisi enye kwakhona. Gcina ubungqina bomthombo ngoxa uxazulula umyalezo.

english: The money and units still describe the original sale, counted once.
isixhosa_draft: Imali neeyunithi zisachaza intengiso yoqobo, ebalwe kanye.

english: Review the on-screen document first: seller and buyer, both references where relevant, dates, goods, units, prices, total, payment status and banking details.
isixhosa_draft: Phonononga uxwebhu lwesikrini kuqala: umthengisi nomthengi, zombini izalathiso apho kufanelekileyo, imihla, iimpahla, iiyunithi, amaxabiso, isixa esipheleleyo, imeko yentlawulo neenkcukacha zebhanki.

english: Share PDF and Print save the current form before producing output. Check your edits first. A paid document shows Invoice total and its Paid stamp; an unpaid document shows Total due.
isixhosa_draft: U-Yabelana nge-PDF no-Shicilela bagcina ifom yangoku phambi kokuvelisa isiphumo. Khangela utshintsho lwakho kuqala. Uxwebhu olwehlawuliweyo lubonisa u-Invoice total nophawu lwalo lwe-Paid; uxwebhu olungahlawulwanga lubonisa u-Total due.

english: Share PDF opens a device share sheet where supported, or downloads a PDF. Check the generated copy. If PDF creation reports an error, the invoice may already be saved; follow the message and try Print rather than creating a duplicate.
isixhosa_draft: U-Yabelana nge-PDF uvula iphepha lokwabelana lesixhobo apho lixhaswayo, okanye ukhuphele i-PDF. Khangela ikopi eyenziweyo. Ukuba ukwenziwa kwe-PDF kuxela impazamo, i-invoyisi isenokuba sele igciniwe; landela umyalezo uze uzame u-Shicilela endaweni yokwenza ikopi ephindiweyo.

english: For a real invoice, check the recipient and attachment before sending through your chosen app. Downloading or printing does not mean the buyer received it.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-invoyisi yokwenyani, khangela umamkeli nesongezo phambi kokuthumela ngokusebenzisa i-app oyikhethileyo. Ukukhuphela okanye ukushicilela akuthethi ukuba umthengi uyifumene.

english: If the buyer needs another copy, reopen and share the same invoice. Keep a checked copy with the source records.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umthengi udinga enye ikopi, vula kwakhona uze wabelane nge-invoyisi enye. Gcina ikopi ehloliweyo kunye neerekhodi zomthombo.

english: The complete invoice stays on its original device. Seeing the sale on another device does not prove the full document is there too.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi epheleleyo ihlala kwisixhobo sayo soqobo. Ukubona intengiso kwesinye isixhobo akubonisi ukuba uxwebhu olupheleleyo lukho nakweso.

english: You can identify which copy was sent, to whom, and which invoice it belongs to.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchonga ukuba yeyiphi ikopi ethunyelwe, kwabani, nokuba ingeyiphi i-invoyisi.

english: Only part of the invoice was paid.
The buyer paid a deposit. Which action keeps the record honest?
isixhosa_draft: Umthengi uhlawule idiphozithi. Liliphi inyathelo eligcina irekhodi linyanisekile?

english: A deposit is not full payment. That would hide the amount still owed.
isixhosa_draft: Idiphozithi ayiyontlawulo epheleleyo. Oko kuya kufihla isixa esisafunekayo.

english: Keep the part payment and balance in a supporting record
isixhosa_draft: Gcina intlawulo enxalenye nebhalansi kwirekhodi exhasayo

english: Correct. The app has no instalment ledger. Keep the evidence separately and do not mark full payment until it is supported.
isixhosa_draft: Ichanekile. I-app ayinayo incwadi yeentlawulo ezinxalenye. Gcina ubungqina ngokwahlukeneyo ungaphawuli intlawulo epheleleyo de ixhaswe.

english: Create another sale for the deposit
A deposit towards the existing invoice is not a second sale. Keep it linked in your supporting payment record.
isixhosa_draft: Idiphozithi eya kwi-invoyisi ekhoyo asiyontengiso yesibini. Gcina inxulunyaniswe kwirekhodi lakho lentlawulo exhasayo.

english: A paid label is a record, not independent proof
isixhosa_draft: Ileyibhile ethi ihlawuliwe yirekhodi, ayingobungqina obuzimeleyo

english: The app relies on the payment details you enter. It does not check your bank account or establish that a transfer cleared. Keep the evidence that supports your update.
isixhosa_draft: I-app ixhomekeke kwiinkcukacha zentlawulo oziphumayo. Ayikhangeli iakhawunti yakho yebhanki okanye iseke ukuba utshintsho lufikile. Gcina ubungqina obuxhasa uhlaziyo lwakho.

english: Independent practice: reopen one paid and one unpaid sample invoice. Explain the date and status on each, then identify the document and recipient you would check before sharing. Do not send the examples.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: vula kwakhona i-invoyisi enye yomzekelo ehlawuliweyo neyodwa engahlawulwanga. Chaza umhla nemeko kwileyo nganye, uze uchonge uxwebhu nomamkeli oya kukhangela phambi kokuyabelana. Musa ukuthumela imizekelo.

english: Find the invoice you want to review
Open Saved, match the reference and compare the payment evidence. Follow the same record through review and sharing.
isixhosa_draft: Vula u-Ezigciniweyo, uthelekise isalathiso uze uthelekise ubungqina bentlawulo. Landela irekhodi elinye ngokuphonononga nokwabelana.

english: For your own records, have a receipt, sale or harvest entry to compare. Read loading, offline and save messages before deciding that a missing figure means zero. Keep private customer and banking details out of group practice.
isixhosa_draft: Kwiirekhodi zakho, yiba nerisithi, intengiso okanye ingeniso yesivuno ukuze uthelekise. Funda imiyalezo yokulayisha, ngaphandle kwe-intanethi nokugcina phambi kokugqiba ukuba inani elilahlekileyo lithetha zero. Gcina iinkcukacha zabathengi nezebhanki zingasese ekuziqhelisweni kweqela.

english: The buttons choose how many months the Cash flow graph shows. Read the dates on that graph. Tap a month to inspect its money in, money out and running total.
isixhosa_draft: Amaqhosha akhetha inani leenyanga elibonakaliswa yigrafu yokuhamba kwemali. Funda imihla kuloo grafu. Cofa inyanga ukuhlola imali engenayo, imali ephumayo nesixa esiqhubekekayo.

english: Cash flow → Money in, money out and the lower running-total band
isixhosa_draft: Ukuhamba kwemali → Imali engenayo, imali ephumayo nebhendi esezantsi yesixa esiqhubekekayo

english: The running total starts at zero at the left edge of the selected window. It adds recorded money in and subtracts recorded spending across those months. It is not your bank balance, because it has no opening bank balance.
isixhosa_draft: Isixa esiqhubekekayo siqala kwi-zero kumphetho wasekhohlo wefestile ekhethiweyo. Songeza imali engenayo erekhodiweyo sisuse into esetyenzisiweyo kuzo ezo nyanga. Asiyiyo ibhalansi yebhanki yakho, kuba asinabhalansi yokuqala yebhanki.

english: Cash surplus and Recorded cash margin describe the included records. Missing expenses, stock, equipment treatment, debt and other accounts can change the complete business result. Do not call one chart a full profit-and-loss statement.
isixhosa_draft: Intsalela yemali kunye neMali eseleyo ebhaliweyo zichaza iirekhodi ezibandakanyiweyo. Iindleko ezilahlekileyo, isitokhwe, unyango lwezixhobo, ityala neminye imali inokutshintsha isiphumo sebhizinisi esipheleleyo. Ungayibizi itshathi enye ngokuba yingxelo epheleleyo yenzuzo nelahleko.

english: Read picked, sold and the remainder
Harvest graphs → Picked & sold → Read the month and orchard setting
isixhosa_draft: Iigrafu zesivuno → Kuvunwe & kuthengiswe → Funda inyanga nesetingi yeorchard

english: Check the selected window and whether Orchard in or Orchard out is shown. That setting changes which kilograms are counted; it does not remove all those activities from the money totals.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela ifestile ekhethiweyo nokuba u-Orchard in okanye u-Orchard out uyabonisiwe. Eso setingi sitshintsha ukuba zeziphi iikhilogram ezibalwayo; asisusi zonke ezo misebenzi kwizixa zemali.

english: Kept is the picked-minus-sold remainder in the records. It does not identify how much was eaten, given away, stored, used elsewhere or lost. Keep those destinations separately when needed.
isixhosa_draft: Okusele kuyintsalela yoko kuvuniweyo kuthatyathwe okuthengisiweyo kwiirekhodi. Akuchongi ukuba kangakanani okutyiweyo, okuphiweyo, okugcinwe, okusetyenziswe kwenye indawo okanye okulahlekileyo. Gcina ezo ndawo ziya kuzo ngokwahlukeneyo xa kuyimfuneko.

english: A dashed outline can mark a month with more sold than logged as picked. Read the explanation and check missing harvests or sales from earlier stock. Do not enter an invented harvest to make the bars agree.
isixhosa_draft: Umda onamachaphaza unokuphawula inyanga enokuthengiswa okungakumbi kunoko kurekhodwe njengokuvuniweyo. Funda inkcazo ukhangele izivuno okanye iintengiso ezilahlekileyo ezivela kwisitokhwe sangaphambili. Musa ukufaka isivuno esiyilisiweyo ukuze iibha zivumelane.

english: This card uses recorded sales minus assigned costs and today’s mapped area. Its square metres are not a historical measurement of harvested ground.
isixhosa_draft: Eli khadi lisebenzisa iintengiso ezirekhodiweyo kuthatyathwe iindleko ezabelweyo nendawo emepiweyo yanamhlanje. Iimitha zayo zesikwere azingumlinganiselo wangaphambili womhlaba ovuniweyo.

english: Read the shared-cost and unassigned-cost notes. Missing overheads or labour are not silently included. Crop performance may say Cost per m²: not attributed rather than supplying a full crop profit.
isixhosa_draft: Funda amanqaku eendleko ezabelwanayo neendleko ezingabelwanga. Iindleko ezongezelelweyo okanye umsebenzi ongekhoyo awubandakanywa ngokuthe cwaka. Ukusebenza kwesityalo kunokuthi Cost per m²: not attributed endaweni yokunika inzuzo epheleleyo yesityalo.

english: You can name an included cost, an excluded or unknown cost, and the area used.
isixhosa_draft: Unokubiza indleko ebandakanyiweyo, indleko ekhutshiweyo okanye engaziwayo nendawo esetyenzisiweyo.

english: My Records → Sold, Spent or Picked → Reopen the source record
isixhosa_draft: Iirekhodi zam → Kuthengisiwe, Iindleko okanye Kuvuniwe → Vula kwakhona irekhodi lomthombo

english: Choose one amount or harvest and find its record. On a wide screen, the Financial sheet also lists dated entries with invoice and receipt links. Reopen the matching document instead of adding another entry.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha isixa esinye okanye isivuno uze ufumane irekhodi laso. Kwisikrini esibanzi, iphepha lemali linika uluhlu lwezinto ezibhaliweyo ezinemihla ezinamakhonkco e-invoyisi nerisithi. Vula kwakhona uxwebhu olufanayo endaweni yokongeza ingeniso enye.

english: Harvest and cost logging forms stamp the entry date. Paid invoices use their recorded payment date. Check the actual source dates and keep late-entry evidence; do not assume every chart month is the date work happened.
isixhosa_draft: Iifom zokurekhoda isivuno neendleko zibeka umhla wengeniso. Ii-invoyisi ezihlawuliweyo zisebenzisa umhla wentlawulo orekhodiweyo. Khangela imihla yomthombo yokwenyani uze ugcine ubungqina bokufakwa kwakamva; ungacingi ukuba inyanga nganye yetshathi ngumhla apho umsebenzi wenzeke khona.

english: A paid invoice has one payment date for its whole amount. The app cannot show a full instalment history from that field. Keep separate evidence for part payments and do not mark a deposit as full payment.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo inomhla omnye wentlawulo kwisixa sayo sonke. I-app ayikwazi ukubonisa imbali epheleleyo yeentlawulo ezinxalenye kuloo ndawo. Gcina ubungqina obwahlukileyo beentlawulo ezinxalenye ungaphawuli idiphozithi njengentlawulo epheleleyo.

english: Write down one question the evidence can answer and one gap still to resolve. Follow the harvest, expense or invoice guide if an actual supported entry needs correction.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala umbuzo omnye onokuphendulwa bubungqina nesikhewu esinye esisafuna ukuxazululwa. Landela umhlahlandlela wesivuno, indleko okanye i-invoyisi ukuba ingeniso exhaswayo yokwenyani ifuna ukulungiswa.

english: The selected cash-flow window shows −R50.00. Does that prove the bank account is overdrawn?
isixhosa_draft: Ifestile ekhethiweyo yokuhamba kwemali ibonisa −R50.00. Ingaba oko kuqinisekisa ukuba i-akhawunti yebhanki ikhutshwe ngaphezu kwemali ekhoyo?

english: Yes, the chart is the bank balance
The running total begins at zero for the selected months. Without the opening balance and all account movements, it cannot establish the bank balance.
isixhosa_draft: Isixa esiqhubekekayo siqala kwi-zero kwiinyanga ezikhethiweyo. Ngaphandle kwebhalansi yokuqala neentshukumo zonke ze-akhawunti, asinakusekwa njengebhalansi yebhanki.

english: Correct. The chart shows the net movement of its included records. Reconcile the account separately before concluding what cash is available.
isixhosa_draft: Ichanekile. Itshathi ibonisa intshukumo ecocekileyo yeerekhodi ezibandakanyiweyo. Vumelanisa i-akhawunti ngokwahlukeneyo phambi kokugqiba ukuba yeyiphi imali ekhoyo.

english: Add an extra sale to bring it above zero
isixhosa_draft: Yongeza intengiso eyongezelelweyo ukuyizisa ngaphezu kwe-zero

english: Do not invent a sale to change a chart. Investigate the period, missing records and original evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Musa ukuyila intengiso ukutshintsha itshathi. Phanda ixesha, iirekhodi ezilahlekileyo nobungqina boqobo.

english: Charts helps you investigate recorded cash, harvests and planning assumptions. It does not produce a complete balance sheet, stock valuation, bank reconciliation or tax return.
isixhosa_draft: Iitshathi zikunceda uphande imali erekhodiweyo, izivuno neengcinga zokucwangcisa. Azivelisi ishiti yebhalansi epheleleyo, ixabiso lesitokhwe, ukuvumelanisa kwebhanki okanye ukubuya kwerhafu.

english: Keep checked supporting schedules for amounts the app does not track, and ask for appropriate bookkeeping help with complete accounts. A map, chart or export does not prove profitability or funding approval.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina izicwangciso ezixhasayo ezihloliweyo zezixa ezingalandelwa yi-app, ufune uncedo olufanelekileyo lokugcina iincwadi kwiiakhawunti ezipheleleyo. Imephu, itshathi okanye ukuthumela ngaphandle akubonisi inzuzo okanye ukuvunywa kwemali.

english: Have the period you need, your invoices, receipts and payment records ready. First check which farm and account you are using.
isixhosa_draft: Yiba nexesha olidingayo, ii-invoyisi zakho, iirisithi neerekhodi zentlawulo bekulungele. Khangela kuqala ukuba usebenzisa yiphi ifama ne-akhawunti.

english: Charts can export a CSV: a table that a spreadsheet app can open. It contains dated harvest, sale, paid-invoice and cost rows for its selected period.
isixhosa_draft: Iitshathi zinokuthumela ngaphandle i-CSV: itafile enokuvulwa yi-app yespredishithi. Iqulethe imiqolo enemihla yesivuno, intengiso, i-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo neendleko zexesha elikhethiweyo.

english: Picked has Records for a lender: a PDF summary of the records entered. It is useful for discussing those records. It is not a credit score or loan approval.
isixhosa_draft: U-Kuvuniwe unayo Iirekhodi ezenzelwe umbolekisi wemali: isishwankathelo se-PDF seerekhodi ezifakiweyo. Iluncedo ekuxoxeni ngezo rekhodi. Asiyiskoro sokuboleka okanye imvume yemboleko.

english: Neither file is a complete backup of the app. Keep original invoices, receipt photos and other evidence separately.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho nye ifayile eyikopi epheleleyo yogcino ye-app. Gcina ii-invoyisi zoqobo, iifoto zeerisithi nobunye ubungqina ngokwahlukeneyo.

english: Match a row to its saved invoice, harvest or receipt. Keep its units: a bunch is not a kilogram. A harvest row records produce, not money received. Paid invoices use the recorded payment date; unpaid invoices are not cash income here.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa umqolo ne-invoyisi yawo egciniweyo, isivuno okanye irisithi. Gcina iiyunithi zawo: isixha asiyikhilogram. Umqolo wesivuno urekhoda imveliso, hayi imali efunyenweyo. Ii-invoyisi ezihlawuliweyo zisebenzisa umhla wentlawulo orekhodiweyo; ii-invoyisi ezingahlawulwanga aziyongeniso yemali apha.

english: View summary shows monthly income, costs and balance. The cash summary covers up to twelve months including the current month, starting no earlier than the first dated sale, paid invoice or cost in your records.
isixhosa_draft: U-Jonga isishwankathelo ubonisa ingeniso yenyanga, iindleko nebhalansi. Isishwankathelo semali sigubungela ukuya kutsho kwiinyanga ezilishumi elinesibini kuquka inyanga yangoku, siqala kungekho phambi kwentengiso yokuqala enomhla, i-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo okanye indleko kwiirekhodi zakho.

english: The harvest and sales track record can cover different dates from the monthly cash summary. Read the dates in each section. A blank or zero in these records does not prove that nothing happened outside the app.
isixhosa_draft: Irekhodi lesivuno nentengiso lingagubungela imihla eyahlukileyo kunesishwankathelo semali yenyanga. Funda imihla kwicandelo ngalinye. Isikhewu okanye zero kwezi rekhodi akubonisi ukuba akukho nto yenzeke ngaphandle kwe-app.

english: Keep invoices, receipts and checked payment records beside the exported files. A CSV does not include the original receipt pictures or complete invoice documents.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ii-invoyisi, iirisithi neerekhodi zentlawulo ezihloliweyo ecaleni kweefayile ezithunyelwe ngaphandle. I-CSV ayiquleki imifanekiso yoqobo yeerisithi okanye amaxwebhu epheleleyo e-invoyisi.

english: Write down missing costs, unpaid amounts and records entered late. The harvest and cost forms use the entry date, so keep the original event date in your supporting papers too.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala iindleko ezilahlekileyo, izixa ezingahlawulwanga neerekhodi ezifakwe kamva. Iifom zesivuno neendleko zisebenzisa umhla wengeniso, ngoko gcina umhla woqobo wesiganeko namaphepha akho axhasayo nawo.

english: Income minus the costs entered is not complete profit or your bank balance. The app cannot include costs you have not recorded, or check your bank for you. Explain what is missing instead of filling gaps with guesses.
isixhosa_draft: Ingeniso kuthatyathwe iindleko ezifakiweyo asiyiyo inzuzo epheleleyo okanye ibhalansi yebhanki yakho. I-app ayinakubandakanya iindleko ongazirekhodanga, okanye ikhangele ibhanki yakho. Chaza oko kusilelayo endaweni yokuzalisa izikhewu ngeengcinga.

english: The exports summarise entered records. They do not verify payment, certify complete accounts or establish eligibility for finance. Keep the evidence and unresolved questions available for the person helping you.
isixhosa_draft: Izinto ezithunyelwe ngaphandle zishwankathela iirekhodi ezifakiweyo. Azikuqinisekisi ukuhlawulwa, azingqinisisi iiakhawunti ezipheleleyo okanye azisekeli ukufanelekela ukuboleka. Gcina ubungqina nemibuzo engaxazululwanga ikhona kumntu okunceda.

english: The fieldwork queue and money book have separate save systems. No entries in the fieldwork queue does not prove that every financial record has synchronised. Follow the result shown by the feature you used.
isixhosa_draft: Umgca wemisebenzi yasentsimini nencwadi yemali zinezinkqubo zazo zokugcina ezahlukeneyo. Ukungabikho kwezinto ezifakiweyo kumgca wemisebenzi yasentsimini akubonisi ukuba zonke iirekhodi zemali zimanyaniswe. Landela isiphumo esibonisiweyo yinkqubo oyisebenzisileyo.

english:
A brief says what the design should help people do. Begin by listening. Ask who uses the place, what is already working and what is difficult. Ask about food, movement, care work and what people want to protect. People may value privacy, a familiar gathering place or a clear route as much as another growing area.

Include the people who do the work. Do not ask only the person who speaks first. A proposal that relies on another person's daily labour needs their agreement. Ask what happens when the usual carer is away. Keep private household information out of a public course example.

Separate a need from an idea. “We need a reliable way to water the existing garden” states a need. “We need a new tank” suggests one possible response. The response still needs information about supply, demand, location, cost and care. Drawing it does not answer those questions.

Write the priorities in plain language, or record them with consent as an oral explanation. Say what is outside this first phase. Record available resources as known, reported or still unknown. Read the brief back to the household and invite corrections. Disagreement is useful information; do not hide it to finish the sheet.
isixhosa_draft:
Isishwankathelo sithi uyilo lufanele lunceda abantu benze ntoni. Qala ngokumamela. Buza ukuba ngubani osebenzisa indawo, yintoni esele isebenza kakuhle nokuba yintoni enzima. Buza ngokutya, ukuhamba, umsebenzi wonophelo nezinto abantu abafuna ukuzikhusela. Abantu banokuxabisa ubumfihlo, indawo yokuhlanganisana eqhelekileyo okanye indlela ecacileyo ngokulingana nenye indawo yokutyala.

Bandakanya abantu abenza umsebenzi. Musa ukubuza kuphela umntu othetha kuqala. Isiphakamiso esixhomekeke emsebenzini wemihla ngemihla womnye umntu sifuna imvume yakhe. Buza ukuba kwenzeka ntoni xa umnonopheli oqhelekileyo engekho. Gcina iinkcukacha zangasese zekhaya zingafakwa kumzekelo wekhosi wesidlangalala.

Wahlula isidingo kwingcamango. “Sifuna indlela ethembekileyo yokunisela igadi esele ikho” ichaza isidingo. “Sifuna itanki entsha” icebisa impendulo enye enokwenzeka. Impendulo isadinga ulwazi ngokubakho, imfuno, indawo, indleko nonophelo. Ukuyizoba akuyiphenduli le mibuzo.

Bhala izinto eziphambili ngolwimi olulula, okanye uzirekhode ngemvume njengenkcazo ethethwayo. Yitsho okungaphandle kwesi sigaba sokuqala. Rekhoda izixhobo ezikhoyo njengezaziwayo, ezibikiweyo okanye ezisengaziwa. Funda isishwankathelo ubuyisele kwikhaya uze umemele ukulungiswa. Ukungavumelani lulwazi oluluncedo; ungakufihli ukugqiba iphepha.

english: BRIEF-A in the busy-yard case prioritises food, clear access and manageable care. The household has not asked for animals. RESOURCES-A has no budget or care-time figures. The learner writes “confirm care time and costs”, not an invented amount, and keeps the route in the brief.
isixhosa_draft: I-BRIEF-A kwityala legceke elixakekileyo ibeka phambili ukutya, ufikelelo olucacileyo nonophelo oluphathekayo. Ikhaya alicelanga zilwanyana. I-RESOURCES-A ayinabhajethi okanye amanani exesha lonophelo. Umfundi ubhala “qinisekisa ixesha lonophelo neendleko”, hayi isixa esiyilisiweyo, aze agcine indlela kwisishwankathelo.

english:
A first idea is a starting point. Make different concept arrangements while changes are still easy. Keep the same brief, base map and evidence for each. A comparison is unfair if one option receives an imaginary water supply or unpaid labour while the other must use the recorded resources.

A concept shows the main relationships and intended uses. It does not yet settle every dimension or technical detail. Use a proposal overlay so existing features remain visible. Label what is retained, changed, added or deferred. Keep unresolved matters beside the affected part of each option.

Make the alternatives genuinely useful. They might compare improving an existing growing area with relocating it, or a modest first phase with later expansion. Do not make one option deliberately foolish so your favourite wins. Keeping the present arrangement while gathering evidence can also be a reasonable option.
isixhosa_draft:
Umbono wokuqala yindawo yokuqalisa. Yenza iingcamango ezahlukeneyo zolungiselelo ngoxa utshintsho lusakhona lula. Gcina isishwankathelo esinye, imephu esisiseko nobungqina obufanayo kwenye nganye. Uthelekiso alunabulungisa ukuba enye inketho ifumana amanzi aqanjiweyo okanye umsebenzi ongahlawulelwanga ngoxa enye kufuneka isebenzise izixhobo ezirekhodiweyo.

Ingcamango ibonisa unxulumano oluphambili nokusetyenziswa okuhlosiweyo. Ayikagqibi yonke imilinganiselo okanye inkcukacha zobugcisa. Sebenzisa ishiti yesiphakamiso ukuze iimpawu ezikhoyo zihlale zibonakala. Phawula oko kugcinwayo, kutshintshwayo, kongezwayo okanye kubambezelwayo. Gcina imiba engaxazululwanga ecaleni kwecandelo elichaphazelekayo kwinketho nganye.

Yenza ezinye iinketho zibe luncedo ngokwenene. Zinokuthelekisa ukuphucula indawo yokutyala esele ikho nokuyithuthela kwenye indawo, okanye inqanaba lokuqala elilinganiselweyo nokwandiswa kamva. Musa ukwenza enye inketho ibe buthuka ngabom ukuze eyona uyithandayo iphumelele. Ukugcina ulungiselelo lwangoku ngoxa uqokelela ubungqina nako kunokuba yinketho elungileyo.

english: Busy-yard concept A improves care of the existing patch while preserving access. Concept B investigates a different location, also preserving access. B must still answer the water report, shade, soil, measurement and care questions; A must still answer whether the existing patch can meet the household's priorities. Neither receives a promised harvest or invented cost advantage.
isixhosa_draft: Ingcamango A yegceke elixakekileyo iphucula unonophelo lwendawo esele ikho ngoxa igcina ufikelelo. Ingcamango B iphanda enye indawo, nayo igcina ufikelelo. I-B kufuneka isaphendula imibuzo ngengxelo yamanzi, umthunzi, umhlaba, ukulinganisa nonophelo; i-A kufuneka isaphendula ukuba indawo esele ikho inokuhlangabezana neenjongo eziphambili zekhaya. Akukho nenye efumana isivuno esithenjisiweyo okanye inzuzo yeendleko eqanjiweyo.

english: Can a concept be called cheaper when its material quantities and costs are missing?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ingcamango inokubizwa ngokuba ayibizi kangako ngoxa ubungakanani bezixhobo neendleko zayo zilahlekile?

english: no. **Reason:** “cost unknown” must stay visible until a comparable estimate is supported.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** “akwaziwa ukuba zingakanani iindleko” kufuneka ihlale ibonakala kude kuxhaswe uqikelelo olunokuthelekiswa.

english:
Compare the options against the criteria you wrote from the brief. Start with needs that cannot be traded away: usable access, agreed care, required permissions and a proposal's basic suitability. Then consider benefits, burdens, costs and what may change over time.

Use words and evidence references. “Possible, but water evidence is missing” is more honest than a precise-looking score with no basis. If you use a scoring exercise, agree what each score means and who chooses the priorities. Adding scores must not cancel an unresolved safety or permission requirement.

Ask the household to explain the choice in its own words. A designer's preference should not quietly replace the household's priorities. Record why an option was chosen, why another was set aside and what new information could change the decision. A conditional choice is valid when its condition is clear and the affected work waits.
isixhosa_draft:
Thelekisa iinketho nemigangatho oyibhale kwisishwankathelo. Qala ngeemfuno ezingenakutshintshiselwa ngenye into: ufikelelo olusebenzayo, unonophelo olwavunyelwanayo, iimvume ezifunekayo nokufaneleka okusisiseko kwesiphakamiso. Emva koko qwalasela iinzuzo, imithwalo, iindleko nento enokutshintsha ngokuhamba kwexesha.

Sebenzisa amagama neencwadi zobungqina. “Kunokwenzeka, kodwa ubungqina bamanzi bulahlekile” kunyanisekile ngakumbi kunenqaku elibonakala lichanekile ngaphandle kwesiseko. Ukuba usebenzisa umsebenzi wokunika amanqaku, vumelanani ukuba inqaku ngalinye sithetha ntoni nokuba ngubani okhetha izinto eziphambili. Ukudibanisa amanqaku akufuneki kurhoxise imfuno engaxazululwanga yokhuseleko okanye imvume.

Cela ikhaya lichaze ukhetho ngamazwi alo. Okuthandwa ngumyili akufuneki kutshintshe ngokuthe cwaka izinto eziphambili zekhaya. Rekhoda ukuba kutheni inketho enye ikhethwe, kutheni enye ibekwe ecaleni nokuba loluphi ulwazi olutsha olunokutshintsha isigqibo. Ukhetho olunemiqathango luvumelekile xa umqathango ucacile kwaye umsebenzi ochaphazelekayo ulinda.

english: The busy-yard household provisionally prefers investigating improvements to the existing patch because the brief values manageable care and keeping access. This is not proof of lower cost or higher yield. Relocation remains available if later measurements or site assessment show the existing patch cannot meet the brief.
isixhosa_draft: Ikhaya legceke elixakekileyo lithanda okwexeshana ukuphanda uphuculo lwendawo esele ikho kuba isishwankathelo sixabisa unonophelo oluphathekayo nokugcina ufikelelo. Oku akubobungqina beendleko eziphantsi okanye isivuno esiphezulu. Ukuthuthela kwenye indawo kuhlala kukhona ukuba imilinganiselo yamva okanye uvavanyo lwendawo lubonisa ukuba indawo esele ikho ayinakuhlangabezana nesishwankathelo.

english: The busy-yard proposal keeps the route visible, but the learner still checks it with its users. A new tank remains only an idea: water demand, supply, siting, support, cost and overflow are not established. The design can progress in other areas while that proposal remains unresolved.
isixhosa_draft: Isiphakamiso segceke elixakekileyo sigcina indlela ibonakala, kodwa umfundi usayikhangela nabayisebenzisayo. Itanki entsha ihlala iyingcamango nje: imfuno yamanzi, ukubakho, ukubeka, ukuxhasa, indleko nokuphuphuma azikaqinisekiswa. Uyilo lunokuqhubela phambili kwezinye iindawo ngoxa esi siphakamiso singaxazululwanga.

english: Mapping, design and exports guides. Compare the saved dimensions and exported view; preserve the original geometry when improving presentation. No paid render is required.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yemephu, uyilo nokuthumela ngaphandle. Thelekisa imilinganiselo egciniweyo nembonakalo ethunyelwe ngaphandle; gcina ijometri yoqobo xa uphucula ukubonisa. Akukho mfanekiso uhlawulelwa ofunekayo.

english: The drawing includes a tank and fence, but the budget has only a plant purchase. Does the budget describe the plan?
isixhosa_draft: Umzobo uquka itanki nothango, kodwa ibhajethi inokuthenga isityalo kuphela. Ingaba ibhajethi ichaza isicwangciso?

english:
Give proposed items consistent references across the plan and cost record. Derive quantities from a checked design or record their source. Keep unknown quantities unknown. Ask for suitable quotations when a purchase is being considered; do not turn a remembered price into a current supplier offer.

Include the work and supporting materials needed for the proposal, not only its most visible object. Separate one-time purchases from ongoing care costs. Record household contributions honestly. A donated material can still require transport, preparation or maintenance; a volunteer's time still needs agreement.

The date money is needed matters. A future sale does not pay today's bill unless funding is actually available. Use the finance lessons to keep budgets, dated cash forecasts, actual payments and amounts owed distinct. Do not count a hoped-for harvest as confirmed cash or a device-generated plan as proof of profitability.
isixhosa_draft:
Nika izinto ezicetywayo izalathiso ezingaguquki kwisicwangciso nakwirekhodi leendleko. Fumana ubungakanani kuyilo oluhloliweyo okanye urekhode umthombo wabo. Gcina ubungakanani obungaziwayo bungaziwa. Cela amaxabiso afanelekileyo xa kuqwalaselwa ukuthenga; musa ukuguqula ixabiso elikhunjulwayo libe sisicelo somthengisi sangoku.

Bandakanya umsebenzi nezixhobo ezixhasayo ezifunekayo kwisiphakamiso, hayi kuphela into yaso ebonakala kakhulu. Wahlula ukuthenga kanye kwiindleko zonophelo oluqhubekayo. Rekhoda igalelo lekhaya ngokunyanisekileyo. Isixhobo esiphiweyo sisenokufuna ukuthuthwa, ukulungiswa okanye ukugcinwa; ixesha lomntu ozinikeleyo lisadinga ukuvunyelwana ngalo.

Umhla imali efunekayo kuwo uyabaluleka. Intengiso yexesha elizayo ayihlawuli ibhili yanamhlanje ngaphandle kokuba inkxaso-mali ikhona ngokwenene. Sebenzisa izifundo zemali ukugcina iibhajethi, uqikelelo lwemali olunemihla, iintlawulo zokwenyani nezixa ezisafunekayo zahlukile. Musa ukubala isivuno olunqwenelekayo njengemali eqinisekileyo okanye isicwangciso esenziwe sisixhobo njengobungqina benzuzo.

english: RESOURCES-A contains no prices, quantities or committed labour. The busy-yard learner creates an unknown-cost register with evidence needed for each proposed change. They cannot claim that concept A is affordable merely because it retains the old patch.
isixhosa_draft: I-RESOURCES-A ayinamaxabiso, ubungakanani okanye umsebenzi obophelelweyo. Umfundi wegceke elixakekileyo wenza irejista yeendleko ezingaziwayo enobungqina obufunekayo kutshintsho ngalunye olucetywayo. Akanakuthi ingcamango A iyabhatalelwa nje kuba igcina indawo endala.

english: Choose a proposed item and trace it from the plan to its quantity source, quotation or unknown, payment timing and care cost. State what the current record includes and excludes. Compare the first phase with available resources before committing to it.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha into ecetywayo uyilandele ukusuka kwisicwangciso ukuya kumthombo wobungakanani bayo, ixabiso elicetyiswayo okanye ingaziwa, ixesha lentlawulo neendleko zonophelo. Chaza oko irekhodi langoku liquka nokungaquki. Thelekisa inqanaba lokuqala nezixhobo ezikhoyo phambi kokuzibophelela kulo.

english: The plan and budget describe the same scope; the learner preserves exclusions, unknowns and cash timing. No purchase is needed to demonstrate the method.
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso nebhajethi zichaza ububanzi obufanayo; umfundi ugcina izinto ezishiyiweyo, ezingaziwayo nexesha lemali. Akukho kuthenga okufunekayo ukubonisa indlela.

english: Should an unpriced item be entered as zero to make the total work?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba into engenaxabiso kufuneka ifakwe njengo-zero ukuze isixa sisebenze?

english: Finance, expenses and crop-planning guides. Use classroom/sample records for practice and keep unknowns visible where an app field cannot represent them safely. The guide is not a substitute for the design's care plan.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yemali, iindleko nocwangciso lwezityalo. Sebenzisa iirekhodi zeklasi/zomzekelo ukuziqhelisa uze ugcine ezingaziwayo zibonakala apho indawo ye-app ingakwazi ukuzimela ngokukhuselekileyo. Umhlahlandlela awuthathi ndawo yesicwangciso sonophelo soyilo.

english:
Decide what to observe from the goals in the brief. If access was a priority, ask its users whether the route works and observe it under relevant conditions. If care was a concern, record the tasks and difficulties. A harvest record can inform food production, but it does not alone prove improved household nutrition or income.

Keep a starting record so later observations have context. Record what was actually implemented, when, and any changes from the plan. Note the conditions and other events that may influence the result. Do not attribute every improvement or setback to the design without considering other explanations.

A short course cannot show a whole seasonal outcome. Agree a follow-up appropriate to the decision and the situation, with actual dates set during delivery. If no implementation has occurred, assess the plan and reasoning as such. Do not substitute a generated picture or imagined harvest for observed results.
isixhosa_draft:
Gqiba ukuba ujonge ntoni kwiinjongo ezikwisishwankathelo. Ukuba ufikelelo lwaluyimfuno ephambili, buza abalusebenzisayo ukuba indlela iyasebenza na, uyijonge phantsi kweemeko ezifanelekileyo. Ukuba unonophelo lwalusisikhalazo, rekhoda imisebenzi neengxaki. Irekhodi lesivuno lingaxelela imveliso yokutya, kodwa lodwa alubonisi ukuphuculwa kokondla ikhaya okanye ingeniso.

Gcina irekhodi lokuqala ukuze ukujonga kwamva kube nomxholo. Rekhoda oko kwenziwe ngokwenene, nini, nayiphi na intshukumo ekude kwisicwangciso. Phawula iimeko neminye imicimbi enokuchaphazela isiphumo. Musa ukunika uyilo sonke isiphumo esihle okanye esibi ngaphandle kokuqwalasela ezinye iingcaciso.

Ikhosi emfutshane ayinakubonisa isiphumo sexesha lonyaka lonke. Vumelanani ngolandelelo olufanelekileyo kwisigqibo nemeko, ngemihla yokwenyani emiswe ngexesha lokuhanjiswa. Ukuba akukho kuphunyezwa kwenzekileyo, vavanya isicwangciso nokuqiqa kwaso njengoko injalo. Musa ukubeka umfanekiso owenziweyo okanye isivuno esicingelwayo endaweni yeziphumo ezijongiweyo.

english: Does a photograph establish that income increased?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ifoto iseka ukuba ingeniso inyukile?

english: If later busy-yard evidence shows that the preferred option cannot preserve access, the learner returns to the alternatives. That is a conditional teaching example, not a reported event. The revision would update the plan, decision record, cost scope and care discussion together.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba ubungqina bamva begceke elixakekileyo bubonisa ukuba inketho ekhethiweyo ayinakugcina ufikelelo, umfundi ubuyela kwezinye iinketho. Lo ngumzekelo wokufundisa onemiqathango, hayi isiganeko esibikiweyo. Uhlaziyo lwaluya kuhlaziya isicwangciso, irekhodi lesigqibo, ububanzi beendleko nengxoxo yonophelo kunye.

english: no. **Reason:** linked quantities, cost assumptions and implementation information must also be checked.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** ubungakanani obuhlanganisiweyo, iingcinga zeendleko nolwazi lokuphunyezwa nazo kufuneka zikhangelwe.

english: All people, observations and events below are invented for classroom discussion. They are not a report of a real household or evidence of an intervention's success. There are no supplied dimensions, rainfall totals, water quantities, costs, yields or plant identities. Do not infer them from a future illustration.
isixhosa_draft: Bonke abantu, ukujonga nemicimbi engezantsi iyilisiwe ukuxoxwa eklasini. Ayingingxelo yekhaya lokwenyani okanye ubungqina bempumelelo yongenelelo. Akukho milinganiselo, izixa zemvula, ubungakanani bamanzi, iindleko, izivuno okanye ukuchongwa kwezityalo okunikeziweyo. Musa ukuzikhupha kumfanekiso wexesha elizayo.

english:
Concept A investigates improving care of the existing patch. Concept B investigates a different location while retaining the access route. Both must meet BRIEF-A. A has not been shown to cost less; B has not been shown to produce more. Both still need the resource and site checks recorded in D1–D2. The provisional preference for investigating A is based on manageable care and existing access, not an invented performance advantage. Do not add new dimensions or resource quantities silently. When a later source card supplies information, identify what changed, why it is credible within the case and which earlier decision it affects.

A completed worked example must eventually show a scaled source pack, concept comparison, developed layout, dependencies and care, a cost/unknown record and a revision after feedback. This file currently supplies the brief, analysis and conditional concept comparison; it is not that completed example. D4–D6 lesson text is drafted, but the measured demonstration, actual plan set and supplied later-evidence/revision exercise remain unfinished.
isixhosa_draft:
Ingcamango A iphanda ukuphucula unonophelo lwendawo esele ikho. Ingcamango B iphanda enye indawo ngoxa igcina indlela yofikelelo. Zombini kufuneka zihlangabezane ne-BRIEF-A. I-A ayikabonisiwe ukuba ibiza kancinci; i-B ayikabonisiwe ukuba ivelisa kakhulu. Zombini zisazidinga izixhobo nokukhangela indawo okurekhodwe kwi-D1–D2. Ukhetho lwexeshana lokuphanda i-A lusekelwe kunonophelo oluphathekayo nofikelelo olukhoyo, hayi into eyilisiweyo yokusebenza. Musa ukongeza imilinganiselo emitsha okanye ubungakanani bezixhobo ngokuthe cwaka. Xa ikhadi lomthombo lamva linika ulwazi, chonga oko kutshintshileyo, kutheni kuthembekile ngaphakathi kwetyala nesigqibo sangaphambili esichaphazelekayo.

Umzekelo osonjululweyo ogqityiweyo kufuneka ekugqibeleni ubonise ipakethe yomthombo osikaliweyo, uthelekiso lweengcamango, uyilo olwandisiweyo, ukuxhomekeka nonophelo, irekhodi leendleko/lengaziwayo nohlaziyo emva kwempendulo. Le fayile okwangoku inika isishwankathelo, uhlalutyo noluhlu lweengcamango ezinemiqathango; asingumzekelo ogqityiweyo. Isicatshulwa sesifundo se-D4–D6 sibhalwe, kodwa umboniso olinganisiweyo, iseti yesicwangciso sokwenyani nomsebenzi onikezelwe wobungqina bamva/wohlaziyo zisengagqitywanga.

english: Put down the opening-balance card: R1,000. Add C01, the owner's R300 contribution. Count R1,300. Put C01 under “Owner added money”, not “Produce sold”. Remove C02, R120 paid for packaging: R1,180 remains. Add C03, R200 cash sale: R1,380 remains. Point back to the reasons, not only the final total.
isixhosa_draft: Beka ikhadi lebhalansi yokuqala: R1,000. Yongeza i-C01, igalelo likamnini elingu-R300. Bala R1,300. Beka i-C01 phantsi kwa-“Imali engeziwe ngumnini”, hayi “Imveliso ethengisiweyo”. Susa i-C02, i-R120 ehlawulelwe ukupakisha: kusala i-R1,180. Yongeza i-C03, intengiso yemali engqo ye-R200: kusala i-R1,380. Khomba ubuyele kwizizathu, hayi isixa sokugqibela kuphela.

english: Give learners C05, C06, C08 and C10 below. Use the headings “Household withdrawal”, “Borrowing”, “Equipment purchase” and “Loan repayment and interest”. Ask which change cash. All four do. Ask whether any is another produce sale. None is. Do not calculate final accounting profit from these headings. Loan principal, interest and equipment need different treatment in full accounts; F6 and F7 develop that distinction.
isixhosa_draft: Nika abafundi i-C05, i-C06, i-C08 ne-C10 ngezantsi. Sebenzisa izihloko “Imali ethathwe yikhaya”, “Imboleko”, “Ukuthenga izixhobo” kunye “Nokubuyisela imboleko nenzala”. Buza ukuba zeziphi ezitshintsha imali engqo. Zozine ziyatshintsha. Buza ukuba ikhona na kuzo eyenye intengiso yemveliso. Akukho. Musa ukubala inzuzo yokugqibela yeeakhawunti kwezi zihloko. Isixa seboleko esiphambili, inzala nezixhobo zidinga unyango oluhlukileyo kwiiakhawunti ezipheleleyo; i-F6 ne-F7 ziphuhlisa loo mahluko.

english: A grower sells produce for R90 and then takes R30 home. Ask separately: “What was the sale?” and “How much of that cash remains at the farm?” Answers: R90 sale; R60 remains from that receipt. R60 is not the sale value and is not a calculation of profit. Then ask where the R30 should be visible: in the household-withdrawal record.
isixhosa_draft: Umtyali uthengisa imveliso nge-R90 aze athathe i-R30 ayise ekhaya. Buza ngokwahlukeneyo: “Yayiyintoni intengiso?” kunye “Mingaphi imali ekhoyo efameni kuloo mali ifunyenweyo?” Iimpendulo: intengiso ye-R90; kusala i-R60 kuloo mali ifunyenwe. I-R60 ayilixabiso lentengiso kwaye ayibalo lwenzuzo. Emva koko buza ukuba i-R30 kufuneka ibonakale phi: kwirekhodi yemali ethathwe yikhaya.

english: If the learner reports a R60 sale, place the buyer's R90 payment card beside the R30 withdrawal card. Keep both events visible and ask again. If the learner calls the contribution a sale, ask what produce the owner bought. In this card they bought none.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi uxela intengiso ye-R60, beka ikhadi lentlawulo yomthengi ye-R90 ecaleni kwekhadi lemali ethathiweyo ye-R30. Gcina zombini iziganeko zibonakala uphinde ubuze. Ukuba umfundi uyibiza igalelo ngokuba yintengiso, buza ukuba umnini wathenga yiphi imveliso. Kweli khadi akathengi nto.

english: Make headings for farm sales, farm purchases, owner contributions and household withdrawals in a notebook. Use a private record or new practice cards. No personal amounts need to be shared in class.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza izihloko zeentengiso zefama, iindleko zefama, igalelo likamnini nemali ethathwe yikhaya kwincwadi yokubhala. Sebenzisa irekhodi lengasese okanye amakhadi amatsha okuziqhelisa. Akukho mali yomntu ezakwabelwana ngayo eklasini.

english: Make three cards: “Sales”, “Cash tin” and “Buyer owes”. Start after C03, with sales R200, cash R1,380 and nothing owed. Read C04: delivered produce worth R150, buyer pays later. Sales become R350; buyer owes R150; cash stays R1,380. Do not move a cash token. Later, read C07: buyer pays that same R150. Move the owed token to “Settled” and add cash once. Sales remain R350. Keep the invoice reference S02 on both cards so the connection is visible.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza amakhadi amathathu: “Iintengiso”, “Ithini yemali” kunye “Umthengi unetyala”. Qala emva kwe-C03, ngeentengiso ze-R200, imali ye-R1,380 kwaye akukho tyala. Funda i-C04: imveliso ehanjisiweyo ye-R150, umthengi uhlawula kamva. Iintengiso ziba yi-R350; umthengi unetyala le-R150; imali ihleli ibe yi-R1,380. Musa ukuhambisa isiphawuli semali. Kamva, funda i-C07: umthengi uhlawula leyo R150 enye. Hambisa isiphawuli sesixa esisafunekayo uye kwa-“Kuhlawulwe” uze wongeze imali kanye. Iintengiso zihleli zibe yi-R350. Gcina isalathiso se-invoyisi i-S02 kumakhadi omabini ukuze unxulumano lubonakale.

english: Work through the event table in order. At the end, sales are R470, cash received from buyers is R350 and buyers still owe R120. Ask the learner to point to S03, which explains that difference. Do not call the R1,380 closing cash profit: it includes opening cash, the owner's contribution and borrowing, and this pack does not supply all production costs, stock or equipment-use information.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenza ngetafile yeziganeko ngokulandelelana. Ekupheleni, iintengiso zi-R470, imali efunyenwe kubathengi yi-R350 yaye abathengi basatyala i-R120. Cela umfundi akhombe i-S03, echaza loo mahluko. Musa ukubiza imali yokuvala ye-R1,380 ngokuba yinzuzo: iquka imali yokuqala, igalelo likamnini nemboleko, yaye eli pakethe alinikezeli yonke indleko zemveliso, isitokhwe okanye ulwazi lokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo.

english: A buyer receives produce for R240. They pay R100 now and agree to pay R140 later. Ask for sale value, payment received and amount still owed. Answers: R240, R100 and R140. The current app has paid-in-full/unpaid invoice status, not a partial-payment ledger. Keep this exercise in the workbook; do not mark the full invoice paid or create another sale to force the app to show the balance.
isixhosa_draft: Umthengi wamkela imveliso ye-R240. Uhlawula i-R100 ngoku avume ukuhlawula i-R140 kamva. Cela ixabiso lentengiso, intlawulo efunyenwe nesixa esisafunekayo. Iimpendulo: i-R240, i-R100 ne-R140. I-app yangoku inemeko ye-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo yonke/ engahlawulwanga, hayi incwadi yeentlawulo ezinxalenye. Gcina lo msebenzi kwincwadi yomsebenzi; musa ukuphawula yonke i-invoyisi njengehlawuliweyo okanye wenze enye intengiso ukunyanzela i-app ibonise ibhalansi.

english: If cash is given as R240, cover the unpaid R140 card and ask what money arrived. If sales are given as R340, place the payment beneath its existing sale instead of adding it as a new sale. Check with a new example, R180 sale and R60 received: R120 remains owed.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba imali engqo inikwa njenge-R240, gubungela ikhadi le-R140 elingahlawulwanga ubuze ukuba yeyiphi imali efikileyo. Ukuba iintengiso zinikwa njenge-R340, beka intlawulo phantsi kwentengiso yayo ekhoyo endaweni yokuyongeza njengentengiso entsha. Hlola ngomzekelo omtsha, intengiso ye-R180 ne-R60 efunyenwe: i-R120 isafuneka.

english: Read [Make and manage an invoice](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices). In the existing sample tour, identify the unpaid/paid-in-full choice and the route for linking an existing sale. Do not enter this entire workbook as crop sales: borrowing and household transfers are different events. The published guide currently teaches text and practice, not a narrated screen recording.
isixhosa_draft: Funda [Yenza uze ulawule i-invoyisi](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices). Kukhenketho lomzekelo olukhoyo, chonga ukhetho lwehlawuliweyo/engahlawulwanga nendlela yokunxulumanisa intengiso ekhoyo. Musa ukufaka lonke olu ncwadi lomsebenzi njengeentengiso zezityalo: imboleko nokuhanjiswa kwekhaya ziziganeko ezahlukeneyo. Umhlahlandlela opapashiweyo okwangoku ufundisa umbhalo nokuziqhelisa, hayi irekhodi lesikrini elibaliswayo.

english: Using practice or redacted evidence, connect one sale to its payment. Preserve both dates when they differ. If the payment cannot be found, keep the status unresolved and name the evidence you need.
isixhosa_draft: Usebenzisa ubungqina bokuziqhelisa okanye obucinyiweyo, nxulumanisa intengiso enye nentlawulo yayo. Gcina yomibini imihla xa ihluka. Ukuba intlawulo ayifumaneki, gcina imeko ingaxazululwanga ubize ubungqina obuyidingayo.

english: Place S02, “Delivered sale R150 on Day 3”, beside C07, “Payment R150 on Day 6 for S02”. Draw a line between their references. A duplicate card says “New produce sale R150 on Day 6” but shows the same payment reference. Ask what new delivery it proves. None. On the practice worksheet, cross out the duplicate, retain a short correction note and recalculate sales. Do not prescribe deleting real transactions without checking linked invoice behaviour.
isixhosa_draft: Beka i-S02, “Intengiso ehanjisiweyo ye-R150 ngoSuku 3”, ecaleni kwe-C07, “Intlawulo ye-R150 ngoSuku 6 ye-S02”. Zoba umgca phakathi kwezalathiso zazo. Ikhadi eliphindiweyo lithi “Intengiso entsha yemveliso ye-R150 ngoSuku 6” kodwa libonisa isalathiso sentlawulo esifanayo. Buza ukuba liqinisekisa uhanjiso olutsha olwluphi. Akukho. Kwiphepha lomsebenzi lokuziqhelisa, rhawula ikhadi eliphindiweyo, gcina inqaku elifutshane lolungiso uze ubale kwakhona iintengiso. Musa ukuyalela ukucinywa kwezinto zokwenyani ngaphandle kokukhangela indlela esebenza ngayo i-invoyisi exhunyiweyo.

english: Give these independent cards: (a) a receipt says 2.5 kg, entry says 2.5 bunches; (b) source says R12.50, entry says R125; (c) transport receipt missing, entry says zero. Learners identify the unit, decimal and missing-evidence errors. Correct (a) and (b) from their sources. For (c), leave the cost unknown until evidence is obtained; a plausible amount is not evidence. These are new error-finding exercises, not additional events in the cash table below.
