isixhosa_draft: Nika la makhadi azimeleyo: (a) irisithi ithi 2.5 kg, ingeniso ithi izixha ezi-2.5; (b) umthombo uthi R12.50, ingeniso ithi R125; (c) irisithi yokuthuthwa ilahlekile, ingeniso ithi zero. Abafundi bachonga iimpazamo zeyunithi, idesimali nobungqina obulahlekileyo. Lungisa i-(a) ne-(b) kwimithombo yazo. Kwi-(c), shiya indleko ingaziwa de kufunyanwe ubungqina; isixa esinokwenzeka asingobungqina. Ezi ziqhelo ezintsha zokufumana iimpazamo, hayi iziganeko ezongezelelweyo kwitafile yemali engezantsi.

english:
Use a notebook, calculator and the event cards below. Learners may point, sort or explain aloud. Read each card aloud before introducing a table. Do not ask anyone to reveal household income, borrowing, customer details or bank records to a group.

**Every amount below is invented solely for arithmetic practice.** These are neither local prices nor recommended budgets. “Day 1” through “Day 7” are an imaginary week. There is one practice farm, one owner and one cash tin. No bank account, tax, opening debt, opening customer balance, refunds or other cash movements are in this example. The opening R1,000 is counted money already in the tin, not a new sale. The cash result is complete for this deliberately bounded example; its production costs and profit are not complete.

Show each card's reference beside the written entry. All events and amounts are also available in [f1-practice.json](f1-practice.json). The JSON uses whole cents to keep arithmetic exact; learner-facing materials use rand and cents.
isixhosa_draft:
Sebenzisa incwadi yokubhala, ikhalkyuleyitha namakhadi eziganeko ngezantsi. Abafundi bangakhomba, bahlele okanye bachaze ngokuvakalayo. Funda ikhadi ngalinye ngokuvakalayo phambi kokwazisa itafile. Musa ukucela mntu ukuba abonise ingeniso yekhaya, imboleko, iinkcukacha zabathengi okanye iirekhodi zebhanki eqenjini.

**Zonke izixa ezingezantsi ziyilelwe ukuziqhelisa ubalo kuphela.** Aziyo mixabiso yalapha okanye iibhajethi ezicetyiswayo. “Usuku 1” ukuya “kuSuku 7” liveki eyilisiweyo. Kukho ifama enye yokuziqhelisa, umnini omnye kunye nethini yemali enye. Akukho akhawunti yebhanki, irhafu, ityala lokuqala, ibhalansi yomthengi yokuqala, imbuyiselo okanye ezinye iintshukumo zemali kulo mzekelo. I-R1,000 yokuqala yimali ebaliweyo esele ikwithini, hayi intengiso entsha. Isiphumo semali sipheleleyo kulo mzekelo ophetheke ngabom; indleko zemveliso nenzuzo yawo azipheleli.

Bonisa isalathiso sekhadi ngalinye ecaleni kwengeniso ebhaliweyo. Zonke iziganeko nezixa zikwafumaneka kwi-[f1-practice.json](f1-practice.json). I-JSON isebenzisa iisenti ezipheleleyo ukugcina ubalo luchanekile; izixhobo ezijolise kubafundi zisebenzisa irandi neesenti.

english: Put down four counters for opening stock, then add H01's 16 kg. Twenty kilograms are now available. Move six counters to Sold for delivery D01 and two to Home for HOME01. Twelve remain. Read the source reference as you write each row. The sold quantity belongs to sale S01; the home quantity is not another sale or a cash receipt.
isixhosa_draft: Beka iikhawunta ezine zesitokhwe sokuqala, uze wongeze iikhilogram ezi-16 ze-H01. Ngoku zikhona iikhilogram ezingamashumi amabini. Hambisa iikhawunta ezintandathu uye kwa-Kuthengisiwe zokuhanjiswa kwe-D01, ezibini uye kwa-Ekhaya zika-HOME01. Zisala ezilishumi elinesibini. Funda isalathiso somthombo njengoko ubhala umqolo ngamnye. Ubungakanani obuthengisiweyo bungobentengiso S01; ubungakanani bekhaya asiyontengiso enye okanye intlawulo yemali.

english: Use the worksheet's new 10 kg example. Ask the learner to show 3 kg sold, 2 kg used at home and 4 kg counted at closing. The record explains only 9 kg. One kilogram is unexplained. There is no loss note or second count yet, so “1 kg spoiled” is not a supported answer. Ask what could be checked: a repeat weighing, a missed gift or delivery record, the opening quantity and the units. Do not imply that every difference has the same cause.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa umzekelo omtsha we-10 kg wephepha lomsebenzi. Cela umfundi abonise i-3 kg ethengisiweyo, i-2 kg esetyenziswe ekhaya ne-4 kg ebaliweyo ekuvaleni. Irekhodi lichaza i-9 kg kuphela. Ikhilogram enye ayichazwanga. Akukho nqaku lelahleko okanye ukubala kwesibini okwangoku, ngoko “1 kg yonakele” asiyompendulo exhaswayo. Buza ukuba yintoni enokukhangelwa: ukupima kwakhona, irekhodi lesipho okanye lokuhanjiswa elilahlekileyo, ubungakanani bokuqala neeyunithi. Musa ukucebisa ukuba onke amahluko anesizathu esinye.

english: Read S02: 5 kg delivered on Day 2 for R100.00. Nothing is paid that day. Put R100.00 in “Buyer B owes”. On Day 4, PAY02 shows R60.00 received into the wallet for S02. Move R60.00 out of the owed amount and into wallet receipts; R40.00 remains owed. Sale value stays R100.00 and delivered weight stays 5 kg. The payment has not produced another delivery.
isixhosa_draft: Funda i-S02: 5 kg ehanjisiweyo ngoSuku 2 nge-R100.00. Akukho nto ihlawulwa ngaloo mini. Beka i-R100.00 kwa-“Umthengi B unetyala”. NgoSuku 4, i-PAY02 ibonisa i-R60.00 efunyenwe kwisipaji ye-S02. Susa i-R60.00 kwisixa esifunekayo uyibeke kwiirisithi zesipaji; i-R40.00 isafuneka. Ixabiso lentengiso lihlala li-R100.00 nobunzima obuhanjisiweyo busala bungu-5 kg. Intlawulo ayizange ivelise enye ihanjiso.

english: Before MOVE01 the cash tin holds R607.50 and the wallet R100.00. Move R100.00 from cash to the wallet. Cash becomes R507.50 and the wallet R200.00. Combined money remains R707.50. Keep both sides connected by MOVE01. This transfer is complete, with no fee attached in the supplied evidence. FEE01 is a separate Day 3 wallet charge of R2.50, not a guessed transfer cost. If a real transfer is pending, record and investigate that state; do not pretend the receiving account already has it.
isixhosa_draft: Phambi kwe-MOVE01 ithini yemali iphethe i-R607.50 nesipaji i-R100.00. Hambisa i-R100.00 ukusuka kwimali engqo uye kwisipaji. Imali engqo iba yi-R507.50 nesipaji i-R200.00. Imali edibeneyo isala i-R707.50. Gcina macala omabini exhunyiwe yi-MOVE01. Oku kuhanjiswa kugqityiwe, akukho ndleko inxulumene nako kubungqina obunikeziweyo. I-FEE01 yintlawulo eyahlukileyo yesipaji yoSuku 3 ye-R2.50, hayi indleko eqikelelwayo yokuhanjiswa. Ukuba ukuhanjiswa kokwenyani kulindile, rekhoda uze uphande loo meko; musa ukuzenza ngathi i-akhawunti yokwamkela sele inayo.

english: Complete all seven money rows. The farm receives R260.00 from buyers and pays R45.00 in documented costs. Combined money changes from R600.00 to R815.00. Sales total R300.00; R40.00 remains owed on S02. Neither R815.00 nor R215.00 is established accounting profit. The pack omits production costs and stock values needed for that conclusion.
isixhosa_draft: Gqiba yonke imiqolo esixhenxe yemali. Ifama yamkela i-R260.00 kubathengi yaye ihlawula i-R45.00 kwiindleko ezibhaliweyo. Imali edibeneyo itshintsha ukusuka kwi-R600.00 ukuya kwi-R815.00. Iintengiso zipheleleyo zi-R300.00; i-R40.00 isafuneka kwi-S02. Nokuba yi-R815.00 okanye i-R215.00 ayiyonzuzo yeeakhawunti esekiweyo. Ipakethe iyishiya iindleko zemveliso namaxabiso esitokhwe afunekayo kuloo sigqibo.

english: A new R90.00 sale has a R30.00 payment. Ask separately for the sale value, money received and amount owed: R90.00, R30.00 and R60.00. Then give the learner a new internal R20.00 transfer between accounts. The transfer alone changes neither total money nor sales. An independently documented R1.00 fee would reduce money by R1.00; it would not make the transfer itself a produce purchase. These are separate practice cases, not extra rows in the main tables.
isixhosa_draft: Intengiso entsha ye-R90.00 inentlawulo ye-R30.00. Buza ngokwahlukeneyo ixabiso lentengiso, imali efunyenwe nesixa esifunekayo: i-R90.00, i-R30.00 ne-R60.00. Emva koko nika umfundi ukuhanjiswa kwangaphakathi okutsha kwe-R20.00 phakathi kweeakhawunti. Ukuhanjiswa kodwa akutshintshi mali iphelele okanye iintengiso. Intlawulo ibhaliweyo ngokuzimeleyo ye-R1.00 yayiya kunciphisa imali nge-R1.00; ayiyi kwenza ukuhanjiswa ngokwayo kube kukuthenga imveliso. Ezi ziqhelo ezahlukeneyo, hayi imiqolo eyongezelelweyo kwiitafile eziphambili.

english: If the learner adds the transfer to income, move one physical token between the two account mats and ask how many tokens were created. If a part-payment settles the whole sale in their answer, place the R60.00 payment under the R100.00 sale and uncover the R40.00 gap. If cents disappear, compare PACK01's R12.50 with the written entry before recalculating.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi ongeza ukuhanjiswa kwingeniso, hambisa isiphawuli esinye somzimba phakathi kweemethi zeeakhawunti ezimbini ubuze zingaphi iiphawuli ezidalwe. Ukuba intlawulo enxalenye ihlawula yonke intengiso kwimpendulo yakhe, beka intlawulo ye-R60.00 phantsi kwentengiso ye-R100.00 uze uvule isikhewu se-R40.00. Ukuba iisenti ziyanyamalala, thelekisa i-R12.50 ye-PACK01 neengeniso ezibhaliweyo phambi kokubala kwakhona.

english: Use [Record a cost and keep its receipt](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) and [Make and manage an invoice](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices). The app currently offers unpaid or paid-in-full invoice status; it does not model the partial-payment or cash-tin/wallet ledgers in this exercise. Keep those in the workbook. Do not mark S02 paid in full, create another sale for its payment, or enter an own-account transfer as a crop sale to make the app resemble the worksheet.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa [Rekhoda indleko uze ugcine irisithi yayo](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) kunye [Nenza uze ulawule i-invoyisi](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices). I-app yangoku inika imeko ye-invoyisi engahlawulwanga okanye ehlawulwe yonke; ayilingisi iincwadi zentlawulo ezinxalenye okanye zethini yemali/isipaji kolu siqhelo. Gcina ezo kwincwadi yomsebenzi. Musa ukuphawula i-S02 ihlawulwe yonke, wenze enye intengiso ngentlawulo yayo, okanye ufake ukuhanjiswa kwe-akhawunti yakho njengentengiso yezityalo ukwenza i-app ifane nephepha lomsebenzi.

english: Use one approved practice or redacted sale and its payment evidence. Record the separate dates and account, match the reference, calculate any balance and name missing evidence. Do not contact a real buyer as part of this classroom task.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa intengiso enye evunyiweyo yokuziqhelisa okanye ecinyiweyo nobungqina bayo bentlawulo. Rekhoda imihla eyahlukileyo ne-akhawunti, uvumelanise isalathiso, ubale nayiphi na ibhalansi uze ubize ubungqina obulahlekileyo. Musa ukunxibelelana nomthengi wokwenyani njengenxalenye yalo msebenzi weklasi.

english: The practice book omits FEE01 and reports wallet money of R340.00. The supplied closing wallet statement shows R337.50. Compare the rows, find the R2.50 debit on that statement and add its missing source reference. The book now agrees with the statement. This correction is supported by FEE01, not by a made-up “balancing fee”. If the statement did not show the reason, the difference would remain unresolved.
isixhosa_draft: Incwadi yokuziqhelisa ayiyifaki i-FEE01 yaye ibika imali yesipaji ye-R340.00. Isitetimenti sesipaji sokuvala esinikeziweyo sibonisa i-R337.50. Thelekisa imiqolo, ufumane ukuhlawulwa kwe-R2.50 kuso isitetimenti uze wongeze isalathiso sayo somthombo esilahlekileyo. Incwadi ngoku ivumelana nesitetimenti. Olu lungiso luxhaswa yi-FEE01, hayi “yintlawulo yokulinganisa” eyilisiweyo. Ukuba isitetimenti besingayibonisi into eyenzekileyo, umahluko ngewuhleli ungaxazululwanga.

english: The worksheet gives an 8 kg record changed to “8 bunches”, a Day 2 delivery with a Day 4 payment, and a closing count that is still unexplained. The learner must keep the original measurement unit, preserve both event dates and leave the unknown cause unresolved. Being able to repeat the rule does not pass the task; they must find and explain each discrepancy on a fresh copy.
isixhosa_draft: Iphepha lomsebenzi linika irekhodi le-8 kg elitshintshelwe kwi-“izixha ezi-8”, ukuhanjiswa kwangoSuku 2 nentlawulo yoSuku 4, nokubala kokuvala okusengachazwanga. Umfundi kufuneka agcine iyunithi yokulinganisa yoqobo, agcine yomibini imihla yeziganeko, ashiye isizathu esingaziwayo singaxazululwanga. Ukwazi ukuphinda umthetho akuwuphumeleli lo msebenzi; kufuneka afumane aze achaze umahluko ngamnye kwikopi entsha.

english: If the learner changes a source document to fit the total, ask which record was the evidence and which was the copy. If they stop after totals agree, show two offsetting errors: an omitted R5.00 receipt and an omitted R5.00 payment. The net change is zero, but both records are still missing. Ask them to identify the missing events rather than congratulating a balanced total. These two example events are outside the main pack.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi utshintsha uxwebhu lomthombo ukuze lihambelane nesixa esipheleleyo, buza ukuba yeyiphi irekhodi ebiyibubungqina nokuba yeyiphi ibiyikopi. Ukuba uyeka emva kokuba izixa zivumelana, bonisa iimpazamo ezimbini ezirhoxisanayo: irisithi ye-R5.00 eshiyiweyo nentlawulo ye-R5.00 eshiyiweyo. Utshintsho olucocekileyo lungu-zero, kodwa zombini iirekhodi zisalahlekile. Mcele achonge iziganeko ezilahlekileyo kunokuvuyela isixa esilinganayo. Ezi ziganeko zimbini zomzekelo azikho kwipakethe ephambili.

english: The published guides provide save/reopen steps for harvests, costs and invoices. Practise through the existing sample tour in the same tab. The sample farm's edited data lives in memory: a full reload restores its starting data, although the tab can remain in sample mode. Reopening within the same session is the task here; sample persistence does not demonstrate real-account sync. On a real account, read pending/offline messages and check the saved result without entering the same event twice. The harvest list currently has no Edit control; keep the exact correction needed rather than inventing an adjustment harvest.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela epapashiweyo inika amanyathelo okugcina/okuvula kwakhona kwezivuno, iindleko nee-invoyisi. Ziqhelise ngokhenketho lomzekelo olukhoyo kwithebhu enye. Idatha ehlelwe yifama yomzekelo ihlala kwimemori: ukulayisha iphepha lonke kubuyisela idatha yokuqala, nangona ithebhu ingahlala kwimo yomzekelo. Ukuvula kwakhona ngaphakathi kweseshoni enye kwaba ngumsebenzi apha; ukuhlala kwemizekelo akubonisi ukumanyaniswa kwe-akhawunti yokwenyani. Kwi-akhawunti yokwenyani, funda imiyalezo elindileyo/engekho kwi-intanethi ukhangele isiphumo esigciniweyo ungafaki isiganeko esifanayo kabini. Uluhlu lwezivuno alunalo ulawulo lwa-Hlela okwangoku; gcina ulungiso oluchanekileyo oluyimfuneko kunokuyila isivuno solungiso.

english: Reconcile one small, agreed set of practice records. Mark each source as checked, record the differences, make only supported corrections and leave an unresolved list. Ask for bookkeeping help on treatment that you cannot establish. Do not show account numbers, payment access details or private customer information to the group.
isixhosa_draft: Vumelanisa isethi encinci evunyelweneyo yeerekhodi zokuziqhelisa. Phawula umthombo ngamnye njengohlolwe, rekhoda iyantlukwano, wenze kuphela ulungiso olunoxhaso uze ushiye uluhlu olungaxazululwanga. Cela uncedo lokugcina iincwadi ngonyango ongakwaziyo ukusiseka. Musa ukubonisa iinombolo ze-akhawunti, iinkcukacha zofikelelo lwentlawulo okanye ulwazi lwabathengi lwangasese eqenjini.

english:
Use the [learner worksheet](f2-worksheet.md) or [four-page printable workbook](../../../../output/pdf/finance-f2-workbook.pdf), a calculator, a notebook and counters representing kilograms and money. Read one event aloud at a time. Let learners point, sort cards, explain aloud or ask someone to write their answer. Introduce the second money account only after the learner can follow the cash tin. Keep real household finances, buyer details and payment credentials out of group exercises and screenshots.

All weights, prices, fees and amounts in this pack are invented for arithmetic practice. They are not local market evidence, recommended fees, budgets or yields. This is a separate four-day practice period for the fictional farm; do not carry forward or add F1's balances. The opening position is given: 4 kg of carrots already stored, R500.00 in a cash tin and R100.00 in a mobile-money wallet, with no buyer balance owed. No field area or production period is supplied, so no yield per area can be calculated.

The exercise tracks the same produce in comparable weighed condition. It excludes purchases, processing, refunds, unknown shrinkage, pending transfers, tax, loans and equipment. In real work, identify additional movements and changes in weighing conditions rather than forcing them into this example. No numerical loss allowance is recommended. Exact quantities are stored as whole grams and money as whole cents in [f2-practice.json](f2-practice.json); the teaching tables use kg and rand.
isixhosa_draft:
Sebenzisa [iphepha lomsebenzi lomfundi](f2-worksheet.md) okanye [incwadi yomsebenzi eshicilelwayo yamaphepha amane](../../../../output/pdf/finance-f2-workbook.pdf), ikhalkyuleyitha, incwadi yokubhala neekhawunta ezimele iikhilogram nemali. Funda isiganeko esinye ngexesha ngokuvakalayo. Vumela abafundi bakhombe, bahlele amakhadi, bachaze ngokuvakalayo okanye bacele omnye ukuba abhale impendulo yabo. Zisa i-akhawunti yesibini yemali emva kokuba umfundi ekwazi ukulandela ithini yemali. Gcina imali yokwenyani yekhaya, iinkcukacha zabathengi neenkcukacha zokufikelela kwintlawulo zingekho kwimisebenzi yeqela nakwimifanekiso yesikrini.

Wonke ubunzima, amaxabiso, iintlawulo zenkonzo nezixa kule pakethe ziyilelwe ukuziqhelisa ubalo. Aziyobungqina bemarike yalapha, iimali ezicetyiswayo, iibhajethi okanye izivuno. Eli lixesha elahlukileyo lokuziqhelisa leentsuku ezine lefama eyilelweyo; musa ukuthatha okanye ukudibanisa iibhalansi ze-F1. Isikhundla sokuqala sinikiwe: i-4 kg yeminqathe esele igciniwe, i-R500.00 ethinini yemali ne-R100.00 kwisipaji semali yefowuni, ngaphandle kwebhalansi yomthengi esafunekayo. Akukho ndawo yentsimi okanye ixesha lemveliso linikezelwayo, ngoko akukho sivuno ngendawo esinokubalwa.

Isiqhelo silandela imveliso enye kwimeko yokupimwa enokuthelekiswa. Asiquki ukuthenga, ukulungisa imveliso, imbuyiselo, ukunciphisa okungaziwayo, ukuhanjiswa kwemali okulindileyo, irhafu, iimboleko okanye izixhobo. Kumsebenzi wokwenyani, chonga ezinye iintshukumo notshintsho kwiimeko zokupima endaweni yokuzinyanzela kulo mzekelo. Akukho mvume yelahleko yamanani icetyiswayo. Ubungakanani obuchanekileyo bugcinwa njengeegram ezipheleleyo nemali njengeesenti ezipheleleyo kwi-[f2-practice.json](f2-practice.json); iitafile zokufundisa zisebenzisa i-kg nerandi.

english:
The learner passes the practical task by (a) tracing the 28 kg available into all destinations; (b) matching three sales to payments and retaining S02's R40.00 balance; (c) keeping the internal transfer out of sales and costs; (d) checking cents; and (e) explaining a supported correction and an unresolved difference. Offer a different example after feedback. A guessed zero for missing information or a total that only matches by cancelling errors is not successful reconciliation.

Worksheet answers: stock task 10 − 3 − 2 − 4 = 1 kg unexplained; payment task R90.00 − R30.00 = R60.00 owed; own-account transfer creates no extra combined money; independently documented R1.00 fee reduces it by R1.00. For the altered H02 unit, retain 8 kg from the weighing record. Keep Day 2 as delivery and Day 4 as payment. No evidence supports relabelling the unexplained kilogram as theft, spoilage or a gift.
isixhosa_draft:
Umfundi uphumelela umsebenzi osebenzayo ngokuthi (a) alandele i-28 kg ekhoyo kuzo zonke iindawo eziya kuzo; (b) ahambelanise iintengiso ezintathu neentlawulo agcine ibhalansi ye-R40.00 ye-S02; (c) agcine ukuhanjiswa kwangaphakathi ngaphandle kweentengiso neendleko; (d) akhangele iisenti; kwaye (e) achaze ulungiso olunoxhaso nomahluko ongaxazululwanga. Nika umzekelo owahlukileyo emva kwempendulo. Zero eqikelelwayo kulwazi olulahlekileyo okanye isixa esihambelana kuphela ngokurhoxisa iimpazamo asiyivumelanisi iphumeleleyo.

Iimpendulo zephepha lomsebenzi: umsebenzi wesitokhwe 10 − 3 − 2 − 4 = 1 kg engachazwanga; umsebenzi wentlawulo R90.00 − R30.00 = R60.00 esafuneka; ukuhanjiswa kwe-akhawunti yakho akudali mali edibeneyo eyongezelelweyo; intlawulo ebhaliweyo ngokuzimeleyo ye-R1.00 iyinciphisa nge-R1.00. Kwiyunithi ye-H02 eguquliweyo, gcina i-8 kg kwirekhodi yokupima. Gcina uSuku 2 njengokuhanjiswa noSuku 4 njengentlawulo. Akukho bungqina buxhasa ukuyibiza ikhilogram engachazwanga ngokuba ibiwe, ikonakele okanye iphiwe.

english:
Place A01-A04 beneath their own crop headings. A05 is one hire bill for R120.00. The equipment record shows two hours for carrots and four for the second crop: carrots receive 2/6 of the bill, the second crop 4/6. Together the shares must still equal the one bill. A06 is a separate R90.00 market trip. Its agreed practice basis is occupied equal-size crate spaces, two for carrots and one for the other crop. Explain why this bill uses a different record.

There is no universal rule that hours or crate spaces always give the fairest allocation. Ask what caused the shared cost and whether the record describes it. The chosen basis must fit the decision and period. If the usage record is missing, show an unallocated amount and investigate. Do not quietly assign it all to the crop that looks most profitable.
isixhosa_draft:
Beka i-A01-A04 phantsi kwezihloko zazo zezityalo. I-A05 yibhili enye yokuqeshisa ye-R120.00. Irekhodi lezixhobo libonisa iiyure ezimbini zeminqathe nezine zesinye isityalo: iminqathe ifumana i-2/6 yebhili, esinye isityalo i-4/6. Zidibene, izabelo kufuneka zisalingana nebhili enye. I-A06 luhambo lwemarike lwahlukileyo lwe-R90.00. Isiseko sayo sokuziqhelisa esivunyelweneyo yindawo zeekhrethi ezilinganayo ezihlalwayo, ezimbini zeminqathe kwaye enye yesinye isityalo. Chaza ukuba kutheni le bhili isebenzisa irekhodi eyahlukileyo.

Akukho mgaqo jikelele wokuba iiyure okanye iindawo zeekhrethi zihlala zinika ukwabiwa okubulungisa kakhulu. Buza ukuba yintoni ebangele indleko eyabelwanayo nokuba irekhodi iyichaza na. Isiseko esikhethiweyo kufuneka sifanele isigqibo nexesha. Ukuba irekhodi lokusetyenziswa lilahlekile, bonisa isixa esingabelwanga uphande. Musa ukusinika ngokuthe cwaka sonke kwisityalo esibonakala sinenzuzo engakumbi.

english: “Which product uses it?” gives direct or shared. “What changes when this activity changes?” gives fixed or variable. Hiring a tool for an agreed day may be direct to one crop but unchanged if that day's output is a little smaller. Extra packaging may vary with packs sold. A shared bill can contain variable items. Always state the period and the change being considered.
isixhosa_draft: “Yeyiphi imveliso eyisebenzisayo?” inika ngqo okanye eyabelwanayo. “Kutshintsha ntoni xa lo msebenzi utshintsha?” inika engatshintshiyo okanye eguqukayo. Ukuqesha isixhobo usuku olunye olwavunyelwana ngalo kunokuba ngqo kwisityalo esinye kodwa kungatshintshi ukuba imveliso yalo mini incinci kancinane. Ukupakisha okongezelelweyo kunokuguquka ngokweepakethi ezithengisiweyo. Ibhili eyabelwanayo inokuqulatha izinto eziguqukayo. Hlala uchaza ixesha notshintsho oluqwalaselwayo.

english: Allocate both shared bills, add each crop's direct costs and check the combined amount. Then add the separately stated family-time comparison: four hours and six hours at the hypothetical R25.00 per hour. Keep the cash column intact. No payment has been invented, and no family time should be added twice if it is already paid and included elsewhere.
isixhosa_draft: Yabela zombini ibhili ezabelwanayo, wongeze iindleko ezithe ngqo zesityalo ngasinye uze ukhangele isixa esidibeneyo. Emva koko yongeza uthelekiso lwexesha losapho olubhalwe ngokwahlukeneyo: iiyure ezine nezintandathu nge-R25.00 yeyure eqikelelwayo. Gcina ikholam yemali iphelele. Akukho ntlawulo eyilisiweyo, kwaye akukho xesha losapho elifanele longezwe kabini ukuba sele lihlawuliwe laza labandakanywa kwenye indawo.

english: A new R75.00 hire bill was used one hour by one activity and two hours by another. Divide it and check the sum. Then explain why “shared” does not automatically mean “fixed”. Classify an owner withdrawal and an equipment purchase separately; neither should be hidden inside materials used. Equipment use and its cash purchase may fall in different periods; ask for bookkeeping help on the appropriate treatment.
isixhosa_draft: Ibhili entsha yokuqeshisa ye-R75.00 yasetyenziswa iyure enye ngumsebenzi omnye neeyure ezimbini ngomnye. Yahlule uze ukhangele isixa. Emva koko chaza ukuba kutheni “eyabelwanayo” ingathethi “engatshintshiyo” ngokuzenzekelayo. Hlela ukuthatha imali kwamnini nokuthenga izixhobo ngokwahlukeneyo; akukho nanye kufuneka ifihlwe phakathi kwezinto zokusebenza ezisetyenzisiweyo. Ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo nokuthenga kwazo ngemali engqo kunokwenzeka emaxesheni ahlukileyo; cela uncedo lokugcina iincwadi ngonyango olufanelekileyo.

english: If both crops receive R120.00, place the single hire receipt between them and ask how the farm obtained two bills. If the learner divides every shared cost equally, ask which source supports the equal split. If family time becomes a cash payment, ask for the payment evidence. Retry with the new hire bill rather than repeating the original numbers.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba zombini izityalo zifumana i-R120.00, beka irisithi enye yokuqeshisa phakathi kwazo ubuze ukuba ifama yazifumana njani iibhili ezimbini. Ukuba umfundi wahlula zonke iindleko ezabelwanayo ngokulinganayo, buza ukuba ngowuphi umthombo oxhasa ukwahlukana okulinganayo. Ukuba ixesha losapho liba yintlawulo yemali, cela ubungqina bentlawulo. Zama kwakhona ngebhili entsha yokuqeshisa kunokuphinda amanani okuqala.

english: Use the published [expense guide](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) to record an actual paid cost and find its receipt in the sample workflow. Use this workbook for the allocation exercise. Do not create a second expense merely to assign one existing bill to another crop, or enter an unpaid comparison value as money spent. The app's current records are not proof that every cost has been included.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa [umhlahlandlela weendleko](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) opapashiweyo ukurekhoda indleko ehlawuliweyo yokwenyani ufumane irisithi yayo kwinkqubo yomzekelo. Sebenzisa olu ncwadi lomsebenzi kumsebenzi wokwabiwa. Musa ukwenza indleko yesibini nje ukwabela ibhili enye ekhoyo kwesinye isityalo, okanye ukufaka ixabiso lothelekiso elingahlawulwanga njengemali esetyenzisiweyo. Iirekhodi zangoku ze-app asiyobungqina bokuba zonke iindleko zibandakanyiwe.

english: Choose one small practice enterprise. Name its product, unit and period. Collect three redacted cost references, identify a shared cost and record a possible allocation basis. List missing evidence. Do not require learners to disclose private household finances.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ishishini elinye elincinci lokuziqhelisa. Libize ngemveliso, iyunithi nexesha lalo. Qokelela izalathiso ezintathu zeendleko ezicinyiweyo, uchonge indleko eyabelwanayo uze urekhode isiseko sokwabiwa esinokwenzeka. Bhala ubungqina obulahlekileyo. Musa ukunyanzela abafundi ukuba bamke iinkcukacha zezemali zangasese zekhaya.

english:
At 30 packs, calculate revenue and both kinds of included cost. Repeat for 18 packs prepared and sold. Then keep the original prices but reduce capacity to 20. The numerical break-even point does not change, but it is outside that capacity. Never recommend “sell more” without testing production capacity and evidence of demand. Expected sales are assumptions, not confirmed orders.

If price equals or is below variable cost while fixed costs remain positive, more units do not cover those fixed costs under this model. Report no feasible break-even quantity under these assumptions, not zero units. If a cost is missing, the result is unknown; an empty value is not a free input.
isixhosa_draft:
Kumapakethe angama-30, bala ingeniso neentlobo zombini zeendleko ezibandakanyiweyo. Phinda kumapakethe angama-18 alungisiweyo athengiswa. Emva koko gcina amaxabiso oqobo kodwa unciphise umthamo ube ngama-20. Indawo yobalo ye-break-even ayitshintshi, kodwa iphandle kwaloo mthamo. Musa ukucebisa “thengisa ngakumbi” ngaphandle kokuvavanya umthamo wemveliso nobungqina bemfuno. Iintengiso ezilindelekileyo ziingcinga, hayi iiodolo eziqinisekisiweyo.

Ukuba ixabiso lilingana okanye liphantsi kweendleko eziguqukayo ngoxa iindleko ezingatshintshiyo zisekhona, amanani amaninzi awazigubungeli ezo ndleko ezingatshintshiyo phantsi kwale modeli. Xela akukho bungakanani be-break-even obunokwenzeka phantsi kwezi ngcinga, hayi iiyunithi ezingu-zero. Ukuba indleko ilahlekile, isiphumo asaziwa; ixabiso elingenanto asiyonto efakwayo yasimahla.

english: A separate card gives included cost R8.00 and selling price R10.00. The difference is R2.00. As a share of cost it is 25% markup; as a share of selling price it is 20% margin on those included costs. These are different denominators. Neither is a complete net-profit margin if costs are missing.
isixhosa_draft: Ikhadi elahlukileyo linika indleko ebandakanyiweyo ye-R8.00 nexabiso lokuthengisa le-R10.00. Umahluko yi-R2.00. Njengesabelo seendleko yi-markup ye-25%; njengesabelo sexabiso lokuthengisa yi-margin ye-20% kuzo ezo ndleko zibandakanyiweyo. Ezi ziimahluleli ezahlukeneyo. Akukho nanye yimargin epheleleyo yenzuzo ecocekileyo ukuba iindleko zilahlekile.

english: Use fixed costs R80.00, price R10.00, variable cost R6.00, and capacity 18 whole packs. Find the break-even quantity and explain the capacity problem. Then compare a R6.00 included cost with a R7.50 selling price: calculate markup and margin, naming the denominator each time.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa iindleko ezingatshintshiyo ze-R80.00, ixabiso le-R10.00, iindleko eziguqukayo ze-R6.00 nomthamo wamapakethe aphelele ali-18. Fumana ubungakanani be-break-even uchaze ingxaki yomthamo. Emva koko thelekisa indleko ebandakanyiweyo ye-R6.00 nexabiso lokuthengisa le-R7.50: bala imarkup nemargin, ubize umahluleli ngalo lonke ixesha.

english: Keep these what-if calculations in the workbook. Do not enter forecast sales as actual sales in My Records. Use the existing expense and harvest guides to find the underlying real records. A chart based on saved rows does not supply a missing stock valuation, family-time value or depreciation policy.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ezi ngcaciso zokubala “kuthekani” kwincwadi yomsebenzi. Musa ukufaka iintengiso ezicetywayo njengeentengiso zokwenyani kwiirekhodi zam. Sebenzisa imihlahlandlela yeendleko nesivuno esele ikhona ukufumana iirekhodi zokwenyani eziphantsi. Itshathi esekelwe kwimiqolo egciniweyo ayinikezi ixabiso lesitokhwe elilahlekileyo, ixabiso lexesha losapho okanye umgaqo-nkqubo wokuncipha kwexabiso.

english: Prepare one labelled cost-per-unit estimate from agreed practice data. Write the period, costs included, exclusions, unit, expected quantity sold, and source date. Test a smaller sales quantity. Explain what evidence is needed before using the estimate to negotiate a real price.
isixhosa_draft: Lungiselela uqikelelo olunye lweendleko ngeyunithi olunamagama ngedatha yokuziqhelisa evunyelweneyo. Bhala ixesha, iindleko ezibandakanyiweyo, ezishiyiweyo, iyunithi, ubungakanani obulindeleke ukuthengiswa nomhla womthombo. Vavanya ubungakanani obuncinci beentengiso. Chaza bungowuphi ubungqina obufunekayo phambi kokusebenzisa uqikelelo ukuxoxisana ngexabiso lokwenyani.

english:
Decision C offers the same 20 kg of accepted produce to either Buyer A or Buyer B. A offers R10.00/kg, collects it, requires no extra packaging and pays on Day 0. B offers R12.00/kg, but the grower pays R35.00 delivery and R10.00 additional packaging; B promises payment on Day 7. These are alternatives, not two simultaneous sales of the same produce.

A leaves R200.00 after the specified offer-specific cash costs. B leaves R195.00. A's lower headline price leaves R5.00 more at that stage. Both options also relate to R140.00 of already-incurred common costs; subtracting those gives R60.00 and R55.00, respectively. Those are partial results, not full profit. Do not charge the common cost twice or add the two offers together.

The cards separately record additional unpaid selling work: half an hour for A, one and a half for B. At the same hypothetical comparison value, that adds R12.50 or R37.50 to the management view, leaving R47.50 or R17.50 after the specified common costs and additional family-time value. The farm has not paid those wages. Other omitted work or costs could still change the full result.
isixhosa_draft:
Isigqibo C sinikezela i-20 kg efanayo yemveliso eyamkelweyo kuMthengi A okanye kuMthengi B. U-A unikezela i-R10.00/kg, uyiqokelela, akadingi ukupakisha okongezelelweyo aze ahlawule ngoSuku 0. U-B unikezela i-R12.00/kg, kodwa umtyali uhlawula i-R35.00 yokuhanjiswa kunye ne-R10.00 yokupakisha okongezelelweyo; u-B uthembisa ukuhlawula ngoSuku 7. Ezi ziinketho ezizezinye, hayi iintengiso ezimbini ezenzeka ngaxeshanye zemveliso enye.

U-A ushiya i-R200.00 emva kweendleko zemali ezichaziweyo zenikelo ngalinye. U-B ushiya i-R195.00. Ixabiso eliphantsi lika-A lishiya i-R5.00 ngakumbi kweli nqanaba. Zozibini iinketho zinxulumene ne-R140.00 yeendleko ezifanayo esele zenzekile; ukuzisusa kuyashiya i-R60.00 ne-R55.00, ngokulandelelana. Ezo ziziphumo ezinxalenye, hayi inzuzo epheleleyo. Musa ukutyala indleko eyabelwanayo kabini okanye ukudibanisa iinikelo zombini.

Amakhadi arekhoda ngokwahlukeneyo umsebenzi wokuthengisa ongahlawulwanga ongezelelweyo: isiqingatha seyure kuka-A, iyure enye nesiqingatha kuka-B. Kwixabiso lothelekiso elifanayo eliqikelelwayo, oko kongeza i-R12.50 okanye i-R37.50 kumbono wolawulo, kushiya i-R47.50 okanye i-R17.50 emva kweendleko ezifanayo ezichaziweyo nexabiso elongezelelweyo lexesha losapho. Ifama ayizihlawulanga ezo mivuzo. Omnye umsebenzi okanye iindleko ezishiyiweyo zisenokutshintsha isiphumo esipheleleyo.

english: State what the supplied evidence favours: A retains more after these specified costs, requires less additional time and pays earlier. Do not claim the buyer is reliable merely because the card promises payment. Ask about confirmed quantities, acceptance standards, rejections, collection arrangements and how the agreement will be recorded. A real buyer relationship may have advantages the cards do not describe; name those separately rather than inventing a monetary score.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza oko ubungqina obunikeziweyo bukuxhasa: u-A ugcina okungakumbi emva kwezi ndleko zichaziweyo, udinga ixesha elincinci elongezelelweyo aze ahlawule kwangoko. Musa ukubanga ukuba umthengi uthembekile nje kuba ikhadi lithembisa intlawulo. Buza ngobungakanani obuqinisekisiweyo, imigangatho yokwamkela, ukwala, ulungiselelo lokuqokelela nendlela esiza kurekhodwa ngayo isivumelwano. Ubudlelwane bomthengi wokwenyani bunokuba neenzuzo ezingachazwanga ngamakhadi; zibize ngokwahlukeneyo endaweni yokuyila inqaku lemali.

english: For a fresh 10 kg, a collecting buyer offers R10.00/kg and a delivery buyer R12.00/kg. The delivery charge is missing. Find the charge at which their cash results would be equal, and explain why no final ranking is justified yet. Another buyer quotes per crate without a crate weight: explain what measurement is needed before comparing it with a per-kg price.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-10 kg entsha, umthengi oqokelelayo unikezela i-R10.00/kg nomthengi okuhanjisayo i-R12.00/kg. Intlawulo yokuhanjiswa ilahlekile. Fumana intlawulo apho iziphumo zabo zemali zingalingana, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni akukho kulandelelwa kokugqibela okuthethelelwayo. Omnye umthengi ucaphula ixabiso ngebhokisi engenabunzima bebhokisi: chaza ukuba kufuneka kulinganiswe ntoni phambi kokuyithelekisa nexabiso le-kg.

english: If the learner chooses B just because 12 is greater than 10, lay the delivery and packaging cards beside that offer. If Day 7 money is treated as today's cash, move its payment card along a paper calendar. If the missing delivery charge becomes zero, keep the result blank and write the next question to ask.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi ukhetha u-B nje kuba u-12 mkhulu kunowe-10, beka amakhadi okuhanjiswa nokupakisha ecaleni kwaloo nikelo. Ukuba imali yoSuku 7 ithathwa njengemali yanamhlanje, hambisa ikhadi layo lentlawulo kwikhalenda yephepha. Ukuba intlawulo yokuhanjiswa elahlekileyo iba ngu-zero, gcina isiphumo singenanto ubhale umbuzo olandelayo ekufuneka ubuzwe.

english: The [invoice guide](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) covers checking the buyer, units, amounts and payment status after an agreement. An invoice is not evidence that payment arrived. Link an existing recorded sale rather than recording it again. These alternative quotes belong in the workbook; do not create two sample sales and present both as completed business. Partial payments still need a separate balance record; do not mark an invoice paid in full after a deposit.
isixhosa_draft: [Umhlahlandlela we-invoyisi](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) ugubungela ukukhangela umthengi, iiyunithi, izixa nemeko yentlawulo emva kwesivumelwano. I-invoyisi asiyobungqina bokuba intlawulo ifikile. Nxulumanisa intengiso ekhoyo erekhodiweyo endaweni yokuyirekhoda kwakhona. La maxabiso acetyiswayo ezinye iindlela ahlala kwincwadi yomsebenzi; musa ukwenza iintengiso ezimbini zomzekelo uzibonise zombini njengeshishini eligqityiweyo. Iintlawulo ezinxalenye zisadinga irekhodi lebhalansi eyahlukileyo; musa ukuphawula i-invoyisi ihlawulwe yonke emva kwediphozithi.

english: Obtain two redacted or facilitator-supplied offers for a clearly specified product. Record the quote date and all conditions. Compare the supported costs and payment timing. Give a reasoned choice or say precisely which missing fact prevents one.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana iinikelo ezimbini ezicinyiweyo okanye ezinikezelwe ngumququzeleli zemveliso echazwe ngokucacileyo. Rekhoda umhla woxabiso elicetyiswayo nemiqathango yonke. Thelekisa iindleko ezixhaswayo nexesha lentlawulo. Nika ukhetho olunesizathu okanye uthi ngokuchanekileyo yeyiphi inyani elahlekileyo ethintela olunye.

english:
Bring paper, a calculator and the learner workbook. Read the cards aloud if needed. Learners may point, sort cards or explain their answer to a partner; fluent reading is not the assessment. Begin by asking what it costs to get one product from the garden into a buyer's hands. Keep quantities, time and money on separate lines.

All amounts, weights, work hours and quotes below are **invented classroom inputs**. They are not recommended prices, wages, productivity rates or yields. The R25.00 hourly value is a comparison assumption, not a legal wage or payment instruction. No area, real growing season or tax status is supplied. Do not infer these. A, B and C are separate exercises; do not add their totals or carry forward F1/F2 balances.

Outcomes: assign a cost once; explain the basis for sharing it; keep unpaid work visible; use the right denominator; distinguish markup from margin; test a bounded break-even calculation; and compare buyer terms without equating the highest price with the best outcome.
isixhosa_draft:
Zisa iphepha, ikhalkyuleyitha nencwadi yomsebenzi yomfundi. Funda amakhadi ngokuvakalayo ukuba kuyimfuneko. Abafundi bangakhomba, bahlele amakhadi okanye bachaze impendulo yabo kozifundela naye; ukufunda ngokugqibeleleyo akuyiyo ivavanyo. Qala ngokubuza ukuba kuxabisa ntoni ukusuka kwimveliso enye ukuyisusa egadini uyifake ezandleni zomthengi. Gcina ubungakanani, ixesha nemali kwimiqolo eyahlukileyo.

Zonke izixa, ubunzima, iiyure zomsebenzi neekhowuthi ezingezantsi ziingeniso **eziyilisiweyo zeklasi**. Aziyomixabiso, imivuzo, amanqanaba emveliso okanye izivuno ezicetyiswayo. Ixabiso leyure le-R25.00 yingcinga yothelekiso, hayi umvuzo osemthethweni okanye umyalelo wentlawulo. Akukho ndawo, xesha lokwenyani lokutyala okanye imeko yerhafu enikezelwayo. Musa ukuzikhupha. U-A, B no-C ziimisebenzi ezahlukeneyo; musa ukudibanisa izixa zazo ezipheleleyo okanye ukuthatha iibhalansi ze-F1/F2.

Iziphumo: abela indleko kanye; chaza isiseko sokwabelana ngayo; gcina umsebenzi ongahlawulwanga ubonakala; sebenzisa umahluleli ochanekileyo; wahlule imarkhophu kwimargin; vavanya ubalo lwe-break-even oluphetheke; uze uthelekise imiqathango yomthengi ngaphandle kokulinganisa ixabiso eliphezulu nesiphumo esingcono.

english:
Each case starts from B01 and applies only its stated change.

| Case | Change | Contribution per pack | Whole-pack break-even | Within capacity? | Result at stated sales |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| B01 | Base; capacity and sales 30 | R4.50 | 24 | Yes | R30.00 |
| B02 | Only 18 prepared and sold | R4.50 | 24 | Yes; demand still matters | -R24.00 |
| B03 | Capacity and sales 20 | R4.50 | 24 | No | -R15.00 |
| B04 | Price R7.50 | R0.00 | None | No | -R105.00 |
| B05 | Price R7.00 | -R0.50 | None | No | -R120.00 |
| B06 | Variable cost missing | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown |

At 23 packs B01 is **-R1.50**; at 24 it is **R3.00**. A break-even quantity below capacity is not proof of demand. B04/B05 have positive fixed costs and no positive unit contribution; B06 lacks required evidence.

| Card | Included cost | Selling price | Difference | Markup on cost | Margin on selling price |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| M01 | R8.00 | R10.00 | R2.00 | 25% | 20% |
isixhosa_draft:
Ityala ngalinye liqala kwi-B01 kwaye lisebenzisa utshintsho lwalo oluchaziweyo kuphela.

| Ityala | Utshintsho | Igalelo kwipakethe nganye | Ipakethe epheleleyo ye-break-even | Ngaphakathi komthamo? | Isiphumo kwiintengiso ezichaziweyo |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| B01 | Isiseko; umthamo neentengiso ezingama-30 | R4.50 | 24 | Ewe | R30.00 |
| B02 | Kuphela angama-18 alungisiwe athengiswa | R4.50 | 24 | Ewe; imfuno isabalulekile | -R24.00 |
| B03 | Umthamo neentengiso ezingama-20 | R4.50 | 24 | Hayi | -R15.00 |
| B04 | Ixabiso R7.50 | R0.00 | Akukho | Hayi | -R105.00 |
| B05 | Ixabiso R7.00 | -R0.50 | Akukho | Hayi | -R120.00 |
| B06 | Indleko eguqukayo ilahlekile | Akwaziwa | Akwaziwa | Akwaziwa | Akwaziwa |

Kumapakethe angama-23 i-B01 ingu-**-R1.50**; kuma-24 ingu-**R3.00**. Ubungakanani be-break-even ongaphantsi komthamo asiyobungqina bemfuno. I-B04/B05 inendleko ezingatshintshiyo ezintle kwaye akukho galelo lweyunithi elintle; i-B06 ilahlekelwe bubungqina obufunekayo.

| Ikhadi | Indleko ebandakanyiweyo | Ixabiso lokuthengisa | Umahluko | Imarkhophu kwindleko | Imargin kwixabiso lokuthengisa |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| M01 | R8.00 | R10.00 | R2.00 | 25% | 20% |

english:
| Offer | Agreed sales value | Extra delivery and packaging | After those cash costs | After common R140.00 | Additional time value | After that time value | Payment promised |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| C01 | R200.00 | R0.00 | R200.00 | R60.00 | R12.50 | R47.50 | Day 0 |
| C02 | R240.00 | R45.00 | R195.00 | R55.00 | R37.50 | R17.50 | Day 7 |

These are alternative offers and partial management results, not money already received or full net profit. The additional family hours relate only to this selling decision; they are not the hours from A.
isixhosa_draft:
| Inikelo | Ixabiso lentengiso elivunyelweneyo | Ukuhanjiswa nokupakisha okongezelelweyo | Emva kwezo ndleko zemali | Emva kwe-R140.00 efanayo | Ixabiso lexesha elongezelelweyo | Emva kwexabiso lelo xesha | Intlawulo ethenjisiweyo |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| C01 | R200.00 | R0.00 | R200.00 | R60.00 | R12.50 | R47.50 | Usuku 0 |
| C02 | R240.00 | R45.00 | R195.00 | R55.00 | R37.50 | R17.50 | Usuku 7 |

Ezi ziinikelo ezizezinye neziphumo zolawulo ezinxalenye, hayi imali esele ifunyenwe okanye inzuzo ecocekileyo epheleleyo. Iiyure zosapho ezongezelelweyo zinxulumene kuphela nesi sigqibo sokuthengisa; asiziyo iiyure ezisuka kwi-A.

english:
The new R75.00 hire allocation is **R25.00 and R50.00**. The new break-even case needs **20 packs**, beyond capacity 18; at 18 its model result is **-R8.00**. R6.00 cost and R7.50 price give **R1.50 difference, 25% markup and 20% margin**. The fresh buyer comparison gives collection value R100.00 versus delivery value R120.00 before the unknown charge: the cash results tie at **R20.00 delivery cost**. Below that charge the delivery offer retains more; above it collection retains more, considering only these stated cash items. With the charge missing, no final ranking follows.

To pass, the learner must allocate each bill once, check the total, name the basis, keep time value separate from cash, use and label a correct denominator, round whole-unit break-even upward, reject a capacity or evidence gap, and compare an offer beyond its price. One correct total with an incorrect explanation is insufficient. Supply a fresh case after feedback; record what the learner actually demonstrates. Completion is evidence of these practice skills, not certification of a business's profitability.
isixhosa_draft:
Ukwabiwa kwebhili entsha yokuqeshisa ye-R75.00 yi-**R25.00 ne-R50.00**. Ityala elitsha le-break-even lidinga **amapakethe angama-20**, ngaphaya komthamo wama-18; kuma-18 isiphumo semodeli yalo singu-**-R8.00**. Indleko ye-R6.00 nexabiso le-R7.50 zinika **umahluko we-R1.50, imarkhophu ye-25% nemargin ye-20%**. Uthelekiso olutsha lwabathengi lunika ixabiso lokuqokelela le-R100.00 ngokuchasene nexabiso lokuhanjiswa le-R120.00 phambi kwentlawulo engaziwayo: iziphumo zemali ziyalingana kwi-**R20.00 yeendleko zokuhanjiswa**. Ngaphantsi kwaloo ntlawulo inikelo lokuhanjiswa ligcina okungakumbi; ngaphezulu kwayo ukuqokelela kugcina okungakumbi, kuqwalaselwa kuphela ezi zinto zemali zichaziweyo. Ngentlawulo elahlekileyo, akukho kulandelelwa kokugqibela okulandelayo.

Ukuphumelela, umfundi kufuneka abele ibhili nganye kanye, akhangele isixa esipheleleyo, abize isiseko, agcine ixabiso lexesha lahlukile kwimali, asebenzise aze aphawule umahluleli ochanekileyo, ajikeleze ukuya phezulu i-break-even yeyunithi epheleleyo, achonge isikhewu somthamo okanye sobungqina, athelekise inikelo ngaphaya kwexabiso layo. Isixa esipheleleyo esinye esichanekileyo esinenkcazo engachanekanga asonelanga. Nika ityala elitsha emva kwempendulo; rekhoda oko umfundi akubonisa ngokwenene. Ukugqitywa bubungqina bezi zakhono zokuziqhelisa, hayi isatifikethi senzuzo yeshishini.

english:
The source cards give expected sales of R600.00 for A and R500.00 for B. Direct inputs are R220.00 and R180.00. Share the R120.00 hire using recorded planned hours, two for A and four for B. Share the R90.00 trip using two and one equal-size crate spaces. A receives R40.00 hire and R60.00 trip; B receives R80.00 and R30.00. Combined shared allocations remain R210.00, not R420.00.

The budget's specified cash inputs total R610.00. Separately show four and six hours of unpaid family work at the exercise comparison value of R25.00/hour, giving R250.00. That rate is a hypothetical comparison, not a wage recommendation or assertion of outside earning opportunities. After these included costs the two activities show R240.00 in planned surplus. Land, owned-equipment use, administration, finance costs, tax and other missing costs prevent this from establishing full farm profit. Do not add the time comparison to the cash payments.
isixhosa_draft:
Amakhadi omthombo anika iintengiso ezilindelekileyo ze-R600.00 ye-A kunye ne-R500.00 ye-B. Izinto ezifakwayo ngqo zi-R220.00 ne-R180.00. Yabelana nge-R120.00 yokuqeshisa usebenzisa iiyure ezicwangcisiweyo ezirekhodiweyo, ezimbini ze-A nezine ze-B. Yabelana nge-R90.00 yohambo usebenzisa iindawo zeebhokisi ezilinganayo ezimbini nenye. I-A ifumana i-R40.00 yokuqeshisa ne-R60.00 yohambo; i-B ifumana i-R80.00 ne-R30.00. Izabelo ezabelwanayo ezidibeneyo zihlala zi-R210.00, hayi i-R420.00.

Izinto zemali ezichaziweyo zebhajethi zidibana nge-R610.00. Ngokwahlukeneyo bonisa iiyure ezine neziyure ezintandathu zomsebenzi wosapho ongahlawulwanga ngexabiso lothelekiso lomsebenzi le-R25.00 ngeyure, nokunika i-R250.00. Eli xabiso lingcinga yothelekiso, hayi iingcebiso zomvuzo okanye ibango leemfuno zangaphandle. Emva kwezi ndleko zibandakanyiweyo imisebenzi emibini ibonisa isixa esicwangcisiweyo esisele se-R240.00. Umhlaba, ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ezikhoyo, ulawulo, iindleko zemali, irhafu neminye iindleko ezilahlekileyo zithintela oku ukuba kuseke inzuzo epheleleyo yefama. Musa ukudibanisa uthelekiso lwexesha neentlawulo zemali.

english: Build the A and B columns and reconcile their sum to the original shared bills. Explain why paying R250.00 for equipment in March is a cash movement but does not establish a R250.00 cost of equipment use for this activity period. The value of its use and accounting treatment need separate evidence and bookkeeping review. Household withdrawal is also a cash movement, not automatically a crop input.
isixhosa_draft: Yakha iikholam ze-A ne-B uvumelanise isixa sazo neebhili zoqobo ezabelwanayo. Chaza ukuba kutheni ukuhlawula i-R250.00 yezixhobo ngoMatshi yintshukumo yemali kodwa ingaseki indleko ye-R250.00 yokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ngeli xesha lomsebenzi. Ixabiso lokusetyenziswa kwazo nonyango lweeakhawunti zifuna ubungqina obahlukileyo nokuphonononga ukugcina iincwadi. Ukuthatha imali kwekhaya nako yintshukumo yemali, hayi isixhobo sesityalo ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: A whole-farm plan also needs the actual availability and timing of land, water, labour, tools and markets. Two activities cannot each be assigned all of the same scarce resource at the same time. This pack supplies cost-sharing hours, not proof that a particular tool or worker is available on the required dates. Keep those checks unresolved until evidence exists. Do not invent a yield from the sales value.
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso sefama yonke sidinga nokubakho kokwenyani kunye nexesha lomhlaba, amanzi, abasebenzi, izixhobo kunye namarike. Imisebenzi emibini ayinakunikwa yonke into enye engaphelelanga ngaxeshanye. Le pakethe inika iiyure zokwabelana ngeendleko, hayi ubungqina bokuba isixhobo okanye umsebenzi othile ukhona ngemihla efunekayo. Gcina ezo zikhangelo zingaxazululwanga de ubungqina bube khona. Musa ukuyila isivuno ukusuka kwixabiso lentengiso.

english: A new shared R60.00 bill is divided by recorded use of one unit and two units. Allocate it, then check the total. A learner says a R500.00 funding application makes the two activities profitable: ask them to identify approval, cash receipt and whether funding is a sale. Do not assume it is a grant or loan when the terms are absent.
isixhosa_draft: Ibhili entsha eyabelwanayo ye-R60.00 yahlulwa ngokusetyenziswa okubhaliweyo kweyunithi enye neeyunithi ezimbini. Yabele uze ukhangele isixa esipheleleyo. Umfundi uthi isicelo senkxaso-mali ye-R500.00 senza imisebenzi emibini ibe nenzuzo: mcele achonge ukuvunywa, ukufumana imali nokuba inkxaso-mali yintengiso na. Musa ukucinga ukuba yi-grant okanye imboleko xa imiqathango ingekho.

english: If the farm total includes both the shared bill and its allocations, physically remove the duplicate card. If unpaid family time becomes a cash payment, ask for payment evidence. If a missing cost becomes zero, replace the zero with an unresolved source request. Give a fresh allocation after feedback.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba isixa esipheleleyo sefama siquka zombini ibhili eyabelwanayo nezabelo zayo, susa ngomzimba ikhadi eliphindiweyo. Ukuba ixesha losapho elingahlawulwanga liba yintlawulo yemali, cela ubungqina bentlawulo. Ukuba indleko elahlekileyo iba ngu-zero, tshintshisa u-zero ngesicelo somthombo ongaxazululwanga. Nika ukwabiwa okutsha emva kwempendulo.

english: The [expense companion](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) helps find actual recorded costs. It does not create this forecast. Keep the proposed budget in the workbook, label actual evidence and estimates, and give each estimate a source date. Bring one redacted quote and one capacity question for local review.
isixhosa_draft: [Isikhokelo esihamba neendleko](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) sinceda ukufumana iindleko zokwenyani ezirekhodiweyo. Asenzi oku kuqikelela. Gcina ibhajethi ecetywayo kwincwadi yomsebenzi, uphawule ubungqina bokwenyani namaqikelelo, wenze naliphi iqikelelo lube nomhla womthombo. Zisa ixabiso elinye elicinyiweyo nombuzo omnye womthamo wokuphononongwa kwalapha.

english:
Start at R300.00. Pay the planned R220.00 on 5 January: R80.00 remains. The next planned R180.00 payment on 10 January produces a projected minus R100.00. Stop the cards here and ask how that payment could be made. No borrowing facility or extra money has been supplied. Continue the calculation as a clearly labelled unfunded projection, not as an instruction to pay unavailable cash. The R120.00 hire on 20 January takes it to minus R220.00; the R600.00 receipt on 25 January brings it to R380.00.

The first shortage is 10 January and the deepest base-case shortage is R220.00 after the 20 January payment. January nevertheless closes at positive R380.00. A monthly closing-only check misses the earlier gap. If a receipt and payment share a real date, check which clears first; this exercise avoids same-date ambiguity. Combined available funds also do not prove the right payment account has accessible funds at the required moment.
isixhosa_draft:
Qala nge-R300.00. Hlawula i-R220.00 ecwangcisiweyo ngomhla we-5 kuJanuwari: kusala i-R80.00. Intlawulo elandelayo ecwangcisiweyo ye-R180.00 ngomhla we-10 kuJanuwari ivelisa isixa esiqikelelwayo esingaphantsi kwe-zero se-R100.00. Yeka amakhadi apha ubuze ukuba loo ntlawulo ingenziwa njani. Akukho ndawo yeboleko okanye imali eyongezelelweyo enikezelwayo. Qhubeka ubalo njengoqikelelo olungaxhaswanga oluphawulwe ngokucacileyo, hayi njengomyalelo wokuhlawula imali engekhoyo. Ukuqeshisa kwe-R120.00 ngomhla we-20 kuJanuwari kuyisa kuba nesixa esingaphantsi kwe-zero se-R220.00; irisithi ye-R600.00 ngomhla we-25 kuJanuwari iyisa kwi-R380.00.

Ukunqongophala kokuqala ngomhla we-10 kuJanuwari kwaye ukunqongophala okunzulu kakhulu kwemeko esisiseko yi-R220.00 emva kwentlawulo yomhla we-20 kuJanuwari. Nangona kunjalo uJanuwari uvala nge-R380.00 ephozithivu. Ukukhangela kokuvala kwenyanga kuphela kuphosa isikhewu sangaphambili. Ukuba irisithi nentlawulo zabelana ngomhla wokwenyani, khangela eyiphi ecocwa kuqala; esi siqhelo siyakuphepha ukungaqiniseki komhla ofanayo. Imali edibeneyo ekhoyo ayibonisi nayo ukuba i-akhawunti yentlawulo echanekileyo inemali efikelelekayo ngexesha elifunekayo.

english:
Continue through February and March. Opening balance plus receipts minus payments equals closing balance. February opens with January's R380.00, not the original R300.00. March's R120.00 collection concerns a customer balance from before the exercise; it is a cash receipt now, not another current-season sale. Paying the old R80.00 supplier bill also needs cash now even though it is not one of these current activity inputs.

Set aside X01, the R50.00 transfer from bank to cash tin: both are already inside the combined cash scope, and the supplied transfer has no fee. It changes location, not the combined amount. Set aside X02, the unapproved R500.00 application. Keep the two issued invoices X03/X04 as links to expected buyer receipts; do not count each invoice and its eventual receipt as two inflows. Family-time comparison is not a payment either.
isixhosa_draft:
Qhubeka ngoFebruwari noMatshi. Ibhalansi yokuvula kunye neerisithi kuthatyathwe iintlawulo ilingana nebhalansi yokuvala. UFebruwari uvulwa nge-R380.00 kaJanuwari, hayi i-R300.00 yokuqala. Ukuqokelelwa kwe-R120.00 kaMatshi kunxulumene nebhalansi yomthengi yangaphambi kwesiqhelo; yirisithi yemali ngoku, hayi enye intengiso yexesha langoku. Ukuhlawula ibhili endala yomthengisi ye-R80.00 nako kudinga imali ngoku nangona ingenguye omnye wezinto ezifakwayo zomsebenzi wangoku.

Bekela bucala i-X01, ukuhanjiswa kwe-R50.00 ukusuka ebhankini ukuya kwithini yemali: zombini sele zikumandla emali edibeneyo, yaye ukuhanjiswa okunikeziweyo akunayo intlawulo. Kutshintsha indawo, hayi isixa esidibeneyo. Bekela bucala i-X02, isicelo se-R500.00 esingavunywanga. Gcina ii-invoyisi ezimbini ezikhutshiweyo i-X03/X04 njengamakhonkco eerisithi ezilindelekileyo zabathengi; musa ukubala i-invoyisi nganye nerisithi yayo yokugqibela njengeentlawulo ezimbini ezingenayo. Uthelekiso lwexesha losapho nalo asiyontlawulo.

english: In a separate example, open with R90.00; pay R130.00 on Day 2, receive R80.00 on Day 10 and pay R20.00 on Day 20. Find closing cash, lowest projected cash and the first date requiring a response. Then ask whether the closing answer is complete if an additional payment fee is known to apply but its amount is missing.
isixhosa_draft: Kumzekelo owahlukileyo, vula nge-R90.00; hlawula i-R130.00 ngoSuku 2, wamkele i-R80.00 ngoSuku 10 uhlawule i-R20.00 ngoSuku 20. Fumana imali yokuvala, eyona mali iphantsi eqikelelwayo nomhla wokuqala odinga impendulo. Emva koko buza ukuba impendulo yokuvala iphelele na ukuba kwaziwa ukuba intlawulo eyongezelelweyo iyasebenza kodwa isixa sayo silahlekile.

english: For a learner who subtracts the net inflow, use counters: opening R10.00, receipt R5.00 and payment R3.00 leaves R12.00. For a learner who sees only the positive ending, replay one card at a time and stop at the first negative projection. For an invoice counted as cash, place its promised receipt on the later date. Ask for a new dated example after correction.
isixhosa_draft: Kumfundi osusa imali engenayo ecocekileyo, sebenzisa iikhawunta: ukuvula i-R10.00, irisithi i-R5.00 nentlawulo i-R3.00 kushiya i-R12.00. Kumfundi ubona isiphelo esiphozithivu kuphela, phinda ukudlala ikhadi elinye ngexesha uze umise kuqikelelo lokuqala olungaphantsi kwe-zero. Kwi-invoyisi ebaliwe njengemali, beka irisithi yayo ethenjisiweyo kumhla wamva. Cela umzekelo omtsha onemihla emva kolungiso.

english: The live records/chart series summarises recorded events and has its own payment and missing-data boundaries. It is not this dated forecast or an available-bank-balance guarantee. Keep invented examples and future expected receipts out of actual My Records. Use the [invoice companion](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) to check an existing unpaid invoice and its source, without marking it paid to make the plan balance. Build a short redacted forecast with exact dates; reconcile its opening funds and list restrictions or timing uncertainty.
isixhosa_draft: Uthotho lweerekhodi/lweetshathi ezisebenzayo lushwankathela iziganeko ezirekhodiweyo kwaye lunemida yalo yentlawulo nedatha elahlekileyo. Asiko oku kuqikelela okunemihla okanye isiqinisekiso sebhalansi yebhanki ekhoyo. Gcina imizekelo eyilisiweyo neerisithi ezilindelekileyo zexesha elizayo ngaphandle kweerekhodi zam zokwenyani. Sebenzisa [isikhokelo se-invoyisi](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) ukukhangela i-invoyisi engahlawulwanga ekhoyo nomthombo wayo, ngaphandle kokuyiphawula ihlawuliwe ukwenza isicwangciso silingane. Yakha uqikelelo olufutshane olucinyiweyo ngemihla echanekileyo; vumelanisa imali yalo yokuqala uze ubhale imiqobo okanye ukungaqiniseki kwexesha.

english:
In LATE, move only A's R600.00 receipt from 25 January to 28 February. Do not make a new receipt or change the sale value. The March closing remains R430.00, but the deepest gap grows from R220.00 to R310.00, after the 5 February trip payment. Equal end totals do not imply equal ability to pay on time.

In HIGH, increase B's input payment from R180.00 to R240.00, with no other change. In COMBINED, apply this increase and the late A receipt together. Do not add the individual scenario balances together: each scenario starts from the same opening position and recomputes the changed events. The combined deepest gap is R370.00 and the closing balance is R370.00.
isixhosa_draft:
Kwi-LATE, hambisa kuphela irisithi ye-R600.00 ye-A ukusuka ngomhla we-25 kuJanuwari ukuya ngomhla we-28 kuFebruwari. Musa ukwenza irisithi entsha okanye utshintshe ixabiso lentengiso. Ukuvala kukaMatshi kusala kuyi-R430.00, kodwa isikhewu esinzulu kakhulu sikhula ukusuka kwi-R220.00 ukuya kwi-R310.00, emva kwentlawulo yohambo lomhla we-5 kuFebruwari. Izixa ezilinganayo zokuphela azithethi ukukwazi ukuhlawula ngexesha ngokulinganayo.

Kwi-HIGH, nyusa intlawulo yezinto ezifakwayo ye-B ukusuka kwi-R180.00 ukuya kwi-R240.00, ngaphandle kwenye inguqu. Kwi-COMBINED, sebenzisa olu nyuko kunye nerisithi ye-A emva kwexesha. Musa ukudibanisa iibhalansi zemeko nganye: imeko nganye iqala kwisikhundla sokuqala esifanayo yaye ibala kwakhona iziganeko ezitshintshileyo. Isikhewu esinzulu esidibeneyo yi-R370.00 kwaye ibhalansi yokuvala yi-R370.00.

english: LOW reduces B's expected sales and receipt from R500.00 to R350.00; this is a lower-sales case, not a claim that a R500.00 debt has been settled in full. OUTSIDE moves B's same R500.00 receipt to 20 April, beyond the 31 March horizon. It remains an expected amount owed, not vanished money; exclude it from cash received inside the horizon. UNKNOWN removes B's input quote. Later exact balances and the deepest gap become unknown, not larger positive balances caused by treating a blank as free.
isixhosa_draft: I-LOW inciphisa iintengiso ezilindelekileyo kunye nerisithi ye-B ukusuka kwi-R500.00 ukuya kwi-R350.00; eli lityala leentengiso eziphantsi, hayi ibango lokuba ityala le-R500.00 selihlawulwe ngokupheleleyo. I-OUTSIDE ihambisa irisithi ye-B efanayo ye-R500.00 ukuya ngomhla we-20 kuEpreli, ngaphaya kwexesha lomhla wama-31 kuMatshi. Isalindelwe njengesixa esisafunekayo, hayi imali enyamalalileyo; ayibandakanye kwimali efunyenwe ngaphakathi kwexesha. I-UNKNOWN isusa ixabiso lezinto ezifakwayo ze-B. Iibhalansi ezichanekileyo zamva nesikhewu esinzulu zibe ngezingaziwayo, hayi iibhalansi ezintle ezinkulu ezibangelwa kukuthatha indawo engenanto njengasimahla.

english: DEFER moves the proposed R250.00 equipment purchase to 10 April, assuming the purchase date can actually be changed by agreement. It improves the March closing figure to R680.00 but leaves January's R220.00 gap. It therefore does not solve that earlier problem. A response must work before the shortage: possible options to investigate include changing the scale and associated costs/revenue, agreeing timing with the buyer or supplier, or identifying genuinely available funds. Do not simply delete essential inputs, assume a buyer pays early, cut basic household needs, or treat an unapproved application as available cash. Borrowing requires its full terms and a repayment plan; this unit recommends no lender or loan size.
isixhosa_draft: I-DEFER ihambisa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo okucetywayo kwe-R250.00 ukuya ngomhla we-10 kuEpreli, kucingwa ukuba umhla wokuthenga unokutshintshwa ngesivumelwano. Iphucula ubalo lokuvala kukaMatshi ukuya kwi-R680.00 kodwa ishiya isikhewu se-R220.00 sikaJanuwari. Ngoko ayisonjululi leyo ngxaki yangaphambili. Impendulo kufuneka isebenze phambi kokunqongophala: iinketho ezinokuphandwa ziquka ukutshintsha isikali neendleko/ingeniso ezinxulumene nayo, ukuvumelana ngexesha nomthengi okanye umthengisi, okanye ukuchonga imali ekhoyo ngokwenene. Musa ukususa nje izinto ezifakwayo ezibalulekileyo, ucinge ukuba umthengi uhlawula kwangoko, unqumle iimfuno ezisisiseko zekhaya, okanye uthathe isicelo esingavunywanga njengemali ekhoyo. Ukuboleka kudinga yonke imiqathango yako nesicwangciso sokuhlawula; le yunithi ayicebisi mboleki okanye ubungakanani beboleko.

english: Give the learner LATE and DEFER without the answer table. Ask which date first fails, whether the proposed equipment deferral solves it, and what evidence would be needed for a different response. Then present a real unknown quote: accept “cannot calculate yet” with a precise source request. Do not reward a guessed zero for producing a tidy budget.
isixhosa_draft: Nika umfundi i-LATE ne-DEFER ngaphandle kwetafile yempendulo. Buza ukuba ngowuphi umhla owasilela kuqala, ukuba ukubambezelwa kwezixhobo okucetywayo kuyawusonjulula na, nokuba bungowuphi ubungqina obuya kufuneka kwimpendulo eyahlukileyo. Emva koko bonisa ixabiso lokwenyani elingaziwayo: yamkela “akunakubalwa okwangoku” kunye nesicelo somthombo esichanekileyo. Musa ukunika umvuzo u-zero oqikelelwayo kuba uvelise ibhajethi ecocekileyo.

english: A good response names the affected date and amount, what can actually change, what must be agreed, and the consequences for later costs, production and receipts. After corrective feedback, use fresh dates or values. For a redacted local practice plan, keep base and adverse cases side by side, label assumptions and set a review date. Compare actual evidence with the plan when it arrives; retain the original forecast rather than rewriting it to pretend it predicted the outcome.
isixhosa_draft: Impendulo elungileyo ibiza umhla nesixa esichaphazelekayo, oko kunokutshintsha ngokwenene, oko kufuneka kuvunyelwane ngako, nemiphumo kwiindleko zamva, imveliso neerisithi. Emva kwempendulo yokulungisa, sebenzisa imihla okanye amaxabiso amatsha. Kwisicwangciso sokuziqhelisa sendawo esicinyiweyo, gcina iimeko eziyisiseko nezingalunganga macala omabini, uphawule iingcinga ubeke umhla wokuphonononga. Thelekisa ubungqina bokwenyani nesicwangciso xa bufika; gcina uqikelelo lokuqala endaweni yokulubhala kwakhona ukuze uzenze ngathi lwaluqikelela isiphumo.

english:
### Included activity budget

| Activity | Planned sales | Direct inputs | Hire share | Trip share | Cash inputs | Unpaid-time comparison | Surplus after included costs |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| A | R600.00 | R220.00 | R40.00 | R60.00 | R320.00 | R100.00 | R180.00 |
| B | R500.00 | R180.00 | R80.00 | R30.00 | R290.00 | R150.00 | R60.00 |
| TOTAL | R1,100.00 | R400.00 | R120.00 | R90.00 | R610.00 | R250.00 | R240.00 |

### Base monthly projection

| Month | Opening | Receipts | Payments | Closing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 2027-01 | R300.00 | R600.00 | R520.00 | R380.00 |
| 2027-02 | R380.00 | R500.00 | R240.00 | R640.00 |
| 2027-03 | R640.00 | R120.00 | R330.00 | R430.00 |

Receipts total R1,220.00 and payments R1,090.00. Opening R300.00 plus the R130.00 net inflow gives R430.00 closing. Do not sum the three opening balances or the three closing balances as money available. Current activity receipts R1,100.00 less current input payments R610.00 gives R490.00 before other cash movements. Add the old-customer R120.00, subtract the R80.00 old bill, R150.00 withdrawal and R250.00 purchase: net cash movement is R130.00. Separately, subtracting the R250.00 unpaid-time comparison from R490.00 gives the R240.00 partial budget surplus. Neither equals established full profit.

### Scenarios before any new funding or corrective agreement

isixhosa_draft:
Beka i-P01: i-odolo O01 yoSuku 1 ye-R120.00; ukuhanjiswa okugqityiweyo nokuhanjiswa kwe-invoyisi D01-I01 ye-R120.00 ngoSuku 2; irisithi R01-A ye-R40.00 ngoSuku 3. Ixabiso le-invoyisi yi-R120.00, imali efunyenwe yi-R40.00, kwaye ibhalansi erekhodiweyo yi-R80.00. NgoSuku 4 umthengi ucela enye ikopi.
