Musa ukudibanisa i-odolo, i-invoyisi, ikopi neerisithi njengengeniso.

Sebenzisa umzekelo wamanqanaba amane entlawulo kwisikhokelo se-app ukubonisa inqanaba elinye ngexesha. Misa phambi kwempendulo nganye. Umfanekiso onyakazayo yinkcazo esebenzisa amanani eyilisiweyo, hayi i-akhawunti ephilayo okanye umboniso wokuba i-app ixhasa ukwabiwa kwentlawulo enxalenye.

english: Invoice M01 has two lines: 2.5 kg at R12.00/kg and three bunches at R8.00/bunch. Calculate each line, then add money. The result is R54.00. Do not add the quantities as 5.5 kg. A bunch has no supplied mass. If a line lacks a price or unit, stop and resolve that source instead of choosing a convenient zero or conversion.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi M01 inemiqolo emibini: i-2.5 kg nge-R12.00/kg kunye nezixha ezintathu nge-R8.00/isixha. Bala umqolo ngamnye, emva koko udibanise imali. Isiphumo yi-R54.00. Musa ukudibanisa ubungakanani njenge-5.5 kg. Isixha asinabunzima obunikeziweyo. Ukuba umqolo ungenaxabiso okanye iyunithi, yeka uxazulule loo mthombo endaweni yokukhetha u-zero okanye ukuguqulwa okulungeleyo.

english: Give the learner four new blank document cards. Read aloud: an agreement is made, produce is delivered, an invoice is issued, and a buyer pays only some of it later. Ask the learner to place each card in the correct sequence and identify the evidence still needed. Then supply the independent R150.00 invoice and R50.00 receipt. Ask for the recorded amount still owed and what would prove settlement.
isixhosa_draft: Nika umfundi amakhadi amane amatsha oxwebhu angenanto. Funda ngokuvakalayo: kwenziwa isivumelwano, imveliso iyahanjiswa, i-invoyisi iyakhutshwa, kwaye umthengi uhlawula inxalenye yayo kuphela kamva. Cela umfundi abeke ikhadi ngalinye kulandelelwano olufanelekileyo aze achonge ubungqina obusafunekayo. Emva koko nika i-invoyisi ezimeleyo ye-R150.00 nerisithi ye-R50.00. Buza isixa esirekhodiweyo esisafunekayo nokuba yintoni eya kubonisa ukuhlawulwa.

english: If invoice value becomes cash received, move the unpaid portion into the “customer owes” envelope. If a copy creates new income, place it behind the original invoice instead of beside a second basket. If mixed quantities become kilograms, return to the two labelled lines. Give a fresh example after feedback.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba ixabiso le-invoyisi liba yimali efunyenwe, hambisa inxalenye engahlawulwanga kwi-envelope ethi “umthengi unetyala”. Ukuba ikopi idala ingeniso entsha, yibeke emva kwe-invoyisi yoqobo endaweni yecaleni kwebhasikidi yesibini. Ukuba ubungakanani obuxubileyo buba ziikhilogram, buyela kwimiqolo emibini enamagama. Nika umzekelo omtsha emva kwempendulo.

english: Use [Record a sale once](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/sales). Before any real entry, find the matching existing sale or invoice. Collect a redacted set of order, delivery, invoice and receipt references and explain any gap. This lesson does not require sending a customer message or sharing private documents.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa [Rekhoda intengiso kanye](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/sales). Phambi kwayo nayiphi na ingeniso yokwenyani, fumana intengiso okanye i-invoyisi ehambelanayo ekhoyo. Qokelela iseti ecinyiweyo yezalathiso ze-odolo, ukuhanjiswa, i-invoyisi nerisithi uze uchaze nasiphi na isikhewu. Esi sifundo asifuni ukuthunyelwa komyalezo kumthengi okanye ukwabelana ngamaxwebhu angasese.

english:
Start in the sample tour, confirm it is sample data, and open My Records → Sold. Show New sale & invoice and Past sale / paper invoice. Show View invoice for an already linked sale and Create invoice when an eligible existing sale needs one. Reopening is different from starting a blank form.

Choose Invoice type and, when asked, Existing sale record **before** entering buyer and line details. Changing either starts a fresh form in the current app. A new invoice begins a new document. Produce already sold and An invoice already written on paper ask whether the sale exists. Select the source sale when applicable; do not choose No merely to avoid matching it. An already invoiced sale should be reopened, not invoiced again. Preserve the original paper reference when the paper route asks for it.

Check buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price, growing area where relevant, dates and payment status. A suggested price is not evidence of the buyer's agreement. Keep bags and bunches as their actual units. The app can link paid kilogram lines into crop-sale evidence; it cannot infer the mass of other units. Existing-sale linking is limited by the supported source records. Do not split one past sale into invented new sales to make the form accept it.

Save, read the actual message, and reopen the same invoice from Saved or its sale link. Check its number, total, date and status. A device save with crop-sale synchronisation pending is not a reason to create another invoice. Documents are currently saved on the device within the account scope; crop-sale sync does not prove the complete invoice document is available on another device.
isixhosa_draft:
Qala kukhenketho lomzekelo, uqinisekise ukuba yidatha yomzekelo, uvule Iirekhodi zam → Kuthengisiwe. Bonisa Intengiso entsha ne-invoyisi kunye Nentengiso edlulileyo / i-invoyisi yephepha. Bonisa Jonga i-invoyisi kwintengiso esele ixhunyiwe kunye Nokwenza i-invoyisi xa intengiso ekhoyo efanelekileyo iyidinga. Ukuvula kwakhona kwahlukile ekuqaleni ifom engenanto.

Khetha Uhlobo lwe-invoyisi kwaye, xa ucelwa, Irekhodi yentengiso ekhoyo **phambi kokufaka** iinkcukacha zomthengi nezomqolo. Ukutshintsha nokuba ngowuphi kuzo kuqala ifom entsha kwi-app yangoku. I-invoyisi entsha iqala uxwebhu olutsha. Kwi-“Imveliso esele ithengisiwe” nakwi-“I-invoyisi esele ibhalwe ephepheni” kuyabuzwa ukuba intengiso ikhona na. Khetha intengiso yomthombo apho kufanelekileyo; musa ukukhetha u-Hayi nje ukuphepha ukuyidibanisa. Intengiso esele inikwe i-invoyisi kufuneka ivulwe kwakhona, hayi ukunikwa i-invoyisi kwakhona. Gcina isalathiso sephepha soqobo xa indlela yephepha ikucela.

Khangela umthengi, imveliso, ubungakanani, iyunithi, ixabiso elivunyelweneyo, indawo yokulima apho kufanelekileyo, imihla nemeko yentlawulo. Ixabiso elicetyiswayo asingobungqina besivumelwano somthengi. Gcina iingxowa nezixha njengeeyunithi zazo zokwenyani. I-app inokunxulumanisa imiqolo ye-kilogram ehlawuliweyo kubungqina bentengiso yezityalo; ayinakuqikelela ubunzima beminye imiyunithi. Ukunxulumanisa intengiso ekhoyo kuxhomekeke kwiirekhodi zomthombo ezixhaswayo. Musa ukwahlula intengiso enye yangaphambili ibe ziintengiso ezintsha eziyilisiweyo ukwenza ifom iyamkele.

Gcina, funda umyalezo wokwenyani, uvule kwakhona i-invoyisi enye kwa-Ezigciniweyo okanye kunxulumano lwentengiso yayo. Khangela inombolo yayo, isixa esipheleleyo, umhla nemeko. Ukugcina kwisixhobo ngoxa ukumanyaniswa kwentengiso yezityalo kulindile asiyisizathu sokwenza enye i-invoyisi. Amaxwebhu agcinwa okwangoku kwisixhobo ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-akhawunti; ukumanyaniswa kwentengiso yezityalo akubonisi ukuba uxwebhu lwe-invoyisi olupheleleyo lufumaneka kwesinye isixhobo.

english:
Sort these situations: (a) an invoice already saved; (b) an eligible sale already recorded with no invoice; (c) a completed sale not yet recorded; (d) an old paper invoice whose sale may already exist. Explain the lookup step and route for each. For (d), missing evidence about an existing sale stays unresolved until checked. “Paper” does not mean “unpaid”.

Use the prepared sample invoice to demonstrate unpaid → paid in full only when the exercise supplies full payment evidence. Keep the same invoice identity. A receipt date and invoice issue date answer different questions. The current app gives the whole paid invoice one receipt date in its records/chart series. For instalments on different dates, the separate supporting schedule must retain each actual receipt date; the app chart cannot represent that full cash history. If the app does not support the original record faithfully, retain it separately and identify the limitation instead of manufacturing a replacement history.
isixhosa_draft:
Hlela ezi meko: (a) i-invoyisi esele igciniwe; (b) intengiso efanelekileyo esele irekhodiwe engenayo i-invoyisi; (c) intengiso egqityiweyo engekarekhodwa; (d) i-invoyisi endala yephepha enokuba intengiso yayo sele ikhona. Chaza inyathelo lokukhangela nendlela kwenye nganye. Kwi-(d), ubungqina obulahlekileyo ngentengiso ekhoyo buhlala bungaxazululwanga de bukhangelwe. “Iphepha” alithethi “ayihlawulwanga”.

Sebenzisa i-invoyisi yomzekelo elungisiweyo ukubonisa engahlawulwanga → ihlawulwe yonke kuphela xa umsebenzi unika ubungqina bentlawulo epheleleyo. Gcina ubuntu be-invoyisi obufanayo. Umhla werisithi nomhla wokukhutshwa kwe-invoyisi baphendula imibuzo eyahlukileyo. I-app yangoku inika yonke i-invoyisi ehlawuliweyo umhla omnye werisithi kuthotho lwayo lweerekhodi/lweetshathi. Kwiintlawulo ezinxalenye ngemihla eyahlukileyo, uluhlu oluxhasayo oluyahlukileyo kufuneka lugcine umhla ngamnye wokwenyani werisithi; itshathi ye-app ayinakubonisa lonke olo hlobo lwembali yemali. Ukuba i-app ayixhasi irekhodi loqobo ngokunyanisekileyo, yigcine ngokwahlukeneyo uchonge umda endaweni yokuvelisa imbali yokutshintsha.

english: Present a saved R150.00 invoice and the R50.00 receipt from F5.1. Ask whether to create a second R50.00 sale, mark the original paid in full, or keep the part payment in a separate checked balance record. Only the last fits these facts. Then ask what to inspect before downloading a requested copy of the existing invoice.
isixhosa_draft: Bonisa i-invoyisi egciniweyo ye-R150.00 nerisithi ye-R50.00 ukusuka kwi-F5.1. Buza ukuba mayenziwe na intengiso yesibini ye-R50.00, iphawulwe i-invoyisi yoqobo ihlawulwe yonke, okanye intlawulo enxalenye igcinwe kwirekhodi yebhalansi ehloliweyo eyahlukileyo. Kuphela eyokugqibela ihambelana nezi nyani. Emva koko buza ukuba yintoni ekufuneka ihlolwe phambi kokukhuphela ikopi ecelwe ye-invoyisi ekhoyo.

english: For duplicates, start at the existing reference and follow it to the document. For premature full payment, compare the invoice amount with all verified receipts. For altered dates, return to original evidence. In the sample workspace, reopen one prepared invoice and identify its amount, payment status and source. Print/PDF is a separate document check; downloading does not send it to a customer. Use the [invoice companion](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) for the detailed steps.
isixhosa_draft: Kwiikopi eziphindiweyo, qala kwisalathiso esikhoyo ulandele esi uye kuxwebhu. Kwintlawulo epheleleyo eziswe kwangethuba, thelekisa isixa se-invoyisi nazo zonke iirisithi ezihloliweyo. Kwimihla eguqulweyo, buyela kubungqina boqobo. Kwindawo yokusebenzela yomzekelo, vula kwakhona i-invoyisi enye elungisiweyo uchonge isixa sayo, imeko yentlawulo nomthombo. Shicilela/i-PDF yihlolo oluhlukileyo loxwebhu; ukukhuphela akuthumeli kumthengi. Sebenzisa [isikhokelo se-invoyisi](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) kumanyathelo aneenkcukacha.

english:
Day 1 order O02 is R90.00. Day 2 advance DEP02 is R30.00; nothing has been delivered and no invoice issued in this exercise. Cash received is R30.00 and the customer's advance remains separately held in the record. This describes an outstanding obligation, not a promise that a separate physical bank account exists. It does not establish completed sales revenue.

Day 5 completed delivery and invoice D02-I02 is R90.00. First identify the original R30.00 receipt, then record ALLOC02 applying it to this invoice. After that allocation, recorded amount owed is R60.00, advance held is zero and total cash received remains R30.00. The intermediate table row before allocation deliberately leaves the deposit separate until matched. Day 6 receipt R02 of R60.00 settles the balance. Total cash collected is R90.00, not R120.00. Real deposits, cancellations, refund terms and tax timing require the actual agreement and local bookkeeping guidance; this pack invents none.
isixhosa_draft:
I-odolo O02 yoSuku 1 yi-R90.00. Imali ephambili DEP02 yoSuku 2 yi-R30.00; akukho nto ihanjisiweyo kwaye akukho i-invoyisi ekhutshiweyo kulo msebenzi. Imali efunyenwe yi-R30.00 kwaye imali ephambili yomthengi ihlala ibanjwe ngokwahlukeneyo kwirekhodi. Oku kuchaza isibophelelo esisafunekayo, hayi isithembiso sokuba i-akhawunti yebhanki eyahlukileyo ikhona ngokomzimba. Akusekanga ingeniso yentengiso egqityiweyo.

Ukuhanjiswa okugqityiweyo nokuhanjiswa kwe-invoyisi D02-I02 yoSuku 5 yi-R90.00. Qala uchonge irisithi yoqobo ye-R30.00, emva koko urekhode i-ALLOC02 ukuyisebenzisa kule invoyisi. Emva kokwabiwa, isixa esirekhodiweyo esisafunekayo yi-R60.00, imali ephambili ebanjwe ngu-zero kwaye imali ephelele efunyenwe isala yi-R30.00. Umqolo wetafile emaphakathi phambi kokwabiwa ushiya idiphozithi ihleli yodwa ngabom de ihambelane. Irisithi R02 yoSuku 6 ye-R60.00 ihlawula ibhalansi. Imali ephelele eqokelelweyo yi-R90.00, hayi i-R120.00. Amadiphozithi okwenyani, ukurhoxiswa, imiqathango yembuyekezo nexesha lerhafu zifuna isivumelwano sokwenyani nesikhokelo sendawo sokugcina iincwadi; eli pakethe aliyiyili nanye kuzo.

english: Invoice D03-I03 is R200.00; R03-A confirms R120.00 received. Q03 records that the customer questions R40.00. Keep the issue and evidence visible. Merely entering that question does not turn the R80.00 recorded balance into zero or establish that the disputed amount is legally owed. Investigate the delivery, price and agreement. For this synthetic case only, ADJ03 is a separately documented, approved R20.00 reduction. Retain the original invoice and adjustment trail. The resulting recorded balance is R60.00. Receipt R03-B of R60.00 settles it. This is a bookkeeping exercise, not advice to demand a disputed amount or authority to create a tax credit note in the app.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi D03-I03 yi-R200.00; i-R03-A iqinisekisa i-R120.00 efunyenwe. I-Q03 irekhoda ukuba umthengi uphikisa i-R40.00. Gcina ingxaki nobungqina bubonakala. Ukufaka nje lo mbuzo akuguquli ibhalansi erekhodiweyo ye-R80.00 ibe zero okanye ukuseka ukuba isixa esiphikiswayo sisafuneka ngokusemthethweni. Phanda ukuhanjiswa, ixabiso nesivumelwano. Kweli tyala eliyilisiweyo kuphela, i-ADJ03 yi-R20.00 yokuncitshiswa evunyiweyo ebhalwe ngokwahlukeneyo. Gcina i-invoyisi yoqobo nomkhondo wesilungiso. Ibhalansi erekhodiweyo ephumayo yi-R60.00. Irisithi R03-B ye-R60.00 iyayihlawula. Lo msebenzi wokugcina iincwadi, hayi ingcebiso yokufuna isixa esiphikisiweyo okanye igunya lokwenza inoti yekhredithi yerhafu kwi-app.

english: BANK04 proves R25.00 arrived, but no buyer or invoice has been identified. Cash received is R25.00; it stays unmatched. Do not select a convenient unpaid invoice or call it produce sales without evidence. Check the reference and appropriate source safely. If unresolved, retain that status for review.
isixhosa_draft: I-BANK04 iqinisekisa ukuba i-R25.00 ifikile, kodwa akukho mthengi okanye i-invoyisi ichongiweyo. Imali efunyenwe yi-R25.00; ihlala ingahambelani. Musa ukukhetha i-invoyisi engahlawulwanga elungeleyo okanye ukuyibiza ngokuba yintengiso yemveliso ngaphandle kobungqina. Khangela isalathiso nomthombo ofanelekileyo ngokukhuselekileyo. Ukuba ayixazululwanga, gcina loo meko ukuze iphononongwe.

english: Invoice D05-I05 is R50.00; R05 proves receipt of R60.00. Only R50.00 settles that invoice. Keep the extra R10.00 as an unresolved customer credit; it is not extra produce revenue or automatically a tip. Confirm an appropriate agreed treatment and its evidence. This exercise performs no refund, future-sale allocation or financial transfer.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi D05-I05 yi-R50.00; i-R05 iqinisekisa ukufunyanwa kwe-R60.00. I-R50.00 kuphela ehlawula loo i-invoyisi. Gcina i-R10.00 eyongezelelweyo njengekhredithi yomthengi engaxazululwanga; ayiyongeniso eyongezelelweyo yemveliso okanye ithiphu ngokuzenzekelayo. Qinisekisa unyango olufanelekileyo olwavunyelwanayo nobungqina baso. Lo msebenzi awenzi mbuyekezo, ukwabiwa kwentengiso yexesha elizayo okanye ukuhanjiswa kwemali.

english: Build a separate customer schedule with original invoice reference, dated receipt references, approved adjustments, allocations and the remaining recorded balance. Keep advance deposits, unknown receipts and customer credits visible. Do not combine unrelated customers' credits and debts into one misleading net figure. In these cases, original invoice less approved reductions minus allocated receipts gives the remaining balance, with any excess shown as customer credit. english:
The practice need is the same suitable tool service on Days 2, 10 and 20 within a 30-day horizon. Opening available cash is R500.00. Suitability, safe operation and access for BUY and HIRE are assumed confirmed solely to isolate the money exercise. SHARE has an unconfirmed Day 10 booking. No other receipts are supplied.

BUY pays R900.00 on Day 1, R60.00 for operating inputs on Day 10 and R40.00 for maintenance on Day 20. Total payments are R1,000.00. The plan is already R400.00 short on Day 1 and ends R500.00 short. It cannot be funded from the stated R500.00. The buyer would retain an asset, but its remaining value and useful life are unknown. Do not call the whole purchase an established 30-day cost of using up the tool, or assume the retained asset is worth zero. A future sale of that asset is not cash until its price, costs and date are evidenced.

HIRE pays R210.00 for all three uses, R60.00 transport and R150.00 refundable security on Day 1. These are three parts of one offer, not three separate R210.00 service fees. The exercise says operating and maintenance service costs are included, no other charges apply, and the R150.00 deposit is returned in full on Day 30. Cash needed first is R420.00, leaving R80.00. After the refund, net cash paid is R270.00 and closing cash is R230.00. A R270.00 net figure does not mean the farmer could start with only R270.00. The refund returns the farmer's money; it is not a produce sale.

SHARE pays R300.00 towards ownership on Day 1, R30.00 operating contribution on Day 10 and R20.00 maintenance contribution on Day 20. The conditional cash plan uses R350.00 and closes at R150.00. The retained share value is unknown. The unconfirmed booking means this offer has not yet been shown to meet the same need. A favourable cash total cannot resolve that availability problem.

These are supplied charge amounts, not an interest calculation or a statement that such terms comply with law.

The payments due are R222.00 on 31 January, R218.00 on 28 February and R214.00 on 31 March. Their total is R654.00. With the separate R30.00 fee, total outflow is R684.00 against the R600.00 gross advance. Specified financing charges are R84.00: interest R24.00, service R18.00, insurance R12.00 and the initial fee R30.00. Repaying R600.00 principal is not an additional R600.00 interest expense or produce sale. Remaining principal is R400.00, R200.00 and zero after the three scheduled payments. That number excludes future charges; label it remaining principal, not a complete early-settlement quote.

The apparent bank receipt differs, but these two cases have the same net initial funds and specified total charges. A fee added to the loan principal would be a different arrangement and needs its own supplied schedule; it is not silently substituted here.
isixhosa_draft: Ngoku gcina isixa seboleko esiphambili esifanayo, intlawulo kunye noluhlu lokubuyisela, kodwa umnikezeli ubamba intlawulo ye-R30.00 kanye phambi kokuhlawula i-R570.00. Musa ukuyisusa kwakhona kwi-R570.00 efakwe ngokwenene. Ukuphuma okucwangcisiweyo kwe-R654.00 kuthatyathwe i-R570.00 efunyenwe kusanika iindleko zemali ze-R84.00. Irisithi ebonakalayo yebhanki iyahluka, kodwa la matyala mabini anemali yokuqala ecocekileyo efanayo neendleko zonke ezichaziweyo. Intlawulo eyongezwe kwisixa seboleko esiphambili ingaba lulungiselelo olwahlukileyo kwaye idinga uluhlu lwayo oluchaziweyo; ayitshintshwa ngokuthe cwaka apha.

english: A different practice quote shows principal R600.00, a separate R30.00 fee, three R200.00 principal components and R10.00 interest per instalment, with no service fee. Required insurance applies but its amount is missing. Each full instalment, the full repayment total and total financing charges remain unknown. The displayed remaining principal assumes the specified principal payments are made; it does not confirm payment or full settlement when charges are unresolved. Do not set missing insurance to zero and advertise this as a cheaper loan. Obtain the required amount, its payment timing and a corrected complete schedule.
isixhosa_draft: Isicelo esahlukileyo sokuziqhelisa sibonisa isixa seboleko esiphambili esi-R600.00, intlawulo eyahlukileyo ye-R30.00, iinxalenye ezintathu zesixa esiphambili ze-R200.00 nenzala ye-R10.00 kwintlawulo nganye, ngaphandle kwentlawulo yenkonzo. I-inshorensi efunekayo iyasebenza kodwa isixa sayo silahlekile. Intlawulo nganye epheleleyo, isixa sokubuyisela esipheleleyo neendleko zemali zizonke zihlala zingaziwa. Isixa seboleko esiphambili esisele esibonisiweyo sicinga ukuba intlawulo zesixa esiphambili ezichaziweyo ziyenziwa; asiqinisekisi intlawulo okanye ukuhlawulwa kokupheleleyo xa iindleko zingaxazululwanga. Musa ukubeka i-inshorensi elahlekileyo njengo-zero uze uyibhengeze le mboleko ibiza kancinane. Fumana isixa esifunekayo, ixesha layo lokuhlawula noluhlu olupheleleyo olulungisiweyo.

english: Separate the principal and charges in each dated row. Match the total to the document rather than adding an included service fee twice. Link each proposed due date to a cash forecast that includes other obligations. Check the actual purpose, disbursement timing, rate basis, variable-rate exposure where applicable, fees, insurance, collateral and consequences of default with suitable help. This practice pack has no complete business-income forecast, household commitments or lender assessment, so it cannot certify affordability or recommend borrowing.
isixhosa_draft: Wahlule isixa esiphambili neentlawulo kumqolo ngamnye onomhla. Hambelanisa isixa esipheleleyo noxwebhu endaweni yokongeza intlawulo yenkonzo ebandakanyiweyo kabini. Nxulumanisa umhla ngamnye ocetywayo wentlawulo noqikelelo lwemali oluquka ezinye izibophelelo. Khangela injongo yokwenyani, ixesha lokukhutshwa, isiseko somrhumo, ukuhlala kwezinga eliguqukayo apho kufanelekileyo, iintlawulo, i-inshorensi, isibambiso neziphumo zokungahlawuli ngoncedo olufanelekileyo. Le pakethe yokuziqhelisa ayinakho uqikelelo lweengeniso zeshishini olupheleleyo, izibophelelo zekhaya okanye uvavanyo lombolekisi, ngoko ayinakuqinisekisa ukuhlawulwa okanye ukucebisa ukuboleka.

english: A separate payment consists of R100.00 principal, R10.00 interest and R2.00 service already included in the instalment. Calculate that instalment. A learner adds the service again: explain the error. Then give an offer with missing compulsory insurance and ask what prevents a complete comparison.
isixhosa_draft: Intlawulo eyahlukileyo iquka isixa seboleko esiphambili se-R100.00, inzala ye-R10.00 kunye nenkonzo ye-R2.00 esele iqukiwe kwintlawulo. Bala loo ntlawulo. Umfundi ongeza inkonzo kwakhona: chaza impazamo. Emva koko nika isicelo esinokungabikho kwe-inshorensi enyanzelekileyo ubuze ukuba yintoni ethintela uthelekiso olupheleleyo.

english: The current My Records summaries and lender record export are not this repayment schedule, a credit assessment or an automatic affordability decision. Keep the complete schedule and supporting evidence separately. F4 supplies dated cash planning; F7 will address statement boundaries. Do not force a loan advance into a produce sale or imply the app distinguishes principal and finance charges automatically.
isixhosa_draft: Isishwankathelo seerekhodi zam zangoku nokuthunyelwa ngaphandle kweerekhodi zombolekisi asiluhlu lokubuyisela oku, uvavanyo lwekhredithi okanye isigqibo esizenzekelayo sokuba ukwazi ukuhlawula. Gcina uluhlu olupheleleyo nobungqina obuxhasayo ngokwahlukeneyo. I-F4 inika ucwangciso lwemali olunemihla; i-F7 iya kuthetha ngemida yezitetimenti. Musa ukunyanzela ukukhutshwa kweboleko kube yintengiso yemveliso okanye ucinge ukuba i-app yahlula ngokuzenzekelayo isixa esiphambili neentlawulo zemali.

english:
Start this separate case with R800.00 total owned cash: R600.00 for daily work and R200.00 earmarked. Both are inside the same scope, available to the owner, with no transfer fees or legal restrictions supplied. Earmarking is a management allocation; real contractual restrictions must be checked separately. A target of R500.00 is an invented goal for the exercise, not a recommended reserve size.

On Day 5 allocate R100.00 from daily work to the reserve. Daily work becomes R500.00 and reserve R300.00; total remains R800.00. On Day 10 pay a R120.00 maintenance bill from the reserve: reserve R180.00 and total R680.00. On Day 15 an evidenced R80.00 operating receipt arrives: daily work R580.00, reserve R180.00, total R760.00. Its source belongs with the receipt; the amount alone does not establish profit. On Day 25 a specified R550.00 essential bill leaves daily work R30.00 and reserve R180.00, total R210.00. The reserve is R320.00 below the invented R500.00 target.

Keep D01, a separate R50.00 non-cash equipment-use estimate, out of these cash movements. It neither pays for replacement nor moves money into the bank. Keep the unapproved R300.00 funding application G01 out too. A proposal is not money received. This lesson does not prescribe depreciation or its tax treatment.
isixhosa_draft:
Qala eli tyala elahlukileyo nge-R800.00 yemali epheleleyo enikwe ngumnini: i-R600.00 yomsebenzi wemihla ngemihla ne-R200.00 ebekelwe bucala. Zombini zikwisigaba esinye, ziyafumaneka kumnini, ngaphandle kweentlawulo zokuhanjiswa okanye imiqobo yasemthethweni enikeziweyo. Ukubekela bucala yindlela yolawulo yokwabiwa; imiqobo yekontraka yokwenyani kufuneka ikhangelwe ngokwahlukeneyo. Injongo ye-R500.00 ngumnqweno oyilisiweyo wesi siqhelo, hayi ubungakanani besigcinakalo obucetyiswayo.

NgoSuku 5 abela i-R100.00 ukusuka kumsebenzi wemihla ngemihla uye kwisigcinakalo. Umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla uba yi-R500.00 nesigcinakalo i-R300.00; isixa esipheleleyo sisala i-R800.00. NgoSuku 10 hlawula ibhili yolondolozo ye-R120.00 usuka kwisigcinakalo: isigcinakalo i-R180.00 nesixa esipheleleyo i-R680.00. NgoSuku 15 kufika irisithi yokusebenza exhaswa bubungqina ye-R80.00: umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla i-R580.00, isigcinakalo i-R180.00, isixa esipheleleyo i-R760.00. Umthombo wayo uhamba nerisithi; isixa esodwa asiseki inzuzo. NgoSuku 25 ibhili ebalulekileyo echaziweyo ye-R550.00 ishiya umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla i-R30.00 nesigcinakalo i-R180.00, isixa esipheleleyo i-R210.00. Isigcinakalo siphantsi nge-R320.00 kwinjongo eyilisiweyo ye-R500.00.

Gcina i-D01, uqikelelo olwahlukileyo lwe-R50.00 lokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo olungelo lwemali engqo, kungekho kwezi ntshukumo zemali. Ayihlawuleli ukubuyisela okanye ayihambisi mali ebhankini. Gcina isicelo senkxaso-mali esingavunywanga G01 i-R300.00 nayo ingekho. Isiphakamiso asiyo mali efunyenweyo. Esi sifundo asimiseli ukuncipha kwexabiso okanye unyango lwayo lwerhafu.

english: Return to the original opening position and insert a R250.00 repair on Day 20. After Day 15 only R180.00 is reserved. Using that plus R70.00 from daily work is a proposed change of plan, not additional income. Total falls from R760.00 to R510.00, with reserve zero. The later R550.00 essential bill would then produce a R40.00 shortage. Stop and investigate a feasible response before that bill is due. Do not silently clip the negative answer to zero or treat an unapproved application as the missing R40.00.
isixhosa_draft: Buyela kwisikhundla sokuqala sokuvula uvule ukulungisa kwe-R250.00 ngoSuku 20. Emva koSuku 15 yi-R180.00 kuphela ebekelwe bucala. Ukusebenzisa leyo kunye ne-R70.00 evela kumsebenzi wemihla ngemihla sisicwangciso esicetywayo sotshintsho, hayi ingeniso eyongezelelweyo. Isixa esipheleleyo siwa ukusuka kwi-R760.00 ukuya kwi-R510.00, ngesigcinakalo ngu-zero. Ibhili ebalulekileyo yamva ye-R550.00 ngoko iya kuvelisa ukunqongophala kwe-R40.00. Yeka uphande impendulo enokwenzeka phambi kokuba ibhili ifike. Musa ukunqumla impendulo engaphantsi kwe-zero ibe zero ngokuthe cwaka okanye ukuthatha isicelo esingavunywanga njenge-R40.00 elahlekileyo.

english: Start a new case with R400.00 total and no reserve. Earmark R90.00. Then pay R20.00 from that reserve. State total cash after the allocation and after the external payment, including what remains reserved. Explain why a non-cash cost estimate cannot pay the next repair.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ityala elitsha nge-R400.00 epheleleyo ngaphandle kwesigcinakalo. Bekela bucala i-R90.00. Emva koko hlawula i-R20.00 usuka kuloo sigcinakalo. Chaza imali epheleleyo emva kokwabiwa nasemva kwentlawulo yangaphandle, kuquka oko kusele kubekelwe bucala. Chaza ukuba kutheni uqikelelo lwendleko engeyiyo imali engqo lungenakuhlawula ukulungisa okulandelayo.

english: If allocation reduces total money, physically move counters between the two envelopes without removing any. For an external payment, remove its counters once. If the later shortage disappears, replay the repair before the essential bill. Kwintlawulo yangaphandle, susa iikhawunta zayo kanye. Ukuba ukunqongophala kwamva kunyamalala, phinda udlale ukulungisa phambi kwebhili ebalulekileyo. Lungiselela uluhlu olucinyiweyo lweemfuno zolondolozo, ubungqina bazo, imihla enokwenzeka yentlawulo, imali ekhoyo ngokwenene neendleko ezingaxazululwanga. Gcina injongo, ibhalansi yokwenyani neziphathelo zahlukile. Akukho bhalansi yebhanki yangasese kufuneka yabelwane ngayo neklasi.

english: Keep reserve allocation and replacement planning in the workbook unless a supported ledger represents them faithfully. Use the expense companion for actual recorded costs, with original receipt evidence. The app chart does not establish your unrestricted bank balance, asset value or depreciation provision.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ukwabiwa kwesigcinakalo nokucwangcisa ukubuyisela kwincwadi yomsebenzi ngaphandle kokuba incwadi yeerekhodi exhaswayo iyamela ngokunyanisekileyo. Sebenzisa isikhokelo seendleko kwiindleko zokwenyani ezirekhodiweyo, ngobungqina berisithi yoqobo. Itshathi ye-app ayiseki ibhalansi yakho yebhanki engenamiqobo, ixabiso lempahla okanye ingqokelela yokuncipha kwexabiso.

english:
Bring three cards marked Buy, Hire and Share, counters, a calculator and two envelopes marked Daily work and Set aside. Read one source card at a time. Learners may point, sort, explain aloud or ask a partner to write. Keep private financial details out of group work. Use approved redacted documents only when people agree to discuss them.

Every rand amount, day, date, fee and schedule here is **invented for arithmetic practice**. None is a local quote, normal price, legal maximum, interest-rate recommendation or offer of credit. The tool is deliberately unspecified. No crop, yield, machine capacity or instruction to perform a farming operation is supplied. Each exercise starts separately; do not carry cash or debt from another case. Full profit remains unknown.

A negative cash projection is an unfunded shortage, not spendable money or an approved overdraft. Continuing the calculation shows a proposed plan's problem; it does not prove the intervening payments can be made. Real affordability needs the full household/farm commitments and income evidence, which this unit does not supply.
isixhosa_draft:
Zisa amakhadi amathathu abhalwe Thenga, Qesha kunye Nabelana, iikhawunta, ikhalkyuleyitha nee-envelope ezimbini ezibhalwe Umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla kunye Nebekelwe bucala. Funda ikhadi elinye lomthombo ngexesha. Abafundi bangakhomba, bahlele, bachaze ngokuvakalayo okanye bacele ozifundela naye abhale. Gcina iinkcukacha zemali zangasese ngaphandle komsebenzi weqela. Sebenzisa kuphela amaxwebhu avunyiweyo acinyiweyo xa abantu bevuma ukuxoxa ngawo.

Wonke amaxabiso erandi, iintsuku, imihla, iintlawulo noluhlu apha **luyilelwe ukuziqhelisa ubalo**. Akukho nanye ixabiso lalapha, ixabiso eliqhelekileyo, ubuninzi bomthetho, icebiso lokuqikelelwa komrhumo okanye isicelo sekhredithi. Isixhobo asichazwanga ngabom. Akukho sityalo, isivuno, umthamo womatshini okanye umyalelo wokwenza umsebenzi wokulima onikezelwayo. Isiqhelo ngasinye siqala ngokwahlukeneyo; musa ukuthatha imali okanye ityala kwelinye ityala. Inzuzo epheleleyo isengaziwa.

Uqikelelo lwemali olungaphantsi kwe-zero lukungabikho kwemali okungaxhaswanga, hayi imali enokusetyenziswa okanye i-overdraft evunyiweyo. Ukuqhubeka nobalo kubonisa ingxaki yesicwangciso esicetywayo; akubonisi ukuba iintlawulo ezisemva zinokwenziwa. Ukuhlawulela kokwenyani kudinga izibophelelo zekhaya/zefama ezipheleleyo nobungqina bengeniso, ethi eli candelo alinikezeli.

Show S01: add R900 to sales and the customer balance; move R350 of stock into goods cost. Cash stays R950 after P01. The running result is R550 before later costs and checks. Then R02 moves R600 from the customer balance into cash. Sales remain R900; R300 remains owed. This model assumes the delivery and accepted invoice establish that sale; an order or an unfulfilled promise alone would not be the same evidence.

Continue with L01: cash and debt both rise R500, while the result stays unchanged. Use the interactive aid one card at a time. Invite the learner to predict which of the three views changes before advancing. Early cards show a running result from the evidence processed so far, not a completed month's profit.
isixhosa_draft:
Beka iindawo ezintathu: Imali engqo, Isiphumo sexesha, Isikhundla. Bonisa i-R01. Hambisa i-R200 ukusuka kwi-“umthengi unetyala” uye kwi-“imali engqo”; musa ukongeza intengiso kaJanuwari. Bonisa i-S01: yongeza i-R900 kwiintengiso nakwibhalansi yomthengi; hambisa i-R350 yesitokhwe uye kwindleko yeempahla. Imali engqo isala i-R950 emva kwe-P01. Isiphumo esiqhubekayo yi-R550 phambi kweendleko zamva nokukhangela. Emva koko i-R02 ihambisa i-R600 ukusuka kwibhalansi yomthengi uye kwimali engqo. Iintengiso zihleli ziyi-R900; i-R300 isafuneka. Le modeli icinga ukuba ukuhanjiswa kunye ne-invoyisi eyamkelweyo ziseka loo ntengiso; i-odolo okanye isithembiso esingazalisekiswanga sodwa ayiyobubungqina obufanayo.

Qhubeka nge-L01: imali engqo netyala zinyuka nge-R500, ngoxa isiphumo sisala singatshintshanga. Sebenzisa uncedo olusebenzisanayo ikhadi elinye ngexesha. Mema umfundi aqikelele ukuba yeyiphi kwezo mbono zintathu ezitshintshayo phambi kokuqhubela phambili. Amakhadi okuqala abonisa isiphumo esiqhubekayo esivela kubungqina obuqhutywe ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, hayi inzuzo yenyanga egqityiweyo.

english: Sort P02, E01, L02 and H01. For each, say what cash leaves and whether the supplied case records a period cost. P02 settles a supplier balance. E01 changes cash into equipment. L02 has two parts: principal reduces debt; the R10 interest is a period cost. H01 reduces cash and the owner's equity; it is not a business expense here. Do not generalise this personal withdrawal into a rule about salaries in every business form.
isixhosa_draft: Hlela i-P02, i-E01, i-L02 ne-H01. Kwenye nganye, chaza ukuba yeyiphi imali ephumayo nokuba ityala elinikeziweyo lirekhoda indleko yexesha. I-P02 ihlawula ibhalansi yomthengisi. I-E01 itshintsha imali ibe zizixhobo. I-L02 inamacandelo amabini: isixa esiphambili sinciphisa ityala; i-R10 yenzala yindleko yexesha. I-H01 inciphisa imali kunye nobunini bomnini; ayiyindleko yebhizinisi apha. Musa ukwenza oku kuthatha imali kobuqu kube ngumthetho ngeemivuzo kuyo yonke imo yeshishini.

english:
Cash receipts total R1300: R200 old balance + R600 current receipt + R500 borrowing. Payments total R1190. Opening R1000 + R1300 − R1190 = closing cash R1110, an increase of R110. February's R300 receipt is excluded. This is a cash summary; it is not a standards-compliant statement of cash flows with all classifications and disclosures.

Sales R900 less goods supplied R350, interest R10, transport R80, utilities R60, stock loss R50 and depreciation R60 gives **R290 result before tax in this model**. No tax amount is inferred. Closing assets are cash R1110 + customers owing R300 + stock R300 + equipment R840 + prepayment R120 = R2670. Liabilities are supplier/service balances R330 + loan R400 = R730. Equity is R1940. Check R2670 = R730 + R1940, and R1800 opening equity + R290 result − R150 personal withdrawal = R1940.
isixhosa_draft:
Iirisithi zemali zidibana nge-R1300: i-R200 yebhalansi endala + i-R600 yerisithi yangoku + i-R500 yeboleko. Iintlawulo zidibana nge-R1190. Ukuvula i-R1000 + i-R1300 − i-R1190 = imali engqo yokuvala i-R1110, ukunyuka kwe-R110. Irisithi kaFebruwari ye-R300 ayibandakanywa. Esi sishwankathelo semali; asiyongxelo ethobelayo yemigangatho yokuhamba kwemali ngazo zonke iindidi nokuhlaziya.

Iintengiso i-R900 kuthatyathwe iimpahla ezinikezelweyo i-R350, inzala i-R10, ukuthuthwa i-R80, iinkonzo i-R60, ilahleko yesitokhwe i-R50 nokuncipha kwexabiso i-R60 inika **isiphumo se-R290 phambi kwerhafu kule modeli**. Akukho sixa serhafu esiqikelelwayo. Impahla yokuvala yimali engqo i-R1110 + abathengi abatyalayo i-R300 + isitokhwe i-R300 + izixhobo i-R840 + intlawulo yangaphambili i-R120 = i-R2670. Amatyala ngamabhalansi abathengisi/ezenkonzo i-R330 + imboleko i-R400 = i-R730. Ubunini yi-R1940. Khangela i-R2670 = i-R730 + i-R1940, kwaye ubunini bokuqala i-R1800 + isiphumo se-R290 − ukuthatha kobuqu i-R150 = i-R1940.

english: Begin another case: cash R400 and resale stock R120, no debts. Deliver the entire stock for a R300 credit sale, then receive R200 of that sale. Ask for cash, the customer balance, remaining stock, result and total assets. Answer: R600 cash, R100 owed, no stock remaining, R180 result and R700 assets. The opening equity R520 plus the R180 result also equals R700. The R200 receipt must not be counted as another sale.
isixhosa_draft: Qala elinye ityala: imali engqo i-R400 nesitokhwe sokuthengisa kwakhona i-R120, akukho matyala. Hambisa sonke isitokhwe ngentengiso ngetyala ye-R300, emva koko wamkele i-R200 yaloo ntengiso. Cela imali engqo, ibhalansi yomthengi, isitokhwe esisele, isiphumo nempahla epheleleyo. Impendulo: imali engqo i-R600, i-R100 isafuneka, akusali sitokhwe, isiphumo se-R180 nempahla ye-R700. Ubunini bokuqala i-R520 kunye nesiphumo se-R180 nazo zilingana ne-R700. Irisithi ye-R200 akufuneki ibalwe njengenye intengiso.

english: If a learner calls R110 January profit, ask which cash movements were borrowing, equipment or a household withdrawal and which period costs had no January payment. If they add a receipt to sales twice, physically join the invoice and receipt with the same reference, then repeat the fresh example.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi ubiza i-R110 ngokuba yinzuzo kaJanuwari, buza ukuba zeziphi iintshukumo zemali eyayiyimboleko, izixhobo okanye ukuthatha kwekhaya nokuba zeziphi iindleko zexesha ezazingenayo ntlawulo kaJanuwari. Ukuba wongeza irisithi kwiintengiso kabini, dibanisa ngomzimba i-invoyisi nerisithi enesalathiso esifanayo, emva koko uphinde umzekelo omtsha.

english: Choose one redacted recorded sale and its evidence. Say which part is a sale, receipt or unpaid amount. Read the Sales and Invoice app companions before changing an entry. Charts presents recorded information; it does not create this complete position, stock valuation or loan ledger. Keep these practice figures outside actual My Records.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha intengiso enye ecinyiweyo erekhodiweyo nobungqina bayo. Chaza ukuba yeyiphi inxalenye eyintengiso, irisithi okanye isixa esingahlawulwanga. Funda izikhokelo ze-app zeNtengiso nezeNvoyisi phambi kokutshintsha ingeniso. Iitshathi zibonisa ulwazi olurekhodiweyo; azidali oku kuma okupheleleyo, ixabiso lesitokhwe okanye incwadi yeboleko. Gcina la manani okuziqhelisa ngaphandle kweerekhodi zam zokwenyani.

english: Run the missing-stock case. Withhold C01 entirely. The book shows R350 before review, but the physical count, valuation and adjustment are unknown. Cash R1110, customer balances R300, equipment R840, prepayment R120, payables R330 and loan R400 still have supplied support. **Adjusted stock, complete period result, total assets and equity are unknown.** Do not reuse R300 from the complete case after its evidence has been removed. Ask the learner to identify the precise document that would allow a reliable update.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa ityala lesitokhwe esilahlekileyo. Fihla i-C01 ngokupheleleyo. Incwadi ibonisa i-R350 phambi kophononongo, kodwa ukubala komzimba, ixabiso nolungiso zingaziwa. Imali engqo i-R1110, iibhalansi zabathengi i-R300, izixhobo i-R840, intlawulo yangaphambili i-R120, ezihlawulwayo i-R330 nemboleko i-R400 zisaxhaswe. **Isitokhwe esilungisiweyo, isiphumo sexesha esipheleleyo, impahla epheleleyo nobunini abaziwa.** Musa ukusebenzisa kwakhona i-R300 evela kwityala eligqityiweyo emva kokuba ubungqina baso bususiwe. Cela umfundi achonge uxwebhu olugqibeleleyo olunokuvumela uhlaziyo oluthembekileyo.

english: New case: start with cash R200 and no other balance. Pay R90 for a service supplied wholly next month, with the right unused at this month's end. Cash becomes R110; the prepayment is R90; the period result is R0; total assets remain R200. If the service period is missing from the document, the R90 payment is known but that classification is not established. Request the agreement and service dates rather than assuming all of it is a current expense.
isixhosa_draft: Ityala elitsha: qala nge-R200 yemali engqo kwaye akukho enye ibhalansi. Hlawula i-R90 yenkonzo enikezelwa ngokupheleleyo kwinyanga ezayo, ilungelo lingasetyenziswanga ekupheleni kwale nyanga. Imali iba yi-R110; intlawulo yangaphambili yi-R90; isiphumo sexesha singu-R0; impahla epheleleyo isala i-R200. Ukuba ixesha lenkonzo lilahlekile kuxwebhu, intlawulo ye-R90 iyaziwa kodwa loo ndidi ayisekwanga. Cela isivumelwano nemihla yenkonzo endaweni yokucinga ukuba yonke yindleko yangoku.

english: If the learner puts A01 into February only because of the invoice date, point to the January service evidence. If they call every purchase an expense, compare stock still held, equipment and a service already used. If they equate a balanced equation with accurate accounts, show that a wrong classification can still balance: evidence and period checks are needed too.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi ubeka i-A01 kuFebruwari kuphela ngenxa yomhla we-invoyisi, khomba ubungqina benkonzo kaJanuwari. Ukuba babiza zonke iintengo ngokuba zindleko, thelekisa isitokhwe esisagcinwe, izixhobo nenkonzo esele isetyenzisiwe. Ukuba bathelekisa ulingano olulinganayo neeakhawunti ezichanekileyo, bonisa ukuba ukwahlulwa okungalunganga kusenokulingana: kufuneka ubungqina nokukhangela ixesha nako.

english: Assemble a small period-end folder: opening balances, sales and deliveries, receipts, supplier bills, payments, stock evidence, equipment schedule, debt schedule and unresolved questions. Keep original references and dates. An export from the app is one input to that folder. Do not invent stock, depreciation or loan entries in a crop-sale form to force a chart to match this exercise.
isixhosa_draft: Hlanganisa ifolda encinci yokuphela kwexesha: iibhalansi zokuvula, iintengiso nokuhanjiswa, iirisithi, iibhili zabathengisi, iintlawulo, ubungqina besitokhwe, uluhlu lwezixhobo, uluhlu lwetyala nemibuzo engaxazululwanga. Gcina izalathiso nemihla yoqobo. Ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwe-app yinto enye eya kuloo folda. Musa ukuyila izinto zesitokhwe, ukuncipha kwexabiso okanye ingeniso yemboleko kwifom yentengiso yezityalo ukunyanzela itshathi ukuba ihambelane nalo msebenzi.

english:
Discuss four cards:

1. “The app printed a VAT number, so this is a valid tax invoice.” **Not established.** A field or title alone does not establish registration, supply treatment or all required particulars. Inspect the document with the applicable current guidance.
2. “I did not need to submit a return, so no records are needed.” **Not established.** Do not infer all record duties from that fact. Ask about the applicable requirements and any continuing audit, dispute or other obligation.
3. “My export is a complete set of accounts and guarantees a loan.” **Not established.** Check it against the other evidence. An export does not establish completeness, creditworthiness or approval.
4. “A missing stock value should be zero.” **Incorrect.** Request the count, valuation and reconciliation. Do not disguise missing information as a measured result.
isixhosa_draft:
Xoxa ngamakhadi amane:

1. “I-app ishicilele inombolo ye-VAT, ngoko le yi-invoyisi yerhafu esebenzayo.” **Akuqinisekisiwe.** Indawo okanye isihloko sodwa asiseki ukubhaliswa, unyango lwenkonzo okanye zonke iinkcukacha ezifunekayo. Hlola uxwebhu ngesikhokelo sangoku esifanelekileyo.
2. “Bendingafanelanga ukungenisa imbuyekezo, ngoko akukho rekhodi zifunekayo.” **Akuqinisekisiwe.** Musa ukucinga zonke iimfanelo zeerekhodi kuloo nyani. Buza ngeemfuno ezisebenzayo nanasiphi na isibophelelo esiqhubekayo sophicotho-zincwadi, impikiswano okanye esinye.
3. “Into endiyithumele ngaphandle iyiseti epheleleyo yeeakhawunti kwaye iqinisekisa imboleko.” **Akuqinisekisiwe.** Yikhangele ngokuchasene nolunye ubungqina. Into ethunyelwe ngaphandle ayiseki ukuphela, ukuthembeka kwekhredithi okanye ukuvunywa.
4. “Ixabiso lesitokhwe elilahlekileyo kufuneka libe zero.” **Akulunganga.** Cela ukubala, ixabiso nokuvumelanisa. Musa ukufihla ulwazi olulahlekileyo njengesiphumo esilinganisiweyo.

english: Give an invoice and cash export with no stock check, unpaid-customer list or equipment schedule. Ask the learner to prepare an index of supplied and missing evidence, name one specific question for a bookkeeper, and record a current SARS source to consult for one compliance question. Accept an oral explanation or a card sort. A satisfactory answer separates known documents from missing ones and does not claim the export proves profit, complete accounts or tax compliance. The answer must be based on the supplied pack, not private records.
isixhosa_draft: Nika i-invoyisi nento ethunyelwe ngaphandle yemali engenako ukukhangela isitokhwe, uluhlu lwabathengi abangahlawulanga okanye uluhlu lwezixhobo. Cela umfundi alungiselele inkcazo yobungqina obunikeziweyo nobulahlekileyo, abize umbuzo omnye othile womgcini-ncwadi, aze arekhode umthombo wangoku we-SARS wokubhekisa kuwo kumbuzo omnye wokuthobela. Yamkela inkcazo ethethwayo okanye ukuhlela amakhadi. Impendulo eneneleyo wahlula amaxwebhu aziwayo kwalahlekileyo kwaye ayibangi ukuba into ethunyelwe ngaphandle iqinisekisa inzuzo, iiakhawunti ezipheleleyo okanye ukuthobela irhafu. Impendulo kufuneka isekwe kwipakethe enikeziweyo, hayi iirekhodi zangasese.

english: If the learner asks for “the tax number that makes everything correct,” return to the supply, business status, document and current rules. If they try to fill gaps with plausible figures, ask them to label the gap and identify who or what can resolve it. Repeat with a different missing document.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi acela “inombolo yerhafu eyenza yonke into ibe lungile,” buyela kwinkonzo, imeko yebhizinisi, uxwebhu nemigaqo yangoku. Ukuba bazama ukuzalisa izikhewu ngamanani anokwenzeka, bacele balibize isikhewu bachonge ukuba ngubani okanye yintoni enokusixazulula. Phinda ngoxwebhu olwahlukileyo olulahlekileyo.

english: Reopen the appropriate saved invoice and inspect its details without sending it. Use the invoice companion and, when available, the export companion. Prepare a private evidence index and questions for appropriate local help. Keep a readable copy and recovery plan for needed records. Do not assume a device-local document has synchronised to another device, or that a course completion badge certifies the business's accounts.
isixhosa_draft: Vula kwakhona i-invoyisi egciniweyo efanelekileyo uhlole iinkcukacha zayo ngaphandle kokuyithumela. Sebenzisa isikhokelo se-invoyisi kwaye, xa sikhona, isikhokelo sokuthumela ngaphandle. Lungiselela inkcazo yobungqina yangasese nemibuzo yoncedo lwalapha olufanelekileyo. Gcina ikopi efundekayo nesicwangciso sokubuyisa kwiirekhodi ezifunekayo. Musa ukucinga ukuba uxwebhu lwesixhobo selo selumanyaniswe nesinye isixhobo, okanye ukuba uphawu lokugqitywa kwekhosi luqinisekisa iiakhawunti zebhizinisi.

Iibhalansi zemodeli eziqhubekayo emva kwekhadi lomthombo ngalinye; imiqolo yokuqala ingaphambi kokukhangela kwamva kokuphela kwexesha. english: Lay out M-A and M-B. Ask the learner to point to a documented statement, a planning assumption and an unanswered question. M-A is an enquiry about up to 40 kg at R12 per kg, subject to quality and confirmation. The forecast assumes the full quantity sells and the money arrives on 30 January. M-B expresses interest in baskets at R30 each, but confirms no quantity. The forecast's 20 items is an assumption, not a completed market survey or agreed order. Neither document proves a secure market. Ask about grade, acceptance, quantities, delivery costs, payment terms, repeat demand and alternative buyers. Keep a date and source beside each answer.
isixhosa_draft: Beka i-M-A ne-M-B. Cela umfundi akhombe isitetimenti esibhaliweyo, ingcinga yocwangciso nombuzo ongaphendulwanga. I-M-A yibuzo ngokuya kutsho kwi-40 kg nge-R12 nge-kg, ixhomekeke kumgangatho nokuqinisekiswa. Uqikelelo lucinga ukuba bonke ubungakanani buyathengiswa kwaye imali ifika ngomhla wama-30 kuJanuwari. I-M-B ibonisa umdla kwiibhasikidi kwi-R30 nganye, kodwa ayiqinisekisi bungakanani. Izinto ezingama-20 zoqikelelo yingcinga, hayi uphando lwemarike olugqityiweyo okanye i-odolo evunyiweyo. Akukho uxwebhu oluqinisekisa imarike ekhuselekileyo. Buza ngomgangatho, ukwamkelwa, ubungakanani, iindleko zokuhanjiswa, iimeko zentlawulo, imfuno ephindaphindwayo nabanye abathengi. Gcina umhla nomthombo ecaleni kwempendulo nganye.

english:
For January, Plan A forecasts sales of R480 and operating payments of R280. Plan B forecasts R600 and operating payments of R480. Their included cash surpluses are R200 and R120 respectively, assuming all forecast sales are paid within the period. These are not full profits: closing stock, equipment use, overheads and unpaid work are not completely supplied. Do not treat the omitted costs as zero. Do not compare R12 per kg with R30 per item as though the larger number identifies the better enterprise.

Each alternative starts with R300. A's quoted payments leave R120 on 5 January, R80 on 10 January and R20 on 20 January. The assumed R480 payment on 30 January brings its closing projection to R500. B's payments leave R20, then an unfunded -R120, then -R180; its assumed receipt brings the closing projection to R420. A positive closing forecast does not make those earlier B payments fundable. The negative amounts are projected gaps, not an assertion that a physical cash tin held negative notes or that an overdraft was approved.

The supplied work plan allows eight owner hours. A requires six; B requires ten in addition to its paid helper. B has a two-hour owner-time gap. Those are exercise capacities, not recommended work rates. A's apparent fit does not establish that a real farm has sufficient land, water, skills, labour or permissions. Check each real constraint separately using suitable local evidence.
isixhosa_draft:
Kwa-Januwari, i-Plan A iqikelela iintengiso ze-R480 neentlawulo zokusebenza ze-R280. I-Plan B iqikelela i-R600 neentlawulo zokusebenza ze-R480. Izixa zemali ezibandakanyiweyo zazo zi-R200 ne-R120 ngokulandelelana, kucingwa ukuba zonke iintengiso eziqikelelweyo ziyahlawulwa ngaphakathi kwexesha. Ezi azizi nzuzo ezipheleleyo: isitokhwe sokuvala, ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo, iindleko ezongezelelweyo nomsebenzi ongahlawulwanga azinikezelwanga ngokupheleleyo. Musa ukuthatha iindleko ezishiyiweyo njengo-zero. Musa ukuthelekisa i-R12 nge-kg ne-R30 ngento nganye ngokungathi inani elikhulu lichonga ishishini elingcono.

Enye nganye iqala nge-R300. Iintlawulo ezicetyiswayo ze-A zishiya i-R120 ngomhla we-5 kuJanuwari, i-R80 ngomhla we-10 kuJanuwari ne-R20 ngomhla we-20 kuJanuwari. Irisithi ecingelwayo ye-R480 ngomhla wama-30 kuJanuwari izisa uqikelelo lokuvala kwi-R500. Iintlawulo ze-B zishiya i-R20, emva koko -R120 engaxhaswanga, emva koko -R180; irisithi yayo ecingelwayo izisa uqikelelo lokuvala kwi-R420. Uqikelelo oluphozithivu lokuvala aluzenzi ezo ntlawulo zangaphambili ze-B zixhaswe. Izixa ezingaphantsi kwe-zero ziziikhewu eziqikelelwayo, hayi ibango lokuba ithini yemali ibiphethe iinoti ezingaphantsi kwe-zero okanye ukuba i-overdraft ivunyiwe.

Isicwangciso somsebenzi esinikeziweyo livumela iiyure ezisibhozo zomnini. I-A idinga ezintandathu; i-B idinga ezilishumi ukongeza kumncedisi wayo ohlawulwayo. I-B inesikhewu seeyure ezimbini zexesha lomnini. Ezo ziimfuno zomsebenzi, hayi amanqanaba omsebenzi acetyiswayo. Ukuhambelana okubonakalayo kwe-A akuseki ukuba ifama yokwenyani inomhlaba owaneleyo, amanzi, izakhono, abasebenzi okanye iimvume. Khangela umqobo ngamnye wokwenyani ngokwahlukeneyo usebenzisa ubungqina bendawo obufanelekileyo.

english: Sort each source into “supports this fact”, “assumption to test” or “missing”. Show the first projected shortage on the dated cash line. Ask the learner to justify a next step, not announce a universal winning enterprise. A defensible answer is to investigate A further while confirming buyer terms, the complete costs and deliverability. Another is to revise B's scope and obtain evidence for labour and cash arrangements before any commitment. “B wins because R600 is bigger” fails. “A is guaranteed profitable” also fails.
isixhosa_draft: Hlela umthombo ngamnye ube “uxhasa le nyani”, “ingcinga yokuvavanya” okanye “ilahlekile”. Bonisa ukunqongophala kokuqala okuqikelelwayo kumgca wemali onemihla. Cela umfundi athethelele inyathelo elilandelayo, angabhengezi ishishini eliphumelelayo jikelele. Impendulo evikelekayo kukuphanda i-A ngakumbi ngoxa uqinisekisa imiqathango yomthengi, iindleko ezipheleleyo nokukwazi ukuhanjiswa. Enye kukuhlaziya ububanzi be-B uze ufumane ubungqina bomsebenzi namalungiselelo emali phambi kokuzibophelela. “I-B iyaphumelela kuba i-R600 inkulu” iyasilela. “I-A iqinisekisiwe inenzuzo” nayo iyasilela.

english: Hide the demonstration. Give the separate items case: planned ten items at R15 each, R60 payments and R80 opening cash. Ask for sales and closing cash, then ask whether these alone prove profit. Next remove the buyer's confirmed quantity from a fresh enquiry. The learner must name a market question rather than fill the blank with ten. Finally show kg beside items: ask which measures can be compared and which cannot be added directly.
isixhosa_draft: Fihla umboniso. Nika ityala lezinto ezahlukeneyo: izinto ezilishumi ezicwangcisiweyo nge-R15 nganye, iintlawulo ze-R60 nemali yokuvula engqo ye-R80. Cela iintengiso nemali engqo yokuvala, emva koko ubuze ukuba ezi zodwa zibonisa inzuzo na. Emva koko susa ubungakanani bomthengi obuqinisekisiweyo kwisicelo esitsha. Umfundi kufuneka abize umbuzo wemarike endaweni yokuzalisa indawo engenanto ngenani lilishumi. Ekugqibeleni bonisa i-kg ecaleni kwezinto: buza ukuba yeyiphi imilinganiselo enokuthelekiswa nokuba yeyiphi engenakongezwa ngqo.

english: If sales become profit, put the excluded-cost card beside the surplus. If January's final cash hides the earlier gap, replay B one bill at a time. If the learner calls an enquiry an order, point to its conditional wording. Use a new example after correction; do not give a pass for repeating the model's answer.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba iintengiso ziba yinzuzo, beka ikhadi lendleko ekhutshiweyo ecaleni kwesixa esisele. Ukuba imali engqo yokugqibela kaJanuwari ifihla isikhewu sangaphambili, phinda udlale i-B ibhili enye ngexesha. Ukuba umfundi ubiza isicelo ngokuba yi-odolo, khomba amagama ayo anemiqathango. Sebenzisa umzekelo omtsha emva kolungiso; musa ukunika ukuphumelela ngokuphinda impendulo yemodeli.

english: Prepare a small market enquiry sheet with product, unit, quality, quantity, collection/delivery, date and payment terms. Record who supplied information and permission to keep it; use redacted copies in class. Use the mapping guide to identify the correct site and distinguish beds from a whole parcel. A place pin does not prove productive area or land rights. Keep these enterprise forecasts in the workbook; My Records is for supported actual entries.
isixhosa_draft: Lungiselela iphepha elincinci lesicelo semarike elinemveliso, iyunithi, umgangatho, ubungakanani, ukuqokelelwa/ukuhanjiswa, umhla neemeko zentlawulo. Rekhoda ukuba ngubani onike ulwazi nemvume yokulugcina; sebenzisa iikopi ezicinyiweyo eklasini. Sebenzisa isikhokelo semephu ukuchonga indawo echanekileyo uze wahlule iibhedi kwisahlulo sonke. Iphini yendawo ayiseki indawo evelisayo okanye amalungelo omhlaba. Gcina oku kuqikelela kweshishini kwincwadi yomsebenzi; Iirekhodi zam zeengeniso ezixhaswayo zokwenyani.

english:
Build eight short sections: purpose and chosen activity; market evidence; site and resource access; work and delivery sequence; cost assumptions; dated cash forecast; risks and responses; review actions. Give every significant figure a reference, date, unit, scope and status. Mark a quotation as a quotation, an enquiry as an enquiry and an actual payment as a record. Keep an original plan version and a date for revisions. Explain the business in plain language before presenting the numbers.

For A, connect the three quote cards to the cash line and its assumed buyer payment. Keep B as a genuine alternative, with its hours and earlier cash gap visible. Do not combine the two R300 opening balances. A funding application F-ASK for R180 has no approval, terms or disbursement date. It does not fill B's gap. Even an approval may have conditions and timing to check; this lesson gives no approval or borrowing recommendation. F6 supplies questions for reading actual finance terms.
isixhosa_draft:
Yakha amacandelo asibhozo amafutshane: injongo nomsebenzi okhethiweyo; ubungqina bemarike; indawo nokufikelela kwizixhobo; ulandelelwano lomsebenzi nokuhanjiswa; iingcinga zeendleko; uqikelelo lwemali olunemihla; iingozi neempendulo; izenzo zokuphonononga. Nika inani ngalinye elibalulekileyo isalathiso, umhla, iyunithi, ububanzi nemeko. Phawula ixabiso njengexabiso, isicelo njengesicelo nentlawulo yokwenyani njengerekhodi. Gcina inguqulo yokuqala yesicwangciso nomhla wohlaziyo. Chaza ibhizinisi ngolwimi olulula phambi kokubonisa amanani.

Kwi-A, nxulumanisa amakhadi amathathu axabisa nomgca wemali nentlawulo yomthengi ecingelwayo. Gcina i-B njengenye inketho yokwenyani, neeyure zayo nesikhewu semali yangaphambili zibonakala. Musa ukudibanisa iibhalansi ezimbini zokuvula ze-R300. Isicelo senkxaso-mali F-ASK se-R180 asinavunyo, miqathango okanye mhla wokukhutshwa. Asizalisi sikhewu se-B. Nokuba ukuvunywa kunokuba nemiqathango nexesha ekufuneka kukhangelwe; esi sifundo asinikezeli ngovunyo okanye icebiso lokuboleka. I-F6 inika imibuzo yokufunda imiqathango yemali yokwenyani.

english:
Move A's entire assumed R480 receipt to 5 February, retaining January's cost dates. January now has no buyer receipt and ends at R20. The projected sale remains R480; payment timing changed, not the quantity or price. The amount remains expected from the buyer at the window's end under this scenario. This is a January horizon, not a full next-season plan: later bills and obligations still need their own dated rows. A real forecast should cover the relevant operating cycle and commitments, rather than copying this short exercise horizon blindly.

A response must be specific and checked. For example, ask the buyer to confirm terms, then record any actual agreement and recalculate; obtain a genuine alternative transport quote; reconsider the proposed quantity against capacity. Do not assume a deposit, delay a supplier's bill without agreement, cut necessary care or insert hoped-for funding as certain income. Explain the effects on quality, workload, household needs and others before adopting a change.
isixhosa_draft:
Hambisa irisithi yonke ecingelwayo ye-R480 ye-A ukuya ngomhla we-5 kuFebruwari, ugcine imihla yeendleko zikaJanuwari. UJanuwari ngoku akanayo irisithi yomthengi aze aphele nge-R20. Intengiso eqikelelwayo isala i-R480; ixesha lentlawulo litshintshile, hayi ubungakanani okanye ixabiso. Isixa sisalindeleke kumthengi ekupheleni kwefestile phantsi kwale meko. Eli lixesha likaJanuwari, hayi isicwangciso esipheleleyo sexesha elilandelayo: iibhili namabopho amva zisadinga imiqolo yazo enemihla. Uqikelelo lwenyani kufuneka lugubungele umjikelo wokusebenza ofanelekileyo nezibophelelo, endaweni yokukopa ixesha elifutshane lalo msebenzi ngokungaboni.

Impendulo kufuneka ibe nesiqinisekiso kwaye ihlolwe. Umzekelo, cela umthengi aqinisekise imiqathango, emva koko urekhode naluphi na isivumelwano sokwenyani uphinde ubale; fumana ixabiso lokuthuthwa langempela elinye; phinda uqwalasele ubungakanani obucetywayo ngokuchasene nomthamo. Musa ukucinga idiphozithi, ukubambezela ibhili yomthengisi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano, ukunqumla unonophelo olufunekayo okanye ukufaka inkxaso-mali enqwenelwa njengengeniso eqinisekileyo. Chaza iziphumo kumgangatho, umthwalo womsebenzi, iimfuno zekhaya nabanye phambi kokwamkela utshintsho.

english: Give one learner the proposed plan and another the evidence cards. For each claim ask “which record supports it?” Put missing demand confirmation, full cost treatment and site/resource evidence into an action register with an owner and review date. The model's proposed 10 February 2027 review is a classroom date, not a universal planning interval. Ask what could make the plan wrong and what observation would trigger reconsideration. Keep a funding pack's requested information separate from what the class currently knows.
isixhosa_draft: Nika umfundi omnye isicwangciso esicetywayo nomnye amakhadi obungqina. Kwibango ngalinye buza “yeyiphi irekhodi eliyixhasayo?” Beka isiqinisekiso semfuno elahlekileyo, unyango lweendleko olupheleleyo nobungqina bendawo/bezixhobo kwirejista yezenzo enomnini nomhla wokuphonononga. Uphononongo olucetywayo lwemodeli lomhla we-10 kuFebruwari 2027 ngumhla weklasi, hayi ixesha lokucwangcisa jikelele. Buza ukuba yintoni enokwenza isicwangciso singalunganga nokuba ngowuphi ukujonga okuya kubangela ukuphinda ucinge. Gcina ulwazi olucelwayo lwepakethe yenkxaso-mali lwahlukile koko iklasi ikwaziyo okwangoku.

english: A learner submits a polished map, a screenshot of R420 closing projected cash and the R180 application. Explain why these do not prove land rights, earlier liquidity, profitability or funding approval. Ask for the dated B payments and the missing work-hour arrangement. Then give A's delayed receipt case without the answer and ask the learner to build January cash. They must leave the February receipt outside January.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi ungenisa imephu ecocekileyo, umfanekiso wesikrini woqikelelo lwemali yokuvala engqo ye-R420 nesicelo se-R180. Chaza ukuba kutheni ezi zingabonisi malungelo omhlaba, ukuhamba kwemali kwangaphambili, inzuzo okanye ukuvunywa kwenkxaso-mali. Cela iintlawulo ze-B ezinemihla nolungiselelo lweeyure zomsebenzi olulahlekileyo. Emva koko nika ityala lerisithi ebambezelweyo ye-A ngaphandle kwempendulo ucele umfundi akhe imali engqo kaJanuwari. Kufuneka ashiye irisithi kaFebruwari ngaphandle kukaJanuwari.

english: Build a redacted practice plan and a short evidence index. Use the live mapping, invoice and Charts guides for supported tasks. A record export or “Records for a lender” summary is supporting material, not a full application, a title document, complete financial statements or an eligibility decision. Check the current requirements with the relevant organisation when preparing a real pack. Keep private documents secure; this lesson sends nothing to a lender or buyer.
isixhosa_draft: Yakha isicwangciso sokuziqhelisa esicinyiweyo nenkcazo emfutshane yobungqina. Sebenzisa imihlahlandlela ephilayo yemephu, i-invoyisi neeTshathi kwimisebenzi exhaswayo. Ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwerekhodi okanye isishwankathelo se-“Iirekhodi ezenzelwe umbolekisi wemali” yinto exhasayo, hayi isicelo esipheleleyo, uxwebhu lwegama, izitetimenti zemali ezipheleleyo okanye isigqibo sokufaneleka. Khangela iimfuno zangoku nombutho ofanelekileyo xa ulungiselela ipakethe yokwenyani. Gcina amaxwebhu angasese ekhuselekile; esi sifundo asithumeli nto kumbolekisi okanye kumthengi.

english:
Actual A has 36 kg delivered at R11 per kg on 25 January, an invoice for R396. R300 arrives on 30 January, leaving R96 owed at 31 January. The remaining R96 arrives on 5 February; it is not January cash. Actual payments are purchase R180, packaging R50 and transport R80, totalling R310. An evidenced R20 owner contribution arrives on 15 January from outside this business cash scope. It is not a sale or loan. Starting with R300, the actual cash sequence is R120, R70, R90, R10 and R310. ACT-C1 reconciles the final R310 to the cash count and statement evidence. This complete model has no unfunded actual negative balance.

The closing forecast was R500; checked actual closing cash is R310, a R190 decrease against that forecast. Do not call this R190 a business loss. The sales-value difference is R84, and neither difference establishes full profit. Use the visual bridge in this stated order:

- Quantity effect: (36 - 40) kg at the planned R12 per kg = -R48.
- Price effect: 36 actual kg at (R11 - R12) per kg = -R36.
- Unpaid January balance: -R96 of the invoiced amount is not yet received.
- Purchase payment difference: R180 versus R180, no change.
- Packaging payment difference: R50 versus R40 reduces cash by R10.
- Transport payment difference: R80 versus R60 reduces cash by R20.
- Owner contribution adds R20 cash, not sales.

R500 - R48 - R36 - R96 - R10 - R20 + R20 = R310. The quantity and price effects sum to the R84 sales difference. This decomposition values the quantity change at planned price and the price change at actual quantity; different valid ordering allocates the interaction differently. It is arithmetic attribution, not proof of cause. The records do not say why fewer kilos sold or why the price changed. Do not invent crop failure, poor effort, buyer misconduct or weather as the explanation. Investigate using appropriate evidence.
isixhosa_draft:
I-A yokwenyani ine-36 kg ehanjisiweyo nge-R11 nge-kg ngomhla wama-25 kuJanuwari, i-invoyisi ye-R396. I-R300 ifika ngomhla wama-30 kuJanuwari, ishiya i-R96 isafuneka ngomhla wama-31 kuJanuwari. I-R96 esele ifika ngomhla we-5 kuFebruwari; asiyo mali kaJanuwari. Iintlawulo zokwenyani yi-R180 yokuthenga, i-R50 yokupakisha ne-R80 yokuthuthwa, ezidibana nge-R310. Igalelo lomnini eliqinisekisiweyo le-R20 lifika ngomhla we-15 kuJanuwari lisuka ngaphandle komda wemali yeli shishini. Asiyontengiso okanye imboleko. Ukuqala nge-R300, ulandelelwano lwemali yokwenyani yi-R120, i-R70, i-R90, i-R10 ne-R310. I-ACT-C1 ivumelanisa i-R310 yokugqibela nobungqina bokubala imali nesitetimenti. Le modeli epheleleyo ayinabhalansi engaphantsi kwe-zero engaxhaswanga yokwenyani.

Uqikelelo lokuvala lwaluyi-R500; imali yokuvala engqo ehloliweyo yi-R310, ukwehla kwe-R190 xa kuthelekiswa noqikelelo. Musa ukubiza le R190 ilahleko yebhizinisi. Umahluko wexabiso lentengiso yi-R84, kwaye akukho nowodwa umahluko oseka inzuzo epheleleyo. Sebenzisa ibhulorho ebonakalayo kolu landelelwano luchaziweyo:

- Isiphumo sobungakanani: (36 - 40) kg ngexabiso elicwangcisiweyo le-R12 nge-kg = -R48.
- Isiphumo sexabiso: 36 kg yokwenyani ngexabiso (R11 - R12) nge-kg = -R36.
- Ibhalansi ekhoyo kaJanuwari engahlawulwanga: -R96 yesixa esinikwe i-invoyisi ayikafunyanwa.
- Umahluko wentlawulo yokuthenga: i-R180 kuthelekiswa ne-R180, akukho tshintsho.
- Umahluko wentlawulo yokupakisha: i-R50 kuthelekiswa ne-R40 inciphisa imali nge-R10.
- Umahluko wentlawulo yokuthuthwa: i-R80 kuthelekiswa ne-R60 inciphisa imali nge-R20.
- Igalelo lomnini longeza i-R20 yemali, hayi iintengiso.

R500 - R48 - R36 - R96 - R10 - R20 + R20 = R310. Iziphumo zobungakanani nexabiso zidibana nomahluko wentengiso we-R84. Olu qhekeko lunika ixabiso lotshintsho lobungakanani ngexabiso elicwangcisiweyo notshintsho lexabiso ngobungakanani bokwenyani; uhlelo olwahlukileyo olusemthethweni lwabela unxibelelwano ngokwahlukeneyo. Kukuchaza ngamanani, hayi ubungqina besizathu. Iirekhodi azithethi ukuba kutheni kuthengiswe iikhilogram ezimbalwa okanye kutheni ixabiso litshintshile. Musa ukuyila ukutshatyalaliswa kwesityalo, umsebenzi ongakhuthalanga, ukuziphatha gwenxa komthengi okanye imozulu njengenkcazo. Phanda usebenzisa ubungqina obufanelekileyo.

english: Hide the amount on ACT-P2 and remove ACT-C1's closing reconciliation. Packaging was paid but its amount is unavailable. Full payments, closing cash, the cash difference and deepest gap now remain unknown. Sales of R396 and the January customer balance of R96 stay supported. Do not use the other case's R310 closing figure to reconstruct the missing amount. With a separate trustworthy closing reconciliation, a discrepancy could be investigated; this case deliberately does not supply one. Keep a request for the receipt and reconciliation open.
isixhosa_draft: Fihla isixa se-ACT-P2 ususe ukuvumelanisa kokuvala kwe-ACT-C1. Ukupakisha kuhlawuliwe kodwa isixa sako asifumaneki. Iintlawulo ezipheleleyo, imali yokuvala, umahluko wemali nesikhewu esinzulu kakhulu ngoku zihlala zingaziwa. Iintengiso ze-R396 nebhalansi yomthengi kaJanuwari ye-R96 zihlala zixhaswe. Musa ukusebenzisa imali yokuvala ye-R310 yelinye ityala ukwakha kwakhona isixa esilahlekileyo. Ngokuvumelanisa kokuvala okuthembekileyo okwahlukileyo, umahluko ungaphandwa; eli tyala alinikezeli nanye ngabom. Gcina isicelo serisithi nokuvumelanisa sivulekile.

english: Return to the separate items case. Plan: ten items at R15, R60 payments, R80 opening. Actual: eight items at R14, R90 received, R70 payments and R20 contributed by the owner; no other movements or opening customer balance. Find actual sales, customer balance, closing cash and the difference from plan. Decompose the sales change with the same order as the demonstration. Then remove the actual cost evidence and ask which answers remain supported. Do not label a missing amount zero.
isixhosa_draft: Buyela kwityala lezinto ezahlukeneyo. Isicwangciso: izinto ezilishumi nge-R15, iintlawulo ze-R60, ukuvula i-R80. Yokwenyani: izinto ezisibhozo nge-R14, i-R90 efunyenwe, iintlawulo ze-R70 kunye ne-R20 enikelwe ngumnini; akukho ntshukumo zinye okanye ibhalansi yomthengi yokuvula. Fumana iintengiso zokwenyani, ibhalansi yomthengi, imali yokuvala engqo nomahluko kwisicwangciso. Qhekeza utshintsho lwentengiso ngolandelelwano olufanayo nomboniso. Emva koko susa ubungqina beendleko zokwenyani ubuze ukuba zeziphi iimpendulo ezisaxhaswayo. Musa ukubiza isixa esilahlekileyo ngokuba zero.

english: The learner must produce R112 sales, R22 still owed and R120 closing cash against the R170 plan, a -R50 cash difference. Sales quantity effect is -R30 and price effect -R8, totalling -R38. Closing bridge: R170 - R30 - R8 - R22 - R10 + R20 = R120. Correct explanations distinguish product sales, money received, owner funds and the period. If a concept is missed, give corrective feedback and a new small source set; do not change the old answer to count it as independent success.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi kufuneka avelise iintengiso ze-R112, i-R22 esafuneka nemali yokuvala engqo ye-R120 ngokuchasene nesicwangciso se-R170, umahluko wemali ongaphantsi (-R50). Isiphumo sobungakanani bentengiso sicaleni (-R30) nesiphumo sexabiso (-R8), ezidibana nge-(-R38). Ibhulorho yokuvala: R170 - R30 - R8 - R22 - R10 + R20 = R120. Iinkcazo ezichanekileyo zahlula iintengiso zemveliso, imali efunyenwe, imali yomnini nexesha. Ukuba ingcinga ayiqondwanga, nika impendulo yolungiso neseti entsha encinci yemithombo; musa ukutshintsha impendulo endala ukuyibala njengempumelelo ezimeleyo.

english: Write a short review with the original assumption, actual evidence, explained difference, unresolved question, next action, responsible person and review date. Use the Charts guide to check each display's time window and cost scope. The app's single paid-in-full date does not reproduce this partial-payment history; keep the settlement schedule separately and do not mark a deposit as full payment. Do not enter invented classroom figures into a real farm's records.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala uphononongo olufutshane lunengcinga yoqobo, ubungqina bokwenyani, umahluko echaziweyo, umbuzo ongaxazululwanga, isenzo esilandelayo, umntu onoxanduva nomhla wokuphonononga. Sebenzisa isikhokelo seTshathi ukukhangela ifestile yexesha yokubonisa ngalinye nobubanzi beendleko. Umhla omnye wentlawulo epheleleyo wale app awuvelisi kwakhona le mbali yentlawulo enxalenye; gcina uluhlu lwentlawulo ngokwahlukeneyo ungaphawuli idiphozithi njengentlawulo epheleleyo. Musa ukufaka amanani eklasi eyilisiweyo kwiirekhodi zefama yokwenyani.

english:
Use `f8-practice.json`, the learner workbook and the visual comparison together. All money, dates, quantities and hours are invented classroom inputs. They are not local prices, yields, recommended workloads or farming forecasts. This case concerns a produce-selling activity and a basket-selling activity; it does not model production from land. Keep kilos and items separate. Both are alternatives using the same opening money, not two activities that can each spend it simultaneously. The actual case is an invented record set shown after the plan, not a prediction of what will happen.

Build on F3 cost boundaries, F4 cash timing, F5 payment evidence and F7 complete-account boundaries. Supply counters, source cards, a calculator and writing space. A learner may explain aloud or point while a facilitator records the reasoning. No real buyer details or bank documents are needed.
isixhosa_draft:
Sebenzisa `f8-practice.json`, incwadi yomsebenzi yomfundi nothelekiso olubonakalayo kunye. Yonke imali, imihla, ubungakanani neeyure ziingeniso eziyilisiweyo zeklasi. Aziyo maxabiso alapha, izivuno, imithwalo yomsebenzi ecetyiswayo okanye uqikelelo lokulima. Eli tyala ligxile kumsebenzi wokuthengisa imveliso nomsebenzi wokuthengisa iibhasikidi; alimeli imveliso evela emhlabeni. Gcina iikhilogram nezinto zahlukile. Zozibini ziinketho zisebenzisa imali yokuvula efanayo, hayi imisebenzi emibini ekwaziyo ukuyisebenzisa ngaxeshanye. Ityala lokwenyani liseti yeerekhodi eyilisiweyo ebonakaliswa emva kwesicwangciso, hayi uqikelelo lwento eya kwenzeka.

Yakha kwimida yeendleko ye-F3, ixesha lemali le-F4, ubungqina bentlawulo be-F5 nemida yeeakhawunti ezipheleleyo ye-F7. Nika iikhawunta, amakhadi omthombo, ikhalkyuleyitha nendawo yokubhala. Umfundi angachaza ngokuvakalayo okanye akhombe ngoxa umququzeleli erekhoda ukucinga. Akukho nkcukacha zomthengi wokwenyani okanye amaxwebhu ebhanki afunekayo.

english:
All cash values are within the stated January scope. Plan gaps are unfunded projections. Complete profit stays unknown. The original cases compare currencies over one period, not quantities across unlike units.

| Case | Sales | Buyer receipts | Payments | Closing cash | Lowest cash | Cash gap |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Plan A | R480.00 | R480.00 | R280.00 | R500.00 | R20.00 | R0.00 |
| Plan B | R600.00 | R600.00 | R480.00 | R420.00 | -R180.00 | R180.00 |
| Actual A | R396.00 | R300.00 | R310.00 | R310.00 | R10.00 | R0.00 |
