english:
The learner presents an original/revised plan pair with: one market evidence sheet; a resource and access check; an activity budget with exclusions; dated cash rows; a delivery/invoice/payment trail; a cost evidence index; an actual-versus-plan review; and a next-action register. Use only systems relevant to that learner. A farming plan needs appropriate land, resource and technical evidence beyond this market exercise. The map and app records can support the pack but cannot replace those checks.

Assess whether the learner can detect an unconfirmed buyer assumption, an unfunded early payment, double-counted income, unlike units, an unpaid invoice counted as cash, an owner contribution called sales, an out-of-period receipt, missing costs presented as zero and a forecast presented as actual. Record the evidence of performance, feedback and next practice. Do not claim accounting competence, business viability, accreditation or funding approval from this classroom pack.
isixhosa_draft:
Umfundi unikezela ngesibini sesicwangciso sokuqala/esihlaziyiweyo esinale: iphepha elinye lobungqina bemarike; ukukhangela izixhobo nofikelelo; ibhajethi yomsebenzi enezinto ezishiyiweyo; imiqolo yemali enemihla; umkhondo wokuhanjiswa/wei-invoyisi/wentlawulo; inkcazo yobungqina beendleko; uphononongo lwenyani ngokuchasene nesicwangciso; kunye nerejista yezenzo ezilandelayo. Sebenzisa kuphela iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo kuloo mfundi. Isicwangciso sokulima sidinga umhlaba ofanelekileyo, izixhobo nobungqina bobugcisa ngaphaya kwalo msebenzi wemarike. Imephu neerekhodi ze-app zinokuxhasa ipakethe kodwa azinakuthatha indawo yezo zikhangelo.

Vavanya ukuba umfundi unokubona ingcinga yomthengi engaqinisekisiweyo, intlawulo yangaphambili engaxhaswanga, ingeniso ebalwe kabini, iiyunithi ezingafaniyo, i-invoyisi engahlawulwanga ebalwe njengemali, igalelo lomnini elibizwe ngentengiso, irisithi engaphandle kwexesha, iindleko ezilahlekileyo ezibonisiweyo njenge-zero noqikelelo olubonisiweyo njengolwenyani. Rekhoda ubungqina bokusebenza, impendulo nokuziqhelisa okulandelayo. Musa ukubanga ubuchule beeakhawunti, ukuphila kweshishini, ukuvunywa okanye inkxaso-mali kwipakethe yeklasi.

english: A fictional classroom plan in metres. Existing evidence stays visible in every view. Concept A retains the existing growing area and shows a proposed compost area before revision. Concept B shows a separate alternative growing area while retaining the original growing area. Revision R2 visibly defers compost because no care role is agreed. The outer frame is a teaching frame, not a land-rights boundary, and the reported eastern water issue has unmeasured extent and levels.
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso seklasi esiyilisiweyo ngeemitha. Ubungqina obukhoyo buhlala bubonakala kuzo zonke iimbonakalo. Ingcamango A igcina indawo yokulima esele ikho kwaye ibonisa indawo yomgquba ecetywayo phambi kohlaziyo. Ingcamango B ibonisa indawo yokulima eyahlukileyo yenye indlela ngoxa igcina indawo yokulima yoqobo. Uhlaziyo R2 lubambezela umgquba ngokubonakalayo kuba akukho mnonopheli uvunyiweyo. Isakhelo sangaphandle sisakhelo sokufundisa, asingumda wamalungelo omhlaba, kwaye ingxaki yamanzi esempuma ebikiweyo ayinabungakanani okanye miphakamo ilinganisiweyo.

english: 6 Compost proposal · P-COMPOST · W-A; only before R2
isixhosa_draft: 6 Isiphakamiso somgquba · P-COMPOST · W-A; phambi kwe-R2 kuphela

english: Existing evidence remains in every view. Concept A retains the existing growing area and, before revision, shows only the separate compost proposal. Concept B retains the original area as evidence while showing its separate alternative; they are not both active production. Geometry demonstrates supplied model fit only. It does not establish water, soil, tenure, drainage, usable access, costs, permissions or care agreement.
isixhosa_draft: Ubungqina obukhoyo buhlala bubonakala kuzo zonke iimbonakalo. Ingcamango A igcina indawo yokulima esele ikho kwaye, phambi kohlaziyo, ibonisa kuphela isiphakamiso somgquba esahlukileyo. Ingcamango B igcina indawo yoqobo njengobungqina ngoxa ibonisa enye indlela eyahlukileyo; azizozonke iindawo ezimbini ezisebenzayo ekuveliseni. Ijometri ibonisa ukulingana kwemodeli enikeziweyo kuphela. Ayiseki manzi, mhlaba, ilungelo lokubamba umhlaba, ukuphuma kwamanzi, ufikelelo olusebenzayo, iindleko, iimvume okanye isivumelwano sonophelo.

english: Name the alternative drawing sheets. Compare them against the same household needs, access, care, water and cost evidence. Include keeping the present arrangement or deferring work where relevant.
isixhosa_draft: Biza amaphepha emizobo yezinye iinketho. Zithelekise nobungqina obufanayo beemfuno zekhaya, ufikelelo, unonophelo, amanzi neendleko. Quka ukugcina ulungiselelo lwangoku okanye ukubambezela umsebenzi apho kufanelekileyo.

english: Trace one proposed item from the drawing into its sequence, resource record and care agreement. A total cost with no timing, missing costs or an unconsulted carer needs revision.
isixhosa_draft: Landela into enye ecetywayo ukusuka emzobeni ukuya kulandelelwano lwayo, irekhodi lezixhobo nesivumelwano sonophelo. Indleko epheleleyo engenaxesha, iindleko ezilahlekileyo okanye umnonopheli ongabuzwanga idinga uhlaziyo.

english: RESOURCES-A gives no care time, reliable water quantity or budget. The next phase must establish those resources with the household. The person carrying water cannot automatically be assigned every new task.
isixhosa_draft: I-RESOURCES-A ayinaxesha lonophelo, ubungakanani bamanzi obuthembekileyo okanye ibhajethi. Inqanaba elilandelayo kufuneka liseke ezo zixhobo nekhaya. Umntu othwala amanzi akanakunikwa yonke imisebenzi emitsha ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: What resources and money will each phase need?
isixhosa_draft: Yeyiphi imali nezixhobo ezifunwa linqanaba ngalinye?

english: Use the same feature references as the drawings. Record measured quantities, quotation references, dates and when money is needed. Label estimates and missing costs. Refer to your finance worksheet; do not turn an unknown into zero.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa izalathiso zeempawu ezifanayo nezemizobo. Rekhoda ubungakanani obulinganisiweyo, izalathiso zamaxabiso acetyiswayo, imihla nexesha imali efunekayo ngalo. Phawula amaqikelelo neendleko ezilahlekileyo. Bhekisa kwiphepha lakho lomsebenzi wemali; musa ukuguqula engaziwayo ibe zero.

english: Describe the tasks, agreed roles, available time and materials, and what happens if water, money or a usual carer is unavailable. Record agreement rather than assigning someone else’s labour.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza imisebenzi, iindima ezivunyelweneyo, ixesha nezixhobo ezikhoyo, nokuba kwenzeka ntoni xa amanzi, imali okanye umnonopheli oqhelekileyo engekho. Rekhoda isivumelwano endaweni yokunika umsebenzi womnye umntu.

english: The busy-yard case supplies no later field results. A learner can propose what to observe, but cannot claim that harvests, access or costs improved. Keep a monitoring plan separate from observed results.
isixhosa_draft: Ityala legceke elixakekileyo alinikezeli ziphumo zamva zasentsimini. Umfundi angacebisa into ekufuneka ijongwe, kodwa akanakubanga ukuba izivuno, ufikelelo okanye iindleko ziphucukile. Gcina isicwangciso sokujonga sahlukile kwiziphumo ezijongiweyo.

english: Keep the earlier version. Identify the new evidence or feedback, the changed decision and affected drawing, cost or care records. Record remaining checks and the next review.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina inguqulo yangaphambili. Chonga ubungqina okanye impendulo entsha, isigqibo esitshintshileyo neerekhodi zomzobo, indleko okanye unonophelo ezichaphazelekayo. Rekhoda ukukhangela okusele nophononongo olulandelayo.

english: It does not estimate profit, nutrition, buyer demand or a global annual maximum; use your own buyer and price information before committing land.
isixhosa_draft: Aluqikeleli nzuzo, ukutya okunempilo, imfuno yabathengi okanye owona mlinganiselo mkhulu wonyaka wehlabathi; sebenzisa ulwazi lwakho ngabathengi namaxabiso phambi kokuba uzibophelele ngomhlaba.

english: NOT A READING. No soil data was available for this point, so these are the app's general figures — the same numbers it would show anywhere. Do not spend money on the strength of them. A soil test is the only way to know.
isixhosa_draft: AYINGOMLINGANISO. Akukho datha yomhlaba efumanekayo kule ndawo, ngoko ezi ziimbalo ezijikelele ze-app — ngamanani afanayo ebeya kuwabonisa naphi na. Musa ukusebenzisa imali ngenxa yawo. Uvavanyo lomhlaba kuphela olunokukwazisa.

english: Separate what is eaten or shared, sold and stored.
isixhosa_draft: Hlula oko kutyiwa okanye kwabelwana ngako, okuthengiswayo nokugcinwayo.

english: What was picked and recorded as sold.
Money received, costs and unpaid invoices.
Check missing records and unpaid invoices before sharing your report.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela iirekhodi ezingekhoyo nee-invoyisi ezingahlawulwanga ngaphambi kokwabelana ngengxelo yakho.

english: Only dated entries in the selected period contribute to period totals. Unpaid invoices are a separate current snapshot, as recorded on this device.
isixhosa_draft: Imibhalo enemihla kuphela ekwixesha elikhethiweyo ebalwa kwiitotali zexesha. Ii-invoyisi ezingahlawulwanga ziyimeko yangoku eyahlukileyo, njengoko zirekhodwe kwesi sixhobo.

english: Source: the harvest, sales and expense books available to this account, plus invoices saved on this device. This export does not establish that the books are complete or independently verified.
isixhosa_draft: Umthombo: iincwadi zesivuno, zentengiso neendleko ezikhoyo kule akhawunti, kunye nee-invoyisi ezigcinwe kwesi sixhobo. Oku kuthunyelwa ngaphandle akuqinisekisi ukuba iincwadi zipheleleyo okanye ziqinisekiswe ngokuzimeleyo.

english: Dates use the same local-calendar period as Records. Harvest, sale, expense and invoice-payment dates determine which entries appear. Some dates record when an entry was saved; check the event date independently.
isixhosa_draft: Imihla isebenzisa ixesha lekhalenda lasekuhlaleni elifanayo neeRekhodi. Imihla yesivuno, yentengiso, yendleko neyentlawulo ye-invoyisi imisela ukuba ngowuphi umbhalo obonakalayo. Eminye imihla irekhoda xa umbhalo wawugcinwa; hlola umhla wesiganeko ngokwahlukileyo.

english: A paid local invoice is counted once as money received. Its linked sale rows are replaced by its recorded quantities. An invoice unavailable on this device may appear through linked sales; non-produce charges may then be absent.
isixhosa_draft: I-invoyisi ehlawulweyo yasekhaya ibalwa kanye njengemali efunyenweyo. Imiqolo yentengiso exhunyiweyo itshintshwa ngobungakanani oburekhodiweyo. I-invoyisi engekho kwesi sixhobo inokubonakala ngeentengiso ezixhunyiweyo; iintlawulo ezingezizo zemveliso zinokungabikho.

english: No modelled harvest, guide price, planned production, opening bank balance or estimated household spending enters this report.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho sivuno esiqikelelweyo, ixabiso eliyisikhokelo, imveliso ecwangcisiweyo, ibhalansi yebhanki yokuqala okanye inkcitho yekhaya eqikelelweyo equkiweyo kule ngxelo.

english: Cash sale entries after local invoice replacement
isixhosa_draft: Imibhalo yentengiso yemali emva kokutshintshwa kwe-invoyisi yasekhaya

isixhosa_draft: Zibalwa kanye, kusetyenziswa umhla wentlawulo yazo

isixhosa_draft: Ii-invoyisi zasekhaya ezingu-{n} zimakishwe njengezingahlawulwanga okwangoku. Azibalwa kwimali efunyenweyo.

english: {n} harvest or sale entries have no usable quantity. Their weights and counts remain unavailable.
isixhosa_draft: Imibhalo yesivuno okanye yentengiso engu-{n} ayinabungakanani busebenzisekayo. Ubunzima namanani abo ahlala engafumaneki.

english: {n} income entries need a possible-duplicate check. {note}
isixhosa_draft: Imibhalo yengeniso engu-{n} ifuna ukuhlolwa ukuba ingaba iphindiwe. {note}

english: Possibly the same sale — a paid invoice is already counted as income.
isixhosa_draft: Isenokuba yintengiso enye kanye — i-invoyisi ehlawulweyo sele ibalwe njengengeniso.

english: Check missing costs, unpaid invoices and supporting slips before sharing the report. Untagged costs are never allocated to crop profit.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola iindleko ezingabhalwanga, ii-invoyisi ezingahlawulwanga neerisithi ezixhasayo phambi kokwabelana ngengxelo. Iindleko ezingaphawulwanga azisoze zabelwe kwinzuzo yesityalo.

english: Recorded receipts minus costs; not accounting profit
isixhosa_draft: Imali efunyenweyo erekhodiweyo ukususa iindleko; asiyonzuzo yeeakhawunti

english: Units stay separate. A sale quantity follows its cash/payment date and may come from an earlier harvest. No food-use residual is calculated.
isixhosa_draft: Iiyunithi zihlala zahlukile. Ubungakanani bentengiso balandela umhla wayo wemali/wentlawulo kwaye bunokuvela kwisivuno sangaphambili. Akukho sisele sokusetyenziswa kokutya esibaliweyo.

english: Paid invoice totals replace their linked sales once. Possible manual duplicates remain included until reviewed. Buyer and supplier contact details are omitted.
isixhosa_draft: Itotali ye-invoyisi ehlawulweyo itshintsha iintengiso zayo ezixhunyiweyo kanye. Imibhalo ebhalwe ngesandla enokuphindwa ihlala ibandakanyiwe de ihlolwe. Iinkcukacha zonxibelelwano zomthengi nomthengisi azibandakanywanga.

english: Local invoices issued on or before {date}, currently marked unpaid. This is not restricted to the selected cash period and is not an independently confirmed receivable balance.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-invoyisi zasekhaya ezikhutshwe ngomhla we-{date} okanye ngaphambi kwawo, ezimakishwe njengezingahlawulwanga okwangoku. Oku akukhawulelwanga kwixesha lemali elikhethiweyo kwaye asisosixa esiqinisekiswe ngokuzimeleyo sokufunyanwa.

english: All logged categories are included. Missing labour, depreciation, stock and other costs are not estimated.
isixhosa_draft: Zonke iindidi ezirekhodiweyo ziqukiwe. Umsebenzi, ukwehla kwexabiso lezixhobo, istokhwe nezinye iindleko ezingabhalwanga aziqikelelwanga.

english: The same local-calendar series as Records, restricted to this selection. No entries means no recorded result. The current month is incomplete. Any future-dated entries in this selection are included and must be checked. Recorded cash margin is not a bank balance or full profit.
isixhosa_draft: Uluhlu olufanayo lwekhalenda lasekuhlaleni njengeeRekhodi, lukhawulelwe kolu khetho. Ukungabikho kwemibhalo kuthetha ukuba akukho siphumo sirekhodiweyo. Inyanga yangoku ayipheleli. Nayiphi na imibhalo enemihla yexesha elizayo kolu khetho iyabandakanywa kwaye kufuneka ihlolwe. Imali eseleyo ebhaliweyo asiyibhalansi yebhanki okanye inzuzo epheleleyo.

english: How many rand did you receive from crop sales in the last 30 days?
isixhosa_draft: Ufumene mangaphi amarandi kuthengiso lwezityalo kwiintsuku ezingama-30 zokugqibela?

english: Can you record a harvest and its sale?
Can you save a harvest or sale in the app?
isixhosa_draft: Ngaba ungagcina isivuno okanye intengiso kwi-app?

english: Explain why money can enter or leave the farm without being a produce sale or an ordinary production cost.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza isizathu sokuba imali ingangena okanye iphume efameni ingeyiyo intengiso yemveliso okanye indleko eqhelekileyo yokuvelisa.

english: Follow a credit sale into a later payment without counting it twice, and explain why closing cash is not enough to establish profit.
isixhosa_draft: Landela intengiso ngetyala ukuya kwintlawulo yamva ngaphandle kokuyibala kabini, uze uchaze isizathu sokuba imali engqo yokuvala ayanele ukubonisa inzuzo.

english: Keep delivery, sale and payment linked; track what a buyer still owes; separate an internal transfer from new farm income or spending.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ukuhanjiswa, intengiso nentlawulo zidityaniswe; landela ityala lomthengi eliseleyo; uze wahlule ukuhambisa imali ngaphakathi kwingeniso entsha yefama okanye iindleko ezintsha.

english: Combine two activity budgets without counting shared bills twice, distinguish cash spending from unpaid resource use, and identify missing costs and capacity evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Dibanisa iibhajethi zemisebenzi emibini ngaphandle kokubala kabini iibhili ezabelwanayo, wahlule imali engqo echithiweyo kusetyenziso lwezixhobo olungahlawulwanga, uze ufumane iindleko nobungqina bokukwazi ukwenza obulahlekileyo.

english: Calculate a dated cash projection, carry closing balances forward, and detect a shortfall hidden by a positive month-end balance.
isixhosa_draft: Bala uqikelelo lwemali engqo olunemihla, uthabathele phambili iibhalansi zokuvala, uze ufumane ukunqongophala okufihlwe yibhalansi entle yasekupheleni kwenyanga.

english: Explain what each document proves, preserve the quantity and unit, and distinguish a sale from cash collected against it.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza ukuba lonke uxwebhu lubonisa ntoni, ugcine ubungakanani neyunithi, uze wahlule intengiso kwimali efunyenweyo ngokuchasene nayo.

english: Choose new, past or paper entry appropriately; preserve a source reference; reopen or link an existing sale; and check the saved result without creating duplicate income.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ngokufanelekileyo ungeniso olutsha, olwangaphambili okanye lwephepha; gcina isalathiso somthombo; vula kwakhona okanye uqhagamshele intengiso esele ikhona; uze ujonge into egciniweyo ngaphandle kokwenza ingeniso ephindiweyo.

english: Keep cash receipts, allocations, adjustments and questions distinct; explain a remaining balance; and know when the current app needs a separate supporting schedule.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iirisithi zemali, ukwabiwa, izilungiso nemibuzo kwahlukene; chaza ibhalansi eseleyo; uze wazi ukuba ixesha lini i-app yangoku idinga ishedyuli eyahlukileyo exhasayo.

english: Compare the same service need, identify cash tied up before use, retain missing information, and explain why a low purchase contribution does not prove a tool will be available.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa isidingo esifanayo senkonzo, ufumane imali evalelwe phambi kokusetyenziswa, ugcine ulwazi olulahlekileyo, uze uchaze isizathu sokuba igalelo elincinci lokuthenga alibonisi ukuba isixhobo siya kufumaneka.

english: Reconcile money received, fees, principal and repayment dates; recognise an incomplete quote; and connect a proposed repayment to a dated cash plan without claiming that arithmetic alone proves affordability.
isixhosa_draft: Vumelanisa imali efunyenweyo, iintlawulo zeenkonzo, imali eboleke ekuqaleni nemihla yokubuyisela; bona isicaphulo esingaphelelanga; uze uqhagamshele intlawulo ecetywayo nesicwangciso semali esinemihla, ungabangi ukuba ubalo lodwa lubonisa ukuba inokuhlawulwa.

english: Distinguish a reserve allocation from money received or spent, retain restricted/earmarked funds in the correct scope, and identify a later cash gap after an unexpected repair.
isixhosa_draft: Wahlule ukwabelwa kwemali yogcino kwimali efunyenweyo okanye echithiweyo, gcina imali ethintelweyo okanye ebekelwe injongo ethile kwindawo efanelekileyo, uze ufumane umsantsa wemali wamva emva kokulungiswa okungalindelekanga.

english: Point to the record that answers each question: what cash moved during a period; what income and costs belong to that period; and what the business owns and owes at a date. Explain why one total cannot answer all three.
isixhosa_draft: Khomba irekhodi eliphendula umbuzo ngamnye: yeyiphi imali eyangena yaphuma ngexesha elithile; zeziphi ingeniso neendleko ezizezeli xesha; kwaye ishishini linantoni nalityala ntoni ngomhla othile. Chaza isizathu sokuba isixa esinye singaziphenduli zontathu.

english: Separate event, document and payment dates. Explain why stock, equipment, unpaid costs and future services matter at the period boundary. Keep an unsupported value unknown.
isixhosa_draft: Wahlule umhla wesiganeko, woxwebhu nowentlawulo. Chaza isizathu sokuba isitokhwe, izixhobo, iindleko ezingahlawulwanga neenkonzo ezizayo zibalulekile ekupheleni kwexesha. Gcina ixabiso elingaxhaswanga lingaziwa.

english: Assemble an evidence pack and find the appropriate current official guidance. Distinguish a readable app invoice from a verified compliant tax invoice. State what remains unconfirmed without guessing a tax rate, deadline or registration outcome.
isixhosa_draft: Hlanganisa ipakethe yobungqina uze ufumane isikhokelo esisemthethweni sangoku esifanelekileyo. Wahlule i-invoyisi yeapp efundekayo kwi-invoyisi yerhafu ethobelayo eqinisekisiweyo. Chaza oko kungaqinisekiswanga ngaphandle kokuqikelela umlinganiselo werhafu, umhla ophelelayo okanye umphumo wobhaliso.

english: Compare two options using demand evidence, the same period, available resources and dated cash needs; explain a missing assumption before choosing a next action.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa iinketho ezimbini usebenzisa ubungqina bemfuno, ixesha elifanayo, izixhobo ezikhoyo neemfuno zemali ezinemihla; chaza ingqikelelo elahlekileyo phambi kokukhetha inyathelo elilandelayo.

english: Present a connected plan whose claims lead back to evidence, show timing and constraints, and distinguish an unapproved funding request from available cash.
isixhosa_draft: Bonisa isicwangciso esidityanisiweyo apho amabango abuyela kubungqina, sibonise ixesha nemiqobo, uze wahlule isicelo senkxaso-mali esingakavunywa kwimali ekhoyo.

english: Reconcile an original forecast with actual records, separate quantity, price, collection and cost differences, preserve a missing value, and set a justified next action.
isixhosa_draft: Vumelanisa uqikelelo lokuqala neerekhodi zokwenyani, wahlule umahluko kubungakanani, ixabiso, ukufumana intlawulo neendleko, ugcine ixabiso elilahlekileyo, uze ubeke inyathelo elilandelayo elinesizathu.

english: Follow what happened. A buyer paid for produce. The owner added some of their own money. The farm borrowed money. All three can put money in the tin, but they are different events. Write the reason beside each amount. When the owner takes money home, record that too. Do not hide it among packaging or transport. The farm and household both matter. Clear records help you see how they support each other.
isixhosa_draft: Landela oko kwenzekileyo. Umthengi uhlawule imveliso. Umnini ufake eyakhe imali. Ifama iboleke imali. Zontathu zinokufaka imali ethini, kodwa ziziganeko ezahlukeneyo. Bhala isizathu ecaleni kwesixa ngasinye. Xa umnini ethatha imali ayise ekhaya, rekhoda oko nako. Ungakufihli phakathi kokupakisha okanye ukuhambisa. Ifama nekhaya zombini ziyabalulekile. Iirekhodi ezicacileyo zikunceda ubone indlela ezixhasana ngayo.

english: A buyer can take produce today and pay later. Record the sale and what the buyer owes. When the payment arrives, match it to that sale. The payment clears the amount owed; it is not a second basket sold. Cash answers how much money is available. Profit needs the income and costs for the period. Some costs or stock information may still be missing. Say what you know and what you still need.
isixhosa_draft: Umthengi unokuthatha imveliso namhlanje ahlawule kamva. Bhala intengiso nesixa umthengi anetyala ngaso. Xa intlawulo ifika, iqhelanise nale ntengiso. Intlawulo icima ityala; ayiyiyo ibhasikidi yesibini ethengisiweyo. Imali engqo iphendula ukuba mingaphi imali ekhoyo. Inzuzo idinga ingeniso neendleko zexesha. Ezinye iindleko okanye ulwazi lwesitokhwe zisenokulahleka. Yitsho oko ukwaziyo noko usakudingayo.

english: Give each record a date and a clear reason. Keep the receipt, invoice or another useful reference. After saving, open the entry again and compare it with the source. Check the amount and the unit. A kilogram and a bunch are different. If evidence is missing, write what is unknown. Do not use zero to mean ‘I do not know’. Keep a note of a correction so you can explain it later.
isixhosa_draft: Unika irekhodi ngalinye umhla nesizathu esicacileyo. Gcina irisithi, i-invoyisi okanye esinye isalathiso esiluncedo. Emva kokugcina, vula kwakhona into engeniswe uyithelekise nomthombo. Jonga isixa neyunithi. Ikhilogram nesixha ayifani. Ukuba ubungqina bulahlekile, bhala oko ungakwaziyo. Musa ukusebenzisa u-zero ukuthetha ‘andazi’. Gcina inqaku lolungiso ukuze ukwazi ukulichaza kamva.

english: Start with what was already here. Add what you picked. Record what left and why. A sale, food for home and a gift are different uses. Keep the same unit. At the end, count or weigh what is still here. Compare that with the book. If they differ, look for the cause. A difference is a question to investigate, not proof that someone stole food.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngoko sele bekukho apha. Yongeza oko ukuvunileyo. Rekhoda oko kuphumileyo nesizathu. Intengiso, ukutya kwasekhaya nesipho zizinto ezahlukeneyo zokusetyenziswa. Sebenzisa iyunithi efanayo. Ekupheleni, bala okanye linganisa oko kusabakho. Thelekisa noko kwincwadi. Ukuba kwahlukile, funa isizathu. Umahluko ngumbuzo wokuphanda, ayingobubungqina bokuba kukho obe ukutya.

english:
Write the sale when the agreed produce is delivered in this exercise. Keep the payment beside that sale, with the date it arrived. If only some money arrives, show what is still owed. Moving your own money from the cash tin to the wallet does not create another sale. It changes where the money is kept. A fee is a separate payment if the evidence shows one. Keep the amount and cents from the source.”

This exercise's agreed delivery is the point used to record its sale. It is not a rule covering every contract, deposit, return or accounting policy. Those need their own terms and bookkeeping review.
isixhosa_draft:
Bhala intengiso xa imveliso eyavunyelwana ngayo ihanjisiwe kulo msebenzi wokuziqhelanisa. Gcina intlawulo ecaleni kwaloo ntengiso, kunye nomhla efike ngawo. Ukuba imali ethile kuphela efikile, bonisa osafanele ukuhlawulwa. Ukuhambisa imali yakho ukusuka ethini yemali ukuya kwisikhwama akwenzi enye intengiso. Kutshintsha kuphela apho imali igcinwa khona. Intlawulo yenkonzo yintlawulo eyahlukileyo ukuba ubungqina bubonisa enye. Gcina isixa namasenti ekuvela kumthombo.”

Ukuhanjiswa okuvunyelweneyo kwalo msebenzi wokuziqhelanisa yindawo esetyenziselwa ukurekhoda intengiso yawo. Ayilulo umthetho ogubungela zonke iikontraki, amadiphozithi, ukubuyiswa kwemveliso okanye imigaqo-nkqubo yokubala. Ezo zifuna imigaqo yazo kunye nokuphononongwa kokugcina iincwadi zemali.

english: Start with a product and a period. A direct cost belongs to that product. A shared cost serves more than one product. Use a record of how it was used to divide it, and explain your choice. Divide the cost; do not copy the whole bill into both crops. Keep the family's work hours visible too. No wage paid does not mean no work done. An amount used to value that time is different from cash paid out.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngemveliso nexesha. Indleko ethe ngqo ngeyaloo mveliso. Indleko eyabelwanayo isebenzela imveliso engaphezu kweyodwa. Sebenzisa irekhodi lokusetyenziswa ukuyahlula, uze uchaze ukhetho lwakho. Yahlula indleko; ungayikopi yonke ibhili kuzo zombini izityalo. Gcina neeyure zomsebenzi wosapho zibonakala. Ukungahlawulwa mvuzo akuthethi ukuba akukho msebenzi wenziweyo. Isixa esisetyenziselwa ukuxabisa eso sihlandlo sahlukile kwimali ehlawuliweyo.

english: A cost per unit needs two things: the costs you included and the quantity you divided by. Say both. Produce available for sale is not always produce sold. A selling price may cover some costs and still leave others unpaid. Contribution is what remains after the included variable costs. It must still cover fixed costs. A break-even answer is useful only when its assumptions fit and the required sales can be achieved.
isixhosa_draft: Indleko ngeyunithi ifuna izinto ezibini: iindleko ozifakileyo nobungakanani owahlula ngabo. Zibhale zombini. Imveliso ekhoyo yokuthengisa ayisoloko ithengisiwe. Ixabiso lokuthengisa linokugubungela ezinye iindleko liyishiye ezinye zingahlawulwanga. Igalelo yile ishiyekayo emva kweendleko ezitshintshayo ezifakiweyo. Kusafuneka igubungele iindleko ezingatshintshiyo. Impendulo ye-break-even iluncedo kuphela xa iingqikelelo zayo zifanelekile kwaye intengiso efunekayo inokufezekiswa.

english: Compare the whole offer. Check the weight, quality, price, packaging, delivery and payment date. Use the same unit for both buyers. A higher price can leave less after delivery. Money promised for next week is not money available today. Write down what is agreed, and check what is still unknown before choosing.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa isiphakamiso sonke. Jonga ubunzima, umgangatho, ixabiso, ukupakisha, ukuhanjiswa nomhla wentlawulo. Sebenzisa iyunithi efanayo kubathengi ababini. Ixabiso eliphezulu linokushiya incinci emva kokuhanjiswa. Imali eyathenjiswa yeveki ezayo ayiyiyo imali ekhoyo namhlanje. Bhala oko kuvunyelwene ngako, ujonge oko kungaziwa kuseleyo phambi kokukhetha.

english: A budget is a plan with reasons behind the numbers. Name the activity and the period. Show what you expect to sell and what you expect to use. Keep shared bills once in the farm total. Family work still matters when no wage is paid. Write down what you do not yet know. A positive answer on paper does not prove that the land, water, time or buyers are available.
isixhosa_draft: Ibhajethi sisicwangciso esinezizathu ngasemva kwamanani. Chaza umsebenzi nexesha. Bonisa oko ulindele ukukuthengisa noko ulindele ukukusebenzisa. Gcina iibhili ezabelwanayo kanye kuphela kwisixa sefama. Umsebenzi wosapho usabalulekile xa kungekho mvuzo uhlawulwayo. Bhala oko ungekakwazi. Impendulo entle ephepheni ayibonisi ukuba umhlaba, amanzi, ixesha okanye abathengi bakhona.

english: Start with money that is available at the beginning. Add a receipt when you expect the money to arrive. Subtract a payment when it must leave. Carry the balance to the next date. An invoice is not cash received. Check the dates between month ends too. A good total at the end cannot pay a bill that comes before the money arrives.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngemali ekhoyo ekuqaleni. Yongeza irisithi xa ulindele ukuba imali ifike. Susa intlawulo xa kufuneka imali iphume. Thabathela ibhalansi kumhla olandelayo. I-invoyisi ayiyiyo imali efunyenweyo. Jonga nemihla ephakathi kwesiphelo senyanga. Isixa esihle ekupheleni asinakuhlawula ibhili efika ngaphambi kokuba imali ifike.

english: Ask what changes if the buyer pays late, less produce sells, or an input costs more. Change the matching card and recalculate from that point onward. A delay changes when cash arrives. A lower sale changes how much arrives. Test them together too. Write down the evidence needed for your response, and check the plan again before committing.
isixhosa_draft: Buza ukuba kutshintsha ntoni xa umthengi ehlawula emva kwexesha, kuthengiswa imveliso encinci, okanye enye yezinto ozifakayo ibiza ngakumbi. Tshintsha ikhadi elihambelanayo uphinde ubale ukusuka kuloo ndawo phambili. Ukulibaziseka kutshintsha ixesha imali efika ngalo. Intengiso encinci itshintsha ukuba mingaphi imali efikayo. Zivavanye zonke kunye. Bhala ubungqina obufunekayo kwimpendulo yakho, uphinde ujonge isicwangciso phambi kokuzibophelela.

english: Keep the story of one sale together. First, agree what the buyer wants and how payment will work. Check what you deliver. Check the invoice against that delivery and the agreed price. When money arrives, match it to the same invoice. The payment does not create another basket of produce. Keep its date and reference so you can show what is still owed.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ibali lentengiso enye lilonke. Okokuqala, vumelanani ukuba umthengi ufuna ntoni nokuba intlawulo iya kusebenza njani. Jonga oko ukuhambisayo. Jonga i-invoyisi ngokuchasene nolo hanjiso nexabiso elivunyiweyo. Xa imali ifika, iqhelanise nale nvoyisi inye. Intlawulo ayenzi enye ibhasikidi yemveliso. Gcina umhla wayo nesalathiso ukuze ubonise ityala eliseleyo.

english: Look in your records before you add anything. If the invoice is already there, open it. If the sale is there but needs an invoice, use that sale. If you are bringing in an older or paper record, keep its original reference and dates. Read the save message. Open the saved document and check it. A second copy of a document must not become a second sale.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela kwiirekhodi zakho phambi kokuba wongeze nantoni na. Ukuba i-invoyisi sele ikhona, yivule. Ukuba intengiso ikhona kodwa idinga i-invoyisi, sebenzisa leyo ntengiso. Ukuba ungenisa irekhodi lakudala okanye lephepha, gcina isalathiso nemihla yalo yokuqala. Funda umyalezo wokugcina. Vula uxwebhu olugciniweyo ulujonge. Ikopi yesibini yoxwebhu mayingabi yintengiso yesibini.

english: Write down every payment once, with its evidence. A deposit may arrive before produce is delivered. Keep it linked to that customer and order. Later, applying that same deposit to an invoice does not bring in more money. Keep questions and agreed corrections visible. If money arrives and you do not know who sent it, investigate before matching it to a sale.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala intlawulo nganye kanye kuphela, nobungqina bayo. Idiphozithi inokufika phambi kokuba imveliso ihanjiswe. Yigcine ihlanganiswe nalo mthengi nalo odolo. Kamva, ukusebenzisa leyo diphozithi ifanayo kwi-invoyisi akungenisi mali engakumbi. Gcina imibuzo nolungiso oluvunyiweyo kubonakala. Ukuba imali ifika kungaziwa ukuba ithunyelwe ngubani, phanda phambi kokuyiqhelanisa nentengiso.

english: Start with the work you need done and the dates. Ask what each offer includes. Buying, hiring and sharing move money at different times. A deposit may come back later, but you still need it before use. Keep the value of a tool you still own separate from cash in your hand. Check who can use a shared tool, when it is available and who pays for damage or repairs.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngomsebenzi odinga ukwenziwa nemihla. Buza ukuba isiphakamiso ngasinye sibandakanya ntoni. Ukuthenga, ukuqesha nokwabelana kuhambisa imali ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo. Idiphozithi inokubuyiswa kamva, kodwa usayidinga phambi kokusetyenziswa. Gcina ixabiso lesixhobo osisenalo lahlukile kwimali esesandleni sakho. Jonga ukuba ngubani onokusebenzisa isixhobo esabiweyo, ukuba sifumaneka nini, nokuba ngubani ohlawula umonakalo okanye ukulungiswa.

english: The amount borrowed is not the amount you may have left to spend. Read the fees and when they are paid. Each instalment may contain repayment of the amount borrowed, interest and other charges. If a charge is already included, do not add it again. Keep the dates. A smaller-looking instalment is not enough information to choose a loan.
isixhosa_draft: Imali oyibolekileyo ayiyiyo imali onokuba nayo eseleyo yokuchitha. Funda iintlawulo xa zihlawulwa. Isabelo ngasinye sinokubandakanya ukubuyisela imali eboleke, inzala nezinye iintlawulo. Ukuba intlawulo sele ifakiwe, musa ukuphinda uyongeze. Gcina imihla. Isabelo esibonakala sincinci asanele ulwazi lokukhetha imboleko.

english: Setting money aside gives it a job. It does not create more money. If you move it between two accounts you own, the total is unchanged unless there is a fee. When you pay someone else for a repair, money leaves. Keep the amount still set aside separate from money for daily work. A reserve target is a plan, not an account balance.
isixhosa_draft: Ukubeka imali eceleni kuyinika umsebenzi. Akwenzi imali eyongezelelekileyo. Ukuba uyihambisa phakathi kweeakhawunti ezimbini ezezakho, isixa sipheleleyo asitshintshi ngaphandle kokuba kukho intlawulo. Xa uhlawula omnye umntu ngokulungisa, imali iyaphuma. Gcina imali esaseceleni ahlukile kwimali yomsebenzi wemihla ngemihla. Injongo yogcino sisicwangciso, ayiyiyo ibhalansi yeakhawunti.

english: Start by saying which business and which dates you mean. Our stall starts with money, stock, equipment and amounts owed. A cash summary follows money received and paid. A profit-and-loss view follows the period's income and costs. A balance sheet shows the position on a date: assets, liabilities and what remains for the owner. The views are connected, but their totals need not match. Borrowed money increases cash and debt. It does not become a sale. A customer can owe us for goods already delivered. That sale can be recorded before the money reaches us.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngokuthi uthetha ngeliphi ishishini neyiphi imihla. Isitali sethu siqala ngemali, isitokhwe, izixhobo namatyala. Isishwankathelo semali engqo silandela imali efunyenweyo nehlawuliweyo. Imbonakalo yenzuzo nelahleko ilandela ingeniso neendleko zexesha. Ishiti lebhalansi libonisa isimo ngomhla othile: ii-asethi, amatyala noko kushiyekayo kumnini. Ezo mbonakalo ziyadityaniswa, kodwa izixa zazo azifuni zivumelane. Imali eboleke ikhulisa imali engqo neetyala. Ayiyiyo intengiso. Umthengi unokuba netyala kuthi ngezinto esele zihanjisiwe. Loo ntengiso inokurekhodwa phambi kokuba imali isifikele.

english: A document can arrive after the work. Payment can happen before or after the service. Keep those dates together. At the end of our month, ask what was delivered, used, owed and still available. A bank line alone cannot answer every question. Check the stock and equipment records too. When evidence is missing, write what you still need. Do not enter zero just to finish a total.
isixhosa_draft: Uxwebhu lunokufika emva komsebenzi. Intlawulo inokwenzeka phambi okanye emva kwenkonzo. Gcina leyo mihla ndawonye. Ekupheleni kwenyanga yethu, buza ukuba kuhanjisiwe, kusetyenzisiwe, kunetyala nokusekhona. Umgca webhanki wodwa awunakuphendula yonke imibuzo. Jonga neerekhodi zesitokhwe nezixhobo. Xa ubungqina bulahlekile, bhala oko usasidinga. Musa ukufaka u-zero ukuze ugqibe isixa.

english: Keep the story behind a number. Who supplied what? When did it happen? Which document supports it? Which money movement belongs with it? Keep records organised and safe. Tax and record duties depend on the business and its circumstances. Use current SARS guidance and suitable help. A saved invoice, tax-reference field or app export cannot confirm all those duties for you.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ibali elingasemva kwenani. Ngubani onikeze ntoni? Kwenzeke nini? Luluphi uxwebhu olulixhasayo? Ngowuphi umhambo wemali ohambelana nalo? Gcina iirekhodi zilungiselelwe nezikhuselekileyo. Imisebenzi yerhafu neyerekhodi ixhomekeke kushishini nakwiimeko zalo. Sebenzisa isikhokelo sangoku se-SARS noncedo olufanelekileyo. I-invoyisi egciniweyo, intsimi yenombolo yerhafu okanye okuthunyelwe ngaphandle kwe-app akunakukuqinisekisela yonke leyo misebenzi.

english: Start with a buyer and a task you can deliver. What does the buyer need? How much, in which unit, at what quality, and by when? Interest is not an order. A high sales total does not tell you what you will keep or whether you can pay the earlier bills. Put the alternatives beside each other. Keep the missing evidence visible.
isixhosa_draft: Qala ngomthengi nomsebenzi onokuwunikezela. Umthengi ufuna ntoni? Kungakanani, kwiyunithi ethile, kumgangatho onjani, nangomhla wesiphi? Umdla ayingowodolo. Isixa esiphezulu sentengiso asikuxeleli oko uya kukugcina okanye ukuba ungakwazi ukuhlawula iibhili zangaphambili. Beka ezinye iindlela ecaleni komnye. Gcina ubungqina obulahlekileyo bubonakala.

english: A useful plan lets another person follow your reasoning. Say what you intend to sell, why a buyer may want it, and what you need to deliver it. Show the work and payments in order. Keep estimates separate from records. If a number or permission is missing, name it and say how you will check it. A neat document cannot turn an application into money.
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso esilungileyo sivumela omnye umntu alandele ukucinga kwakho. Chaza oko uceba ukukuthengisa, isizathu sokuba umthengi angafuna, noko ukudingayo ukukuhambisa. Bonisa umsebenzi neentlawulo ngokulandelelana. Gcina uqikelelo lwahlukile kwiirekhodi. Ukuba inani okanye imvume ilahlekile, yibize uze uchaze indlela oya kuyijonga ngayo. Uxwebhu olucocekileyo alunakuguqula isicelo sibe yimali.

english: Keep the plan you started with. Put the actual records beside it for the same period and units. What sold? What money arrived? What was paid? Which amounts are still owed? Explain each difference with evidence before saying why it happened. Then make the next plan. Changing the old plan to match the result hides what you learned.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina isicwangciso owaqala ngaso. Beka iirekhodi zokwenyani ecaleni kwaso kwixesha neeyunithi ezifanayo. Kuthengiswe ntoni? Yeyiphi imali efikileyo? Kuhlawulwe ntoni? Ngawaphi amatyala asekho? Chaza umahluko ngamnye ngobungqina phambi kokuthi uchaze isizathu sokuba wenzeke. Emva koko yenza isicwangciso esilandelayo. Ukutshintsha isicwangciso esidala sihambelane nesiphumo kufihla oko ukufundileyo.

english: Cash, sales, amounts owed and profit
Direct costs, shared costs and family labour
isixhosa_draft: Iindleko ezithe ngqo, ezabelwanayo nomsebenzi wosapho

english: Compare buyers and agree a price
Build an enterprise and whole-farm budget
Put receipts and payments on their dates
Follow the order, delivery, invoice and receipt
Choose the right invoice route and verify the saved result
isixhosa_draft: Khetha indlela efanelekileyo ye-invoyisi uqinisekise okugciniweyo

english: Reconcile deposits, part payments and unresolved balances
isixhosa_draft: Vumelanisa amadiphozithi, iintlawulo ezinxalenye namatyala angaxazululwanga

english: Set money aside and test a shock
Prepare records and ask the right tax questions
isixhosa_draft: Lungiselela iirekhodi ubuze imibuzo efanelekileyo yerhafu

english: Lowest forecast cash balance, including any gap as a negative number
isixhosa_draft: Ibhalansi esezantsi yemali engqo eqikelelwe, kubandakanya nawuphi na umsantsa njengenani elingaphantsi kwe-zero

english: Closing cash in the original forecast
Value of produce actually delivered and invoiced
isixhosa_draft: Ixabiso lemveliso ehanjiswe ngokwenene yabhalwa kwi-invoyisi

english: Payment received from the buyer within this month
Amount the buyer still owes at month end
isixhosa_draft: Isixa umthengi asisenetyala ngaso ekupheleni kwenyanga

english: Actual closing cash after all supplied cash movements
isixhosa_draft: Imali engqo yokuvala yokwenyani emva kwayo yonke imihambo yemali enikeziweyo

english: Actual closing cash minus original forecast closing cash
isixhosa_draft: Imali engqo yokuvala yokwenyani ukususa imali engqo yokuvala eqikelelwe ekuqaleni

english: Name the order, delivery, invoice and payment references. Explain why they describe one sale. Keep the later payment outside this month. Explain how you would show the unpaid balance without marking the invoice paid in full.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza izalathiso ze-odolo, ukuhanjiswa, i-invoyisi nentlawulo. Chaza isizathu sokuba zichaza intengiso enye. Gcina intlawulo yamva ngaphandle kwale nyanga. Chaza indlela ongabonisa ngayo ibhalansi engahlawulwanga ngaphandle kokuphawula i-invoyisi ihlawulwe yonke.

english: Keep the original forecast. Identify when cash first falls short and what evidence would be needed before changing the plan. Compare the basket alternative, keeping items and kilograms separate. Check buyer commitment and available work hours.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina uqikelelo lokuqala. Chonga ukuba imali iqala nini ukunqongophala nobungqina obuya kufuneka phambi kokutshintsha isicwangciso. Thelekisa enye indlela yebhasikidi, ugcine izinto neekhilogram zahlukene. Jonga ukuzibophelela komthengi neeyure zomsebenzi ezikhoyo.

english: Explain the effects of quantity, payment timing, actual expenses, funding and household withdrawal. A matching closing total does not prove the plan was followed. Name the source of each difference.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza iziphumo zobungakanani, ixesha lentlawulo, iindleko zokwenyani, inkxaso-mali nokuthathwa kwemali yekhaya. Isixa sokuvala esifanayo asibonisi ukuba isicwangciso silandelwe. Chaza umthombo womahluko ngamnye.

english: Explain why the water charge cannot be entered as zero, why closing cash is not full profit, and what evidence is missing. Explain why a mapped plot does not prove land rights or harvest. Classify the funding card as its stated owner contribution or loan, not sales.
isixhosa_draft: Chaza isizathu sokuba intlawulo yamanzi ayinakungeniswa njenge-zero, isizathu sokuba imali engqo yokuvala ayiyonzuzo epheleleyo, nobungqina obulahlekileyo. Chaza isizathu sokuba isiza esimaphiweyo singabonisi amalungelo omhlaba okanye isivuno. Hlela ikhadi lenkxaso-mali njengoko kuchaziwe: igalelo lomnini okanye imboleko, hayi iintengiso.

english: Write one action, the evidence needed, who would obtain it, and a review date. Use classroom roles and dates only. Do not put real customer, household or bank details here.

Isicwangciso sentsimi sisafuna imilinganiselo efanelekileyo, ubungqina bendawo nawuphi na ucebo okanye imvume efanelekileyo.

english: Practise in the sample farm first. Keep the source map and its measurements when trying a proposal. A paper design folder is also valid.
isixhosa_draft: Ziqhelise kuqala kwifama yomzekelo. Gcina imephu yomthombo nemilinganiselo yayo xa uzama isiphakamiso. Ifolda yoyilo ephepheni nayo iyasebenza.

english: Drawn from Rory’s course outlines, handbook and RVCC planning material, with the design framework checked against these primary references.
isixhosa_draft: Kuthathwe kwimigaqo-nkqubo yekhosi kaRory, incwadi yezandla nezixhobo zocwangciso lwe-RVCC, kunye nesakhelo soyilo esikhangelwe ngokuthelekiswa nale mithombo iphambili.

english: Design for the people. Work with the place.
Build one design folder as you learn
isixhosa_draft: Yakha ifolda enye yoyilo njengoko ufunda

english: Record this stage in your design folder →
isixhosa_draft: Rekhoda eli nqanaba kwifolda yakho yoyilo →

english: Use a notebook, drawings or supported spoken answers. The supplied fictional worked demonstration supports the lesson method; a real field plan still needs checked measurements, evidence and review. These pages do not certify a design or award assessed progress. Audio and translations are not yet available; save the pathway from its overview before leaving signal.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa incwadi yokubhala, imizobo okanye iimpendulo ezithethiweyo ezixhaswayo. Umboniso osonjululweyo oyilelwe uxhasa indlela yesifundo; isicwangciso sentsimi yokwenyani sisafuna imilinganiselo ekhangeliweyo, ubungqina nophononongo. La maphepha akaqinisekisi uyilo okanye anike inkqubela evavanyiweyo. I-audiyo neenguqulelo akukafumaneki; gcina indlela yokufunda ukusuka kwisishwankathelo sayo phambi kokushiya indawo enesiginali.

english: Analysis overlays and design questions with their missing checks.
isixhosa_draft: Izixhobo zohlalutyo nemibuzo yoyilo kunye nokukhangela okungekhoyo.

english: An explained design, monitoring approach and justified revision.
isixhosa_draft: Uyilo olucaciswe, indlela yokubeka esweni nohlaziyo olunesizathu.

english: Observe whether the design is helping
On a trainer device, check sign-in, lesson access, slide and audio language, download and offline reopening. Use a demo account or practice site for exercises.
isixhosa_draft: Kwisixhobo somqeqeshi, khangela ukungena, ukufikelela esifundweni, ulwimi lweesilayidi nolweaudiyo, ukukhuphela nokuvula kwakhona ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Sebenzisa i-akhawunti yomzekelo okanye indawo yokuziqhelisa kwimisebenzi.

english: Confirm ACT’s register and consent wording before collecting real data. Ask separately before photographing or sharing anyone’s work. Do not use a shared device for private household records.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa irejista namagama okuvuma e-ACT phambi kokuqokelela idatha yokwenyani. Buza ngokwahlukeneyo phambi kokuthatha ifoto okanye ukwabelana ngomsebenzi womntu. Musa ukusebenzisa isixhobo esabelwanayo kwiirekhodi zangasese zekhaya.

english: Arrange small parallel groups for teach-backs so every participant gets a turn. Assign someone to observe and record feedback.
isixhosa_draft: Cwangcisa amaqela amancinci asebenza ngaxeshanye ekufundiseni ngokubuyisela ukuze wonke umthathi-nxaxheba afumane ithuba. Misa umntu oza kujonga aze arekhode impendulo.

english: Invite each person to share one farm question and one teaching concern. Offer a spoken or drawn response.
isixhosa_draft: Mema umntu ngamnye ukuba abelane ngombuzo omnye wefama nenkxalabo enye yokufundisa. Nika ithuba lempendulo ethethwayo okanye ezotyiweyo.

english: Agree how to ask questions, share time and give feedback. Explain attendance separately from photo or app consent.
isixhosa_draft: Vumelanani ngendlela yokubuza imibuzo, ukwabelana ngexesha nokunika impendulo. Chaza ukubakho ngokwahlukileyo kwimvume yefoto okanye ye-app.

english: Identify what the learner does at each part of a practical lesson.
isixhosa_draft: Chonga oko umfundi akwenzayo kwinxalenye nganye yesifundo esisebenzayo.

english: Ask groups to trace a possible water route, identify where soil is exposed and explain one planting question that needs local checking.
isixhosa_draft: Cela amaqela alandele indlela enokwenzeka yamanzi, achonge apho umhlaba ungagqunywanga, aze achaze umbuzo omnye wokutyala odinga ukukhangelwa ekuhlaleni.

english: Test on a trainer device or demo account; do not sign in as a farmer or use someone else’s records.
isixhosa_draft: Vavanya kwisixhobo somqeqeshi okanye kwi-akhawunti yomzekelo; musa ukungena njengomfama okanye usebenzise iirekhodi zomnye umntu.

english: A personal practice goal, without a competence or certificate claim.
isixhosa_draft: Injongo yobuqu yokuziqhelisa, ngaphandle kokubanga ubuchule okanye isatifikethi.

english: Assign a role and a safe action to every learner.
isixhosa_draft: Nika umfundi ngamnye indima nesenzo esikhuselekileyo.

english: Groups redesign a trainer demonstration so learners handle, point, sort, explain or record something themselves.
isixhosa_draft: Amaqela aphinda ayile umboniso womqeqeshi ukuze abafundi bayiphathe, bayalatha, bayihlele, bayichaze okanye bayirekhode ngokwabo.

english: Use a supplied practice site or a consenting participant’s own site. Label every entry as demo or real before entering it.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa indawo yokuziqhelisa enikeziweyo okanye indawo yomthathi-nxaxheba ovumayo. Phawula into nganye njengomzekelo okanye yokwenyani phambi kokuyifaka.

english: Compare an observation with a proposed design. Keep measurements, plant names, water and animal advice within the checked core lesson.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa into ejongiweyo nouyilo oluceliweyo. Gcina imilinganiselo, amagama ezityalo, icebiso lamanzi nelezilwanyana ngaphakathi kwesifundo esisisiseko esikhangeliweyo.

english: Use the same case on a printed base map; do not enter a private household’s data into a shared trainer device.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa imeko efanayo kwimephu esisiseko eshicilelweyo; musa ukufaka idatha yekhaya langasese kwisixhobo somqeqeshi esabelwanayo.

english: Keep attendance, consent, skill observation and any programme certificate decision as separate records under ACT’s policy.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ukubakho, imvume, ukujonga isakhono nasiphi na isigqibo sesatifikethi senkqubo njengeerekhodi ezahlukeneyo phantsi komgaqo-nkqubo we-ACT.

english: Assessment summaries reviewed and shared by the organisation.
isixhosa_draft: Izishwankathelo zovavanyo ezijongwe zabelwana ngazo ngumbutho.

english: Farm design, seasonal planning, practical learning, mentor oversight and funder-ready evidence — all in one app.
isixhosa_draft: Uyilo lwefama, ucwangciso lwexesha lonyaka, ukufunda ngokwenza, ukubekwa esweni ngumcebisi nobungqina obulungele umxhasi-mali — konke kwi-app enye.

english: A location-specific report — climate, soil, water and a garden design — generated for the exact spot a farm sits on, and saved so it can be reread without regenerating it.
isixhosa_draft: Ingxelo ethile yendawo — imozulu, umhlaba, amanzi noyilo lwegadi — eveliswe kwindawo echanekileyo efama ikuyo, igcinwe ukuze ibuyele ifundwe ngaphandle kokuyenza kwakhona.

english: A complete farm design on a satellite map, zoomed in on zoned beds — daily garden, orchard, staple crops and natural habitat — each planted with mapped species
isixhosa_draft: Uyilo olupheleleyo lwefama kwimephu yesathelayithi, olusondeleliswe kwimibhede ehlulwe ngeendawo — igadi yemihla ngemihla, ingadi yemithi yeziqhamo, izityalo eziphambili nendawo yendalo — nganye itshaywe ngeentlobo ezibekwe kwimephu

english: On iPhone: open the link in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-iPhone: vula ilinki kwi-Safari, ucofe Share, uze ucofe “Add to Home Screen”.

english: It grows as you find your land, trace its boundary, survey it, design it and plan crops.
isixhosa_draft: Liyakhula njengoko ufumana umhlaba wakho, ulandela umda wawo, wenza uphando lwawo, uwuyila uze ucwangcise izityalo.

english: No design on this device yet.
Your design is here and unchanged. To keep this load light, your saved sheets didn't open on their own this time.
isixhosa_draft: Uyilo lwakho luhleli apha alutshintshanga. Ukuze oku kulayishwa kungasindi, amaphepha akho agciniweyo avulekanga ngokwawo ngeli xesha.

english: Local chicken adaptation varies within provinces. Location alone does not identify the best breed for this farm.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelanisa kweenkukhu zasekuhlaleni kuyahluka ngaphakathi kwamaphondo. Indawo kuphela ayibonisi uhlobo olulunge ngakumbi kule fama.

english: Confirm the actual citrus product and named cultivar with the supplier; this combined palette choice does not identify planting stock.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa nomthengisi imveliso yokwenyani ye-citrus kunye nendidi ethiyiweyo; olu khetho ludibeneyo lwephaleti aluchazi izinto zokutyala.

english: Choose identified stock for the actual product and cultivar. A generic low-chill label does not select Earligold, Cederberg or Afrisun or establish a joined season.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha izinto zokutyala ezichongiweyo zemveliso nendidi yokwenyani. Igama elisisiqhelo 'low-chill' alikhethi i-Earligold, i-Cederberg okanye i-Afrisun, kwaye alimiseli ixesha elidityanisiweyo.

english: Every cattle owner must register an official identification mark and brand or mark their cattle with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini nganye wenkomo kufuneka abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuchonga kwaye aphawule iinkomo zakhe ngalo, phantsi kwe-Animal Identification Act.

english: Every goat owner must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini ibhokhwe nganye kufuneka abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuchonga kwaye aphawule iibhokhwe zakhe ngalo, phantsi kwe-Animal Identification Act.

english: Every goat owner, including communal/smallholder owners, must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini ibhokhwe nganye, kuquka abanini bomphakathi/abalimi abancinci, kufuneka abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuchonga kwaye aphawule iibhokhwe zakhe ngalo, phantsi kwe-Animal Identification Act.

english: A pig owner must apply to register an official identification mark and mark their pigs with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini wehagu kufuneka afake isicelo sokubhalisa uphawu olusemthethweni lokuchonga kwaye aphawule iihagu zakhe ngalo, phantsi kwe-Animal Identification Act.

english: Every sheep owner must register an official identification mark and mark their sheep with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
isixhosa_draft: Umnini wegusha nganye kufuneka abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuchonga kwaye aphawule igusha zakhe ngalo, phantsi kwe-Animal Identification Act.

english: {prod} of {total} farm shares a harvest record
isixhosa_draft: Ifama e-{prod} kwezi-{total} yabelana ngerekhodi yesivuno

english: {prod} of {total} farms share a harvest record
isixhosa_draft: Iifama ezi-{prod} kwezi-{total} zabelana ngerekhodi yesivuno
Akukho namnye kubo wabelana ngazo zombini.
yifama e-{n} kuphela eyabelana ngazo zombini
ziifama ezi-{n} kuphela ezabelana ngazo zombini

english: None of these {total} farmers has agreed to share a training record.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho namnye kubafama aba-{total} ovumele ukwabelana ngerekhodi yoqeqesho.

english: {reporting} of {total} farmer shares a training record. The course is {modules} modules.
isixhosa_draft: Umfama o-{reporting} kwabo-{total} wabelana ngerekhodi yoqeqesho. Ikhosi ineemodyuli ezi-{modules}.

english: {reporting} of {total} farmers share a training record. The course is {modules} modules.
isixhosa_draft: Abafama aba-{reporting} kwabo-{total} babelana ngerekhodi yoqeqesho. Ikhosi ineemodyuli ezi-{modules}.

english: A training record nobody agreed to share is not a farmer who has done no training, so nobody is drawn at zero here — they are simply not drawn.
isixhosa_draft: Irekhodi yoqeqesho engavunyelwanga ukuba yabelwe ayingomfama ongenzanga qeqesho, ngoko akukho mntu ubonakaliswa kwi-zero apha — abazobwanga nje.

english: A module counts once the farmer has completed it in the app. Farmers who have not shared a training record are not drawn at zero — they are not drawn at all.
isixhosa_draft: Imodyuli ibalwa xa umfama ayigqibile kwi-app. Abafama ababelananga ngerekhodi yoqeqesho abazobwa kwi-zero — abazobwa kwaphela.

english: Ask a local rooibos nursery or adviser for correctly identified, locally proven planting material. The Cape cycle is not a nationwide tea forecast.
isixhosa_draft: Cela inethsari yerooibos okanye umcebisi wasekuhlaleni izinto zokutyala ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo nezivavanywe apha ekuhlaleni. Umjikelo weKapa awulo uqikelelo lweti kwilizwe lonke.

english: Ask a local supplier for healthy, identified Zingiber officinale planting rhizomes; no South African cultivar-specific yield curve is verified.
isixhosa_draft: Cela umthengisi wasekuhlaleni iirhayizomu zokutyala ezisempilweni, ezichongiweyo ze-Zingiber officinale; akukho jika lesivuno lendidi ethile eMzantsi Afrika eliqinisekisiweyo.

english: Ask a specialist local nursery for identified C. genistoides and a locally proven selection; different ecotypes do not perform equally.
isixhosa_draft: Cela inethsari yezityalo ekhethekileyo i-C. genistoides echongiweyo nokhetho oluvavanywe apha ekuhlaleni; iindidi zendalo ezahlukeneyo azisebenzi ngokulinganayo.

english: Ask for Tulbaghia violacea, rather than a plant identified only as wild garlic. Record local leaf and flower picking separately.
isixhosa_draft: Cela i-Tulbaghia violacea, kungekhona isityalo esichongwe kuphela njenge-wild garlic. Bhala ngokwahlukileyo ukuvunwa kwamagqabi nentyatyambo yasekuhlaleni.

english: Ask for an identified buffalo-thorn plant suited to local conditions; the checked source supplies no named food cultivar.
isixhosa_draft: Cela isityalo se-buffalo-thorn esichongiweyo esifanelekileyo kwiimeko zasekuhlaleni; umthombo ohloliweyo awunikezi ndidi yokutya ethiyiweyo.

english: Ask for botanically identified Carissa bispinosa and local provenance. The checked source supplies no named fruit cultivar.
isixhosa_draft: Cela i-Carissa bispinosa echongwe ngokwezityalo nemvelaphi yasekuhlaleni. Umthombo ohloliweyo awunikezi ndidi yeziqhamo ethiyiweyo.

english: Ask for correctly identified Euclea undulata and record the actual planting date and local ripe-picking months.
isixhosa_draft: Cela i-Euclea undulata echongwe ngokuchanekileyo ubhale umhla wokwenyani wokutyala neenyanga zasekuhlaleni zokuvuna iziqhamo ezivuthiweyo.

english: Ask for correctly identified spekboom and record whether it is planted for food, browse or restoration. No measured household leaf yield is supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Cela i-spekboom echongwe ngokuchanekileyo ubhale ukuba ityalelwa ukutya, ukutyiwa yimfuyo okanye ukubuyisela indalo. Akukho sivuno silinganisiweyo samagqabi ekhaya esinikeziweyo.

english: Ask for correctly identified, lawfully sourced stock and check current protected-tree collection requirements before harvesting existing wild trees.
isixhosa_draft: Cela izinto zokutyala ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo nezifunyenwe ngokusemthethweni uhlole iimfuno zangoku zokuqokelela imithi ekhuselweyo phambi kokuvuna imithi yasendle ekhoyo.

english: Ask for identified Morus nigra fruiting material with a locally observed season. Do not use a generic black-fruited mulberry or fruitless ornamental as proof of this product.
isixhosa_draft: Cela i-Morus nigra echongiweyo eqhamayo enexesha elibonwe apha ekuhlaleni. Ungasebenzisi i-mulberry enesiqhamo esimnyama ngokubanzi okanye isityalo sokuhombisa esingaqhamiyo njengobungqina bale mveliso.

english: Ask the nursery to identify the subspecies and sex and provide compatible male and female plants for fruit.
isixhosa_draft: Cela inethsari ichonge udidi olungaphantsi nesini kwaye ibonelele ngezityalo ezisisilisa nezisisifazane ezihambelanayo ukuze kubekho iziqhamo.

english: Ask the supplier about identified sweet narrow-leaf material and whether it is qualified for the intended food use. Current Mandellup/Lila-Baer options are supplier context, not calibrated local food-yield predictions.
isixhosa_draft: Buza umthengisi ngezinto ezichongiweyo ze-sweet narrow-leaf nokuba ziyafaneleka na kusetyenziso lokutya olujoliswe kulo. Ukhetho lwangoku lwe-Mandellup/Lila-Baer lulingcaciso lomthengisi, hayi uqikelelo lwesivuno sokutya olulinganiswe apha ekuhlaleni.

english: Assessment identifies the catalogue species and Northern/Western Cape distribution; it does not provide a harvest calendar or food yield.
isixhosa_draft: Uhlolo luchonga udidi lwekhathalogu nokusasazeka kwalo kuMntla/kuNtshona Koloni; alunikezi khalenda yokuvuna okanye isivuno sokutya.

english: Buy correctly identified subspecies material. Record actual leaf-cutting dates and weights; no local yield variety or first-cutting duration is verified.
isixhosa_draft: Thenga izinto ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo zodidi olungaphantsi. Bhala imihla yokwenyani yokusika amagqabi nobunzima; akukho ndidi yesivuno sasekuhlaleni okanye ixesha lokusika kokuqala eliqinisekisiweyo.

english: Choose locally appropriate, correctly identified material; no named cultivar is sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha izinto ezifanelekileyo apha ekuhlaleni, ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo; akukho ndidi ebizwe ngegama efunyenweyo.

english: Coastal-sand perennial with edible congested flower buds. The stated July–September flowering interval does not identify exact unopened-bud picking months.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo esihlala ixesha elide esisantini yasonxweni esineentyatyambo ezingekavuleki ezityiwayo. Ixesha elichaziweyo lokuqhakaza ngoJulayi–Septemba alichongi neenyanga ezichanekileyo zokuvuna iintyatyambo ezingekavuleki.

english: Confirm the exact mulberry species and that the chosen plant is a fruiting form. Fruit colour alone cannot identify it.
isixhosa_draft: Qinisekisa udidi oluchanekileyo lwe-mulberry nokuba isityalo esikhethiweyo siyaqhama. Umbala weziqhamo kuyodwa awunakusichonga.

english: DAFF industry reference: earlier Prime Seedless, Sugraone and Flame Seedless; later Dauphine and Crimson Seedless. SATI identifies Orange River choices including Prime, Thompson Seedless and Sugraone. Confirm local dates and stock; the industry sequence is not a KZN farm calendar.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso seshishini le-DAFF: ngaphambili i-Prime Seedless, i-Sugraone ne-Flame Seedless; kamva i-Dauphine ne-Crimson Seedless. I-SATI ichonga ukhetho lwe-Orange River kubandakanya i-Prime, i-Thompson Seedless ne-Sugraone. Qinisekisa imihla nesitokhwe sasekuhlaleni; ulandelelwano lweshishini aluyikhalenda yefama ye-KZN.

english: Extension identifies culinary ginger rhizomes used as spice, preserves and beverages. Florida planting and harvest months are not imported into the South African calendar.
isixhosa_draft: Ulwandiso luchonga iirhayizomu zejinja zokupheka ezisetyenziswa njengesinongo, ezigciniweyo nemiselo. Iinyanga zokutyala nokuvuna zaseFlorida azifakwanga kwikhalenda yoMzantsi Afrika.

english: General KZN peach guide; the section identifies Muden, Middelrus and Weenen river valleys as low-chill growing areas. Confirm the cultivar and nursery starting age.
isixhosa_draft: Isikhokelo jikelele sepetshi se-KZN; icandelo lichonga iinkonde zemilambo yaseMuden, iMiddelrus naseWeenen njengeendawo zokukhula ezinobubanda obuphantsi. Qinisekisa indidi nobudala bokuqala benethsari.

english: Keep this as an identified hedge/inventory plant. Seek expert local food-use review before treating berries as household food.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina esi sityalo njengothango/isityalo senkcazelo esichongiweyo. Funa uhlolo lwesazi lokusetyenziswa kokutya apha ekuhlaleni phambi kokuphatha amaberry njengokutya kwekhaya.

english: Light cropping at about year 5 in the KZN guide, for irrigated areas with hot summers, cold winters and low growing-season humidity. It identifies dry Zululand/Lowveld river valleys as suitable regional areas. Propagation, cultivar and nursery age are not specified; this is a qualified general reference, not an expected farm quantity.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuthwala okuncinci malunga nonyaka wesi-5 kwisikhokelo se-KZN, kwiindawo ezinkcenkceshelwayo ezinehlobo elishushu, ubusika obubandayo nomswakama ophantsi ngexesha lokukhula. Sichonga iinkonde zemilambo ezomileyo zaseZululand/Lowveld njengeendawo zengingqi ezifanelekileyo. Ukuphindaphindwa, indidi nobudala benethsari azichazwanga; esi sisalathiso jikelele esifanelekileyo, hayi isixa sefama esilindelekileyo.

english: Obtain an identified edible food landrace from a trusted local seed source. A wild-looking melon or the common name karkoer alone is insufficient.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana uhlobo lwasekhaya lokutya olwachongwa kumthombo wembewu wasekuhlaleni othenjwayo. Imeloni ebonakala yasendle okanye igama eliqhelekileyo i-karkoer kuphela akwanelanga.

english: Obtain correctly identified coastal planting material; record local growth and leaf-picking months because rainy seasons differ across South Africa.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana izinto zokutyala zonxweme ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo; bhala ukukhula kwasekuhlaleni neenyanga zokuvuna amagqabi kuba amaxesha emvula ayahluka kuMzantsi Afrika wonke.

english: Obtain correctly identified legal nursery stock and local growing advice. No food-yield cultivar or maturity curve is verified.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana isitokhwe senethsari esisemthethweni esichongwe ngokuchanekileyo nesiluleko sokulima sasekuhlaleni. Akukho ndidi yesivuno sokutya okanye ijika lokuvuthwa eliqinisekisiweyo.

english: Obtain correctly identified local planting material; no named food cultivar or annual kg/plant benchmark is sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana izinto zokutyala zasekuhlaleni ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo; akukho ndidi yokutya ebizwe ngegama okanye umlinganiselo wonyaka we-kg/isityalo ofunyenweyo.

english: Obtain correctly identified planting tubers or pieces. A local named selection and food kg/plant benchmark remain unverified.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana iitiyubha okanye iinxalenye zokutyala ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ukhetho olubizwe ngegama lwasekuhlaleni nomlinganiselo wokutya we-kg/isityalo zisahlala ziqinisekisiwe.

english: Obtain correctly identified pond plants. Confirm local pond conditions and actual picking dates; no pond-area yield or planting density is sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana izityalo zechibi ezichongwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa iimeko zechibi lasekuhlaleni nemihla yokwenyani yokuvuna; akukho sivuno sendawo yechibi okanye ubuninzi bokutyala obufunyenweyo.

english: Obtain identified Centella asiatica material from a reputable nursery; no regional food cultivar or measured annual leaf yield is verified.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana izinto ezichongiweyo ze-Centella asiatica kwinethsari ethembekileyo; akukho ndidi yokutya yengingqi okanye isivuno samagqabi sonyaka esilinganisiweyo esiqinisekisiweyo.

english: Obtain identified healthy rosemary material and local growing advice; no regional culinary-leaf yield variety is verified.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana izinto ezichongiweyo, ezisempilweni ze-rosemary nesiluleko sokulima sasekuhlaleni; akukho ndidi yesivuno samagqabi okupheka yengingqi eqinisekisiweyo.

english: Obtain identified material for the intended food or forage purpose. Availability and eating quality of early trial accessions are unverified; record the purchased type and actual sowing and picking dates.
