isixhosa_draft: U-Thumela ngaphandle iirekhodi ezenzelwe umbolekisi wemali wenza i-PDF. Kuxhomekeke kwisixhobo, ikhuphela okanye ivula iphepha lokwabelana. Gcina ikopi uze uhlole onke amaphepha, kuquka igama lefama, umhla wokwenziwa kunye no-Covers dates.

english: For real records, check what your bookkeeper or adviser needs and choose the recipient yourself. Review the attachments and private details before sending. Saving or downloading does not send the file to them.
isixhosa_draft: Kwiirekhodi zokwenyani, khangela oko umgcini wakho wezincwadi okanye umcebisi wakho akudingayo uze ukhethe umamkeli wena. Phonononga izihlomelo neenkcukacha zangasese phambi kokuthumela. Ukugcina okanye ukukhuphela akuyithumeli ifayile kubo.

english: Have the site name, visit notes, photographs and any original test reports ready. Know when and where each record was made. Use only pictures and information you have permission to include.
isixhosa_draft: Yiba negama lendawo, amanqaku okutyelela, iifoto naziphi na iingxelo zovavanyo zoqobo bekulungele. Yazi ukuba nini nalapho irekhodi ngalinye lenziwe khona. Sebenzisa kuphela imifanekiso nolwazi onemvume yokulubandakanya.

english: Review the site and household survey. Write what was observed or reported, and identify what you still need to check. Do not invent an answer to fill a gap.
isixhosa_draft: Phonononga uphando lwendawo nolwekhaya. Bhala oko kubonwe okanye kuxelwe, uchonge oko usafuna ukukukhangela. Musa ukuyila impendulo yokuzalisa isikhewu.

english: Review Boundary & measurements, Site design and Planting plan too. A drawn tank, bed or crop can be planned work. Check on the ground before describing it as installed, planted or harvested.
isixhosa_draft: Phonononga kwakhona u-Umda nobungakanani, u-Uyilo lwendawo no-Isicwangciso sokutyala. Itanki ezotyiweyo, ibhedi okanye isityalo zinokuba ngumsebenzi ocwangcisiweyo. Khangela emhlabeni phambi kokuchaza ukuba efakiwe, ityaliwe okanye ivuniwe.

english: Every entered result has a source, a unit and a sample you can identify.
isixhosa_draft: Isiphumo ngasinye esifakiweyo sinomthombo, iyunithi nesampuli onokuyichonga.

english: Start with a site you can identify
Read the actual assignment before taking a photograph. Keep the original photo and any notes on your device. Use evidence of your own work, with permission for any people shown.
isixhosa_draft: Funda umsebenzi wokwenyani phambi kokuthatha ifoto. Gcina ifoto yoqobo nawo nawaphi amanqaku kwisixhobo sakho. Sebenzisa ubungqina bomsebenzi wakho, ngemvume yabo bonke abantu ababonisiweyo.

english: Make a brief with spaces for people and uses, priorities, things to protect, agreed scope, available resources, and questions still open. Use the practice case or obtain consent for a real household exercise. A partner reads it back. Change anything that misrepresents the household.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza isishwankathelo esinezithuba zabantu nokusetyenziswa, izinto eziphambili, izinto ekufuneka zikhuselwe, ububanzi obuvunyiweyo, izixhobo ezikhoyo nemibuzo esavulekile. Sebenzisa ityala lokuziqhelisa okanye ufumane imvume yomsebenzi wekhaya lokwenyani. Ozifundela naye uyalifunda ngokubuyisela. Tshintsha nantoni na engalimeli ngokuchanekileyo ikhaya.

english: Does agreement on the brief establish permission to alter a neighbour's drainage route?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukuvumelana ngesishwankathelo kuseka imvume yokutshintsha indlela yokuphuma kwamanzi yommelwane?

english: no. **Reason:** the brief records household aims; permissions and effects beyond the site need their own checks.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** isishwankathelo sirekhoda iinjongo zekhaya; iimvume neziphumo ezingaphaya kwendawo zifuna ukukhangelwa kwazo.

english: Getting started and evidence guides. A paper brief is valid; do not put private household details into a public sample.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yokuqalisa nobungqina. Isishwankathelo sephepha sivumelekile; musa ukufaka iinkcukacha zangasese zekhaya kumzekelo wesidlangalala.

english:
Observation starts with what is there. Walk safely with someone who knows the place. Look at routes, water points, ground cover, shade, buildings, growing areas and signs of past use. Listen to the people who use the site. A short visit and a long memory offer different evidence.

Keep those differences visible. “I saw this” is an observation. “The resident described this” is a report. “I measured this” needs the method and unit. “I think this may happen” is an interpretation. “I want to put this here” is a proposal. All can be useful, but they are not interchangeable.

Record when and under what conditions you observed. A shaded patch during one visit is not a full seasonal sunlight record. A dry water point on one day does not by itself explain the cause or the whole year's supply. Look again when it is safe and useful. Do not wait for perfect knowledge before keeping a record, and do not pretend a short visit supplies it.

Use a notebook, labelled drawing or consented photograph. Give each piece of evidence a short reference you can put on the map. If a plant, pipe or boundary is uncertain, label the uncertainty. Do not identify a plant or underground service from an attractive illustration.
isixhosa_draft:
Ukujonga kuqala ngoko kukhoyo. Hamba ngokukhuselekileyo nomntu owaziyo indawo. Jonga iindlela, iindawo zamanzi, ukugquma komhlaba, umthunzi, izakhiwo, iindawo zokutyala neempawu zokusetyenziswa kwangaphambili. Mamela abantu abasebenzisa indawo. Utyelelo olufutshane nenkumbulo ende zinika ubungqina obahlukileyo.

Gcina ezo ndidi zahlukeneyo zibonakala. “Ndiyibonile le nto” kukujonga. “Umhlali uchaze le nto” yingxelo. “Ndiyilinganisile le nto” ifuna indlela neyunithi. “Ndicinga ukuba oku kunokwenzeka” kutoliko. “Ndifuna ukubeka oku apha” sisiphakamiso. Zonke zinokuba luncedo, kodwa azitshintshiselani.

Rekhoda ukuba nini nangaziphi iimeko wajonga. Isiqwenga somthunzi ngexesha lotyelelo olunye asiyirekhodi epheleleyo yelanga lexesha lonyaka. Indawo yamanzi eyomileyo ngosuku olunye ayichazi yodwa isizathu okanye ukubakho kwamanzi onyaka wonke. Jonga kwakhona xa kukhuselekile kwaye kunobuncedo. Musa ukulinda ulwazi olugqibeleleyo phambi kokugcina irekhodi, kwaye musa ukuzenza ngathi utyelelo olufutshane lulunika.

Sebenzisa incwadi yokubhala, umzobo onamagama okanye ifoto enemvume. Unika isiqwenga ngasinye sobungqina isalathiso esifutshane onokusibeka kwimephu. Ukuba isityalo, umbhobho okanye umda awuqinisekanga, kubhalele ukungaqiniseki. Musa ukuchonga isityalo okanye inkonzo engaphantsi komhlaba ngomfanekiso omhle.

english: Make the existing-features map and a separate blank proposal sheet. Match each important feature to a note from D1.2. If measurement is unavailable, identify the missing measurement and the decision it prevents. For a real site, retain the original measurements when trying a new layout.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza imephu yeempawu ezikhoyo nephepha lesiphakamiso elingenanto elahlukileyo. Dibanisa ipawu ngalinye elibalulekileyo nenqaku elisuka kwi-D1.2. Ukuba ukulinganisa akunakwenzeka, chonga umlinganiselo olahlekileyo nesigqibo okuthintelayo kuso. Kwindawo yokwenyani, gcina imilinganiselo yoqobo ngoxa uzama ulungiselelo olutsha.

english: Mapping and design guides. Practise on a copy or sample first. Verify the saved feature and its measurements after editing; use Undo for an accidental edit rather than accepting a convenient distortion.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yemephu noyilo. Ziqhelise kwikopi okanye umzekelo kuqala. Qinisekisa ipawu elagciniweyo nemilinganiselo yalo emva kokuhlela; sebenzisa u-Buyisela kutshintsho lwengozi endaweni yokwamkela ukugwenxa okulungeleyo.

english:
Zone planning considers how people use and care for things. Something needing frequent attention should be considered in relation to the routes people already take. Look at the actual work: visiting, watering, harvesting, feeding, carrying and checking. A short distance on paper may still be awkward if there is a steep step, a locked gate or an obstructed path.

Zones are a thinking tool, not compulsory rings. A small site does not need to contain every zone. Do not assign a fixed zone to every animal or crop without considering its care and the household. The placement must also suit the element's other needs.

Sector analysis considers influences such as sun, wind, incoming water and neighbouring activities. Use the evidence for this site. Label a direction as observed, reported or still needing confirmation. A regional description is not proof that the wind at this particular home always comes from one direction.

Put the layers beside each other. Convenience may suggest a place near the home; shade, access or other constraints may make that place unsuitable. This is a question to resolve, not a reason to ignore one of the layers. Explain both the benefit and the limitation of a proposed position.
isixhosa_draft:
Ucwangciso lwemimandla luqwalasela indlela abantu abasebenzisa ngayo baze banyamekele izinto. Into efuna ingqalelo rhoqo kufuneka ijongwe ngokunxulumene neendlela abantu abasele bezithatha. Jonga umsebenzi wokwenyani: ukutyelela, ukunisela, ukuvuna, ukondla, ukuthwala nokukhangela. Umgama omfutshane ephepheni unokuba nzima ukuba kukho inyathelo eliyithambeka, isango elitshixiweyo okanye indlela evaliweyo.

Imimandla sisixhobo sokucinga, hayi izangqa ezinyanzelekileyo. Indawo encinci akufuneki iqulathe yonke imimandla. Musa ukunika isilwanyana okanye isityalo ngasinye ummandla omiselweyo ngaphandle kokucinga ngonophelo lwaso nekhaya. Indawo kufuneka ihambelane nemfuno yento leyo.

Uhlalutyo lwamacandelo luqwalasela impembelelo efana nelanga, umoya, amanzi angenayo neminye imisebenzi kwindawo ekufuphi. Sebenzisa ubungqina bale ndawo. Phawula ulwalathiso njengolujongiweyo, olubikiweyo okanye olusafuna ukuqinisekiswa. Inkcazo yommandla ayisiyobungqina bokuba umoya kweli khaya ukhona ukuhlala uvela kolunye ulwalathiso.

Beka iingqimba ecaleni kwenye. Ukunethezeka kunganikela indawo ekufutshane nekhaya; umthunzi, ufikelelo okanye eminye imiqobo ingasenza loo ndawo ingafaneleki. Ngumbuzo ekufuneka uxazululwe, hayi isizathu sokungasihoyi esinye sezo ngqimba. Chaza zombini inzuzo nomda wesikhundla esicetywayo.

english: The learner explains the difference between a care journey and an external influence, uses site evidence, and identifies a placement trade-off.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi uchaza umahluko phakathi kohambo lonophelo nempembelelo yangaphandle, asebenzise ubungqina bendawo, aze achonge into ekufuneka ayinikele ekubekeni.

english: Must a small homestead contain all the zones to be a valid design?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ikhaya elincinci kufuneka liqulathe yonke imimandla ukuze uyilo lube semthethweni?

english: Design guide, Base and Sector stages. Adding an arrow is a way to record a claim, not a way to verify it.
isixhosa_draft: Isikhokelo soyilo, amanqanaba e-Base ne-Sector. Ukongeza utolo yindlela yokurekhoda ibango, hayi indlela yokuliqinisekisa.

english:
A design brings different observations together. Trace how people reach the places they use, where water is observed or reported, and where shade changes. Consider how the same arrangement might work in different conditions. Keep a useful access route in view while thinking about a new growing area.

The position of a water point does not tell you how much suitable water is reliably available. A tank drawn higher on a map is not necessarily higher on the ground. A flow arrow does not supply levels, soil information, a safe outlet or permission to redirect water. Those questions need appropriate evidence and, where relevant, qualified help. Keep drainage and construction proposals separate from what is already known.

A photograph of a green site does not prove year-round supply. Ask what changes during dry periods, rain, cold or household absence. Use local records and the existing seasonal-planning lessons to decide what else to observe. Do not copy a calendar or a fixed compass rule from another place without checking its relevance.

Some constraints change the scope of a proposal. If water, access or care is unresolved, improving a smaller existing area may be worth comparing with expansion. Deferring a feature can be a sound design decision. Explain the missing evidence and the next action so “later” does not mean forgotten.
isixhosa_draft:
Uyilo lubeka kunye ulwazi olwahlukeneyo. Landela indlela abantu abafikelela ngayo kwiindawo abazisebenzisayo, apho amanzi ajongwe okanye ebikwe khona, nalapho umthunzi utshintsha khona. Cinga indlela olo lungiselelo lunokusebenza ngayo kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo. Gcina indlela yofikelelo eluncedo ibonakala ngoxa ucinga ngendawo entsha yokutyala.

Indawo yendawo yamanzi ayichazi ukuba mangaphi amanzi afanelekileyo afumaneka ngokuthembekileyo. Itanki ezotywe phezulu kwimephu ayiphezulu ngokufuneka emhlabeni. Utolo lokuhamba kwamanzi aluniki miphakamo, ulwazi lomhlaba, indawo ekhuselekileyo yokuphuma okanye imvume yokuguqula amanzi. Le mibuzo ifuna ubungqina obufanelekileyo kwaye, apho kufanelekileyo, uncedo olufanelekileyo. Gcina iziphakamiso zokuphuma kwamanzi nokwakha zahlukile koko sele kwaziwa.

Ifoto yendawo eluhlaza ayiqinisekisi ukubakho konyaka wonke. Buza kutshintsha ntoni ngexesha elomileyo, imvula, ukubanda okanye xa ikhaya lingekho. Sebenzisa iirekhodi zalapha nezifundo zocwangciso lweziqendu zonyaka ukuze ugqibe ukuba yintoni enye ekufuneka uyijonge. Musa ukukopa ikhalenda okanye umgaqo ongaguquki wekhampasi kwenye indawo ngaphandle kokukhangela ukuhambelana kwawo.

Eminye imiqobo itshintsha ububanzi besiphakamiso. Ukuba amanzi, ufikelelo okanye unonophelo alukaxazululwa, ukuphucula indawo encinci esele ikho kunokufaneleka ukuthelekiswa nokwandisa. Ukubambezela into kunokuba sisigqibo soyilo esilungileyo. Chaza ubungqina obulahlekileyo nesenzo esilandelayo ukuze “kamva” kungathethi “kulityiwe”.

english: The learner connects access, care and environmental information without inventing a design threshold or treating an unresolved technical proposal as ready to build.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi udibanisa ufikelelo, unonophelo nolwazi lokusingqongileyo ngaphandle kokuyila umda woyilo okanye ukuthatha isiphakamiso setekhnoloji esingaxazululwanga njengesikulungele ukwakhiwa.

english: no. **Reason:** a drawing cannot replace terrain, soil, water, outlet and permission checks or relevant qualified assessment.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** umzobo awuthathi ndawo yokukhangela indawo, umhlaba, amanzi, indawo yokuphuma nemvume okanye uvavanyo olufanelekileyo lolwazi.

english: Mapping, design and crop-planning guides. Keep a proposed water feature labelled as proposed; do not mistake software availability for site suitability.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yemephu, uyilo nocwangciso lwezityalo. Gcina into yamanzi ecetywayo iphawulwe njengecetywayo; musa ukuthatha ukubakho kwesoftiwe ukuba kukufaneleka kwendawo.

english: “Put a new bed here” gives a location. “How can we grow food without blocking access or adding more care than we can manage?” gives a design question. Which helps compare options?
isixhosa_draft: “Beka ibhedi entsha apha” inika indawo. “Singatyala njani ukutya ngaphandle kokuvala ufikelelo okanye ukongeza unonophelo olungaphezu kwalo sinokuluphatha?” inika umbuzo woyilo. Yeyiphi ekunceda uthelekise iinketho?

english:
Analysis turns the brief and evidence into questions that can guide a design. For each important observation, explain why it matters to the household. Then identify a possible response and what would need to be true for that response to work.

Keep the chain visible: need, evidence, implication, possible response, missing check. If a step is missing, return to it. A learner may notice that a route is used frequently, but still need to ask who uses it and what they carry before changing its shape.

Use the ethics in a practical way. Who gains from a proposal? Who takes on more work? What existing life, soil, water or shared resource could be harmed? A benefit for one element may create a problem elsewhere. Do not call a system sustainable simply because it has many features or recycles something.

Write criteria before choosing your favourite drawing. Criteria come from the brief and site evidence: access remains usable, care is agreed, water needs can be met, and important unknowns are resolved or the affected work is deferred. A criterion needs evidence. “Looks natural” alone does not demonstrate that the household can maintain it.
isixhosa_draft:
Uhlalutyo luguqula isishwankathelo nobungqina zibe yimibuzo enokukhokela uyilo. Kwinto nganye ebalulekileyo ejongiweyo, chaza ukuba kutheni ibalulekile kwikhaya. Emva koko chonga impendulo enokwenzeka nento ekufuneka ibe yinyani ukuze loo mpendulo isebenze.

Gcina ikhonkco libonakala: isidingo, ubungqina, iziphumo, impendulo enokwenzeka, ukukhangela okulahlekileyo. Ukuba inyathelo lilahlekile, buyela kulo. Umfundi usenokuqaphela ukuba indlela isetyenziswa rhoqo, kodwa asadinga ukubuza ukuba ngubani oyisebenzisayo nokuba uthwele ntoni phambi kokutshintsha ubume bayo.

Sebenzisa imigaqo yokuziphatha ngokwenyani. Ngubani onenzuzo kwisiphakamiso? Ngubani othatha umsebenzi omkhulu? Yeyiphi ubomi obukhoyo, umhlaba, amanzi okanye izixhobo ezabelwanayo ezinokonzakala? Inzuzo yento enye inokuvelisa ingxaki kwenye indawo. Musa ukuyibiza inkqubo ngokuba iyahlala nje kuba inezinto ezininzi okanye iphinda isebenzise into.

Bhala imigangatho phambi kokukhetha umzobo wakho owuthandayo. Imigangatho ivela kwisishwankathelo nobungqina bendawo: ufikelelo luhlala lusebenza, unonophelo luvunyiwe, iimfuno zamanzi zinokuhlangatyezwa, kwaye ezingaziwayo ezibalulekileyo ziyaxazululwa okanye umsebenzi ochaphazelekayo uyabambezelwa. Umgangatho udinga ubungqina. “Ubonakala uyindalo” kuwodwa awubonisi ukuba ikhaya linokuwugcina.

english: Is choosing the design with the most components a fair test of quality?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukukhetha uyilo olunezinto ezininzi kulingana kuvavanya umgangatho?

english: Evidence and design guides. The decision sheet can stay on paper with an exported map. It is the explanation of the plan, not an automatic result produced by the app.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yobungqina noyilo. Iphepha lesigqibo lingahlala ephepheni nemephu ethunyelwe ngaphandle. Yinkcazo yesicwangciso, hayi isiphumo esizenzekelayo se-app.

english: Design and evidence guides. Keep versions of alternative concepts; do not overwrite the existing base or silently change measured features when comparing layouts.
isixhosa_draft: Imihlahlandlela yoyilo nobungqina. Gcina iinguqulo zeengcamango ezizezinye; musa ukubhala ngaphezulu kwesiseko esikhoyo okanye ukutshintsha ngokuthe cwaka iimpawu ezilinganisiweyo xa uthelekisa olungiselelo.

english:
Fitting the objects is only one check. Follow the people, water, materials and maintenance journeys between them. Check that a route remains usable when people carry tools or produce. Ask whether a mature planting or a stored material could obstruct access that is clear in today's drawing.

Look beyond the selected area. A water change can affect places downstream; a fence can affect shared access. Record the people and resources affected. The design folder should identify relevant permissions and technical advice, not assume them from a boundary line or software tool.

Ask how the system behaves when something goes wrong. If supply is interrupted, who responds? If a component blocks or overflows, where could the problem go? Technical designs need appropriate assessment; do not invent a safe outlet or drainage capacity. When evidence is incomplete, hold the affected work and explain the dependency.
isixhosa_draft:
Ukungena kwezinto yinxalenye enye yokukhangela. Landela uhambo lwabantu, amanzi, izixhobo nolondolozo phakathi kwazo. Khangela ukuba indlela isalungile xa abantu bethwele izixhobo okanye imveliso. Buza ukuba isityalo esikhulile okanye into egcinwayo inokuvala ufikelelo olucacileyo kumzobo wanamhlanje.

Jonga ngaphaya kwendawo ekhethiweyo. Utshintsho lwamanzi lunokuchaphazela iindawo ezantsi; uthango lungachaphazela ufikelelo olwabelwanayo. Rekhoda abantu nezixhobo ezichaphazelekayo. Ifolda yoyilo kufuneka ichonge iimvume nengcebiso yobugcisa efanelekileyo, ingacingi ngazo kumda okanye kwisixhobo sesoftiwe.

Buza ukuba inkqubo iziphatha njani xa kukho into ephosakeleyo. Ukuba ukubonelelwa kuphazamiseka, ngubani ophendulayo? Ukuba icandelo liyavalwa okanye lizele, ingxaki inokuya phi? Uyilo lobugcisa ludinga uvavanyo olufanelekileyo; musa ukuyila indawo ekhuselekileyo yokuphuma okanye umthamo wokuphuma kwamanzi. Xa ubungqina bungaphelelanga, ibambe umsebenzi ochaphazelekayo uchaze ukuxhomekeka.

english: The learner checks relationships and consequences, identifies an unresolved dependency and keeps the corresponding work conditional.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi ukhangela unxulumano neziphumo, achonge ukuxhomekeka okungaxazululwanga agcine umsebenzi ohambelana nako unemiqathango.

english: no. **Reason:** drawing software does not replace site-specific assessment or permission.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** isoftiwe yokuzoba ayithathi ndawo yovavanyo olukhethekileyo lwendawo okanye imvume.

english: Give the plan to a partner without explaining it first. Ask them to identify what exists, what is proposed, where access runs and which work is still on hold. Record the confusion, revise the sheet and repeat the reading task.
isixhosa_draft: Nika ozifundela naye isicwangciso ngaphandle kokuqala ukusichaza. Mcele achonge okukhoyo, okucetywayo, apho ufikelelo lusingqongileyo nokuba ngumsebenzi ophi osamiswe. Rekhoda ukudideka, uhlaziye iphepha uphinde umsebenzi wokufunda.

english: The busy-yard first phase begins with checking care capacity, access and the existing patch's conditions. Buying animals is outside scope. A new drainage intervention stays on hold. Improving the design record is real progress even before a physical change is justified.
isixhosa_draft: Inqanaba lokuqala legceke elixakekileyo liqala ngokukhangela umthamo wonophelo, ufikelelo neemeko zendawo esele ikho. Ukuthenga izilwanyana akukho phakathi kobubanzi. Ukungenelela okutsha kokuphuma kwamanzi kuhlala kumisiwe. Ukuphucula irekhodi loyilo luphuhliso lokwenyani nangaphambi kokuba utshintsho olubonakalayo luthethelelwe.

english: The learner identifies dependencies and a feasible first phase, rather than a calendar of unsupported promises.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi uchonga ukuxhomekeka kunye nenqanaba lokuqala elinokwenzeka, kunokuba likhalenda lezithembiso ezingaxhaswanga.

english:
A design continues after installation. Ask what must be checked, maintained, cleaned, repaired, harvested or recorded. Use the relevant technical lesson and local advice to establish the actual task. Do not assign a generic weekly schedule to living systems with different care needs.

Agree who will do each task and what they need. Ask about normal commitments and absences. A task is not allocated just because a name appears beside it; the person must understand and accept the responsibility. Plan how they will ask for help and what can be reduced if the workload is too much.

Identify relevant disruptions. Water interruptions, damaged access, a missing carer or unavailable materials may change what is feasible. Define a response that preserves welfare and safety. Where the answer depends on specialist advice, record that dependency instead of inventing an emergency procedure.
isixhosa_draft:
Uyilo luqhubeka emva kokufakwa. Buza ukuba yintoni ekufuneka ikhangelwe, igcinwe, icocwe, ilungiswe, ivunwe okanye irekhodwe. Sebenzisa isifundo sobugcisa esifanelekileyo kunye nengcebiso yalapha ukuseka umsebenzi wokwenyani. Musa ukunika ucwangciso lweveki jikelele kwiinkqubo eziphilayo ezinemfuno zonophelo ezahlukeneyo.

Vumelanani ukuba ngubani oza kwenza umsebenzi ngamnye nokuba udinga ntoni. Buza ngezibophelelo eziqhelekileyo nokungabikho. Umsebenzi awunikwa nje kuba igama libhalwe ecaleni kwawo; umntu kufuneka aqonde aze amkele uxanduva. Cwangcisa indlela aza kucela ngayo uncedo nokuba yintoni enokuncitshiswa xa umthwalo ungaphezulu.

english:
Begin a design presentation with the brief. Show the existing situation and the evidence that mattered most. Then explain the chosen arrangement, an alternative you considered, the important trade-off and the first feasible phase. Keep unknowns visible; explaining a limitation is better than hiding it behind a confident picture.

Choose a format the learner can use: drawings, a printed map, spoken explanation, supported notes or the app. Assess the reasoning and relevant evidence rather than fluency with a device. Ask for consent before recording or sharing a person's presentation.

Invite specific feedback. A reviewer can name a supported strength, a missing assumption and a question that might change the plan. Listen before defending the drawing. Record whether the question exposes missing evidence, a misunderstanding in the presentation or a genuine conflict in the design.

english: The soil holds a lot of iron but little of the nutrients plants need most (phosphorus and nitrogen). Cover the soil with mopane leaves, but only a thin layer — too much can stop other plants growing nearby. Plant acacia trees nearby; their roots add nitrogen to the soil. Moringa trees also pull nutrients up from deep soil. Add compost and biochar (charcoal mixed into soil) until the soil holds at least 2% carbon.
isixhosa_draft: Umhlaba uqulethe intsimbi eninzi kodwa zimbalwa izondlo ezifunwa kakhulu zizityalo (i-phosphorus ne-nitrogen). Gquma umhlaba ngamagqabi e-mopane, kodwa ngumaleko omncinci kuphela — amaninzi kakhulu anokuthintela ezinye izityalo ukuba zikhule kufutshane. Tyala imithi ye-acacia kufutshane; iingcambu zayo zongeza i-nitrogen emhlabeni. Imithi ye-moringa nayo itsala izondlo isuka kumhlaba onzulu. Yongeza umgquba ne-biochar (amalahle axutywe nomhlaba) de umhlaba ube nekhabhoni engange-2% ubuncinane.

english: Forest soil is rich — disturb it as little as possible. Use small, deep planting holes (keyhole beds) for vegetables rather than large cleared areas. Cover the soil with fallen leaves as mulch. Working with the forest's own structure (a food-forest approach) gives the best results. Leave most of the forest undisturbed.
isixhosa_draft: Umhlaba wehlathi utyebile — wuphazamise kancinci kangangoko unako. Sebenzisa imingxuma emincinci nenzulu yokutyala (keyhole beds) kwimifuno kunokuba ucoce iindawo ezinkulu. Gquma umhlaba ngamagqabi awileyo njengengca yokugquma. Ukusebenza nolwakhiwo lwehlathi ngokwalo (indlela yehlathi lokutya) kunika iziphumo ezona zilungileyo. english: These values describe a software example. Whether people can work and move comfortably needs a separate site check.

english: Coordinates locate the top-left corner in the sample model’s metre frame. They are not latitude and longitude or measurements taken by a learner. The exercise uses the same two bed records as the app’s sample garden.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-koordinethi zibonisa ikona ephezulu ngasekhohlo kwisakhelo semitha semodeli yomzekelo. Azizizo ilatitudi nelongitudi okanye imilinganiselo ethathwe ngumfundi. Lo msebenzi usebenzisa iirekhodi ezimbini zebhedi ezifanayo nezegadi yomzekelo ye-app.

english: The supplied gap is the left edge of Bed 2 minus the right edge of Bed 1: {x2} − ({x1} + {width}) = {gap} m.
isixhosa_draft: Umsantsa onikeziweyo ngumphetho wasekhohlo weBhedi 2 ukuthabatha umphetho wasekunene weBhedi 1: {x2} − ({x1} + {width}) = {gap} m.

english: The two bed outlines keep the positions supplied by the app’s sample model.
isixhosa_draft: Imidwebo yeebhedi ezimbini ihlala kwiindawo ezinikezwe yimodeli yomzekelo ye-app.

english: Only Bed 2 moves. Its left edge meets Bed 1’s right edge. There is no clear gap between them.
isixhosa_draft: Yibhedi 2 kuphela ehambayo. Umphetho wayo wasekhohlo udibana nomphetho wasekunene weBhedi 1. Akukho msantsa ucacileyo phakathi kwazo.

english: Bed widths and lengths stay the same.
Scale diagram; enlarged view can be scrolled
The gap is outside both bed outlines. Do not count it as bed area.
isixhosa_draft: Umsantsa ungaphandle kwemidwebo yeebhedi zombini. Ungawubali njengendawo yebhedi.

english: Touching edges leave no gap. A neat rectangle does not prove there is usable access.
isixhosa_draft: Imiphetho ethintanayo ayishiyi msantsa. Unxande olungeleleneyo awubonisi ukuba kukho indlela esebenzisekayo yokungena.

english: Changing the view changes screen size only. It does not change the supplied dimensions or improve their evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Ukutshintsha imbonakalo kutshintsha ubungakanani besikrini kuphela. Akutshintshi milinganiselo enikeziweyo okanye ukuphucula ubungqina bayo.

english: Enter a number in each box to check. This is practice; no result is saved or awarded as course credit. Changing the arrangement clears the previous answers.
isixhosa_draft: Faka inombolo kwibhokisi nganye ukuze ukhangele. Oku kukuziqhelisa; akukho siphumo sigcinwayo okanye sinikwa njengekhredithi yekhosi. Ukutshintsha ulungiselelo kucima iimpendulo zangaphambili.

english: Ground inside the bed outlines, counting overlap only once
isixhosa_draft: Umhlaba ongaphakathi kwemidwebo yeebhedi, ubalwa ukugqubhana kanye kuphela

english: No overlap: {bed} + {bed} = {covered} m² inside the bed outlines.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho kugqubhana: {bed} + {bed} = {covered} m² ngaphakathi kwemidwebo yeebhedi.

english: That includes {gapArea} m² between the beds; this gap is not bed area.
isixhosa_draft: Oko kubandakanya i-{gapArea} m² phakathi kweebhedi; lo msantsa ayiyondawo yebhedi.

english: In this arrangement there is no gap between the outlines. That does not make it a suitable real layout.
isixhosa_draft: Kolu lungiselelo akukho msantsa phakathi kwemidwebo. Oko akukwenzi kube sisicwangciso sokwenyani esifanelekileyo.

english: Now explain whether the drawing establishes access, usable growing space or an expected harvest. It establishes only the supplied geometry; those real-world decisions need further evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Ngoku chaza ukuba umzobo uqinisekisa na indlela yokungena, indawo esebenzisekayo yokutyala okanye isivuno esilindelekileyo. Uqinisekisa kuphela ijometri enikeziweyo; ezo zigqibo zehlabathi lokwenyani zifuna ubungqina obongezelelekileyo.

english: The downloaded diagram includes its model dimensions. Its size on paper depends on the print settings: do not measure the print with a ruler and assume a ground distance unless you have established and checked the printed scale.
isixhosa_draft: Umzobo okhutshelweyo ubandakanya imilinganiselo yemodeli yawo. Ubungakanani bawo ephepheni buxhomekeke kwiisetingi zokushicilela: musa ukulinganisa okushicilelweyo ngomlawuli uthi ngumgama womhlaba, ngaphandle kokuba usiqinisekisile wasikhangela isikali esishicilelweyo.

english: Keep the measured source, units and drawing revision together. Check the clear space between actual edges, not just the distance between centres. Then check it with the people doing the work, the proposed system and the relevant technical guidance. The full busy-yard plan still needs its own measured source pack.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina umthombo olinganisiweyo, iiyunithi nenguqulelo yomzobo kunye. Khangela indawo ecacileyo phakathi kwemiphetho yokwenyani, hayi umgama phakathi kweziko kuphela. Emva koko ukhangele nabantu abenza umsebenzi, inkqubo ecetywayo nesikhokelo setekhnikhi esifanelekileyo. Isicwangciso esipheleleyo sebala elixakekileyo sisafuna ipakethe yaso yomthombo olinganisiweyo.

english: Diagram requested: {name}. It carries model dimensions, not a fixed printed scale.
isixhosa_draft: Umzobo uceliwe: {name}. Uphethe imilinganiselo yemodeli, hayi isikali esishicilelweyo esimiselweyo.

english: 1 · Read the brief and source map
Read the source cards before accepting a mark on a drawing. The frame is a classroom model; the top edge is model north by convention.
isixhosa_draft: Funda amakhadi omthombo phambi kokwamkela uphawu emzobeni. Isakhelo yimodeli yeklasi; umphetho ophezulu ngumntla wemodeli ngokwesiqhelo.

english: All values below are fictional classroom inputs in metres. Existing features belong to W-MAP; the alternative belongs to W-B; the compost proposal belongs to W-A. No value is inferred from the picture.
isixhosa_draft: Onke amaxabiso ngezantsi ngamaxabiso eklasi ayilwe ngokucinga, ngeemitha. Iimpawu ezikhoyo zivela ku-W-MAP; olunye ulungiselelo luvela ku-W-B; isiphakamiso somgquba sivela ku-W-A. Akukho xabiso lithathwe kumfanekiso.

english: Follow people and care before adding features
isixhosa_draft: Landela abantu nokukhathalela phambi kokongeza iimpawu

english: The water point, growing area and home-to-gate route suggest journeys to discuss with the people doing the work. They do not establish a measured travel time or an agreed workload.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yamanzi, indawo yokutyala nendlela esuka ekhaya iya esangweni zibonisa uhambo olufanele ukuxoxwa nabantu abenza umsebenzi. Azimisi xesha lokuhamba elilinganisiweyo okanye umthwalo womsebenzi ovunyelweneyo.

english: Use the dimensions written on the diagram. Printing may change its size; no physical print scale is claimed.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa imilinganiselo ebhalwe emzobeni. Ukushicilela kunokutshintsha ubungakanani bawo; akukho sikali sokushicilela esibonakalayo esibanjwayo.

english: A keeps the existing growing location. B investigates a different location with the same {area} m² model area. Both must answer the same food, access and care brief. Neither is approved for construction.
isixhosa_draft: U-A ugcina indawo yokutyala ekhoyo. U-B uphanda indawo eyahlukileyo enendawo yemodeli efanayo ye-{area} m². Zombini kufuneka ziphendule isishwankathelo esifanayo sokutya, sokungena nesokukhathalela. Akukho nanye evunyelwe ukwakhiwa.

english: Choose A, B or deferral. Explain aloud or on paper: which source supports your choice, what trade-off remains, and what new evidence could change your mind?
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-A, u-B okanye ukulibazisa. Chaza ngokuvakalayo okanye ephepheni: ngumphi umthombo oxhasa ukhetho lwakho, yintoni eseleyo ekufuneka uyinikele, kwaye bubuphi ubungqina obutsha obunokutshintsha ingqondo yakho?

english: Discuss the reason, not just the selection.
Investigating B can be reasonable if you explain its additional location checks. A relocated outline is not evidence of better growing conditions.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuphanda u-B kunokuba nengqiqo ukuba uchaza ukukhangelwa kwayo kwendawo okongezelelweyo. Umdwebo wendawo ewuthuthileyo asingobungqina bemiqathango engcono yokutyala.

english: Compare each option against the same evidence
This is a discussion exercise, not an assessment result. A facilitator reviews the evidence and explanation.
isixhosa_draft: Lo ngumsebenzi wengxoxo, hayi siphumo sovavanyo. Umququzeleli uphonononga ubungqina nenkcazo.

english: The guided choice is to investigate A while keeping physical changes on hold. B remains an alternative. Inspect each outline against the supplied frame and the existing route.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhetho olukhokelwayo kukuphanda u-A ngoxa utshintsho olubonakalayo luhlala lumisiwe. U-B uhlala eyenye indlela. Khangela umdwebo ngamnye ngokuchasene nesakhelo esinikeziweyo nendlela ekhoyo.

english: For B, calculate the horizontal gap from the route’s right edge to the proposed growing area’s left edge. Use E-ROUTE in W-MAP and P-B-PLOT in W-B. These rectangles overlap along the north–south direction, so this is their clear horizontal separation.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-B, bala umsantsa othe tye ukusuka kumphetho wasekunene wendlela ukuya kumphetho wasekhohlo wendawo yokutyala ecetywayo. Sebenzisa u-E-ROUTE ku-W-MAP no-P-B-PLOT ku-W-B. Ezi nxande ziyagqubhana ngokwesalathiso esisuka emantla ukuya emzantsi, ngoko ke olu lulwahlulo lwazo oluthe tye olucacileyo.

english: B’s left edge ({left} m) minus the route’s right edge ({right} m) = {gap} m. Centre-to-centre distance includes parts of both rectangles and would answer a different question.
isixhosa_draft: Umphetho wasekhohlo ka-B ({left} m) ukuthabatha umphetho wasekunene wendlela ({right} m) = {gap} m. Umgama osuka kwiziko ukuya kwiziko ubandakanya iinxalenye zazo zombini iinxande kwaye uya kuphendula umbuzo owahlukileyo.

english: The supplied route footprint and gap are fictional geometry, not access standards. They do not establish drainage, crop spacing, soil suitability or safe working clearance. The original growing area remains existing evidence when B is displayed; do not count both outlines as active production.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yendlela nomsantsa onikeziweyo yijometri eyilwe ngokucinga, hayi imigangatho yokungena. Azimisi ukuphuma kwamanzi, ukwahlulwa kwezityalo, ukufaneleka komhlaba okanye indawo ekhuselekileyo yokusebenza. Indawo yokutyala yokuqala ihlala ibubungqina obukhoyo xa u-B ebonisiwe; musa ukubala imidwebo yazo zombini njengemveliso esebenzayo.

english: Keep each feature connected to its next task
isixhosa_draft: Gcina uphawu ngalunye luqhagamshelene nomsebenzi walo olandelayo

english: What changes when care is not agreed?
Before opening the record, name what should change in the drawing, work sequence, purchasing and care plan.
isixhosa_draft: Phambi kokuvula irekhodi, chaza into ekufuneka itshintshe kumzobo, ulandelelwano lomsebenzi, ukuthenga nesicwangciso sokukhathalela.

english: Agree the observer and timing with the household. These are proposed checks; no later field results are supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Vumelanani nekhaya ngoqwalaselayo nexesha. Ezi ziingqwalaselo ezicetywayo; akukho ziphumo zamva zasentsimini ezinikeziweyo.

english: Apply the method to new evidence
Keep the plan and its reasons together

isixhosa_draft: Uphononongo lomxholo, uvavanyo nabafundi novavanyo lokugqibela zisalungiswa.

english: One unit each day, mixing explanation, guided practice and an independent attempt.
isixhosa_draft: Iyunithi enye mihla le, edibanisa inkcazo, umsebenzi okhokelwayo nobuzaza obuzimeleyo.

english: A supported project, then practical assessment, feedback and another attempt where needed.
isixhosa_draft: Iprojekthi exhaswayo, emva koko uvavanyo lwezandla, impendulo nobunye ubuzaza apho kufuneka.

english: Plan around four to five teaching hours per day, excluding breaks. This is an estimate to test with learners; translation, device sharing and additional practice may need more time.
isixhosa_draft: Cwangcisa malunga neeyure ezine ukuya kwezintlanu zokufundisa mihla le, ngaphandle kwezithuba. Esi sisiqikelelo sokuvavanywa nabafundi; ukuguqulelwa, ukwabelana ngezixhobo nomsebenzi owongezelelweyo wokuziqhelisa kunokufuna ixesha elingakumbi.

english: Self-paced learners can take the lessons at their own pace. A connected project now offers a supported case, an independent attempt and a fresh retry. Practitioner review and final assessed-course integration remain in preparation. Reading this preview does not award a qualification.
isixhosa_draft: Abafundi abazihambela ngamandla abo banokuthatha izifundo ngesantya sabo. Iprojekthi edibeneyo ngoku inikezela ngekesi exhaswayo, ubuzaza obuzimeleyo nokuphinda kwakhona ngekesi entsha. Uphononongo lwabasebenzi bezandla nokudityaniswa kokugqibela kwekhosi evavanywayo kusalungiswa. Ukufunda esi siboniso akunikezi sidanga.

english: Work through these examples with a facilitator or learning partner. The amounts and dates are invented practice inputs, not advice for your own accounts.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenza ngale mizekelo nomququzeleli okanye neqabane lokufunda. Izixa nemihla ziingeniso zokuziqhelisa ezilelwe, hayi ingcebiso yee-akhawunti zakho.

english: Use this unit’s own opening balances and source cards. Do not carry a previous unit’s totals into this exercise.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa izixa zokuvula namakhadi omthombo eyunithi le. Ungazisebenzisi izixa zeyunithi edlulileyo kulo msebenzi.

english: Use the event cards and worked examples below with a notebook and calculator.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa amakhadi ezehlo nemizekelo esonjululweyo engezantsi kunye nencwadi yokubhala nekhalkyuleyitha.

isixhosa_draft: Vula imeko yeyunithi, amakhadi omthombo neempendulo ezisonjululweyo

english: Use the app alongside this lesson
Read the relevant guide, then practise in the sample farm. Keep workbook figures out of your real farm records.
isixhosa_draft: Funda umhlahlandlela ofanelekileyo, uze uziqhelise kwifama yomzekelo. Gcina amanani encwadi yomsebenzi ngaphandle kweerekhodi zakho zefama yokwenyani.

english: Find your way and keep work safe
isixhosa_draft: Fumana indlela uze ugcine umsebenzi ukhuselekile
Thumela iirekhodi ngaphandle uze ulungiselele ubungqina

english: Try the connected practice case, then work through an independent case with fresh figures.
isixhosa_draft: Zama ikesi yokuziqhelisa edibeneyo, uze usebenze ngekesi ezimeleyo enamanani amatsha.

english: For the supported project day, use “Work together”. For an independent attempt, use “Try it yourself”. After feedback, use “A fresh case”. Each case starts again with its own sources and opening balances.
isixhosa_draft: Ngosuku lweprojekthi exhaswayo, sebenzisa “Sebenzani kunye”. Kubuzaza obuzimeleyo, sebenzisa “Zama ngokwakho”. Emva kwempendulo, sebenzisa “Ikesi entsha”. Ikesi nganye iqala kwakhona ngemithombo yayo kunye namanani ayo okuvula.

english: The practice site and opening record
Imaginary practice site and Plot A
A {width} by {height} metre site. Plot A is {plotWidth} by {plotHeight} metres, offset {x} metres from the left edge and {y} metres from the top edge. This is not a real location.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yeemitha ezi-{width} ngeemitha ezi-{height}. Isiza A siziimitha ezi-{plotWidth} ngeemitha ezi-{plotHeight}, sisuka kumphetho wasekhohlo ngeemitha ezi-{x} nakumphetho ophezulu ngeemitha ezi-{y}. Le ayiyondawo yokwenyani.

english: On your copy, mark Plot A and write its reference beside the harvest card. List the access, water and growing information you would still need for a real plan. The card gives no legal access agreement and no forecast of production from this area.
isixhosa_draft: Kwikopi yakho, phawula Isiza A uze ubhale isalathiso saso ecaleni kwekhadi lesivuno. Bhala ulwazi lokungena, lwamanzi nolokutyala oya kuba usalufuna kwisicwangciso sokwenyani. Ikhadi alinikeli sivumelwano semvume yokungena okanye uqikelelo lwemveliso ukusuka kule ndawo.
