isixhosa_draft: Umfama uxela ukuba ulima ngemvula kuphela. Sebenzisa uhlolo lwezityalo ezixhomekeke kwimvula kule ndawo; amanzi ezilwanyana yimfuno eyahlukileyo.

english: Not recorded. Complete the site survey and confirm water before choosing an intensive plan.
isixhosa_draft: Akubhalwanga. Gqibezela uphando lwendawo kwaye uqinisekise amanzi phambi kokukhetha isicwangciso sokulima ngokunzulu.

english: Drainage: {state}. Soil-test results and crop-specific needs still need checking.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuphuma kwamanzi: {state}. Iziphumo zovavanyo lomhlaba neemfuno ezithile zesityalo zisafuna ukujongwa.

english: stays wet, as reported; assess the ground before planting
isixhosa_draft: umhlaba uhlala umanzi, njengoko kuxelwe; vavanya umhlaba phambi kokutyala

english: Farmer-reported annual total - reporting year not recorded: {qty}.
isixhosa_draft: Isixa sonyaka esibikwe ngumfama - unyaka wengxelo awubhalwanga: {qty}.

english: Reported harvest months: {months}. These are survey observations, not a new production forecast.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zesivuno ezibikiweyo: {months}. Ezi ziinkalo ezibonwe kuphando, hayi uqikelelo olutsha lwemveliso.

english: Check the recorded unit and totals before using this row.
isixhosa_draft: Jonga iyunithi ebhaliweyo nezixa phambi kokusebenzisa lo mqolo.

english: The research has no matching regional shortlist. Ask a local grower or extension officer which named variety suits this season.
isixhosa_draft: Uphando alunalo uluhlu olufanayo lwengingqi. Buza umlimi wasekuhlaleni okanye igosa lolwandiso ukuba yeyiphi indidi ephawulweyo efanelekileyo kweli xesha.

english: This site's climate has not resolved, so no local shortlist is claimed. Open the crop card to see sources and record your choice.
isixhosa_draft: Imozulu yale ndawo ayikamiselwa, ngoko akukho luhlu lufutshane lwasekuhlaleni lucelwayo. Vula ikhadi lesityalo ukuze ubone imithombo kwaye ubhale ukhetho lwakho.

english: Select the actual lemon or mandarin catalogue choice for this mapped plant before assigning a production season. One mapped plant is one plant; the two product calendars are not joined.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ukhetho lokwenyani lwelamuni okanye lemandarin ekhathalogu kwesi sityalo sibekwe emephini phambi kokunikezela ixesha lemveliso. Isityalo esinye semephu sisityalo esinye; amakhalenda amabini eemveliso akadityaniswa.

english: The named peach windows are source references only. Record the actual peach or nectarine cultivar; its chilling and picking dates must be checked for this site.
isixhosa_draft: Amaxesha epetshi ethiyiweyo ziyizalathiso zomthombo kuphela. Bhala indidi yokwenyani yepetshi okanye ye-nectarine; imfuno yayo yokubanda nemihla yokuvuna kufuneka kujongwe kule ndawo.

english: Food use needs review before household production is planned
isixhosa_draft: Ukusetyenziswa njengokutya kufuna ukuhlolwa phambi kokucwangciswa kwemveliso yekhaya

english: Enter a whole number of plants
Age-group counts exceed plants on the map
isixhosa_draft: Amanani amaqela obudala adlula izityalo ezisemephini

english: Existing plants have a future planting date
isixhosa_draft: Izityalo ezikhoyo zinomhla wokutyala wexesha elizayo

english: Not planted yet · see future harvest
Age schedule: no crop planned now
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso sobudala: akukho sityalo sicwangcisiweyo ngoku

english: Projection, not a harvest promise. Vegetables and staples repeat only saved recurring sowings; dated and existing crops happen once.
isixhosa_draft: Uqikelelo, hayi isithembiso sesivuno. Imifuno nezityalo eziyisiseko ziphinda kuphela ukuhlwayela okuphindaphindayo okugciniweyo; izityalo ezinemihla nezikhoyo zenzeka kanye.

english: Vegetable and staple crop-cycle kilograms are counted in the year of first picking, not divided into monthly quantities. Carry-in harvests need actual records.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-kilogram zomjikelo wesityalo semifuno neziyisiseko zibalwa kunyaka wokuqala wokuvuna, azahlulwa zibe ngamanani enyanga. Izivuno ezivela kwixesha eledlulileyo zifuna iirekhodi zokwenyani.

english: Vegetable and staple estimates hold bed area, sowings and crop benchmarks constant. Revise the plan if growing trees change shade, water or available bed space.
isixhosa_draft: Uqikelelo lwemifuno neziyisiseko lugcina indawo yebhedi, ukuhlwayela nemilinganiselo yezityalo ingatshintshi. Hlaziya isicwangciso ukuba imithi ekhulayo itshintsha umthunzi, amanzi okanye indawo ekhoyo yebhedi.

english: Tree ages run from planting on this site. Separate older and younger plants into age groups. Research first-crop ages are references, not guaranteed dates.
isixhosa_draft: Ubudala bemithi bubalwa ukusukela ekutyaleni kule ndawo. Wahlule izityalo ezindala nezincinci kumaqela obudala. Ubudala bophando besivuno sokuqala zizalathiso, ayimihla eqinisekisiweyo.

english: Tree kg are your farm or nursery assumptions per plant per year. Values hold until the next age you enter; no growth multiplier is invented. A range covers changes within the year. Review the schedule as plants age.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-kg zemithi ziingcinga zefama yakho okanye zenkulisa ngesityalo ngasinye ngonyaka. Amaxabiso ahlala kude kufike ubudala obulandelayo obufakayo; akukho mpindaphindo wokukhula wenziweyo. Uluhlu luquka utshintsho kunyaka. Phonononga isicwangciso njengoko izityalo zindala.

english: Check that the variety, local climate, pollination, water and care match your yield assumptions. Ages alone do not establish site suitability or survival.
isixhosa_draft: Jonga ukuba uhlobo, imozulu yasekuhlaleni, ukuthwalwa komungu wentyatyambo, amanzi nokunakekela kuhambelana neengcinga zakho zesivuno. Ubudala bodwa abubonisi ukufaneleka kwendawo okanye ukusinda.

english: Known subtotals leave out missing yields. Eggs, meat, milk, fish and honey are not included in these crop kg totals. Picking months and food-gap checks still need local confirmation.
isixhosa_draft: Izixa ezisezaziwayo ziyashiya izivuno ezingekhoyo. Amaqanda, inyama, ubisi, iintlanzi nobusi azibandakanywa kwezi zixa ze-kg zezityalo. Iinyanga zokukha nokujonga izikhewu zokutya zisafuna ukuqinisekiswa apha ekuhlaleni.
Akukho mlinganiselo we-kg womjikelo wesityalo onomthombo

english: Existing catalogue restriction flag: NEMBA {nemba}. Legal status needs checking; kept as mapped inventory without planting advice or production dates.
isixhosa_draft: Uphawu olukhoyo lwemiqathango yekhathalogu: NEMBA {nemba}. Imeko yomthetho ifuna ukujongwa; igcinwe njengolwazi lwempahla elapha emephini ngaphandle kwesiluleko sokutyala okanye imihla yemveliso.

english: Invented stock months from January to March 2027, not a safe shelf life. Freezer conditions, a safe processing method and the amount held are not supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuJanyuwari ukuya kuMatshi 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Iimeko zefriza, indlela ekhuselekileyo yokulungisa nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

english: Invented stock months from June to August 2027, not a safe shelf life. The example banana picking record is also invented; a safe drying method and the amount held are not supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuJuni ukuya kuAgasti 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Irekhodi lomzekelo lokuvuna ibhanana nalo liqanjiwe; indlela ekhuselekileyo yokomisa nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

english: Invented stock months from May to August 2027, not a safe shelf life. The processing method, a tested preservation recipe and the amount held are not supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuMeyi ukuya kuAgasti 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Indlela yokulungisa, iresiphi yokugcina eyavavanywayo nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

english: Invented stock months from March to May 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried stock; no harvest from this example mango tree is claimed. A safe drying method and the amount held are not supplied.
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuMatshi ukuya kuMeyi 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Yimpahla eqanjiweyo ethengiweyo okanye eyathwalwa; akukho sivuno sivela kulo mthi we-mango womzekelo esicelwayo. Indlela ekhuselekileyo yokomisa nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

english: The first-crop age above is for leaves, not pods. Local leaf-picking months are not sourced. The pod reference describes North West provincial production, not an established picking calendar for this KZN example.
isixhosa_draft: Ubudala besivuno sokuqala obungasentla bobamagqabi, hayi iipodi. Iinyanga zasekuhlaleni zokukha amagqabi azinamthombo. Isalathiso seepodi sichaza imveliso yephondo laseNyakatho Ntshona, hayi ikhalenda lokuvuna elimisiweyo lalo mzekelo we-KZN.

english: Keep hives away from playgrounds, provide fresh water and use a dry site. Ask a registered beekeeper to check safe local placement before adding a hive.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina imizinga kude neendawo zokudlala abantwana, unike amanzi acocekileyo kwaye usebenzise indawo eyomileyo. Cela umfuyi weenyosi obhalisiweyo ajonge indawo ekhuselekileyo yasekuhlaleni phambi kokwongeza umzinga.

english: Site and secure hives against theft and vandalism, which is one of the biggest challenges facing South African beekeepers.
isixhosa_draft: Beka kwaye ukhusele imizinga ukuze ingabiwa okanye yonakaliswe, nto leyo enye yeengxaki ezinkulu ezijongene nabafuyi beenyosi baseMzantsi Afrika.

english: Register with the Department before beekeeping. Registration lasts 24 months from registration or renewal and must be renewed when it expires.
isixhosa_draft: Bhalisa kwiSebe phambi kokufuya iinyosi. Ukubhalisa kuhlala iinyanga ezingama-24 ukusukela ekubhaliseni okanye ekuhlaziyweni kwaye kufuneka kuhlaziywe xa kuphelelwa.

english: A beekeeper who fails to renew registration at expiry will be deregistered and face penalties under the Act.
isixhosa_draft: Umfuyi weenyosi ongahlaziyi ukubhalisa xa kuphelelwa uya kukhutshwa kwirejista aze ajongane nezohlwayo phantsi komThetho.

english: Beekeeping activities and hired beekeeping services require a valid registration certificate. Check the certificate before using a beekeeper.
isixhosa_draft: Imisebenzi yokufuya iinyosi neenkonzo zokufuya iinyosi eziqeshiweyo zifuna isatifikethi sokubhalisa esisebenzayo. Jonga isatifikethi phambi kokusebenzisa umfuyi weenyosi.

english: Every beehive must be clearly and legibly marked with the beekeeper's registration number.
isixhosa_draft: Umzinga ngamnye kufuneka uphawulwe ngokucacileyo nangokufundekayo ngenombolo yokubhalisa yomfuyi weenyosi.

english: Do not move honeybees across the Cape bee line, or keep Cape bees north of it, without written approval.
isixhosa_draft: Musa ukuhambisa iinyosi zobusi ngaphesheya komgca weenyosi zeKapa, okanye ugcine iinyosi zeKapa ngasemantla alo mgca, ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliweyo.

english: Cattle pens must not be overcrowded: there must be enough floor space for every animal to lie down at the same time.
isixhosa_draft: Iibhoma zeenkomo akufuneki zigcwale kakhulu: kufuneka kubekho indawo yomgangatho eyaneleyo ukuze yonke inkomo ilale ngaxeshanye.

english: During transport, cattle must have at least 1.4 m² of floor space each so loading is neither too tight nor too loose.
isixhosa_draft: Ngexesha lokuthuthwa, iinkomo kufuneka zibe nokungabi ngaphantsi kwe-1.4 m² yendawo yomgangatho inye ngenye ukuze ukulayisha kungabi manzima kakhulu okanye kukhululeke kakhulu.

english: Cattle may not be transported for more than 18 hours without being off-loaded and given feed, water and shelter.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkomo azinakuthuthwa ngaphezu kweeyure ezili-18 ngaphandle kokukhutshwa zinikwe ukutya, amanzi nendawo yokukhusela.

english: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to cattle.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukuphelisa indlala, ukutyisa kancinci, okanye ukunqanda amanzi okanye ukutya kwiinkomo.

english: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, with the exception below.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho silwanyana esinokuhlatywa naphi na ngaphandle kwe-abattoir ebhalisiweyo, ngaphandle kwemeko ekhutshiweyo engezantsi.

english: Slaughter for the farmer's own household consumption, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuhlaba ukutya komfama ngokwakhe ekhaya, okanye ngeenjongo zenkcubeko okanye zonqulo, akuphantsi komgaqo we-abattoir.

english: In hotter, humid KZN, KZN DARD describes Nguni × Jersey dairy trials at Makhathini to combine milk potential with local adaptation. Hand milking with the calf present highlights competition between household milk and calf growth. Discuss adapted stock and feeding locally; commercial milk-recording totals do not forecast this system. Record calving, lactation stage and milk available after calf needs.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-KZN eshushu, enomswakama, i-KZN DARD ichaza uvavanyo lobisi lweenkomo ze-Nguni × Jersey eMakhathini ukudibanisa amandla obisi nokuziqhelanisa nendawo. Ukukhama ngesandla ngelixa inkonyana ikhona kubonisa ukhuphiswano phakathi kobisi lwekhaya nokukhula kwenkonyana. Xoxa ngemfuyo eziqhelaniswe nendawo nokutya apha ekuhlaleni; izixa zorhwebo zokubhala ubisi azibikeli le nkqubo. Bhala ukuzala, inqanaba lokuvelisa ubisi nobisi olukhoyo emva kweemfuno zenkonyana.

english: Cows must not be loaded for transport if their udders are distended with milk.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkomo akufuneki zilayishwe ukuze zithuthwe ukuba amabele azo anyuliwe bubisi.

english: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a dairy cow.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukuphelisa indlala, ukutyisa kancinci, okanye ukunqanda amanzi okanye ukutya kwinkomo evelisa ubisi.

english: Cows on pasture or in open camps need shade: shade structures should give at least 4 to 5 m² of shade per cow.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkomo ezikwindawo yokudlela okanye kwiinkampu ezivulekileyo zidinga umthunzi: izakhiwo zomthunzi kufuneka zinike ubuncinane i-4 ukuya kwi-5 m² yomthunzi inkomo nganye.

english: Dairy farmers are legally required to test their herds for bovine TB, mainly because of export requirements, so most dairy cattle in South Africa are tested.
isixhosa_draft: Abalimi bobisi banyanzelekile ngokomthetho ukuba bavavanye imihlambi yabo i-bovine TB, ikakhulu ngenxa yeemfuno zokuthumela ngaphandle, ngoko uninzi lweenkomo zobisi eMzantsi Afrika luyavavanywa.

english: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, under the national bovine brucellosis control scheme.
isixhosa_draft: Naliphi na ukukhutshwa kwesisu okukrokrelwayo okanye okuqinisekisiweyo okunxulumene ne-brucellosis kwiinkomo kufuneka kuxelwe kwiofisi yoGqirha wezilwanyana kaRhulumente, phantsi kwenkqubo yesizwe yokulawula i-bovine brucellosis.

english: A cull cow may be slaughtered only at an abattoir, except for the farmer's own consumption or for cultural or religious purposes.
isixhosa_draft: Inkomo ekhutshiweyo ingahlatywa kuphela kwi-abattoir, ngaphandle kokutya komfama ngokwakhe okanye ngeenjongo zenkcubeko okanye zonqulo.

english: Newer South African commercial reference: SAPA 2024 reports average slaughter at 30–31 days with bird weight 1.8–1.85 kg. The primary range above remains the earlier 2022 reference at 32–33 days. These are commercial bird weights, not dressed meat kg or a village flock target. Record hatch or purchase age, feeding system, actual harvest date and weighed product basis.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sorhwebo seMzantsi Afrika esitsha: i-SAPA 2024 ixela ukuhlatywa okumlinganiselo kweentsuku ezingama-30–31 kunye nobunzima beentaka obungu-1.8–1.85 kg. Uluhlu oluphambili olungasentla lusesisalathiso sangaphambili sango-2022 seentsuku ezingama-32–33. Ezi bubunzima beentaka zorhwebo, hayi ii-kg zenyama ehlutshiweyo okanye injongo yomhlambi wasezilalini. Bhala ubudala bokuqanyelwa okanye bokuthengwa, inkqubo yokutya, umhla wokwenyani wokuvuna nesiseko somveliso olinganisiweyo.

english: Floor-housed broilers: no more than 40 kg of bird per square metre.
isixhosa_draft: Ii-broiler ezikwindlu enomgangatho: akungabi ngaphezu kwe-40 kg yeentaka kwi-mitha yesikwere enye.

english: Newly hatched chicks must be given feed within 24 hours of hatching.
isixhosa_draft: Amantshontsho asandula ukuqanyelwa kufuneka anikwe ukutya kwisithuba seeyure ezingama-24 emva kokuqanyelwa.

english: Newly hatched chicks must be given access to water within 24 hours of hatching, sooner in hot weather.
isixhosa_draft: Amantshontsho asandula ukuqanyelwa kufuneka anikwe ukufikelela kumanzi kwisithuba seeyure ezingama-24 emva kokuqanyelwa, kwangoko ngakumbi kwimozulu eshushu.

english: Fresh water and the right feed always available, so birds are free from hunger and thirst.
isixhosa_draft: Amanzi acocekileyo nokutya okufanelekileyo kufuneka kuhlale kukhona, ukuze iintaka zingabi nandlala nanxano.

english: Broiler houses need a minimum ventilation/airflow rate of 5 cubic metres per hour for every kilogram of bird mass in the house.
isixhosa_draft: Iindlu ze-broiler zifuna izinga eliphantsi lokuhamba komoya elili-5 leemitha ezikhubekileyo ngeyure kwikhilogram nganye yobunzima beentaka ezikwindlu.

english: In free-range broiler production, indoor stocking must not exceed 15 birds per square metre of floor space.
isixhosa_draft: Kuvelisho lwe-broiler lokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo, ukugcina iintaka ngaphakathi akufuneki kudlule iintaka ezili-15 kwimitha yesikwere nganye yomgangatho.

english: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but an abattoir, with the exceptions below.
isixhosa_draft: Akukho silwanyana esinokuhlatywa naphi na ngaphandle kwe-abattoir, ngaphandle kweemeko ezikhutshiweyo ezingezantsi.

english: Slaughter for your own household, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuhlaba ukutya kwekhaya lakho, okanye ngeenjongo zenkcubeko okanye zonqulo, akuphantsi komgaqo we-abattoir.

english: The ARC Irene trial compared Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck under commercial feed, water and controlled lighting. Mean eggs/hen in a 52-week cycle were 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 and 138.9 respectively; first-egg ages were 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 and 129.0 days from hatch, with no significant first-egg age difference among breeds. This is managed breed context, not the yield of scavenging hens in KZN. Match feeding and housing before using a benchmark.
isixhosa_draft: Uvavanyo lwe-ARC Irene lathelekisa i-Potchefstroom Koekoek, i-Venda, i-Ovambo ne-Naked Neck phantsi kokutya kwezorhwebo, amanzi nokukhanya okulawulwayo. Imilinganiselo yamaqanda/kwisikhukhukazi kumjikelo weeveki ezingama-52 yayi-195.9, 153.7, 125.5 kunye ne-138.9 ngokulandelelana; iminyaka yeqanda lokuqala yayiyintsuku ezili-138.5, 139.0, 134.5 kunye ne-129.0 ukusuka ekuqanyelweni, kungekho mahluko obalulekileyo wobudala beqanda lokuqala phakathi kweendidi. Le yimeko yohlobo olulawulwayo, hayi isivuno seenkukhu ezikrwelayo eKZN. Linganisa ukutya nendawo yokuhlala phambi kokusebenzisa umlinganiselo.

english: In extensive village systems the chickens have to find their own water and food.
isixhosa_draft: Kwiinkqubo ezibanzi zasezilalini iinkukhu kufuneka zizifunele amanzi nokutya.

english: In the Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal survey, 94.9% of farmers housed their chickens at night.
isixhosa_draft: Kuphando lwaseLimpopo naseKwaZulu-Natal, i-94.9% yabalimi yayigcina iinkukhu zabo endlwini ebusuku.

english: What free-ranging hens forage met their needs for maintenance and growth but not for laying: protein in every season, calcium and phosphorus in winter.
isixhosa_draft: Oko izikhukhukazi ezikrwelayo ngokukhululekileyo zikufunayo kwanelisa iimfuno zazo zokugcina nokukhula kodwa hayi zokubeka amaqanda: iprotheni ngamaxesha onke, ikhalsiyam ne-phosphorus ebusika.

english: SAPA 2024 commercial strain standards cumulative to 90 weeks: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 and Lohmann Brown Lite 413. These are full-cycle objectives, not eggs per calendar year or a smallholder forecast. Purchase age, actual onset of lay, surviving laying hens, feed, water and lighting need separate records.
isixhosa_draft: Imilinganiselo yohlobo lorhwebo ye-SAPA 2024 ewonke ukuya kwiiveki ezingama-90: i-Dekalb Amberlink 429 amaqanda/kwisikhukhukazi esigcinwe endlwini, i-Dekalb Brown 428, i-Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, i-Hy-Line Brown 434 kunye ne-Lohmann Brown Lite 413. Ezi ziinjongo zomjikelo opheleleyo, hayi amaqanda ngonyaka wekhalenda okanye uqikelelo lomfama omncinci. Ubudala bokuthenga, ukuqala kokwenyani kokubeka, izikhukhukazi eziphilayo ezibekayo, ukutya, amanzi nokukhanya zifuna iirekhodi ezahlukeneyo.

english: In free-range systems, hens must have access to the outdoor range for at least 8 hours a day in daylight.
isixhosa_draft: Kwiinkqubo zokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo, izikhukhukazi kufuneka zibe nokufikelela kwindawo yangaphandle ubuncinane iiyure ezi-8 ngosuku emini.

english: Where individual nest boxes are used, at least one nest for every 8 hens.
isixhosa_draft: Apho kusetyenziswa iibhokisi zezidleke ezizodwa, kufuneka kubekho isidleke esinye ubuncinane kwizikhukhukazi ezi-8 ngazo zonke.

english: Hens need at least 8 hours of continuous darkness in every 24-hour cycle to rest properly.
isixhosa_draft: Izikhukhukazi zidinga ubuncinane iiyure ezi-8 zobumnyama obuqhubekayo kumjikelo ngamnye weeyure ezingama-24 ukuze ziphumle kakuhle.

english: Floor housing needs litter on at least a third (33%) of the floor.
isixhosa_draft: Indlu enomgangatho ifuna izinto zokulala (litter) kwisithathu (33%) somgangatho ubuncinane.

english: The outdoor free-range area must not be overstocked: no more than 5 birds per square metre of range.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yangaphandle yokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo akufuneki igcwale kakhulu: akungabi ngaphezu kweentaka ezi-5 kwimitha yesikwere nganye yendawo yokuhamba.

english: It is an offence to deny a duck food or water, or keep it somewhere lacking adequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat and cold.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukukhanyela idada ukutya okanye amanzi, okanye ukulibeka kwindawo engenayo indawo eyaneleyo, umoya ohamba kakuhle, ukukhanya okanye ukukhuselwa kubushushu nakubanda.

english: Ducks are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so its rules on registered abattoirs and hygiene apply to them.
isixhosa_draft: Iidada ziphakathi kwezilwanyana ezifuyiweyo ezibhalwe kwi-Meat Safety Act, ngoko imithetho yayo ngee-abattoir ezibhalisiweyo nococeko isebenza kuzo.

english: At the abattoir, ducks must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-abattoir, iidada kufuneka zijongwe ngobubele ngexesha lokulayisha, ukuthuthwa, ukukhutshwa, ukuhlala, ukunqandwa nokubulawa, phantsi kwe-Animals Protection Act.

english: ARC makes tilapia suitability depend on water temperature: summer grow-out can be suitable anywhere in South Africa when water exceeds 20°C; growth is poor below 18°C and winter water below 13°C can kill farmed tilapia. The Highveld reference is a summer crop; tunnels can widen the range. Measure pond water and confirm stocking species and dates. Air climate or a mapped pond does not prove harvest months, fish numbers or food kg.
isixhosa_draft: I-ARC yenza ukufaneleka kwe-tilapia kuxhomekeke kubushushu bamanzi: ukukhula kwasehlotyeni kunokufanelekile naphi na eMzantsi Afrika xa amanzi edlula kwi-20°C; ukukhula kubi ngaphantsi kwe-18°C kwaye amanzi asebusika angaphantsi kwe-13°C anokubulala i-tilapia efuyiweyo. Isalathiso seHighveld sisityalo sasehlotyeni; iitonela zinokwandisa uluhlu. Linganisa amanzi echibi kwaye uqinisekise iindidi zokubeka kunye nemihla. Imozulu yomoya okanye ichibi elibekwe emephini alibonisi iinyanga zesivuno, amanani eentlanzi okanye ii-kg zokutya.

english: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is a nationally listed invasive fish species: Category 1b inside National Parks, Provincial Reserves, Mountain Catchment Areas and Forestry Reserves, and Category 3 in all other areas.
isixhosa_draft: I-Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) yindidi yentlanzi ephazamisayo ebhalwe ngokwesizwe: i-Category 1b ngaphakathi kwiiPaki zeSizwe, iindawo zokugcinwa zephondo, iindawo zokuqokelela amanzi entabeni neendawo zokugcinwa kwamahlathi, kunye ne-Category 3 kuzo zonke ezinye iindawo.

english: Outside protected areas Nile tilapia is Category 3: it may remain in prescribed areas or provinces, but further propagation or trade is prohibited.
isixhosa_draft: Ngaphandle kweendawo ezikhuselweyo i-Nile tilapia yi-Category 3: inokuhlala kwiindawo okanye kumaphondo amiselweyo, kodwa ukuyandisa okanye ukurhweba ngayo kuthintelwe.

english: Nile Tilapia has been listed under the NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations as requiring a permit to produce.
isixhosa_draft: I-Nile Tilapia ibhaliwe phantsi kwe-NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations njengefuna imvume yokuyivelisa.

english: Producing an alien or invasive species (such as Nile Tilapia) is prohibited in areas designated under the Protected Areas Act and the Fish Sanctuary Act; a permit is required to produce it elsewhere.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuvelisa indidi engeyiyo yendawo okanye ephazamisayo (ezifana ne-Nile Tilapia) kuthintelwe kwiindawo ezimiselweyo phantsi kwe-Protected Areas Act kunye ne-Fish Sanctuary Act; imvume iyafuneka ukuyivelisa kwenye indawo.

english: Producing tilapia in South Africa requires a water use licence under the National Water Act.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuvelisa i-tilapia eMzantsi Afrika kufuna ilayisenisi yokusebenzisa amanzi phantsi kwe-National Water Act.

english: South African Saanen reference by lactation number, not age in years: mean milk mass per standardised 305-day lactation was 947.3 kg at first parity, 1043.2 at second, 1073.4 at third, 1020.3 at fourth, 972.8 at fifth, 901.6 at sixth and 775.4 at ≥7th. These ARC milk-recorded groups were mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Record actual kidding date, lactation number and collected milk; do not divide these totals evenly into months.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso se-Saanen yaseMzantsi Afrika ngokwenani lokuvelisa ubisi, hayi ubudala ngeminyaka: ubunzima obumlinganiselo bobisi ngexesha ngalinye elimiselweyo leentsuku ezingama-305 yayi-947.3 kg ekuzaleni kokuqala, 1043.2 kwesesibini, 1073.4 kwesesithathu, 1020.3 kwesesine, 972.8 kwesesihlanu, 901.6 kwesesithandathu kunye ne-775.4 kwi-≥7th. Aya maqela abhalwe ubisi yi-ARC ayenemihlambi ye-stud enzulu/ephakathi nenzulu ikakhulu. Bhala umhla wokwenyani wokuzala, inani lexesha lokuvelisa ubisi nobisi olukhutshiweyo; musa ukwahlula ezi zixa zilingane ziye kwiinyanga.

english: At Putukwane near Polokwane, 179 lactating does under extensive feeding with irregular supplementation were observed for 210 days after kidding. Mean milk mass was 1.45 kg/day for Saanen, 0.75 for British Alpine and 0.56 for Toggenburg during observed lactation. Early lactation exceeded mid and late lactation; March–April kidding outperformed October–November in this cohort. These conditions differ from stud-herd records. Discuss adapted stock and feed locally; these are not litres/day or year-round promises.
isixhosa_draft: ePutukwane ngasePolokwane, iimazi ezingama-179 ezivelisa ubisi phantsi kokutya okubanzi kunye nokongezwa okungaqhelekanga zajongwa iintsuku ezingama-210 emva kokuzala. Ubunzima bobisi obumlinganiselo bubuyi-1.45 kg/ngosuku kwi-Saanen, i-0.75 kwi-British Alpine kunye ne-0.56 kwi-Toggenburg ngexesha lokuvelisa ubisi elijongiweyo. Ubisi lwexesha lokuqala lokuvelisa lwaludlula olwexesha eliphakathi neliphelayo; ukuzala kukaMatshi–Epreli kwadlula ukuzala kuka-Okthobha–Novemba kweli qela. Ezi meko ziyahluka kwiirekhodi zemihlambi ye-stud. Xoxa ngemfuyo eziqhelaniswe nendawo nokutya apha ekuhlaleni; ezi aziziilitha/ngosuku okanye izithembiso zonyaka wonke.

english: It is an offence to keep a goat somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukugcina ibhokhwe kwindawo engenayo indawo eyaneleyo, umoya ohamba kakuhle, ukukhanya okanye ukukhuselwa kubushushu, ebubandayo okanye kwimozulu, okanye ukuyivalela/ukuyibophelela ngendlela ebangela ukubandezeleka okungafunekiyo.

english: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a goat.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukuphelisa indlala, ukutyisa kancinci, okanye ukunqanda amanzi okanye ukutya kwibhokhwe.

english: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products (including milk) cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
isixhosa_draft: Ngaphakathi kwindawo ebhengezwe ichatshazelwe yi-FMD, iibhokhwe neemveliso zazo (kuquka ubisi) azinakuhanjiswa ukuya, ukusuka okanye ngaphakathi kwendawo ngaphandle kwemvume yokuhambisa kagqirha wezilwanyana kaRhulumente nokuthobela iimeko zayo.

english: In KZN Highland Sourveld smallholder systems, winter and early-spring feed shortage can restrict goats. Autumn-kidding does feed kids through winter; spring-kidding does face late-pregnancy feed shortage, especially with late rains. Plan local winter feed and monitor weights with extension support; this is regional care context, not kg or a universal kidding calendar.
isixhosa_draft: Kwiinkqubo zabalimi abancinci kwi-KZN Highland Sourveld, ukunqongophala kokutya ebusika nasekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo kunganciphisa iibhokhwe. Iimazi ezizala ekwindla zondla amathole ebusika; iimazi ezizala entwasahlobo zijongana nokunqongophala kokutya ekupheleni kokukhulelwa, ngakumbi xa imvula iphuma kade. Cwangcisa ukutya kobusika kwindawo yakho kwaye ujonge ubunzima ngenkxaso yolwandiso; olu lwazi lwemeko yengingqi yokunakekela, hayi ii-kg okanye ikhalenda eliqhelekileyo lokuzala.

english: Winter feed shortage on communal sourveld is a known welfare/production risk: does that kid in autumn must feed kids through winter, and does that kid in spring suffer poor nutrition during late pregnancy, so winter feed supplementation matters.
isixhosa_draft: Ukunqongophala kokutya ebusika kwi-sourveld yasekuhlaleni yingozi eyaziwayo yokunakekelwa/yemveliso: iimazi ezizala ekwindla kufuneka zondle amathole ebusika, kwaye iimazi ezizala entwasahlobo ziyathotyeleziswa kukutya okungalunganga ekupheleni kokukhulelwa, ngoko ukongezwa kokutya kobusika kubalulekile.

english: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
isixhosa_draft: Ngaphakathi kwindawo ebhengezwe ichatshazelwe yi-FMD, iibhokhwe neemveliso zazo azinakuhanjiswa ukuya, ukusuka okanye ngaphakathi kwendawo ngaphandle kwemvume yokuhambisa kagqirha wezilwanyana kaRhulumente nokuthobela iimeko zayo.

english: When pigs are trucked, the SA code of practice for handling and transporting animals recommends 0.3 m² per porker, 0.4 m² per baconer and 0.8 m² per adult pig.
isixhosa_draft: Xa iihagu zithuthwa ngenqwelo, i-SA code of practice yokuphatha nokuthutha izilwanyana incoma i-0.3 m² kwi-porker nganye, i-0.4 m² kwi-baconer nganye kunye ne-0.8 m² kwihagu ekhulileyo nganye.

english: It is an offence to keep a pig somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukugcina ihagu kwindawo engenayo indawo eyaneleyo, umoya ohamba kakuhle, ukukhanya okanye ukukhuselwa kubushushu, ebubandayo okanye kwimozulu, okanye ukuyivalela/ukuyibophelela ngendlela ebangela ukubandezeleka okungafunekiyo.

english: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a pig.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukuphelisa indlala, ukutyisa kancinci, okanye ukunqanda amanzi okanye ukutya kwihagu.

english: In heat waves, pig houses need better ventilation/airflow and lower stocking density, and outdoor pigs need shade and shelter.
isixhosa_draft: Kwimiqondiso yobushushu obukhulu, iindlu zeehagu zifuna umoya ohamba kakuhle kunye nobuninzi obuncinane bezilwanyana, kwaye iihagu zangaphandle zidinga umthunzi nendawo yokukhusela.

english: Swill (food waste) may not be fed to pigs unless it has been boiled for at least 60 minutes or sterilised by another equally effective method.
isixhosa_draft: Inkunkuma yokutya (swill) ayinakutyiswa kwiihagu ngaphandle kokuba ibilisiwe imizuzu engama-60 ubuncinane okanye ikhutshelwe iintsholongwane ngenye indlela esebenza ngokufanayo.

english: Pigs may only be moved into a biosecure compartment from another compartment that is officially certified/approved for that purpose.
isixhosa_draft: Iihagu zinokuhanjiswa kuphela kwi-biosecure compartment zisuka kwenye i-compartment eqinisekisiweyo/eyamkelweyo ngokusemthethweni kwesi sizathu.

english: A pig may not be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, except for own household consumption or cultural/religious purposes.
isixhosa_draft: Ihagu ayinakuhlatywa naphi na ngaphandle kwe-abattoir ebhalisiweyo, ngaphandle kokutya kwasekhaya okanye ngeenjongo zenkcubeko/zonqulo.

english: South African grower reference: New Zealand White and Phendula rabbits in the 2017 Stellenbosch trial were slaughtered at about 11 weeks from birth. Overall means were 2.62 kg live slaughter weight, 1.55 kg hot carcass, 1.48 kg chilled carcass and 1.26 kg reference carcass with head and red offal removed, still including bones. Balanced pellets and water were freely available in a grower house. These weights are not boneless meat or annual doe output; do not multiply them by the unrelated FAO backyard target.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sabakhuli baseMzantsi Afrika: imivundla ye-New Zealand White ne-Phendula kuvavanyo lwango-2017 eStellenbosch yahlatywa malunga neeveki ezili-11 ukusukela ekuzalweni. Imilinganiselo ngokubanzi yayi-2.62 kg yobunzima bokuhlatywa obuphilayo, i-1.55 kg yesidumbu esishushu, i-1.48 kg yesidumbu esipholileyo kunye ne-1.26 kg yesidumbu sesalathiso esingenaso intloko nezitho zangaphakathi ezibomvu (red offal), kusabandakanya amathambo. Iipelethi ezilinganisiweyo namanzi ayefumaneka ngokukhululekileyo endlwini yabakhuli. Ezi bunzima aziyonyama engenamathambo okanye imveliso yonyaka yemazi; musa ukuziphindaphinda ngenjongo ye-FAO yasegadini engahambelaniyo.

english: It is an offence to deny a rabbit food or water, or keep it somewhere lacking adequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat and cold.
isixhosa_draft: Kuwulwaphulo-mthetho ukukhanyela umvundla ukutya okanye amanzi, okanye ukuwugcina kwindawo engenayo indawo eyaneleyo, umoya ohamba kakuhle, ukukhanya okanye ukukhuselwa kubushushu nakubanda.

english: Give breeding rabbits roughly 0.48-0.70 m2 of hutch floor space each, 50-60 cm high, not a cramped cage.
isixhosa_draft: Nika imivundla yokwenzalana malunga ne-0.48-0.70 m2 yomgangatho wekheji nganye, ukuphakama kwe-50-60 cm, hayi ikheji ecinezelayo.

english: Rabbits are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so the Act's rules on abattoirs and hygiene apply to them, as they do to ducks and other listed species.
isixhosa_draft: Imivundla ziphakathi kwezilwanyana ezifuyiweyo ezibhalwe kwi-Meat Safety Act, ngoko imithetho ye-Act ngee-abattoir nococeko isebenza kuyo, njengoko isebenza kwiidada nakwezinye iindidi ezibhalweyo.

english: At the abattoir, rabbits (like other listed animals) must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
isixhosa_draft: Kwi-abattoir, imivundla (njengezinye izilwanyana ezibhalweyo) kufuneka iphathwe ngobubele ngexesha lokulayisha, ukuthuthwa, ukukhutshwa, ukuhlala, ukunqandwa nokubulawa, phantsi kwe-Animals Protection Act.

english: The wild European rabbit (the same species as farmed New Zealand White/Californian rabbits) is only listed as an invasive species under NEMBA on South Africa's off-shore islands - it is not a listed/restricted species on the mainland.
isixhosa_draft: Umvundla wasendle waseYurophu (udidi olufanayo nemivundla ye-New Zealand White/Californian efuyiweyo) ubhalwe njengendidi ephazamisayo phantsi kwe-NEMBA kuphela kwiiziqithi zaseMzantsi Afrika ezingaphandle kolwandle - ayiyiyo indidi ebhalwe/ethintelweyo kwilizwekazi.

english: Sheep must not be penned overcrowded: at least 0.56 square metres of floor space per sheep so every animal can lie down.
isixhosa_draft: Igusha akufuneki ibekwe ngokugcwele kakhulu: ubuncinane i-0.56 yeemitha ezisikwere zendawo yomgangatho igusha nganye ukuze yonke ilale.

english: Sheep driven on the hoof may not be moved more than 20 km in a single day (25 km is regarded as excessive).
isixhosa_draft: Igusha ezihanjiswa ngokuhamba ngeenyawo azinakuhanjiswa ngaphezu kwe-20 km ngosuku olunye (i-25 km ithathwa njengokugqithisileyo).

english: Injured, disabled or blind sheep must be given priority slaughter, or emergency slaughter, to prevent further pain or distress.
isixhosa_draft: Igusha ezenzakeleyo, ezilimeleyo okanye eziyimfama kufuneka zinikwe ukuhlatywa kokuqala, okanye ukuhlatywa kwexesha lengxakeko, ukuthintela intlungu okanye ukubandezeleka ngakumbi.

english: Inside a declared FMD zone, sheep and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within it without a state veterinary permit.
isixhosa_draft: Ngaphakathi kwindawo ebhengezwe yi-FMD, igusha neemveliso zazo azinakuhanjiswa ukuya, ukusuka okanye ngaphakathi kwayo ngaphandle kwemvume kagqirha wezilwanyana kaRhulumente.

english: Against sheep scab, all small stock on the farm must be treated with a remedy registered under Act 36 of 1947, and infected sheep treated twice, eight to ten days apart.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuthintela i-sheep scab, zonke izilwanyana ezincinci efama kufuneka zinyangwe ngamayeza abhalisiweyo phantsi kwe-Act 36 ka-1947, kwaye igusha ezisulelekileyo zinyangwe kabini, ngeentsuku ezisi-8 ukuya kweziyi-10 ukusuka kwenye.

english: A sheep may be slaughtered only at an abattoir, except for the farmer's own consumption or for cultural or religious purposes.
isixhosa_draft: Igusha inokuhlatywa kuphela kwi-abattoir, ngaphandle kokutya komfama ngokwakhe okanye ngeenjongo zenkcubeko okanye zonqulo.

english: From a 2008 national postal survey of 112 SABIO-member beekeepers (22.4% response rate) managing an estimated 19,520 hives at 2,094 apiary sites; figure is self-reported and un-weighted. Table 7 (same doc, p.13-14) shows wide variance by region/operation-focus/size for the same year: e.g. 'All' region, honey-focused, all-size operations = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr across 3 survey sites; Western Cape honey-focused = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; Western Cape pollination-focused, small operations = only 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr. The same document also quotes an earlier, more rigorously validated study: 'Their average reported yield is very low, at just 13.4 kilograms per hive' for Western Cape hives (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, cited p.2 of this working paper), and historical national bee-census data of 8.3 kg/hive/annum (1911-1988 average) rising to 24 kg/hive in the 1974/5 census (same doc, p.1). No single number can be called definitive; 25 kg/hive/yr is used as the document's own headline national estimate.
isixhosa_draft: Ivela kuphando lwesizwe lweposi lwango-2008 lwabafuyi beenyosi abayi-112 abangamalungu e-SABIO (izinga lokuphendula elingu-22.4%) abalawula uqikelelo lwemizinga eyi-19,520 kwiindawo zeenyosi ezi-2,094; esi sixa sixelwe ngabo ngokwabo kwaye asilinganiswanga. Itheyibhile 7 (uxwebhu olufanayo, iphe. 13-14) ibonisa umahluko omkhulu ngengingqi/ugxininiso lomsebenzi/ubukhulu kunyaka ofanayo: umzekelo, ingingqi 'Yonke', ugxininiso kubusi, yonke imisebenzi yobukhulu bonke = 25.1-26.9 kg/umzinga/ngonyaka kwiindawo ezi-3 zophando; ubusi eNtshona Koloni obugxininise kubusi = 23.6-27.9 kg/umzinga/ngonyaka; ugxininiso kuthwalo-mungu (pollination) eNtshona Koloni, imisebenzi emincinci = nje 7.0-7.5 kg/umzinga/ngonyaka. Uxwebhu olufanayo luphinda lucaphule uphando lwangaphambili olunobungqina obungcono: 'Isivuno sabo esimlinganiselo esixelwe siphantsi kakhulu, nje ngama-13.4 kilogram ngomzinga' kwimizinga yeNtshona Koloni (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, ecaphuliweyo kwiphe. 2 yeli phepha lomsebenzi), kunye nedatha yakudala yobalo lweenyosi lwesizwe ye-8.3 kg/umzinga/ngonyaka (umlinganiselo ka-1911-1988) ekhula ukuya kuma-24 kg/umzinga kubalo luka-1974/5 (uxwebhu olufanayo, iphe. 1). Akukho nani linye linokubizwa ngokuba liqinisekisiweyo; i-25 kg/umzinga/ngonyaka isetyenziswa njengoqikelelo oluphambili lwesizwe lolu xwebhu ngokwalo.

english: Table 5 gives weaning weight (WW) across four agro-ecological zones for the same nine Nguni communal herds: arid 114.51 kg (lowest), semi-arid 119.98 kg, dry sub-humid 117.91 kg, humid 121.21 kg (highest). The range recorded here spans this one study's own arid-to-humid zone means; it is not merged with any other paper's weaning-weight figures (other SA studies report different ranges for different systems - e.g. research-station or stud herds - and were deliberately excluded to avoid mixing systems). 826 Nguni calves from nine herds that the paper itself says were 'kept under extensive grazing system' in Limpopo Province - a genuine communal/extensive veld system matching this enterprise.
isixhosa_draft: Itheyibhile 5 inika ubunzima bokuyekiswa ebeleni (WW) kwiindawo ezine ze-agro-ecological kwimihlambi efanayo yoNguni elithoba yasekuhlaleni: indawo eyomileyo 114.51 kg (eyona iphantsi), indawo eyomileyo ngokwesiqingatha 119.98 kg, indawo e-dry sub-humid 117.91 kg, indawo enomswakama 121.21 kg (eyona iphezulu). Uluhlu olubhaliweyo apha luquka kuphela imilinganiselo yeendawo zolu phando ngokwalo ukusuka kwindawo eyomileyo ukuya kwenomswakama; aluqhagamshelwanga nobunye ubunzima bokuyekiswa ebeleni obuvela kwamanye amaphepha (ezinye izifundo zaseMzantsi Afrika zixela uluhlu olwahlukileyo kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo - umzekelo, izikhululo zophando okanye imihlambi ye-stud - kwaye zashiywa ngabom ukuphepha ukuxuba iinkqubo). Iinkonyana ezingama-826 ezivela kwimihlambi esithoba, eyathi iphepha ngokwalo ithi 'igcinwe phantsi kwenkqubo yokudlala ngokubanzi' kwiphondo laseLimpopo - inkqubo yokwenyani yasekuhlaleni/yokudlala ngokubanzi ehambelana nalo shishini.

english: 2354 days / 365.25 = 6.44 years. 'Failure time' is the length of productive herd life for the 580 uncensored (fully-observed) records in the combined dataset; the dissertation itself defines productive herd life as 'the time interval between first calving date to culling date'. Combined data from three extensively-grazed Nguni stud herds, animals born 1968-2015.
isixhosa_draft: Iintsuku ezili-2354 / 365.25 = iminyaka eyi-6.44. 'Ixesha lokusilela' ubude bobomi bemveliso bomhlambi kwiirekhodi ezingama-580 ezibonwe ngokupheleleyo kwidathasethi edibeneyo; i-dissertation ngokwayo ichaza ubomi bemveliso bomhlambi njengo 'xesha eliphakathi komhla wokuzala wokuqala nomhla wokuhlinzwa'. Idatha edibeneyo evela kwimihlambi emithathu ye-stud yamaNguni edla ngokubanzi, izilwanyana ezizalwe ngo-1968-2015.

english: Table 1 ('Comparison of number of cows, production and fertility in the main dairy breeds in South Africa'), Milk column, Grade rows: Jersey 3840 kg and Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg per lactation (Registered rows: 4468 and 6426 kg). The document says these are National Milk Recording Scheme herds, which 'have been shown to be better managed than those outside the scheme, with their performance per lactation being 50 % greater than that of the national herd', so a smallholder herd should expect less.
isixhosa_draft: Itheyibhile 1 ('Ukuthelekisa inani leenkomo, imveliso nokuzala kwiindidi ezikhulu zobisi eMzantsi Afrika'), ikholam yobisi, imiqolo ye-Grade: iJersey 3840 kg kunye ne-Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg ngexesha ngalinye lokuvelisa ubisi (imiqolo ye-Registered: 4468 kunye ne-6426 kg). Uxwebhu lusithi le yimihlambi ye-National Milk Recording Scheme, 'eboniswe ukuba iphathwa kakuhle kunaleyo engaphandle kwenkqubo, kunye nokusebenza kwayo ngexesha ngalinye lokuvelisa ubisi kuphezulu nge-50 % kunomhlambi wesizwe', ngoko umhlambi womfama omncinci kufuneka ulindele ngaphantsi.

english: Table 1, AFC column, rows in the table's order Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, Jersey Reg./Grade, Ayrshire Reg./Grade: 28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32 months. The Grade rows used here are Holstein-Friesland 30 and Jersey 28 (Grade Ayrshire 32 is not used: the enterprise is Jersey or Holstein type). 28 x 4.35 = 121.8 weeks; 30 x 4.35 = 130.5 weeks. Milk begins at first calving, so age at first calving is the time to first product.
isixhosa_draft: Itheyibhile 1, ikholam ye-AFC, imiqolo ngokulandelelana kwetheyibhile i-Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, i-Jersey Reg./Grade, i-Ayrshire Reg./Grade: iinyanga ezingama-28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32. Imiqolo ye-Grade esetyenziswe apha yi-Holstein-Friesland 30 kunye ne-Jersey 28 (i-Grade Ayrshire 32 ayisetyenziswanga: ishishini yi-Jersey okanye uhlobo lwe-Holstein). 28 x 4.35 = iiveki ezili-121.8; 30 x 4.35 = iiveki ezili-130.5. Ubisi luqala ekuzaleni kokuqala, ngoko ubudala xa izala okokuqala yixesha lokufumana imveliso yokuqala.

english: Holstein 739.33 and Jersey 696.81 days of productive life (first calving to culling) in South African milk-recorded herds, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = 1.91 and 739.33/365.25 = 2.02 years.
isixhosa_draft: I-Holstein 739.33 kunye ne-Jersey 696.81 iintsuku zobomi bemveliso (ukuzala kokuqala ukuya ekuhlinzweni) kwimihlambi yaseMzantsi Afrika ebhalwe ubisi, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = iminyaka eyi-1.91 kunye ne-739.33/365.25 = iminyaka eyi-2.02.

english: Dry-matter (DM) intake for lactating dairy cows: Jersey 14-16 kg DM/day, Holstein 24-28 kg DM/day. Full span across both breeds used here (14 to 28 kg/day) since the enterprise covers Jersey, Holstein or crossbred cows generically.
isixhosa_draft: Ukutya okomileyo (DM) okudliwayo kweenkomo zobisi ezivelisa ubisi: iJersey 14-16 kg DM/ngosuku, i-Holstein 24-28 kg DM/ngosuku. Uluhlu olupheleleyo kwiindidi zombini olusetyenziswe apha (14 ukuya kuma-28 kg/ngosuku) kuba ishishini liquka iinkomo ze-Jersey, i-Holstein okanye ezixubileyo ngokubanzi.

english: Table 21.1 gives water intake for a lactating Holstein-type cow under comfortable versus hot conditions: 58 L/day (comfortable) to 75 L/day (hot). Used as the general lactating-cow range; not broken out by breed since the table's other columns are for comfort/heat-stress states rather than breed.
isixhosa_draft: Itheyibhile 21.1 inika amanzi adliwa yinkomo yohlobo lwe-Holstein evelisa ubisi phantsi kweemeko zokuthamba nezishushu: 58 L/ngosuku (ukuthamba) ukuya kuma-75 L/ngosuku (ubushushu). Isetyenziswe njengoluhlu jikelele lwenkomo evelisa ubisi; ayahlulwanga ngohlobo kuba ezinye iikholam zetheyibhile zeemeko zokuthamba/uxinzelelo lobushushu hayi uhlobo.

english: National commercial broiler industry average, South Africa, 2022. A separate breed-trial table (Table 4b, same document, p.39) gives named-strain 'Cumulative FI (kg)' and 'Body weight (kg)' at exactly 35 days: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (cumulative feed intake 3.21-3.64kg) - a slightly older age (35 vs 32-33 days) and higher weight than the industry-wide average quoted above; not merged into the primary figure since it is a different (breed-standard trial) dataset, but used below for the feed-intake figure.
isixhosa_draft: Umlinganiselo weshishini lorhwebo lwe-broiler lesizwe, eMzantsi Afrika, 2022. Itheyibhile eyahlukileyo yovavanyo lohlobo (Itheyibhile 4b, uxwebhu olufanayo, iphe. 39) inika 'Cumulative FI (kg)' kunye 'Body weight (kg)' zeentlobo ezibizwa ngamagama kwiintsuku ezingama-35 ngqo: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (ukutya okudliwe ngokudibeneyo 3.21-3.64kg) - ubudala obukhulu kancinci (35 vs 32-33 iintsuku) kunye nobunzima obuphezulu kunomlinganiselo weshishini lonke ocatshulwe ngasentla; ayidibaniswanga kwinani eliphambili kuba yidathasethi eyahlukileyo (uvavanyo lomgangatho wohlobo), kodwa isetyenziswe ngezantsi kwinani lokutya okudliwayo.

english: 32 days / 7 = 4.57 weeks; 33 days / 7 = 4.71 weeks. This enterprise has a single grow-out cycle ending in slaughter, so 'time to first product' = age at slaughter. South Africa, commercial industry average.
isixhosa_draft: 32 iintsuku / 7 = iiveki ezi-4.57; 33 iintsuku / 7 = iiveki ezi-4.71. Eli shishini linomjikelo omnye wokukhula ogqiba ngokuhlinzwa, ngoko 'ixesha lemveliso yokuqala' = ubudala ekuhlinzweni. EMzantsi Afrika, umlinganiselo weshishini lorhwebo.

english: Free-range village chickens, KwaZulu-Natal; dry-environment birds started laying earlier (15.74 weeks) than wet-environment birds (27.78 weeks), difference flagged significant ('*') in the source table. Wide range reflects genuine dry/wet-season environmental variation reported by the source, not measurement uncertainty.
isixhosa_draft: Iinkukhu zasezilalini ezikhululekileyo, KwaZulu-Natal; iintaka zendawo eyomileyo zaqala ukubeka kwangaphambili (iiveki ezili-15.74) kunezendawo emanzi (iiveki ezingama-27.78), umahluko uphawulwe njengobalulekileyo ('*') kwitheyibhile yomthombo. Uluhlu olubanzi lubonisa umahluko wokwenyani wemeko yexesha elomileyo/elimanzi obikwe ngumthombo, hayi ukungaqiniseki kokulinganisa.

english: Table 4a's cumulative 'Eggs/hen housed' for five commercial strains; the same table gives 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' for every strain. Commercial barn/cage average, not a free-range smallholder trial. Kept as the source gives it: a per-year rate would need a point-of-lay age from another document.
isixhosa_draft: 'Amaqanda/isikhukhukazi esigcinwe endlwini' esidibeneyo setheyibhile 4a kwiintlobo ezintlanu zorhwebo; itheyibhile efanayo inika 'Ubudala ekupheleni kweeveki 90.0' kuhlobo ngalunye. Umlinganiselo wendlu/wekheji yorhwebo, hayi uvavanyo lomfama omncinci okhululekileyo. Igcinwe njengoko umthombo uyinika: izinga lonyaka lifuna ubudala bokubeka obuvela kwenye incwadi.

english: Commercial layer reference: bird age from hatch, not weeks after buying point-of-lay pullets or building housing. Supplier strain, rearing and actual onset can differ. The former 16–17 week figure was the SAPA receiving/housing age, not evidence of first eggs.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sorhwebo sezikhukhukazi ezibeka amaqanda: ubudala beentaka ukususela ekuqanyelweni, hayi iiveki emva kokuthenga ii-pullet ezikulungele ukubeka okanye ukwakha indawo yokuhlala. Uhlobo lomthengisi, ukukhula nokuqala kokwenyani kunokwahluka. Inani langaphambili leeveki ezili-16–17 yayiyiminyaka ye-SAPA yokwamkela/yokubeka endlwini, hayi ubungqina beqanda lokuqala.

english: Source states water intake is twice the WEIGHT of feed consumed, and gives water as approximately 220 ml/day. Feed weight = 220 ml (treated as 220 g, water density) / 2 = 110 g/day = 0.11 kg/day. Cross-check: SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Table 4a (p.39) gives cumulative 'Feed intake kg' of 53.5-58.1 kg per hen over the ~73-74 week laying period (511-518 days): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/day to 58100/518 = 112.2 g/day, i.e. approximately 0.105-0.112 kg/day - consistent with the 0.11 kg/day figure used here. Commercial system, South Africa.
isixhosa_draft: Umthombo uthi amanzi adliwayo asemlinganisweni wokubini wobunzima bokutya okudliwayo, kwaye unika amanzi malunga ne-220 ml/ngosuku. Ubunzima bokutya = 220 ml (kuthathwa njengama-220 g, ukuxinana kwamanzi) / 2 = 110 g/ngosuku = 0.11 kg/ngosuku. Ukuhlolwa okunqamlezileyo: i-SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Itheyibhile 4a (iphe. 39) inika 'Feed intake kg' edibeneyo ye-53.5-58.1 kg kwisikhukhukazi ngasinye kwixesha lokubeka elilingana neeveki ezingama-73-74 (iintsuku ezingama-511-518): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/ngosuku ukuya ku-58100/518 = 112.2 g/ngosuku, oko kukuthi malunga ne-0.105-0.112 kg/ngosuku - kuyahambelana nenani le-0.11 kg/ngosuku elisetyenziswe apha. Inkqubo yorhwebo, eMzantsi Afrika.

english: 220 ml/day = 0.22 L/day. Commercial system, South Africa.
isixhosa_draft: 220 ml/ngosuku = 0.22 L/ngosuku. Inkqubo yorhwebo, eMzantsi Afrika.

english: Indoor/house floor space in a Free Range or Barn system with perches: 12 birds/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/bird. The same Code's external range limit is much larger (5 birds/m2 = 0.2 m2/bird outdoors, see welfare) - not mixed into this indoor figure, per the instruction not to combine different systems. A separate cage-system table in the same document (Table 3.1) gives a different, more confined figure for battery cages, also not used here since this enterprise is framed as free-range/barn. South Africa.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yomgangatho wangaphakathi/wendlu kwinkqubo ye-Free Range okanye i-Barn enezindlu zokuphumla: iintaka ezi-12/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/intaka. Umda wangaphandle wokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo weKhowudi efanayo mkhulu kakhulu (iintaka ezi-5/m2 = 0.2 m2/intaka ngaphandle, jonga unakekelo lwezilwanyana) - ayixutywanga kweli nani langaphakathi, ngokomyalelo wokungadibanisi iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Itheyibhile eyahlukileyo yeenkqubo zekheji kuxwebhu olufanayo (Itheyibhile 3.1) inika inani elahlukileyo, elivaleleke ngakumbi lee-battery cage, nalo alisetyenziswanga apha kuba eli shishini lenziwe njengelokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo/le-barn. EMzantsi Afrika.

english: Non-SA (Guyana study reporting a citation to Steklenev 1990); no SA-specific absolute slaughter live-weight figure was found (see gaps). 2.93 kg = Pekin at 8-10 weeks, 2.29 kg = Muscovy at 8-10 weeks - matches this enterprise's two breeds. The same LRRD paper's own experiment (Table 2, intensive system, Guyana) measured live weight at slaughter (8 weeks) as: Pekin drakes 2.53 kg, Pekin hens 2.29 kg, Muscovy drakes 2.47 kg, Muscovy hens 1.51 kg - broadly consistent with, but not merged into, the cited range above since it is a separate dataset/table in the same source. No sourced eggs/duck/year figure was found for either breed (see gaps); the LRRD and SAJAS sources used here studied ducks reared only for meat.
isixhosa_draft: Hayi eyaseMzantsi Afrika (uphando lwaseGuyana olubika ucaphulo luka-Steklenev 1990); akukho nani leMzantsi Afrika lobunzima obuphilayo xa ihlatywa elafunyanwa (jonga izikhewu). 2.93 kg = Pekin kwiiveki ezi-8-10, 2.29 kg = Muscovy kwiiveki ezi-8-10 - kuhambelana neendidi ezimbini zeli shishini. Uvavanyo lwephepha le-LRRD ngokwalo (Itheyibhile 2, inkqubo enzulu, iGuyana) lwalinganisa ubunzima obuphilayo ekuhlinzweni (iiveki ezi-8) njengo: iidada zeduna ze-Pekin 2.53 kg, iimazi ze-Pekin 2.29 kg, iidada zeduna ze-Muscovy 2.47 kg, iimazi ze-Muscovy 1.51 kg - ngokubanzi ziyahambelana, kodwa azidityaniswanga, noluhlu olucatshulwe ngasentla kuba yidathasethi/itheyibhile eyahlukileyo kumthombo ofanayo. Akukho nani lamaqanda/idada/ngonyaka lafunyanwa kuzo zombini iindidi (jonga izikhewu); imithombo ye-LRRD ne-SAJAS esetyenziswe apha yafunda iidada ezikhuliswe inyama kuphela.

english: P44 = Pekin (7 weeks to slaughter); MR71 = Muscovy (10 weeks for ducks/hens, 12 weeks for drakes). Treated as 'time to first product' = age to slaughter, since this is a single-cycle meat enterprise (no repeat product like eggs). Non-South-African trial by Warsaw researchers, published in SAJAS; journal location does not establish local applicability.
isixhosa_draft: P44 = Pekin (iiveki ezisi-7 ukuya ekuhlinzweni); MR71 = Muscovy (iiveki eziyi-10 kwiidada/iimazi, iiveki eziyi-12 kwiidada zeduna). Kuthathwa 'ixesha lemveliso yokuqala' = ubudala ekuhlinzweni, kuba lishishini lenyama lomjikelo omnye (akukho mveliso iphindaphindayo njengamaqanda). Uvavanyo olungelolwaseMzantsi Afrika lwabaphandi baseWarsaw, olupapashwe kwi-SAJAS; indawo yejenali ayimisi ukusebenza kwasekuhlaleni.

english: 0.08 bird/m2 (outdoor/free-range system) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/bird - used here as the primary figure since smallholder/backyard duck-keeping is closer to this free-range system than to intensive deep-litter housing. The same source's INTENSIVE deep-litter system gives 2.9 bird/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/bird (a very different, much more confined figure) - noted here for context but NOT merged into the range above, per the instruction not to mix figures from different systems. Non-South-African trial by Warsaw researchers, published in SAJAS; journal location does not establish local applicability.
isixhosa_draft: 0.08 intaka/m2 (inkqubo yangaphandle/yokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/intaka - isetyenziswe apha njengenani eliphambili kuba ukufuya iidada kwabalimi abancinci/segadini kusondele kule nkqubo ikhululekileyo kunendlu enzulu ye-deep-litter. Inkqubo ye-INTENSIVE deep-litter yomthombo ofanayo inika iintaka ezi-2.9/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/intaka (inani elahlukileyo kakhulu, elivaleleke ngakumbi) - liphawulwe apha ukuze kubekho imvelaphi kodwa alidityaniswanga noluhlu olungasentla, ngokomyalelo wokungaxuxi amanani avela kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Uvavanyo olungelolwaseMzantsi Afrika lwabaphandi baseWarsaw, olupapashwe kwi-SAJAS; indawo yejenali ayimisi ukusebenza kwasekuhlaleni.

english: 10 months x 4.35 = 43.5 weeks; 12 months x 4.35 = 52.2 weeks. This is Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) grow-out time to harvestable size; the source separately states Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) reaches harvestable maturity faster, in 6-10 months (= 26.1-43.5 weeks) — not used here as it is a different species with a different legal status (see 'legal').
isixhosa_draft: Iinyanga eziyi-10 x 4.35 = iiveki ezingama-43.5; iinyanga eziyi-12 x 4.35 = iiveki ezingama-52.2. Eli lixesha lokukhula kwe-Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) ukuya kubukhulu obunokuvunwa; umthombo uthi ngokwahlukileyo i-Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) ifikelela kubudala obunokuvunwa ngokukhawuleza, kwiinyanga ezi-6-10 (= iiveki ezingama-26.1-43.5) — ayisetyenziswanga apha kuba yindidi eyahlukileyo enemeko yomthetho eyahlukileyo (jonga 'legal').

english: Lowest (≥7th parity) and highest (3rd parity) group means for milk yield per 305-day standardised lactation in 16,407 analysed South African ARC Saanen lactation records, 1955–2018, mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Original PDF Table 3 labels the last group ≥7th; HTML renders it >7th. Kept in kg, without litres conversion, annualisation or yield-by-age interpolation.
isixhosa_draft: Intsingiselo esezantsi (≥7th parity) neyona iphezulu (3rd parity) yamaqela kwisivuno sobisi ngexesha ngalinye lokuvelisa ubisi elimiselweyo leentsuku ezingama-305 kwiirekhodi zokuvelisa ubisi zeSaanen ze-ARC zaseMzantsi Afrika ezingama-16,407 ezihlalutyiweyo, 1955–2018, ikakhulu imihlambi ye-stud enzulu/ephakathi nenzulu. I-PDF yoqobo Itheyibhile 3 ibiza iqela lokugqibela ≥7th; i-HTML ikubonisa >7th. Igcinwe nge-kg, ngaphandle kokuguqulwa ibe ngamalitha, ukuguqulwa ibe ngonyaka okanye ukubala phakathi kwesivuno ngokobudala.

english: This is age at first KIDDING (birth of first kids), not first weaned kids. 16 months x 4.35 = 69.6 weeks; 18 months x 4.35 = 78.3 weeks, from doe birth to her giving birth for the first time. Adding the source's own ~150-day (~5-month, ~21.75-week) weaning assumption would put first WEANED kids at roughly 91-100 weeks of doe age, but that compound figure is not shown as the primary value since the field is documented as 'age/time from start (hatch, birth) to first product' and first kidding is the clearer, directly-stated milestone; the weaning offset is noted here for transparency.
isixhosa_draft: Obu bubudala xa izala amathole okokuqala (ukuzalwa kwamathole okuqala), hayi amathole okuqala ayekisiweyo ebeleni. Iinyanga ezili-16 x 4.35 = iiveki ezingama-69.6; iinyanga ezili-18 x 4.35 = iiveki ezingama-78.3, ukusuka ekuzalweni kwemazi ukuya xa izala okokuqala. Ukongeza ukucinga komthombo ngokwawo kweentsuku ezili-150 (~iinyanga ezi-5, ~iiveki ezingama-21.75) zokuyekisa ebeleni kuya kubeka amathole okuqala ayekisiweyo ebeleni malunga neeveki ezingama-91-100 zobudala bemazi, kodwa eli nani lidityanisiweyo alibonakaliswa njengexabiso eliphambili kuba intsimi ibhaliwe njengo 'budala/ixesha ukusuka ekuqaleni (ukuqanyelwa, ukuzalwa) ukuya kwimveliso yokuqala' kwaye ukuzala kokuqala yinto ecacileyo, ebekwe ngqo; ukungena kokuyekiswa ebeleni kuphawulwe apha ukuze kubekho ukuvuleka.

english: The reported weaning rate is 149%, or 1.49 kids weaned per doe mated. The source describes observations over twenty years for extensive Boer does at 295 mm rainfall; it does not state kids weaned per doe per calendar year. This is a reproductive outcome, not kg of live animals or dressed meat. A separate mean litter size of 1.93 kids born per parturition has a different denominator and stage and is not merged into this figure.
isixhosa_draft: Izinga elibikiweyo lokuyekiswa ebeleni li-149%, okanye amathole ayi-1.49 ayekisiweyo ebeleni kwimazi nganye ekhwelisiweyo. Umthombo uchaza ukubonwa kweminyaka engamashumi amabini kwiimazi zeBoer ezikwindawo ebanzi kwimvula engama-295 mm; awuchazi amathole ayekisiweyo ebeleni kwimazi nganye ngonyaka wekhalenda. Esi sisiphumo sokwenzalana, hayi ii-kg zezilwanyana eziphilayo okanye zenyama ehlutshiweyo. Umlinganiselo ohlukileyo wobungakanani bezalo (amathole ayi-1.93 azalwe ekuzaleni ngalinye) unomdivisi ohlukileyo kwaye inqanaba elahlukileyo kwaye alidityaniswanga kweli nani.

english: Table 1 gives separate ranges by physiological class of the same animal (sow): pregnant sows 10-18 L/day and lactating sows 18-23 L/day. Combined here into a single sow-herd range [10,23] spanning both states, rather than mixing in the table's other classes (nursery, grower, finishing pigs, boars), which are a different animalUnit. South Africa (general smallholder/commercial training-manual figure, not tied to one system).
isixhosa_draft: Itheyibhile 1 inika uluhlu olwahlukeneyo ngekhlasi yomzimba yesilwanyana esifanayo (imazi yehagu): iimazi zehagu ezikhulelweyo ezili-10-18 L/ngosuku kunye neemazi ezivelisa ubisi ezili-18-23 L/ngosuku. Zidityaniswe apha zibe luhlu olunye lomhlambi wemazi [10,23] oluqukayo zombini iimeko, kunokuba kuxutywe amanye amakhlasi etheyibhile (ihagu zenkulisa, abakhuli, abagqibezelayo, iinkunzi), ezilunye i-animalUnit. EMzantsi Afrika (inani lencwadana yoqeqesho jikelele lomfama omncinci/lorhwebo, elingabotshelelwanga kwinkqubo enye).

english: FAO general backyard target, not a South African observed rate. The 30–35 young per doe annually have reached slaughter or reproduction age after allowance for post-weaning loss; they are not merely weaned and are not kg of meat. The source models six litters and 5.5 surviving young per litter, describing a 30-rabbit objective; an extra litter raises its stated objective to 35. Do not combine this backyard target with grower-house carcass weight from a different trial.
isixhosa_draft: Injongo jikelele ye-FAO yasegadini, hayi izinga elibonwe eMzantsi Afrika. Amathole angama-30–35 kwimazi nganye ngonyaka afikelele kubudala bokuhlatywa okanye bokwenzalana emva kokuvumela ukulahleka emva kokuyekiswa ebeleni; awayekiswanga ebeleni nje kuphela kwaye awayi-kg zenyama. Umthombo wenza imodeli yeenzala ezintandathu kunye namathole asindayo ayi-5.5 kuzala ngalunye, echaza injongo yemivundla engama-30; inzala eyongezelelekileyo inyusa injongo echaziweyo ibe ngama-35. Musa ukudibanisa le njongo yasegadini nobunzima besidumbu sendlu yabakhuli kuvavanyo olwahlukileyo.

english: 279 days / 365 = 0.76 years. This figure is from French INTENSIVE commercial rabbitries (average of 1992 national recording-scheme data), NOT backyard/extensive hutches - the source gives no separate productive-life figure for backyard systems (see gaps). Treat as a lower-bound / industrial-system reference only.
isixhosa_draft: Iintsuku ezingama-279 / 365 = iminyaka eyi-0.76. Eli nani lisuka kwiindawo zorhwebo zemivundla ye-INTENSIVE yaseFrance (umlinganiselo wedatha yenkqubo yesizwe yokurekhoda ka-1992), HAYI ii-hutch zasegadini/zokudlala ngokubanzi - umthombo awunikezeli nani elahlukileyo lobomi bemveliso kwiinkqubo zasegadini (jonga izikhewu). Lithathe njengesalathiso somda ophantsi / senkqubo yemizi-mveliso kuphela.

english: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 to 0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, indoor/hutch cage per single breeding adult (one buck or doe per cage), 50-60 cm high. FAO (general, not SA-specific). A separate FAO table (p.174, Fort & Martin 1981) gives a doe's cage as 65-70 cm (front) x 50 cm (depth) = 0.325-0.35 m2 and a buck's cage as 40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - a narrower alternative figure from the same book, not merged into the range above to avoid mixing two different tabulated sources.
isixhosa_draft: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 ukuya ku-0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, ikheji ye-indoor/hutch kwisilwanyana esinye esikhulile sokwenzalana (iduna elinye okanye imazi enye ikheji nganye), ukuphakama kwe-50-60 cm. I-FAO (jikelele, hayi eyaseMzantsi Afrika). Itheyibhile eyahlukileyo ye-FAO (iphe. 174, Fort & Martin 1981) inika ikheji yemazi njengama-65-70 cm (phambili) x 50 cm (ubunzulu) = 0.325-0.35 m2 kunye nekheji yeduna njengama-40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - inani elincinci elikhethiweyo elivela kwincwadi enye, elingadityaniswanga noluhlu olungasentla ukuphepha ukuxuba imithombo emibini eyahlukileyo yeethebhile.

english: outputUnit is 'lambs born/ewe/year' rather than the suggested 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' or 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': the source explains 'Measuring accurate lambing percentages for smallholder sheep farmers is challenging as these farmers mostly farm extensively and do not keep records', and instead calculates 'Lambs born per ewe (as recorded from the surveys based on interviews with individual respondents)' - a lambing (born), not weaning, figure, self-reported by smallholder farmers rather than measured/weighed. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 lambs born/ewe/year; the range [0.61, 1.39] spans the three Western Cape smallholder districts surveyed (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), all from this one study/quote - not merged with any other document. The same paper separately states a COMMERCIAL extensive benchmark of 110-156% lambing and 94-132% weaning (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), explicitly 'expressed over ewes joined' (a different denominator/system) - not merged into this smallholder range.

english: CONVERTED, arithmetic shown: took the 'Average' yield band (15-18 t/ha) and the same source's stated spacing ('Generally planted 6m x 4m or 5 m x 3 m'). At 6x4m = 24 m²/tree → 10000/24 = 416.7 trees/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 and 18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/tree. At 5x3m = 15 m²/tree → 666.7 trees/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 and 18000/666.7=27.0 kg/tree. Combined range across both spacings, rounded: [23, 43] kg/tree. This spread reflects the two different sourced spacings, not cultivar variation.
isixhosa_draft: KUTSHINTSHIWE, ubalo luboniswe: kwathathwa ibhendi yesivuno 'Umndilili' (15-18 t/ha) kunye nesithuba esichazwe ngumthombo omnye (‘Kuqhelekile ukutyalwa 6m x 4m okanye 5 m x 3 m’). Kwi-6x4m = 24 m²/umthi → 10000/24 = 416.7 yemithi/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 kunye ne-18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/umthi. Kwi-5x3m = 15 m²/umthi → 666.7 yemithi/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 kunye ne-18000/666.7=27.0 kg/umthi. Uluhlu oluhlanganisiweyo kuzo zombini izithuba, lujikelezisiwe: [23, 43] kg/umthi. Olu hlahlo luboniswa zizithuba ezibini ezahlukeneyo ezivela kumthombo, hayi ukwahluka kweendidi.

english: Calculated orchard-average equivalent using the KZN guide's likely production of 50 t/ha and midpoint planting spacings: cool KZN Midlands, 5.75 x 2.75 m, about 79 kg/tree; hot areas, 7.5 x 3.5 m, about 131 kg/tree. english: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
isixhosa_draft: I-Hass kwi-Duke 7, ekuqaleni imithi eyi-200/ha eBruyns Hill (iqela lemozulu yendalo lesi-2 laseNatal Midlands), kunye nokunkcenkceshela nokondla okunzulu. Iminyaka emi-3: 10,000 kg/ha; iminyaka emi-6: 20,000 kg/ha; umndilili oqhubekayo malunga ne-22,500 kg/ha. Ubuninzi bophando olufanayo bugunyaza ezilinganayo ne-50 kg/umthi kwiminyaka emi-3 kunye ne-100 kg/umthi kwiminyaka emi-6; akukho sisalathiso kuyo yonke iminyaka ephakathi. Ezi zalathiso zesitiya ziphantsi kwezixhobo ezilungileyo, imozulu efanayo nolawulo lwesitiya ngexesha, kubandakanya ulawulo lwe-Phytophthora nokucutha; ungazifaki ngokuzenzekelayo amanani efama.

english: Hex River/Wolseley trial reference; confirm cultivar, chilling and acidic soil.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sovavanyo lweHex River/Wolseley; qinisekisa indidi, ukubanda nomhlaba onomuncu.

english: Historical processed fat, not a fresh-fruit forecast
isixhosa_draft: Amafutha asetyenzisiweyo akudala, hayi uqikelelo lweziqhamo ezitsha

english: Hluhluwe production-cycle reference: 18 months / 12 = 1.5 years. The source explicitly says cycle length varies greatly. Starting material, cultivar, weather and flower initiation matter; this is neither a universal first-harvest date nor a 12-month annual yield.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso somjikelo wemveliso eHluhluwe: iinyanga ezili-18 / 12 = iminyaka e-1.5. Umthombo uthi ngokucacileyo ubude bomjikelo buyahluka kakhulu. Izinto zokuqala, indidi, imozulu nokuqalwa kweentyatyambo kubalulekile; oku akusosiqinisekiso somhla wokuvuna kokuqala kuyo yonke indawo okanye isivuno sonyaka seenyanga ezili-12.

english: ICRAF reports 200–1,500 kg of whole fruit collected from a single wild tree in one season (0.2–1.5 tonnes x 1,000). This seasonal collection range does not establish an orchard average, edible pulp or kernel weight, or a production-by-age forecast.
isixhosa_draft: I-ICRAF ixela ii-kg ezingama-200–1,500 zeziqhamo ezipheleleyo ezaqokelelwa kumthi omnye wasendle ngexesha elinye (0.2–1.5 yeetoni x 1,000). Olu luhlu lokuqokelela lwexesha alubonisi umndilili wesitiya, ubunzima bepulpu etyiwayo okanye bekernel, okanye uqikelelo lwemveliso ngobudala.

english: ICRAF's international species reference reports maximum production of 50–70 kg/plant at about 7 years under good management; at age 5 it reports 30–40 kg/plant. These are not South Africa-specific farm forecasts. Match plant age, cultivar, site and care before applying this reference.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sezizwe ngezizwe seentlobo se-ICRAF sixela ubuninzi bemveliso obungu-50–70 kg/isityalo kwiminyaka emi-7 malunga phantsi kolawulo olulungileyo; kubudala obuyi-5 kuxela ii-30–40 kg/isityalo. Ezi azizizo iziqikelelo zefama ezithile zoMzantsi Afrika. Hambelanisa ubudala besityalo, indidi, indawo nenkathalo phambi kokusebenzisa esi sisalathiso.

english: In this irrigated, intensively managed Natal Midlands trial, Hass reached about 20 t/ha at age 6 and orchards approached maximum sustainable average yield by age 8. This is a trial-specific bearing reference; there is no national plateau or automatically interpolated age-yield curve.
isixhosa_draft: Kolu vavanyo lwe-Natal Midlands olunkcenkceshelwayo, olulawulwa kakhulu, i-Hass yafikelela malunga ne-20 t/ha kwiminyaka emi-6 kwaye izitiya zasondela kwisivuno somndilili omkhulu oqhubekayo kwiminyaka emi-8. Esi sisalathiso sokuthwala sovavanyo oluthile; akukho sikhundla sikazwelonke okanye ijika lesivuno ngobudala elizalelwa ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: Institutional management reference links dry roots to early fruit drop. It contains a non-local 15-year substantial-bearing statement; that is not a South African first-crop age and is not used as a forecast.

Ixesha lesityalo esivela embewini kumthombo libhekisele ekuqhakazeni, ngoko akukho budala bokuqala beziqhamo ezivela embewini obabelweyo. Oku akuqinisekisiwe kwiindawo zoMzantsi Afrika.

english: Irrigated production reference; confirm cultivar, pollination, summer heat and water capacity.
