isixhosa_draft: Fumana izinto ezinelebheli ze-Basella alba. Indidi yengingqi yoMzantsi Afrika, umlinganiselo we-kg/isityalo nefestile yokuvuna enemihla zisahlala ziqinisekisiwe.

english: Optimal from-seed cutting-cycle reference — Florida extension
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso somjikelo wokusika wokuqala embewini ogqwesileyo — ulwandiso lwaseFlorida

english: Pecan guide output — dry nut-in-shell hectare basis
isixhosa_draft: Imveliso yesikhokelo se-pecan — isiseko sehektare yamandongomane omileyo asebusweni

english: Pick at the intended green, black or oil stage. Processing and safe kept-stock conditions must be recorded separately.
isixhosa_draft: Vuna kwisigaba esijoliswe kuso esiluhlaza, esimnyama okanye seoli. Ukusetyenzwa neemeko ezikhuselekileyo zesitokhwe esigcinwayo kufuneka zibhalwe ngokwahlukileyo.

english: Pick ripe fruit and record drying separately.
isixhosa_draft: Vuna iziqhamo ezivuthiweyo kwaye ubhale ukomiswa ngokwahlukileyo.

english: Pineapple fruit; whole fruit and processed portions have different weights
isixhosa_draft: Isiqhamo se-pineapple; isiqhamo esipheleleyo neenxalenye ezisetyenzisiweyo zinobunzima obahlukeneyo

english: Plan around actual calving/kidding and lactation. Dry animals do not supply milk.
isixhosa_draft: Cwangcisa ngokubeleka kwenkomo/kwebhokhwe kwangempela nokukhupha ubisi. Izilwanyana ezomileyo aziniki bisi.

english: Plan balanced feed, clean water, shade, ventilation and predator protection. Egg supply depends on laying birds, their age, health and care; a coop alone supplies no eggs.
isixhosa_draft: Cwangcisa ukutya okulinganisiweyo, amanzi acocekileyo, umthunzi, umoya nokukhuselwa kwizilwanyana ezidlayo. Ukubakho kwamaqanda kuxhomekeke kwiintaka ezibekayo, ubudala bazo, impilo nenkathalo; indlu yeenkukhu yodwa ayinikezi maqanda.

english: Planning choice for warm sites: Sunrise Solo. Confirm plant sex/form with the nursery.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhetho lokucwangcisa kwiindawo ezishushu: Sunrise Solo. Qinisekisa isini/uhlobo lwesityalo kunye nenethsari.

english: Pod development, not a young green-pod picking calendar
isixhosa_draft: Ukukhula kwe-pod, hayi ikhalenda yokuvuna ama-pod aluhlaza amatsha

english: Pollination depends on the selected cultivar. Compatible flowering and pollen sources are separate from early or late fruit ripening.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuthwalwa komungu wentyatyambo kuxhomekeke kwindidi ekhethiweyo. Ukuqhakaza nemithombo yomungu wentyatyambo ehambelanayo ihlukile ekuvuthweni kweziqhamo kwangoko okanye kamva.

english: Pollination: {kind}. Check the chosen cultivar's requirements with the nursery.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuthwalwa komungu wentyatyambo: {kind}. Hlola iimfuno zendidi ekhethiweyo kunye nenethsari.

english: Portuguese quince has a source-backed Robertson orchard reference. Ask for a fruiting quince cultivar: quince names used as pear rootstocks are not a fruit-harvest recommendation.
isixhosa_draft: I-Portuguese quince inesalathiso sesitiya saseRobertson esixhaswa ngumthombo. Cela indidi ye-quince eqhamayo: amagama e-quince asetyenziswa njengeengcambu zepere asilosincomo sokuvuna iziqhamo.

english: Potchefstroom 2020/21, good rainfall season: ICEAP01258 versus ICEAP01284 and 22 October versus 25 November sowing. ARC tentatively favours ICEAP01284 in late October and calls for further agro-ecological trials. Exact yield values were not taken from graph bars. Confirm current seed availability; this is not a national cultivar recommendation.
isixhosa_draft: IPotchefstroom 2020/21, ixesha lemvula elilungileyo: ICEAP01258 ngokuchasene ne-ICEAP01284 nokuhlwayela ngomhla we-22 Okthobha ngokuchasene ne-25 Novemba. I-ARC ithanda ngokwexeshana i-ICEAP01284 ekupheleni kuka-Okthobha kwaye icela uvavanyo olongezelelweyo lwe-agro-ecological. Amaxabiso achanekileyo esivuno awathathwanga kwiibhari zegrafu. Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kwembewu yangoku; esi asisosincomo sendidi sikazwelonke.

english: Primary Brazilian germplasm experiment found both compatibility classes. Biological evidence supports checking the actual cultivar and compatible pollen, not assigning one universal species category or copying its calendar to South Africa.
isixhosa_draft: Uvavanyo oluphambili lwe-germplasm yaseBrazil lufumene iindidi zombini zokuhambelana. Ubungqina bebhayoloji busixhasa ekuhloleni indidi yokwenyani nomungu wentyatyambo ohambelanayo, hayi ukunikezela udidi olunye jikelele lodidi okanye ukukopa ikhalenda yalo eMzantsi Afrika.

english: Prince Albert establishment and maturity expectation
Protect young plants from heavy browsing. SANBI reports warm rocky and semi-arid habitats; ground-level goat browsing can prevent vegetative spread and reduce regeneration.
isixhosa_draft: Khusela izityalo ezincinci ekutyiweni kakhulu. I-SANBI ixela iindawo ezishushu ezinamatye nezingaphelelanga zomileyo; ukutyiwa kwebhokhwe emhlabeni kunokuthintela ukusasazeka kwezityalo kwaye kunciphise ukuvuselela.

english: Provide a trellis or other support. Young plants need water until established; SANBI describes later drought tolerance and sun to semi-shade use.
isixhosa_draft: Nika i-trellis okanye enye inkxaso. Izityalo ezincinci zidinga amanzi de zisekwe; i-SANBI ichaza ukunyamezela imbalela kamva nokusetyenziswa elangeni ukuya emthunzini ongaphelelanga.

english: Provide climbing support and adequate moisture in a warm growing position.
isixhosa_draft: Nika inkxaso yokunyuka namanzi anele kwindawo yokukhula eshushu.

english: Purple granadilla is the KZN fresh-fruit reference; yellow forms are more acidic and used for juice. Confirm stock health and local season.
isixhosa_draft: I-Purple granadilla sisalathiso seziqhamo ezitsha se-KZN; iindidi ezityheli zinomuncu ngakumbi kwaye zisetyenziselwa ijusi. Qinisekisa impilo yesitokhwe nexesha lasekuhlaleni.

english: Qualitative ideal-condition establishment duration; it is not inserted into a generic tree-age curve.
isixhosa_draft: Ixesha elikumgangatho wemeko efanelekileyo yokuqala ngokomgangatho; alifakwanga kwijika jikelele lobudala bomthi.

english: Queen and Smooth Cayenne serve different uses. The guide's example fruit weights (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) are cultivar descriptions, not annual yields per plant. Queen is re-established after the plant crop in this system.
isixhosa_draft: I-Queen ne-Smooth Cayenne zinezinjongo ezahlukeneyo. Ubunzima beziqhamo bomzekelo wesikhokelo (Queen 0.75 kg; Smooth Cayenne 2 kg) ziingcaciso zeendidi, hayi izivuno zonyaka zesityalo ngasinye. I-Queen iphinda isekwe emva kwesityalo somhlaba kule nkqubo.

english: Record coffee-cherry picking separately from drying, hulling and roasting. Do not use roasted packet stock months as the fresh harvest calendar.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuvunwa kweecherry zekofi ngokwahlukileyo kwiqulathe lokomisa, ukususa amaxolo nokosa. Ungasebenzisi iinyanga zesitokhwe sepakethi eyosiweyo njengekhalenda yokuvuna okutsha.

english: Record edible flowers/buds and pond area. Dormant tubers resume growth as autumn water returns in the winter-rainfall cycle.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala iintyatyambo/iintyatyambo ezingekavuleki ezityiwayo nendawo yechibi. Iitiyubha ezilele ziqala ukukhula kwakhona xa amanzi ekwindla ebuya kumjikelo wemvula yasebusika.

english: Record edible unopened heads by planting batch; do not use open-flower months as picking months.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala iintloko ezingekavuleki ezityiwayo ngebhetshi lokutyala; ungasebenzisi iinyanga zeentyatyambo ezivulekileyo njengeenyanga zokuvuna.

english: Record fresh leaves, dried seasoning and essential oil as different products.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala amagqabi amatsha, isinongo esomileyo neoli ebalulekileyo njengeemveliso ezahlukeneyo.

english: Record fresh rhizome and dried spice weights separately; keep edible ginger distinct from ornamental or African ginger species.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ubunzima beerhayizomu ezintsha nesinongo esomileyo ngokwahlukileyo; gcina ijinja etyiwayo ihlukile kwiindidi zejinja yokuhombisa okanye yaseAfrika.

english: Record green immature seed and dry grain separately; fodder biomass cannot be counted as household food kg.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala imbewu eluhlaza engekavuthi nenkozo eyomileyo ngokwahlukileyo; ibhayomasi yokutyisa imfuyo ayinakubalwa njengee-kg zokutya kwekhaya.

english: Record local ripe picking dates and output. Foreign cultivar seasons do not establish a South African season.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala imihla yasekuhlaleni yokuvuna ezivuthiweyo nemveliso. Amaxesha eendidi zangaphandle awaqinisekisi ixesha loMzantsi Afrika.

english: Record picking of young flower buds separately from open flowers.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuvunwa kweentyatyambo ezingekavuleki ezincinci ngokwahlukileyo kwiintyatyambo ezivulekileyo.

english: Record planting and actual picking dates. Year-round commercial planting or marketing does not mean every planted pineapple gives fruit in every month.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukutyala nemihla yokwenyani yokuvuna. Ukutyala okanye ukuthengisa kwezorhwebo unyaka wonke akuthethi ukuba zonke iipineapple ezityaliweyo ziqhama kwinyanga nganye.

english: Record planting batches and harvested leaves/fruit separately.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala amabhetshi okutyala namagqabi/iziqhamo ezivuniweyo ngokwahlukileyo.

english: Record successive leaf harvests by planting batch rather than using tree-age production.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuvuna amagqabi alandelelanayo ngebhetshi lokutyala kunokusebenzisa imveliso yobudala bomthi.

english: Record the exact identity and obtain local expert food-use advice before counting it as household food.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuchongwa okuchanekileyo kwaye ufumane isiluleko sengcali sasekuhlaleni sokutya phambi kokuyibala njengokutya kwekhaya.

english: Record the named cultivar and actual first and last picking months. January and February references are alternatives, not a mixed-orchard calendar for every tree.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala indidi ebizwe ngegama neenyanga zokuqala nezokugqibela zokwenyani zokuvuna. Izalathiso zikaJanuwari noFebruwari ziindlela ezinye, hayi ikhalenda yesitiya esixubeneyo kuyo yonke imithi.

english: Record tuber harvest by planting batch and bed area, rather than a generic fruit-tree maturity curve.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuvunwa kweetiyubha ngebhetshi lokutyala nendawo yebhedi, kunokusebenzisa ijika jikelele lokuvuthwa komthi weziqhamo.

english: Record whether nut weights mean kernels or nuts in shell; these are different quantities.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuba ubunzima bamandongomane bubhekisa kwii-kernel okanye kumandongomane asebusweni; ezi ngamanani ahlukeneyo.

english: Record young-bud picking separately from flowering or ornamental growth.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuvunwa kweentyatyambo ezingekavuleki ezincinci ngokwahlukileyo kwintyatyambo okanye ukukhula kokuhombisa.

english: Record young-leaf harvest separately from fruit consumed by wildlife.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala ukuvunwa kwamagqabi amatsha ngokwahlukileyo kwiziqhamo ezityiwa zizilwanyana zasendle.

english: Reference first pick, not the whole harvest duration.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sokuvuna kokuqala, hayi ubude bonke bexesha lokuvuna.

english: Reference first pick; confirm chilling and compatible pollinator.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sokuvuna kokuqala; qinisekisa ukubanda nomthwali womungu wentyatyambo ohambelanayo.

english: Regional guide candidates include Bing, Van, Rainier, Burlat and Vista, which generally need compatible pollen partners. It explicitly lists Lapins, Stella and Sweetheart as self-fertile. Minnie Royal, Royal Lee, Royal Dawn and Early Sweet are lower-chill candidates. Confirm current stock, exact rootstock, compatibility and measured local chilling before purchase; this is not a warm-coast recommendation.
isixhosa_draft: Abagqatswa besikhokelo sengingqi babandakanya i-Bing, i-Van, i-Rainier, i-Burlat ne-Vista, ezidla ngokudinga abalingane bomungu wentyatyambo abahambelanayo. Sidwelisa ngokucacileyo i-Lapins, i-Stella ne-Sweetheart njengezizithwalisayo. I-Minnie Royal, i-Royal Lee, i-Royal Dawn ne-Early Sweet ngabagqatswa bobubanda obuphantsi. Qinisekisa isitokhwe sangoku, ingcambu exhasayo echanekileyo, ukuhambelana nobubanda basekuhlaleni obulinganisiweyo phambi kokuthenga; esi asisosincomo sonxweme olushushu.

english: Regional hectare reference: conservative 50 t/ha, average 60–75 t/ha, good 80 t/ha per production crop. The same page describes a normal 18-month Hluhluwe cycle. These are not kg/plant/year or a forecast for a household planting.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso sehektare yengingqi: ubuncinane obu-50 t/ha, umndilili ongu-60–75 t/ha, ezilungileyo ezingama-80 t/ha ngesityalo ngasinye semveliso. Iphepha elifanayo lichaza umjikelo oqhelekileyo weenyanga ezili-18 eHluhluwe. Ezi azizi-kg/isityalo/unyaka okanye uqikelelo lokutyala kwekhaya.

english: Regional industry season, not a Tommy Atkins-only harvest window.
isixhosa_draft: Ixesha leshishini lengingqi, hayi ifestile yokuvuna ye-Tommy Atkins kuphela.

english: Regional nut-in-shell season; individual cultivar maturity still needs checking.
isixhosa_draft: Ixesha lengingqi lamandongomane asebusweni; ukuvuthwa kwendidi nganye kusafuna ukuhlolwa.

english: Regional production reference: conservative 10–15 t/ha, average 20–25 t/ha, good 30 t/ha. These area figures are not a per-plant annual age schedule. Match plant sex, bearing plants, spacing, climate and water before setting expected kilograms.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso semveliso yengingqi: ubuncinane obu-10–15 t/ha, umndilili ongu-20–25 t/ha, ezilungileyo ezingama-30 t/ha. Ezi zibalo zommandla aziyondlela yobudala yonyaka yesityalo ngasinye. Hambelanisa isini sesityalo, izityalo ezithwalayo, isithuba, imozulu namanzi phambi kokumisela ii-kg ezilindelekileyo.

english: Request labelled lemon stock and rootstock advice from a reputable citrus nursery. A locally validated named cultivar shortlist is not established here.
isixhosa_draft: Cela isitokhwe selamuni esinelebheli nesiluleko sengcambu exhasayo kwinethsari ye-citrus ethembekileyo. Uluhlu olufutshane lweendidi ezibizwe ngegama ezivavanywe apha ekuhlaleni alumisiwe apha.

english: Request locally appropriate fruiting stock; no named cultivar is sourced.
isixhosa_draft: Cela isitokhwe esiqhamayo esifanele apha ekuhlaleni; akukho ndidi ebizwe ngegama efunyenweyo.

english: Resolve food-use and preparation with an experienced local food-plant specialist before buying it as a household crop.
isixhosa_draft: Sombulula ukusetyenziswa njengokutya nokulungiswa kunye nengcali yezityalo zokutya yasekuhlaleni enamava phambi kokuyithenga njengesityalo sekhaya.

english: Retain this climber in mapped inventory, but do not count it as normal household food until a qualified local specialist confirms identity, edible part and safe preparation.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina esi sinyuki kuluhlu lwemephu, kodwa ungasibali njengokutya kwekhaya okuqhelekileyo de ingcali yasekuhlaleni enesakhono iqinisekise ukuchongwa, inxalenye etyiwayo nokulungiswa okukhuselekileyo.
Isiqhamo esivuthiweyo nexesha lokuqhama lommandla owomileyo

english: Ripe fruit for fresh use or preserves
isixhosa_draft: Isiqhamo esivuthiweyo sokusetyenziswa sisitsha okanye sokugcina

english: Ripe fruit pulp for fresh use or preserves
isixhosa_draft: Ipulpu yesiqhamo esivuthiweyo sokusetyenziswa sisitsha okanye sokugcina

english: Robertson irrigation and food end-use context
isixhosa_draft: Imeko yokunkcenkceshela eRobertson nokusetyenziswa kokugqibela kokutya

english: Rosemarie Select is a source-backed Western Cape candidate to discuss with the nursery. Ask about December or Packham's Triumph as compatible pollen partners.
isixhosa_draft: I-Rosemarie Select ngumgqatswa waseNtshona Koloni osekelwe kumthombo wokuxoxa ngawo kunye nenethsari. Buza nge-December okanye i-Packham's Triumph njengabalingane bomungu wentyatyambo abahambelanayo.

english: Ruby Crisp achievable output is 30,000 kg/ha. Table 1 on PDF p.5 lists Ruby Crisp trial spacing 4 x 1.25 m and 2,000 trees/ha; the derived equivalent is 15 kg/tree, but the achievable claim is not explicitly the trial measurement or a mature-age benchmark. Keep native kg/ha and the qualification.
isixhosa_draft: Imveliso enokufezekiswa ye-Ruby Crisp ingu-30,000 kg/ha. ITafile 1 kwi-PDF p.5 idwelisa isithuba sovavanyo se-Ruby Crisp esingu-4 x 1.25 m kunye nemithi eyi-2,000/ha; olufanayo oluphuma kubalo yi-15 kg/umthi, kodwa ibango elinokufezekiswa alilulinganiso lovavanyo ngokucacileyo okanye isalathiso sobudala obukhulileyo. Gcina i-kg/ha yomthombo kunye nokufaneleka.

english: Ruby Crisp achievable yield — age unspecified
isixhosa_draft: Isivuno esinokufezekiswa se-Ruby Crisp — ubudala abuchazwanga

english: SA accession maturity and grain trial
SA cultivar maturity and grain trial
SA industry reference, not a Wonderful-only window.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso seshishini le-SA, hayi ifestile ye-Wonderful kuphela.

english: SA sweet narrow-leaf field grain and harvest
isixhosa_draft: Inkozo yasentsimini nokuvunwa kwe-sweet narrow-leaf ye-SA

english: SANBI also records flower-bud pickle use. Root porridge/coffee references are not instructions to harvest roots or a complete preparation guide.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI ibhala nokusetyenziswa kweentyatyambo ezingekavuleki njenge-pickle. Izalathiso zeporridge/yekofi yengcambu azizizo imiyalelo yokuvuna iingcambu okanye isikhokelo esipheleleyo sokulungiselela.

english: SANBI describes dry, slightly sweet ripe pulp. Fruit remaining on leafless trees March–August is persistence, not a verified six-month picking season.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI ichaza ipulpu evuthiweyo eyomileyo, emnandi kancinci. Iziqhamo ezisele emthini ongenamagqabi kuMatshi–Agasti kukuqhubeka, hayi ixesha eliqinisekisiweyo lokuvuna lweenyanga ezintandathu.

english: SANBI describes green fruits that later split to expose edible red flesh. Its December–July fruit-production interval does not state when the fruit is ripe. Retain this as a general southern African phenology reference; local ripe picking months remain unknown.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI ichaza iziqhamo eziluhlaza eziqhekeka kamva zibonise inyama ebomvu etyiwayo. Ixesha layo lemveliso yeziqhamo likaDisemba–Julayi alichazi ukuba isiqhamo sivuthwa nini. Gcina oku njengesalathiso jikelele sexesha lokuqhama saseMzantsi Afrika; iinyanga zasekuhlaleni zokuvuna ezivuthiweyo zisakwaziwa.

english: SANBI describes sweet, jelly-like ripe flesh. January–May is fruiting; it does not state exact ripe-picking limits.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI ichaza inyama evuthiweyo emnandi efana nejeli. UJanuwari–Meyi lixesha lokuqhama; alichazi imida echanekileyo yokuvuna ezivuthiweyo.

english: SANBI qualifies the food statement; it is about ripe berries, not latex, bark or roots. Fruit presence February–September does not establish ripe picking throughout.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI inika imiqathango kwingxelo yokutya; ibhekisele kumaberry avuthiweyo, hayi i-latex, igxolo okanye iingcambu. Ukubakho kweziqhamo kuFebruwari–Septemba akuqinisekisi ukuvuna ezivuthiweyo ngalo lonke ixesha.

english: SANBI records it across South Africa except Western Cape, in varied habitats.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI iyibhala kulo lonke uMzantsi Afrika ngaphandle kweNtshona Koloni, kwiindawo zokuhlala ezahlukeneyo.

english: SANBI records it across varied eastern habitats and some Cape areas. It is hardy and drought resistant and can form a hedge.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI iyibhala kwiindawo zokuhlala ezahlukeneyo zasempuma nakwezinye iindawo zeKapa. Iyaqina, inyamezela imbalela kwaye inokwenza uthango.

english: SANBI reports that leaf browsing can taint cattle milk. No feed ration is recommended.
isixhosa_draft: I-SANBI ixela ukuba ukutyiwa kwamagqabi kunokwenza ubisi lweenkomo lube nencasa embi. Akukho sabelo sokutya sicetywayo.

english: SANBI's botanical account includes C. haematocarpa among South African Carissa. Its identity is bridged to C. bispinosa by the current SANBI assessment; no distinct Karoo cultivar is established.
isixhosa_draft: Ingxelo yezityalo ye-SANBI ibandakanya i-C. haematocarpa phakathi kwee-Carissa zoMzantsi Afrika. Ukuchongwa kwayo kudityaniswe ne-C. bispinosa luvavanyo lwangoku lwe-SANBI; akukho ndidi eyahlukileyo yaseKaroo emisiweyo.

english: SAPO describes chilling qualitatively as low and production as high; neither supplies a numeric age or kg/tree.
isixhosa_draft: I-SAPO ichaza ububanda ngokomgangatho njengobuphantsi kunye nemveliso njengephezulu; akukho nanye inika ubudala bamanani okanye i-kg/umthi.

english: SAPPA shortlist: wetter KZN/Lowveld — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; wet, colder KZN — Barton; drier Highveld — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; dry western areas — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. The inferred climate group alone cannot distinguish all these areas. Confirm local humidity, soils and the pollination pair before buying.
isixhosa_draft: Uluhlu olufutshane lwe-SAPPA: i-KZN/Lowveld emanzi — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; i-KZN emanzi, ebandayo — Barton; i-Highveld eyomileyo — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; iindawo ezomileyo zasentshona — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. Iqela lemozulu elicingelwayo kuphela alinakwahlula zonke ezi ndawo. Qinisekisa umswakama wasekuhlaleni, umhlaba nesibini sokuthwalwa komungu wentyatyambo phambi kokuthenga.

english: SL28, Catuai and F6 are documented on a working Port Edward estate. Ask a local nursery or coffee adviser which planting material fits the site and intended processing.
isixhosa_draft: I-SL28, i-Catuai ne-F6 zibhaliwe kwipropati esebenzayo yasePort Edward. Buza inethsari yasekuhlaleni okanye umcebisi wekofi ukuba zeziphi izinto zokutyala ezifanelekileyo kwindawo nakwisetyenziso olujoliswe kulo.

english: Same-trial arithmetic at the initial 200 trees/ha: 20,000 kg/ha / 200 = 100 kg/tree at age 6; sustainable average 22,500 kg/ha / 200 = 112.5 kg/tree. At age 3, 10,000 kg/ha / 200 = 50 kg/tree equivalent. These are average-equivalent reference values for the named Hass/Duke 7 orchard conditions, not measured individual-tree yields or default production for a different density, cultivar, climate or management. Intermediate ages are not inferred.
isixhosa_draft: Ubalo lovavanyo olufanayo kwimithi eyi-200/ha yokuqala: 20,000 kg/ha / 200 = 100 kg/umthi kwiminyaka emi-6; umndilili oqhubekayo 22,500 kg/ha / 200 = 112.5 kg/umthi. Kwiminyaka emi-3, 10,000 kg/ha / 200 = 50 kg/umthi ilinganayo. Ezi ziqhelo zesalathiso esilinganayo zomndilili zeemeko ezibizwe ngamagama zesitiya se-Hass/Duke 7, hayi izivuno ezilinganisiweyo zomthi omnye okanye imveliso engagqibekanga yobuninzi, indidi, imozulu okanye ulawulo oluhlukileyo. Iminyaka ephakathi ayiqikelelwa.

english: Satsuma group reference; other soft-citrus varieties have different seasons.
isixhosa_draft: Isalathiso seqela le-Satsuma; ezinye iindidi ze-citrus ethambileyo zinamaxesha ahlukeneyo.

english: The 6–12-month reference concerns the first leaf harvest after planting. Flowers and pods are normally produced during the second year of growth in the same North West guide. Leaf readiness does not establish pod production or picking months.

Ukulunga kwamagqabi akuqinisekisi imveliso yama-pod okanye iinyanga zokuvuna.

english: The KZN guide gives 13–20 months for both the first planting-to-harvest cycle and subsequent harvest-to-harvest cycles. It lists different commercial densities for Williams, Grand Nain and Chinese Cavendish. A banana circle counts as three planted bananas here; replacement followers are stages of those mats, not extra mapped trees or guaranteed year-round supply.

Sidwelisa ubuninzi bezorhwebo obahlukeneyo bee-Williams, Grand Nain nee-Chinese Cavendish. Isangqa sebhanana sibalwa njengeebhanana ezintathu ezityalwe apha; amahlumela atshintshayo ziziqendu zaloo mamati, hayi imithi eyongezelelweyo ekwimephu okanye unikezelo oluqinisekileyo lonyaka wonke.

english: The KZN guide gives about 4–5 years as the economic life of a plantation. Review replanting in the future plan; this commercial renewal reference does not mean every household plant dies at five or starts full production then.

Phonononga ukutyalwa kwakhona kwisicwangciso esizayo; esi sisalathiso sorhwebo sokuhlaziya asithethi ukuba yonke isityalo sekhaya sifa kwiminyaka emihlanu okanye siqala imveliso epheleleyo ngelo xesha.

english: What these quantities do and do not cover

Field-position ranges come from mapped area and published spacing; they are not guaranteed buy quantities or germination/loss allowances. Supplier and crop-specific guidance may change what to purchase. Botanical seed quantity is not inferred from mature spacing: use the packet's crop-specific direct-sowing rate and germination guidance. Where a row layout is not verified, confirm it locally before buying material.

english: Know which place you are mapping

To practise, open the sample tour. Choose Start with a garden, then Open the garden on the map. The Tour button shows that you are practising. Use a clearly named practice outline; sample changes reset on a full reload.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa, vula ukhenketho lomzekelo. Khetha u-Qala ngegadi, emva koko u-Vula igadi kwimephu. Iqhosha lokhenketho libonisa ukuba uziqhelisa. Sebenzisa umda wokuziqhelisa onegama elicacileyo; utshintsho lomzekelo lucinywa xa uphinda ulayishe iphepha lonke.

english: Map → Show map tools → Find your land
isixhosa_draft: Imephu → Bonisa izixhobo zemephu → Fumana umhlaba wakho

english: If the tools are closed, choose Show map tools. For a saved site, open Places and choose its name. Let the map finish moving, then check the site name and landmarks.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba izixhobo zivaliwe, khetha u-Bonisa izixhobo zemephu. Kwindawo egciniweyo, vula u-Iindawo uze ukhethe igama layo. Yiyeke imephu igqibe ukuhamba, uze ukhangele igama lendawo neempawu zayo.

english: For a new location, use Search town or address, then zoom in and tap the correct spot. A town search is a starting point, not the exact position of your garden.
isixhosa_draft: Kwindawo entsha, sebenzisa u-Khangela idolophu okanye idilesi, emva koko ukhulise uze ucofe indawo echanekileyo. Ukukhangela idolophu yindawo yokuqala, hayi indawo echanekileyo yegadi yakho.

english: The name, buildings and roads match the place you mean to work on.
isixhosa_draft: Igama, izakhiwo neendlela zihambelana nendawo ofuna ukusebenza kuyo.

english: Save place → Name and label → Save place
isixhosa_draft: Gcina indawo → Igama nolwabiso → Gcina indawo

english: Choose Save place for the selected spot. Give it a recognisable name and choose a label such as Home or Field. Save the place.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-Gcina indawo kwindawo ekhethiweyo. Yinike igama elaziwayo ukhethe ileyibhile efana no-Ikhaya okanye u-Intsimi. Gcina indawo.

english: If the app finds an existing place nearby, read its name. Update it when it is the same site. Save as new place only when you really mean a different place; do not create a second record just to try saving again.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba i-app ifumana indawo ekhoyo kufutshane, funda igama layo. Yihlaziye ukuba yindawo enye. Gcina njengendawo entsha kuphela xa ufuna ngokwenene enye indawo; ungenzi irekhodi lesibini ukuzama ukugcina kwakhona.

english: Open Places and choose the saved name again. Check where the map goes. The pin saves a location; it does not trace the land around it.
isixhosa_draft: Vula u-Iindawo uze ukhethe igama elagciniweyo kwakhona. Khangela apho imephu iya khona. Iphini igcina indawo; ayizobi umhlaba ojikelezileyo.

english: You can find the same named place again, and have not accidentally duplicated it.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuyifumana kwakhona indawo enegama elinye, kwaye awuyiphindanga ngempazamo.

english: Add to my map → Land boundary
If the right outline already exists, inspect it under Parcels first. Use Edit shape for a correction instead of drawing the same parcel again.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umda ofanelekileyo sele ukho, uhlole kuqala phantsi kwa-Izahlulo. Sebenzisa u-Hlela imilo ukulungisa endaweni yokuzoba isahlulo esifanayo kwakhona.

english: For a new outline, choose Land boundary, or Add parcel under Parcels. Tap each corner in order around the edge. You can also move the map until the crosshair is on a corner, then choose Add corner.
isixhosa_draft: Kumda omtsha, khetha u-Umda womhlaba, okanye u-Yongeza isahlulo phantsi kwa-Izahlulo. Cofa ikona nganye ngokulandelelana macala. Ungafuna ukuhambisa imephu ide isiphambano sibe sikwikona, uze ukhethe u-Yongeza ikona.

english: Use Undo if the last corner is wrong. Keep following the edge without crossing your own line. Choose Finish to close the shape. Cancel stops the unfinished drawing without adding it.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa u-Buyisela ukuba ikona yokugqibela ayilunganga. Qhubeka ulandela umphetho ungawunqumli umgca wakho. Khetha u-Gqiba ukuvala ubume. U-Rhoxisa umisa umzobo ongagqitywanga ungawongezi.

english: The outline follows the intended edge, and you can explain any uncertain corner.
isixhosa_draft: Umda ulandela umphetho ofunekayo, kwaye ungachaza nayiphi na ikona engaqinisekanga.

english: Finish → Name your land → Save name → Parcels
isixhosa_draft: Gqiba → Nika igama umhlaba wakho → Gcina igama → Izahlulo

english: After Finish, give the parcel a clear name, choose what it represents and check the optional link to a saved place. Choose Save name. Finish has already created the outline; Skip in the naming form does not undo it.
isixhosa_draft: Emva kwe-Gqiba, nika isahlulo igama elicacileyo, ukhethe oko sikumela uze ukhangele unxulumano olukhethwayo nendawo egciniweyo. Khetha u-Gcina igama. U-Gqiba sele wenze umda; U-Tsiba kwifom yokunika igama akuwucimi.

english: Find the named entry under Parcels. Check its units and shape against your sketch and measurements. A displayed area comes from the drawn shape, so a misplaced corner can change the result.
isixhosa_draft: Fumana into enegama phantsi kwa-Izahlulo. Khangela iiyunithi nobume baso uthelekise nomzobo wakho nemilinganiselo. Indawo ebonisiweyo ivela kubume obuzotyiweyo, ngoko ikona ephosakeleyo inokutshintsha isiphumo.

english: For a correction, choose that parcel’s Edit shape. Move the intended corner and review it before choosing Done. Use Cancel if you do not want those edits. A plausible total does not prove every corner is right.
isixhosa_draft: Kulungiso, khetha u-Hlela imilo yaloo sahlulo. Hambisa ikona efunekayo uze uyiphonononge phambi kokukhetha u-Kugqityiwe. Sebenzisa u-Rhoxisa ukuba awufuni ezo zilungiso. Isixa esinokwenzeka asiqinisekisi ukuba zonke iikona zichanekile.

english: The named parcel, its location and its drawn edge agree with your evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Isahlulo esinegama, indawo yaso nomphetho waso ozotyiweyo zihambelana nobungqina bakho.

english: A land boundary can include paths, a house and places where nothing is planted. It is not automatically the area of your vegetable beds.
isixhosa_draft: Umda womhlaba unokuquka iindlela, indlu neendawo ongatyalwanga kuzo nto. Ayiyondawo yeebhedi zakho zemifuno ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: You can point separately to the place pin, the parcel edge and the growing beds.
isixhosa_draft: Unokukhomba ngokwahlukeneyo iphini yendawo, umphetho wesahlulo neebhedi zokutyala.

english: Return to Places and open the same site. Find the parcel by name. Explain one corner you checked and one uncertainty that still needs checking on the ground.
isixhosa_draft: Buyela kwa-Iindawo uvule indawo enye. Fumana isahlulo ngegama. Chaza ikona enye oyihloliweyo nesinye isiqinisekiso esisafuna ukukhangelwa emhlabeni.

english: In the sample tour, do this in the same session. A full reload restores the sample starting data. This exercise does not test your own account’s backup or another device.
isixhosa_draft: Kukhenketho lomzekelo, yenza oku kwiseshoni enye. Ukulayisha iphepha lonke kubuyisela idatha yokuqala yomzekelo. Lo msebenzi awuvavanyi ukugcinwa kwe-akhawunti yakho okanye kwesinye isixhobo.

english: For your own work, check the saved result and any connection messages. Do not draw a duplicate because you are unsure whether the first save worked. Keep your source sketch and measurements.
isixhosa_draft: Kumsebenzi wakho, khangela oko kugciniweyo nayiphi na imiyalezo yonxibelelwano. Ungazobi into ephindiweyo ngenxa yokungaqiniseki ukuba ukugcina kokuqala kusebenzile. Gcina umzobo wakho womthombo nemilinganiselo.

english: You can find the saved work and explain what is measured, estimated or still unknown.
isixhosa_draft: Unokufumana umsebenzi ogciniweyo uchaze oko kulinganisiweyo, kuqikelelwe okanye kusengaziwa.

english: The pin is in the right place.
Does that mean the whole area around it is ready to use as vegetable-bed area in a forecast?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba oko kuthetha ukuba lonke ummandla ojikelezileyo sele ulungele ukusetyenziswa njengendawo yebhedi yemifuno kuqikelelo?

english: Yes, use the whole parcel as growing area
isixhosa_draft: Ewe, sebenzisa sonke isahlulo njengendawo yokutyala

english: A parcel may include a house, paths and unplanted land. Its area is not automatically the area of the beds.
isixhosa_draft: Isahlulo sinokuquka indlu, iindlela nomhlaba ongatyalwanga. Indawo yaso ayiyondawo yeebhedi ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: Check the boundary and map the actual beds
isixhosa_draft: Khangela umda uze umephe iibhedi zokwenyani

english: Yes. A pin locates the site, a boundary outlines land, and beds describe the growing area. Check which site and areas the forecast uses.
isixhosa_draft: Ewe. Iphini ibonisa indawo, umda ubonisa umhlaba, iibhedi zichaza indawo yokulima. Khangela ukuba uqikelelo lusebenzisa yiphi indawo neendawo.

english: Add another pin to increase the area
Another pin does not measure more growing space. Reopen the correct place and check its mapped beds.
isixhosa_draft: Enye iphini ayilinganisi ndawo yongezelelweyo yokutyala. Vula kwakhona indawo echanekileyo ukhangele iibhedi zayo ezimepiweyo.

english: Keep the evidence beside the map
The sample uses prepared records. A completion badge shows recorded steps, not an independent check that a drawing or a financial forecast is accurate.
isixhosa_draft: Umzekelo usebenzisa iirekhodi ezilungisiweyo. Uphawu lokugqiba lubonisa amanyathelo arekhodiweyo, hayi ukukhangela okuzimeleyo ukuba umzobo okanye uqikelelo lwemali luchanekile.

english: Now find and check your site
Open Map in your current workspace. Start with Places if the site is already saved. Use the sample tour above for practice.
isixhosa_draft: Vula Imephu kwindawo yakho yokusebenza yangoku. Qala nge-Iindawo ukuba indawo sele igciniwe. Sebenzisa ukhenketho lomzekelo ngasentla ukuziqhelisa.

english: Make a plan you can check on the ground.
Illustration of two growers comparing a site sketch with their homestead garden
isixhosa_draft: Umfanekiso wabatyali ababini bethelekisa umzobo wendawo negadi yomzi wabo

english: Bring your site observations and measurements
isixhosa_draft: Zisa oko ukubonileyo kwindawo nemilinganiselo yakho

english: Have the correct saved site, your field sketch and checked measurements ready. Keep a note of what already exists, what is proposed and what still needs measuring.
isixhosa_draft: Yiba nendawo echanekileyo egciniweyo, umzobo wakho wasentsimini nemilinganiselo ehloliweyo. Gcina inqaku lezinto ezikhoyo kwaye sele zikhona, ezicetywayo nezo zisadinga ukulinganiswa.

english: Check the site and its base
Check the site name and recognise the boundary and buildings. The sample tour starts on Planting; choose Base to review the starting information.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela igama lendawo uchonge umda nezakhiwo. Ukhenketho lomzekelo luqala kwi-Ukutyala; khetha u-Base ukuphonononga ulwazi lokuqala.

english: Compare the traced boundary, house and existing ground features with your field record. A satellite picture or a drawing is not a ground measurement. Keep uncertain dimensions marked for checking.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa umda ozotyiweyo, indlu neempawu zomhlaba ezikhoyo nerekhodi lakho lasentsimini. Umfanekiso wesathelayithi okanye umzobo asingumlinganiselo womhlaba. Gcina imilinganiselo engaqinisekanga iphawulwe ukuze ikhangelwe.

english: Open the step guide when you need the next task. Do this selects the relevant tool. A tick shows that something has been drawn; it does not establish that its size or position is right.
isixhosa_draft: Vula isikhokelo samanyathelo xa udinga umsebenzi olandelayo. U-Yenza oku ukhetha isixhobo esifanelekileyo. Uphawu lokuthikha lubonisa ukuba kukho into ezotyiweyo; alubonisi ukuba ubukhulu bayo okanye indawo ichanekile.

english: Read the site before placing new work
isixhosa_draft: Funda indawo phambi kokubeka umsebenzi omtsha

english: Sector → Read the source notes → Compare with your observations
isixhosa_draft: Sector → Funda amanqaku omthombo → Thelekisa nokubonileyo

english: Compare the display with what you have observed and recorded. Note a disagreement or an unknown instead of changing your field record to match the screen.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa into ebonisiweyo nalento ukhe wayibona waza wayibhala. Phawula ukungavumelani okanye into engaziwayo endaweni yokutshintsha irekhodi lakho lasentsimini ukuze ihambelane nesikrini.

english: Use Learn and the linked course explanations for the farming ideas. These app instructions teach the controls; they do not replace a site assessment.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa u-Funda neenkcazo zekhosi ezidityanisiweyo kwiingcamango zokulima. Le miyalelo ye-app ifundisa izilawuli; ayibuyisi uvavanyo lwendawo.

english: You can say which information was observed and which still needs checking on site.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchaza ukuba yeyiphi ingcaciso ejongiweyo nokuba yeyiphi esafuna ukukhangelwa kwindawo.

english: Use each step for the part of the plan you are considering. Read the step guide, choose the appropriate tool and place or draw the proposed item. You do not need every item in the palette.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa inyathelo ngalinye kwicandelo lesicwangciso olicingayo. Funda isikhokelo samanyathelo, khetha isixhobo esifanelekileyo uze ubeke okanye uzobe into ecetywayo. Akufuneki wonke into ekwipalethi.

english: Check how the parts work together: water access, paths, beds, trees and structures. Keep existing features distinguishable in your notes from work you have only proposed.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela indlela amacandelo asebenza ngayo kunye: ufikelelo lwamanzi, iindlela, iibhedi, imithi nezakhiwo. Gcina iimpawu ezikhoyo zahlukile kumanqaku akho kumsebenzi oyicebileyo kuphela.

english: Each item has a reason and checked dimensions, or a clearly recorded question to resolve.
isixhosa_draft: Into nganye inesizathu nemilinganiselo ehloliweyo, okanye umbuzo ocacileyo orekhodiweyo ekufuneka uxazululwe.

english: Planting → Select → Zoom in if needed → Move the item → Undo
isixhosa_draft: Ukutyala → Khetha → Khulisa xa kufuneka → Hambisa into → Buyisela

english: Check the result immediately. If you meant to move the bed but its width changed, choose Undo, confirm the original dimensions and try again at a larger zoom.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela iziphumo ngoko nangoko. Ukuba ubuhlose ukuhambisa ibhedi kodwa ububanzi bayo butshintshile, khetha u-Buyisela, qinisekisa imilinganiselo yoqobo uze uzame kwakhona ukhulisile.

english: Make and inspect a plan sheet

Open the resulting map full screen. Check the site name, sheet title, boundary, positions, scale, legend and readable labels. Compare with the drawing and field record; an attractive picture is not evidence that a planned feature exists.
isixhosa_draft: Vula imephu eyenziweyo kwisikrini esipheleleyo. Khangela igama lendawo, isihloko sephepha, umda, iindawo, isikali, intsingiselo neelebhile ezifundekayo. Thelekisa nomzobo nerekhodi lasentsimini; umfanekiso omhle awungobungqina bokuba into ecetywayo ikhona.

english: The selected sheet is readable and represents the version you intend to discuss.
isixhosa_draft: Iphepha elikhethiweyo liyafundeka kwaye limela inguqulo ofuna ukuyixoxa.

english: Download the selected sheets and open the file
isixhosa_draft: Khuphela amaphepha akhethiweyo uze uvule ifayile

english: Select the saved sheet or sheets you want. Choose PDF for one document, or an available image format. Check the selection and quality before choosing Download.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha iphepha okanye amaphepha agciniweyo owafunayo. Khetha i-PDF kuxwebhu olunye, okanye ifomathi yomfanekiso ekhoyo. Khangela ukhetho nomgangatho phambi kokukhetha u-Khuphela.

english: You meant to move a bed.
After dragging, its width has changed. What should you do?
isixhosa_draft: Emva kokutsalwa, ububanzi bayo butshintshile. Ufanele wenze ntoni?

english: Keep it because the drawing looks tidy
A tidy drawing does not justify a changed dimension. Check the edit against your intended plan.
isixhosa_draft: Umzobo ococekileyo awusiyiso isizathu sokutshintsha umlinganiselo. Khangela utshintsho ngokuchasene nesicwangciso osihlosileyo.

english: Undo, check the dimensions and move its body carefully
isixhosa_draft: Buyisela, khangela imilinganiselo uze uhambise umzimba wayo ngobunono

english: Change the field notes to match the screen
isixhosa_draft: Tshintsha amanqaku asentsimini ukuze ahambelane nesikrini

english: When the growing areas are checked, use the site’s Crop plan link to continue planning. Proposed plantings and forecast harvests remain plans until the real work is recorded.
isixhosa_draft: Xa iindawo zokulima sele zihloliwe, sebenzisa ikhonkco le-Isicwangciso sezityalo lendawo ukuqhubeka nokucwangcisa. Ukutyala okucetywayo nezivuno ezoqikelelwayo zihlala zingamacebo kude kurekhodwe umsebenzi wokwenyani.

english: Start with a site you recognise
Turn the map into a crop plan
Plan the growing work, then record what happens.
isixhosa_draft: Cwangcisa umsebenzi wokutyala, uze urekhode oko kwenzekayo.

english: Check mapped beds, choose plantings and read the calendar without confusing a plan with a harvest.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela iibhedi ezimepiweyo, ukhethe ukutyala uze ufunde ikhalenda ungasidibanisi isicwangciso nesivuno.

english: Illustration of two growers checking a site sketch beside planted beds in a homestead garden
isixhosa_draft: Umfanekiso wabatyali ababini bekhangela umzobo wendawo ecaleni kweebhedi ezityaliweyo kwigadi yomzi

english: Check the growing space before planning the season · illustrated example
isixhosa_draft: Khangela indawo yokulima phambi kokucwangcisa ixesha · umzekelo ongumfanekiso

english: Have the site and growing areas ready
Bring your checked bed and plot measurements, what is already growing, seed-packet information and notes about available water. Keep unknown details as questions to resolve.
isixhosa_draft: Zisa imilinganiselo yebhedi neziza ezihloliweyo, oko sele kukhula, ulwazi lephakethi yembewu namanqaku ngamanzi akhoyo. Gcina iinkcukacha ezingaziwayo njengemibuzo ekufuneka ixazululwe.

english: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Plan the growing season. Open its crop plan. The prepared crops and dates are examples, not instructions for your own farm.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa, vula ukhenketho lomzekelo uze ukhethe u-Cwangcisa ixesha lokutyala. Vula isicwangciso sayo sezityalo. Izityalo nemihla elungisiweyo ngemizekelo, hayi imiyalelo yefama yakho.

english: Follow the correct site into its plan
Open the bed and plot count to see each area and width. Match these with the map and your measurements. The whole boundary area is not the same as usable growing space.
isixhosa_draft: Vula inani lebhedi neziza ukubona indawo nganye nobubanzi. Zithelekise nemephu nemilinganiselo yakho. Indawo yonke yomda ayifani nendawo yokutyala esetyenzisekayo.

english: Choose a new planting or edit the existing row
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ukutyala okutsha okanye uhlele umqolo osele ukho

english: + crop on the intended bed, or crop bar → Edit
isixhosa_draft: + isityalo kwibhedi ehlosiweyo, okanye ibha yesityalo → Hlela

english: For a new planting, choose + crop on its actual bed or plot and select the crop. If the planting already appears, open its bar and choose Edit instead of adding it again.
isixhosa_draft: Kukutyala okutsha, khetha + isityalo kwibhedi yayo yokwenyani okanye isiza uze ukhethe isityalo. Ukuba ukutyala sele kuvela, vula ibha yako uze ukhethe u-Hlela endaweni yokukongeza kwakhona.

english: Enter the variety from your seed packet if you know it. Leave it blank if you do not. An entered variety name does not turn general crop guidance into a verified variety-specific schedule.
isixhosa_draft: Faka uhlobo oluvela kwiphakethi yembewu ukuba uyalwazi. Lushiye lungenanto ukuba awulwazi. Igama lohlobo olufakiweyo alitshintshi isikhokelo jikelele sesityalo sibe sisicwangciso esiqinisekisiweyo solo hlobo.

english: Choose This is already growing only when that describes the real crop. Planned sowing and a crop already in the ground are different records. Check any nursery or transplant information too.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha u-This is already growing kuphela xa oko kuchaza isityalo sokwenyani. Ukuhlwayela okucwangcisiweyo nesityalo esele siseplasini zahlukile kwiirekhodi. Khangela nolwazi lwezithole okanye lokutshintshela ngaphandle.

english: You are adding one intended planting or editing its existing row, with its actual status clear.
isixhosa_draft: Wongeza ukutyala okunye okuhlosiweyo okanye uhlela umqolo wako osele ukho, ngemeko yako yokwenyani icacile.

english: For a crop raised in trays, sowing and planting out happen at different times. Read the readiness window and planned transplant month. Check actual seedlings and the bed before planting out; update a delayed plan.
isixhosa_draft: Kwesityalo esikhuliswa kwiitreyi, ukuhlwayela nokutyala ngaphandle kwenzeka ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo. Funda ifestile yokulungela nenyanga ecwangcisiweyo yokutyala. Khangela izithole zokwenyani nebhedi phambi kokutyala ngaphandle; hlaziya isicwangciso esibambezelekileyo.

english: The proposed timing and area are consistent with the bed, other crops and information you have checked.
isixhosa_draft: Ixesha nesabelo esicetywayo siyahambelana nebhedi, nezinye izityalo nolwazi olulihloliweyo.

english: Add to bed, Add as existing or Save changes → Reopen the crop bar
isixhosa_draft: Yongeza kumbhede, Yongeza njengesele sikhona okanye Gcina utshintsho → Vula kwakhona ibha yesityalo

english: In the sample plan, change one planned month, save and reopen it. Then choose Undo and reopen the row to confirm the original month returned. Keep your own planting evidence separately; the sample workspace resets on reload.
isixhosa_draft: Kwisicwangciso somzekelo, tshintsha inyanga enye ecwangcisiweyo, ugcine uze uvule kwakhona. Emva koko khetha u-Buyisela uvule kwakhona umqolo ukuqinisekisa ukuba inyanga yoqobo ibuyile. Gcina ubungqina bakho bokutyala ngokwahlukeneyo; indawo yomzekelo iyacinywa xa ulayisha kwakhona.

english: You can find the intended row again and recover a practice edit without duplicating it.
isixhosa_draft: Unokufumana umqolo ohlosiweyo kwakhona ubuyise utshintsho lokuziqhelisa ngaphandle kokuyiphinda.

english: Use automatic suggestions only with checked assumptions
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa ingcebiso ezenzekelayo kuphela ngeengcinga ezihloliweyo

english: Auto-suggest a plan → Goals and conditions → Review the proposal
isixhosa_draft: Cebisa isicwangciso ngokuzenzekelayo → Goals and conditions → Phonononga isiphakamiso

english: Automatic planning is optional. Choose your purpose, crop preferences and whether you are planning from this month or comparing a whole-year pattern. Read the climate source and the options before continuing.
isixhosa_draft: Ukucwangcisa okuzenzekelayo kukukhetha. Khetha injongo yakho, ukhetho lwezityalo nokuba ucwangcisa ukusuka kule nyanga okanye uthelekisa umzekelo wonyaka wonke. Funda umthombo wemozulu nezinketho phambi kokuqhubeka.

english: This automatic planner requires reliable irrigation for every suggested crop cycle. Select that only if it is true for your farm. A rainfall pattern or a tank drawn on the map does not prove that water is available throughout the plan. Otherwise continue with a locally checked manual plan.
isixhosa_draft: Lo mcwangcisi ozenzekelayo udinga ukunkcenkceshela okuthembekileyo kwisigaba ngasinye sesityalo esicetyiswayo. Khetha oko kuphela ukuba kuyinyani kwifama yakho. Umzekelo wemvula okanye itanki ezotyiweyo kwimephu aziqinisekisi ukuba amanzi akhona kulo lonke icebo. Ngaphandle koko qhubeka nesicwangciso esiyilwe ngesandla esihloliweyo kwindawo.

english: You can explain the assumptions behind a suggestion and have reviewed it before adding anything.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchaza iingcinga ezingasemva kwesiphakamiso kwaye usiphonononge phambi kokuba wongeze nantoni na.

english: Read the calendar and its limits
Year one and Year two → Tasks → Food, field & value
isixhosa_draft: Year one kunye ne-Year two → Imisebenzi → Ukutya, intsimi nexabiso

english: Year one begins from the current month. Year two shows the repeated annual timing for planned rows; a one-off crop marked already growing is not automatically repeated. Read the explanation below the calendar.
