english: You can explain which dates each section covers and whose records it shows.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchaza ukuba lilo licandelo ligubungela yiphi imihla nokuba lubonisa iirekhodi zabani.

english: Keep the evidence and gaps together
Match the export to the source records
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa oko kuthunyelwe ngaphandle neerekhodi zomthombo

english: Someone helping you can follow the figures to evidence and see what is still unknown.
isixhosa_draft: Umntu okunceda unokulandela amanani ukuya kubungqina abone nokuba yintoni esengaziwa.

english: Keep the checked copy, then choose who sees it
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ikopi ehloliweyo, uze ukhethe ukuba ngubani oyibonayo

english: Check the files → Keep a dated copy → Review the intended recipient
isixhosa_draft: Khangela iifayile → Gcina ikopi enomhla → Phonononga umamkeli ohlosiweyo

english: The CSV dates show day and month, without a year. Name your saved copy with the farm and full period, including the year, so it stays clear later. Keep the original exported file unchanged; make a separate working copy if you need to add notes in a spreadsheet.
isixhosa_draft: Imihla ye-CSV ibonisa usuku nenyanga, ngaphandle konyaka. Nika ikopi yakho egciniweyo igama lefama nexesha elipheleleyo, kuquka unyaka, ukuze ihlale icacile kamva. Gcina ifayile yoqobo ethunyelwe ngaphandle ingatshintshanga; yenza ikopi yokusebenza eyahlukileyo ukuba ufuna ukongeza amanqaku kwispredishithi.

english: For this practice, stop with your checked sample copy. Explain its limits; do not submit example records as your own.
isixhosa_draft: Kule meko yokuziqhelisa, yeka ngekopi yakho yomzekelo ehloliweyo. Chaza imida yayo; musa ukungenisa iirekhodi zomzekelo njengezakho.

english: You have a usable copy with its period and sources, and control who receives it.
isixhosa_draft: Unekopi esetyenzisekayo enexesha layo nemithombo, kwaye ulawula ukuba ngubani oyifumanayo.

english: On a phone, you choose Export this month (CSV). Which period should you check in the file?
isixhosa_draft: Kwifowuni, ukhetha u-Thumela le nyanga ngaphandle (CSV). Liliphi ixesha ekufuneka ulikhangele kwifayile?

english: The twelve months visible in the chart
The chart window and compact-screen export are separate. That button exports the current calendar month.
isixhosa_draft: Ifestile yetshathi nokuthumela ngaphandle kwesikrini esincinci zahlukile. Eli qhosha lithumela inyanga yekhalenda yangoku.

english: Correct. Check the rows and their dates. For the current season or year, use the wide Financial sheet’s period choice and Export.
isixhosa_draft: Ichanekile. Khangela imiqolo nemihla yayo. Kwisizini okanye unyaka wangoku, sebenzisa ukhetho lwexesha lephepha lemali elibanzi kunye no-Thumela ngaphandle.

english: Every record the farm has ever entered
isixhosa_draft: Zonke iirekhodi ezifakwe yifama kuwo onke amaxesha

english: This is a period export, not a complete backup. Keep the source records and check the file’s actual coverage.
isixhosa_draft: Oku kuthunyelwa ngaphandle ngexesha, akuyikopi epheleleyo yogcino. Gcina iirekhodi zomthombo uze ukhangele ubungakanani bokwenyani befayile.

english: A clear summary still needs its source records
isixhosa_draft: Isishwankathelo esicacileyo sisadinga iirekhodi zaso zomthombo

english: Independent practice: in the sample tour, compare the CSV period with View summary. Open an exported copy, trace one figure to its source, and name one item the file does not contain. Stop before sharing.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: kukhenketho lomzekelo, thelekisa ixesha le-CSV no-Jonga isishwankathelo. Vula ikopi ethunyelwe ngaphandle, ulandele inani elinye ubuyele kumthombo walo, uze ubize into enye ayiqulethe ifayile. Yeka phambi kokwabelana.

english: Choose the period you want to check
Open Charts for the CSV, or switch to Picked for Records for a lender. Start with sample records if you are practising.
isixhosa_draft: Vula Iitshathi ukufumana i-CSV, okanye utshintshele ku-Kuvuniwe ukufumana Iirekhodi ezenzelwe umbolekisi wemali. Qala ngeerekhodi zomzekelo ukuba uziqhelisa.

english: Keep field evidence and check a report
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ubungqina basentsimini uze ukhangele ingxelo

english: Keep the report connected to the land.
Choose the right site, keep the source evidence and check what a saved report actually includes.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha indawo echanekileyo, gcina ubungqina bomthombo uze ukhangele ukuba yintoni ngokwenene equlethwe yingxelo egciniweyo.

english: Illustration of two growers checking a site sketch together beside a homestead garden
isixhosa_draft: Umfanekiso wabatyali ababini bekhangela umzobo wendawo kunye ecaleni kwegadi yomzi

english: Check the site together before trusting the plan · illustrated example
isixhosa_draft: Khangelani indawo kunye phambi kokuthemba isicwangciso · umzekelo ongumfanekiso

english: Bring observations, dates and original records
isixhosa_draft: Zisa oko ukubonileyo, imihla neerekhodi zoqobo

english: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Turn site evidence into a report. Its pictures, household interview and soil values are examples. Do not use them as evidence about your own land.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa, vula ukhenketho lomzekelo uze ukhethe u-Turn site evidence into a report. Imifanekiso yalo, udliwanondlebe lomzi namaxabiso omhlaba ngemizekelo. Musa ukuzisebenzisa njengobungqina ngomhlaba wakho.

english: Start with the correct saved site
Saved sites & reports → Saved sites → Open site & generate report
isixhosa_draft: Iindawo neengxelo ezigciniweyo → Iindawo ezigciniweyo → Vula indawo wenze ingxelo

english: Match the name and map position to the place you intend to describe. Open that site’s report workspace, then open Improve this report.
isixhosa_draft: Thelekisa igama nendawo yemephu nendawo ofuna ukuyichaza. Vula indawo yokusebenzela yengxelo yaloo ndawo, emva koko vula u-Phucula le ngxelo.

english: If the site has not been saved, name it and use Save site before attaching evidence. A familiar name alone is not enough if the map position is wrong.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba indawo ayigcinwanga, yinike igama uze usebenzise u-Gcina indawo phambi kokuqhotyoshelwa kobungqina. Igama elaziwayo alwanelanga ukuba indawo yemephu ayilunganga.

english: The checklist shows whether records are present. It does not establish that they are accurate, checked or complete.
isixhosa_draft: Uluhlu lokuhlola lubonisa ukuba iirekhodi zikhona na. Alubonisi ukuba zichanekile, ziyahlolwa okanye ziyapheleleka.

english: The report workspace belongs to the place you visited, and you know which evidence is still missing.
isixhosa_draft: Indawo yokusebenzela yengxelo yeyendawo oyityelele, kwaye uyazi ukuba bungeobuphi ubungqina obusalahlekile.

english: Improve this report → Add site photos and Complete or review survey
isixhosa_draft: Phucula le ngxelo → Yongeza iifoto zendawo no-Complete or review survey

english: Use Add site photos to include clear views of the actual site. Keep the original files with their dates, locations and notes. The app stores smaller copies; it is not your only photo archive.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa u-Yongeza iifoto zendawo ukubandakanya imibono ecacileyo yendawo yokwenyani. Gcina iifayile zoqobo nemihla yazo, iindawo namanqaku. I-app igcina iikopi ezincinci; ayiyiyo kuphela ugcino lwakho lweefoto.

english: You can distinguish a real observation, a planned item and an illustration.
isixhosa_draft: Unokwahlula into ebonwe ngokwenene, into ecetywayo nomfanekiso.

english: Enter the results from their source
Add soil test results or Add water test results → Results and sampling details → Save test results
isixhosa_draft: Yongeza iziphumo zovavanyo lomhlaba okanye Add water test results → Iziphumo neenkcukacha zesampuli → Gcina iziphumo zovavanyo

english: Keep the original laboratory report. The test folder accepts its PDF or a clear photograph, but uploading the file does not make the app read its results automatically.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ingxelo yoqobo yelebhu. Ifolda yovavanyo yamkela i-PDF yayo okanye ifoto ecacileyo, kodwa ukulayisha ifayile akwenzi ukuba i-app ifunde iziphumo zayo ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: Enter the sampling date, sample location or ID, laboratory, results, units and relevant method or comments in Results and sampling details. Copy these from the source, then compare them with it before choosing Save test results.
isixhosa_draft: Faka umhla wokuthatha isampuli, indawo okanye i-ID yesampuli, ilebhu, iziphumo, iiyunithi nendlela efanelekileyo okanye amagqabantshintshi kwa-Iziphumo neenkcukacha zesampuli. Kopa ezi kumthombo, uze uzithelekise nawo phambi kokukhetha u-Gcina iziphumo zovavanyo.

english: Reopen the same test folder and check the saved entry. A filename alone is not a measured result. Keep missing results unknown. Regional soil and climate layers are context, not a test of your own sample.
isixhosa_draft: Vula kwakhona ifolda yovavanyo enye ukhangele ingeniso egciniweyo. Igama lefayile ngokwalo asiyiso isiphumo esilinganisiweyo. Gcina iziphumo ezilahlekileyo zingaziwa. Iingqimba zommandla zomhlaba nemozulu zimeko, hayi uvavanyo lwesampuli yakho.

english: Improve this report → Review settings and included maps → Generate report
isixhosa_draft: Phucula le ngxelo → Phonononga useto nemephu ebandakanyiweyo → Yenza ingxelo

english: Check the source records, selected sections, language, wording and depth. Review the maps selected for the report. A map saved on another device may not be available here.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela iirekhodi zomthombo, amacandelo akhethiweyo, ulwimi, amagama nobunzulu. Phonononga iimephu ezikhethiweyo kwingxelo. Imephu egciniwe kwesinye isixhobo isenokungafumaneki apha.

english: Generate report creates the advice from the available information. Read it against your actual site and records. Investigate conflicts or missing evidence before acting on the advice.
isixhosa_draft: U-Yenza ingxelo wenza icebiso ngolwazi olukhoyo. Yifunde ngokuchasene nendawo yakho yokwenyani neerekhodi. Phanda iingxabano okanye ubungqina obulahlekileyo phambi kokwenza ngokweengcebiso.

english: If you add evidence after a report was written, the earlier text stays as it was. Use Generate new report when you need updated advice. Changing the screen, print layout or summary view does not rewrite the full report.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba wongeza ubungqina emva kokuba ingxelo ibhaliwe, umbhalo wangaphambili uhlala unjalo. Sebenzisa u-Yenza ingxelo entsha xa udinga ingcebiso ehlaziyiweyo. Ukutshintsha isikrini, uyilo lokushicilela okanye ukujonga isishwankathelo akubhali kwakhona ingxelo epheleleyo.

english: You know which information supports the advice, and which questions still need an answer.
isixhosa_draft: Uyazi ukuba loluphi ulwazi oluxhasa ingcebiso, nokuba yimiphi imibuzo esafuna impendulo.

english: Save a version you can return to
Save → Check the result → Saved sites & reports → Saved reports
isixhosa_draft: Gcina → Khangela isiphumo → Iindawo neengxelo ezigciniweyo → Iingxelo ezigciniweyo

english: Use the report’s Back control to return. In Saved sites & reports, open Saved reports or use Read latest saved report on the site card. Check the site, saved date and text without generating it again.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa iqhosha lika-Emva lengxelo ukubuyela. Kwa-Iindawo neengxelo ezigciniweyo, vula u-Iingxelo ezigciniweyo okanye usebenzise u-Read latest saved report kwikhadi lendawo. Khangela indawo, umhla ogciniweyo nombhalo ngaphandle kokuphinda uwuvelise.

english: An older saved report is a snapshot. The current evidence checklist and photographs can be newer than its text. Read those labels and dates before assuming the advice used the latest evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Ingxelo endala egciniweyo sisifaniso sexesha elithile. Uluhlu lokukhangela ubungqina lwangoku neefoto zinokuba zintsha kunombhalo wayo. Funda ezo leyibhile nemihla phambi kokucinga ukuba ingcebiso isebenzise ubungqina obutsha.

english: You can reopen the intended version and tell what has changed since it was written.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuvula kwakhona inguqulo ohlosile uze uthi yintoni etshintshileyo ukusukela yabhalwa.

english: Export PDF → Open the file → Compare it with the source records
isixhosa_draft: Khupha i-PDF → Vula ifayile → Ithelekise neerekhodi zomthombo

english: Choose the view and image options you need. On a phone, open View and print options to find these choices. Then use Export PDF and open the saved file.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha uhlobo lokujonga nezikhetho zomfanekiso ozidingayo. Kwifowuni, vula u-Iinketho zokubuka nokushicilela ukufumana ezi zikhetho. Emva koko sebenzisa u-Khupha i-PDF uze uvule ifayile egciniweyo.

english: Inspect every page: site name, dates, measurements, units, included maps and pictures, source labels and gaps. Check that text and tables are readable. Keep original evidence separately; a report is not a complete backup.
isixhosa_draft: Hlola onke amaphepha: igama lendawo, imihla, imilinganiselo, iiyunithi, iimephu nemifanekiso ebandakanyiweyo, iileyibhile zomthombo nezikhewu. Khangela ukuba umbhalo neetafile ziyafundeka. Gcina ubungqina boqobo ngokwahlukeneyo; ingxelo ayiyikopi epheleleyo yogcino.

english: Keep a dated copy. Before sending a real report, check the intended recipient and any household details, faces or precise locations it includes. Downloading a file does not mean anyone else received it.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina ikopi enomhla. Phambi kokuthumela ingxelo yokwenyani, khangela umamkeli ohlosiweyo nazo naziphi iinkcukacha zekhaya, ubuso okanye iindawo ezichanekileyo eziqulethwe yiyo. Ukukhuphela ifayile akuthethi ukuba omnye umntu uyifumene.

english: You have inspected the right version, understand its limits and know who should see it.
isixhosa_draft: Uhlole inguqulo echanekileyo, uyaziqonda imida yayo kwaye uyazi ukuba ngubani ofanele ayibone.

english: The test PDF has been uploaded.
Does the attached file mean its results are ready for the report to use?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ifayile eqhotyoshelweyo ithetha ukuba iziphumo zayo zikulungele ukusetyenziswa yingxelo?

english: Yes, every result is read automatically
This test folder stores the file but does not automatically read its contents. You still need to enter and check the relevant results.
isixhosa_draft: Le folda yovavanyo igcina ifayile kodwa ayifundi ngokuzenzekelayo okuqulethwe kuyo. Usadinga ukufaka nokukhangela iziphumo ezifanelekileyo.

english: Enter and check the results, units and sample details
isixhosa_draft: Faka uze ukhangele iziphumo, iiyunithi neenkcukacha zesampuli

english: Correct. Use the original report as the source, save the entered results and reopen the folder to check them.
isixhosa_draft: Ichanekile. Sebenzisa ingxelo yoqobo njengomthombo, gcina iziphumo ezifakiweyo uze uvule kwakhona ifolda ukuzikhangela.

english: Use the sample farm’s values for now
The sample values are invented for practice. They say nothing about your land. Leave your unknown results missing until you have evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Amaxabiso omzekelo ayilelwe ukuziqhelisa. Awathethi nto ngomhlaba wakho. Shiya iziphumo zakho ezingaziwayo zilahlekile de ube nobungqina.

english: Practise the evidence pack, then check the site report
isixhosa_draft: Ziqhelise ipakethe yobungqina, uze ukhangele ingxelo yendawo

english: In the sample farm, change Mentor notes and follow-up to a clearly labelled practice note. Use Save edits, then Download evidence report. Open the file and find that note and the example-picture labels. Stop before sharing.
isixhosa_draft: Kwifama yomzekelo, tshintsha u-Mentor notes and follow-up ube linqaku lokuziqhelisa eliphawulwe ngokucacileyo. Sebenzisa u-Save edits, emva koko u-Khuphela ingxelo yobungqina. Vula ifayile ufumane eli nqaku neleyibhile zemifanekiso yomzekelo. Yeka phambi kokwabelana.

english: That practice evidence pack is separate from the full Site Analysis Report. Its prepared pictures are not photographs of the real garden, and its soil values are not laboratory findings. The practice workspace resets on reload; it is not a place to keep real records.
isixhosa_draft: Loo pakethe yobungqina bokuziqhelisa ihlukile kwi-Site Analysis Report epheleleyo. Imifanekiso yayo elungisiweyo ayiyiyo ifoto yegadi yokwenyani, kwaye amaxabiso ayo omhlaba ayiyiyo iziphumo zelebhu. Indawo yokusebenzela yokuziqhelisa icinywa xa uphinda ulayishe; asiyondawo yokugcina iirekhodi zokwenyani.

english: Independent practice: explain one recorded fact, one planned item and one gap. Then save and reopen a sample site report, check its date, and explain why adding a later photo does not prove its earlier advice was updated.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: chaza inyani enye erekhodiweyo, into enye ecetywayo nesikhewu esinye. Emva koko gcina uze uvule kwakhona ingxelo yendawo yomzekelo, ukhangele umhla wayo, uchaze ukuba kutheni ukongeza ifoto yamva kungabonisi ukuba ingcebiso yayo yangaphambili ihlaziyiwe.

english: Open your saved sites and review the evidence checklist. Use the sample tour first if you are practising.
isixhosa_draft: Vula iindawo zakho ezigciniweyo uphonononge uluhlu lokukhangela ubungqina. Sebenzisa ukhenketho lomzekelo kuqala ukuba uziqhelisa.

english: Study offline, practise and get guidance
isixhosa_draft: Funda ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, ziqhelise uze ufumane isikhokelo

english: Save available lessons, check them without a connection and keep learning at your own pace.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina izifundo ezikhoyo, uzikhangele ngaphandle koqhagamshelwano uze uqhubeke nokufunda ngesantya sakho.

english: Illustration of two growers studying a site sketch together beside a homestead garden
isixhosa_draft: Umfanekiso wabatyali ababini bezifundela kunye umzobo wendawo ecaleni kwegadi yomzi

english: Learn together, then practise on your own site · illustrated example
isixhosa_draft: Fundani kunye, emva koko ziqhelise kwindawo yakho · umzekelo ongumfanekiso

english: Prepare on the device you will use
Use the sample tour for practice. Its progress is disposable. Do not keep your real course evidence in the sample workspace. Ask your facilitator which module and practical task to work on.
isixhosa_draft: Sebenzisa ukhenketho lomzekelo ukuziqhelisa. Inkqubela yalo iyalahlwa. Ungagcini ubungqina bekhosi yakho yokwenyani kwindawo yomzekelo yokusebenzela. Buza umququzeleli wakho ukuba yeyiphi imodyuli nomsebenzi osebenzayo osebenza kuwo.

english: My Studies → Open a module, or Study offline
isixhosa_draft: Izifundo zam → Vula imodyuli, okanye Funda ngaphandle kwe-intanethi

english: Open the module you need to find its download control. Study offline offers the available lessons together. It does not unlock modules you have not been given access to.
isixhosa_draft: Vula imodyuli oyidingayo ukufumana ulawulo lwayo lokukhuphela. U-Funda ngaphandle kwe-intanethi unikezela izifundo ezikhoyo kunye. Akavuli iimodyuli ongazinikwanga ufikelelo kuzo.

english: Check the language shown for the slides and narration. Some translated material is not available yet, so the app may offer English instead. Downloading does not create a missing translation.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela ulwimi olubonisiweyo lwezilayidi nokubalisa. Okunye okuguqulelweyo akukakhoyo, ngoko i-app inokunikezela isiNgesi endaweni yoko. Ukukhuphela akwenzi uguqulo olulahlekileyo.

english: You know which module, language and download size you are choosing.
isixhosa_draft: Uyazi ukuba loluphi imodyuli, ulwimi nobungakanani bokukhuphela obukhethayo.

english: Wait for the download to finish
Download → Check for On this phone
Keep the page open while files arrive. If you need to interrupt the download, use Stop. Files already saved can be used when you finish the download later.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina iphepha livuliwe ngoxa iifayile zifika. Ukuba kufuneka umise ukukhuphela, sebenzisa u-Yeka. Iifayile ezigciniweyo sele zinokusetyenziswa xa uqukumbela ukukhuphela kamva.

english: Finish download means some files are still missing. Reconnect and use that button, then check again. A progress bar or a few working slides does not mean the whole module is ready.
isixhosa_draft: U-Gqiba ukukhuphela kuthetha ukuba ezinye iifayile zisalahlekile. Qhagamshela kwakhona usebenzise eli qhosha, emva koko ukhangele kwakhona. Ibha yenkqubela okanye izilayidi ezimbalwa ezisebenzayo akuthethi ukuba imodyuli yonke ikulungele.

english: Check the module’s own On this phone message. If you downloaded one module, the whole-course control may still show missing files for other modules. Read which pack each message describes.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela umyalezo wemodyuli wayo othi On this phone. Ukuba ukhuphele imodyuli enye, ulawulo lwekhosi yonke lusenokubonisa iifayile ezilahlekileyo kwezinye iimodyuli. Funda ukuba umyalezo ngamnye uchaza yiphi ipakethe.

english: The module you need says On this phone, with no unfinished download for that pack.
isixhosa_draft: Imodyuli oyidingayo ithi On this phone, ingenakho ukukhuphela okungagqitywanga kwelo pakethe.

english: Open the module online → Briefly disconnect → Reopen My Studies
isixhosa_draft: Vula imodyuli usemgceni → Nqamula ixesha elifutshane → Vula kwakhona Izifundo zam

english: While still somewhere you can reconnect, open the module once. Then briefly turn off your connection and reopen My Studies in the same browser or app.
isixhosa_draft: Ngoxa usekwindawo onokuqhagamshela kuyo kwakhona, vula imodyuli kanye. Emva koko cima uqhagamshelwano lwakho ixesha elifutshane uvule kwakhona Izifundo zam kwisikhangeli esinye okanye kwi-app enye.

english: Check that a slide picture loads. Open Read this slide and read its text. Choose Play to check the narration. Use Stop when you want to read quietly; Back and Next start narration on the selected slide.
isixhosa_draft: Khangela ukuba umfanekiso wesilayidi uyalayisha. Vula u-Read this slide ufunde umbhalo wawo. Khetha u-Play ukukhangela ukubalisa. Sebenzisa u-Yeka xa ufuna ukufunda ngokuthe cwaka; u-Emva no-Okulandelayo baqala ukubalisa kwisilayidi esikhethiweyo.

english: You have actually reopened the lesson and used its picture, text and voice without a connection.
isixhosa_draft: Uvule kwakhona isifundo ngokwenene wasebenzisa umfanekiso, umbhalo nelizwi laso ngaphandle koqhagamshelwano.

english: Read, listen and explain it yourself
Open a lesson → Read or listen → Try its questions
isixhosa_draft: Vula isifundo → Funda okanye mamela → Zama imibuzo yaso

english: The slide presentation and the lesson list are different ways into the topic. Open a named lesson below the slides to find its reading and questions.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuboniswa kwezilayidi noluhlu lwezifundo ziindlela ezahlukeneyo zokungena kwesi sihloko. Vula isifundo esinegama ngezantsi kwezilayidi ukufumana ukufunda nemibuzo yaso.

english: Read the feedback after answering. If an idea is unclear, return to the explanation and describe it in your own words. Use the practical task to connect it with your own site.
isixhosa_draft: Funda impendulo emva kokuphendula. Ukuba umbono awucacanga, buyela kwinkcazo uwuchaze ngamazwi akho. Sebenzisa umsebenzi osebenzayo ukuwunxulumanisa nendawo yakho.

english: Downloading a pack does not mark a module done or submit its practical work. Mark done is your progress marker; it is not proof that a facilitator has assessed your work.
isixhosa_draft: Ukukhuphela ipakethe akuphawuli imodyuli njengegqityiweyo okanye akuthumeli umsebenzi wayo osebenzayo. U-Phawula kugqityiwe luphawu lwenkqubela yakho; asingobungqina bokuba umququzeleli uvavanye umsebenzi wakho.

english: You can explain the idea and the practical work still needed, rather than only recognising the slide.
isixhosa_draft: Unokuchaza umbono nomsebenzi osebenzayo osafunekayo, hayi nje ukuqaphela isilayidi.

english: Submit this module → Read the task and self-checks
isixhosa_draft: Thumela le modyuli → Funda umsebenzi neentlolo zokuzihlola

english: The submission form requires a photo and offers an optional voice note. Adding a file only prepares it; Submit sends it. Reconnect before submitting and check the result. An error is not confirmation that your facilitator received it.
isixhosa_draft: Ifom yokuthumela ifuna ifoto kwaye inika inqaku lelizwi elikhethwayo. Ukongeza ifayile kuyilungiselela kuphela; U-Thumela uyithumela. Qhagamshela kwakhona phambi kokuthumela ukhangele isiphumo. Impazamo asiyiqinisekiso sokuba umququzeleli wakho uyifumene.

english: Resubmit replaces the previous submission’s photo and voice note. Check which version you intend to send and keep your originals. If you need help, show your facilitator the task, your attempt and the question you still have.
isixhosa_draft: U-Thumela kwakhona ufaka endaweni yefoto nenqaku lelizwi lokuthunyelwa kwangaphambili. Khangela ukuba yeyiphi inguqulo ofuna ukuyithumela ugcine ezoqobo. Ukuba udinga uncedo, bonisa umququzeleli wakho umsebenzi, ukuzama kwakho nombuzo osenawo.

english: Your evidence belongs to the task, and you distinguish a prepared file from a confirmed submission.
isixhosa_draft: Ubungqina bakho bungabomsebenzi, kwaye wahlula ifayile elungisiweyo kuthumelo oluqinisekisiweyo.

english: Reconnect → Read save messages → Offline & sync if needed
isixhosa_draft: Qhagamshela kwakhona → Funda imiyalezo yokugcina → Ngaphandle kwe-intanethi nokumanyanisa xa kufuneka

english: Ask for help on Studies opens Lima. AI chat and AI reports need a connection. A saved lesson can still be read while you wait; keep a note of your question for a facilitator.
isixhosa_draft: U-Ask for help on Studies uvula u-Lima. Intetho ye-AI neengxelo ze-AI zifuna uqhagamshelwano. Isifundo esigciniweyo sisenokufundwa ngoxa ulinde; gcina inqaku lombuzo wakho kumququzeleli.

english: For fieldwork, Offline & sync has a separate Prepare fieldwork on this device action. Read its results and open saved designs, crop plans and reports online before relying on them away from signal. A lesson download is not a download of every app page or all your farm records.
isixhosa_draft: Kumsebenzi wasentsimini, u-Ngaphandle kwe-intanethi nokumanyanisa unesenzo esahlukileyo esithi Prepare fieldwork on this device. Funda iziphumo zaso uze uvule uyilo olugciniweyo, izicwangciso zezityalo neengxelo usemgceni phambi kokuzithemba ungekho kwisiginali. Ukukhuphela isifundo akukhuphelanga zonke iphepha ze-app okanye zonke iirekhodi zefama yakho.

english: You know what is ready here, what is still waiting to send and what requires a connection.
isixhosa_draft: Uyazi ukuba yintoni ekulungeleyo apha, yintoni esalindele ukuthunyelwa nokuba yintoni efuna uqhagamshelwano.

english: One slide opens, but files are still missing.
isixhosa_draft: Isilayidi esinye siyavuleka, kodwa iifayile zisalahlekile.

english: The module says Finish download. Is the whole module ready to take offline?
isixhosa_draft: Imodyuli ithi Gqiba ukukhuphela. Ngaba imodyuli yonke ikulungele ukuthatha ngaphandle kwe-intanethi?

english: Yes, because the first picture loads
A working picture only proves that picture is available. Other slides or narration may still be missing.
isixhosa_draft: Umfanekiso osebenzayo ubonisa kuphela ukuba lo mfanekiso uyafumaneka. Ezinye izilayidi okanye ukubalisa kusenokulahleka.

english: Finish the download and test it without a connection
isixhosa_draft: Gqiba ukukhuphela uze uvavanye ngaphandle koqhagamshelwano

english: Correct. Check On this phone for that module, then reopen and try its picture, text and narration while briefly disconnected.
isixhosa_draft: Ichanekile. Khangela u-On this phone kuloo modyuli, emva koko uvule kwakhona ukuzame umfanekiso, umbhalo nokubalisa ngoxa unqunyulwe ixesha elifutshane.

english: Mark the module done to finish the download
Mark done records your progress. It does not download missing files or submit your practical evidence.
isixhosa_draft: U-Phawula kugqityiwe urekhoda inkqubela yakho. Akukhupheli iifayile ezilahlekileyo okanye akuthumeli ubungqina bakho obusebenzayo.

english: A saved lesson is one part of learning

Independent practice: choose an available module, explain its size and language, download it and demonstrate its picture, text and voice without a connection. Reconnect afterwards. Name one action that still needs a connection.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuziqhelisa ngokuzimeleyo: khetha imodyuli ekhoyo, uchaze ubungakanani bayo nolwimi, uyikhuphele uze ubonise umfanekiso, umbhalo nelizwi laso ngaphandle koqhagamshelwano. Qhagamshela kwakhona emva koko. Bhekisa isenzo esinye esisafuna uqhagamshelwano.

english: These app guides are separate from assessed modules. Reading this guide does not submit coursework. For your real course, check progress and submission messages in your own account; ask a facilitator about assessment and feedback.
isixhosa_draft: Le mihlahlandlela ye-app ihlukile kwiimodyuli ezivavanyiweyo. Ukufunda lo mhlahlandlela akuthumeli umsebenzi wekhosi. Kwikhosi yakho yokwenyani, khangela inkqubela kunye nemiyalezo yokuthumela kwi-akhawunti yakho; buza umququzeleli ngovavanyo nengxelo.

english: Choose a lesson to take with you
Open My Studies while connected. Start with one available module and test the saved lesson on this device.
isixhosa_draft: Vula u-Izifundo zam uqhagamshelekile. Qala ngemodyuli enye ekhoyo uvavanye isifundo esigciniweyo kwesi sixhobo.

english: A drawing contains a pond, orchard, poultry area and many beds. The household asked for food near home and less carrying. Has the drawing answered the brief?
isixhosa_draft: Umzobo uqulathe ichibi, igadi yeziqhamo, indawo yeenkukhu neebhedi ezininzi. Ikhaya licele ukutya kufutshane nekhaya nokuthwala kancinane. Ngaba umzobo uyiphendulile na isishwankathelo?

english: The learner distinguishes needs from proposed objects, includes the people doing the work, and leaves missing resources visible. A list of attractive features alone does not pass this task.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi wahlula iimfuno kwizinto ezicetywayo, abandakanye abantu abenza umsebenzi, aze ashiye izixhobo ezilahlekileyo zibonakala. Uluhlu lweempawu ezinomtsalane zodwa aluwuphumeleli lo msebenzi.

english: A resident describes water crossing the yard during heavy rain. The visit is dry. How should that information appear in the notes?
isixhosa_draft: Umhlali uchaza amanzi anqumla igceke ngexesha lemvula enkulu. Utyelelo lwenzeka xa kwomile. Ingaba olo lwazi kufuneka lubonakale njani kumanqaku?

english: For each note, record the feature, what is known, how it is known, source/conditions, and what needs checking. Ask a partner to point out any sentence where a guess sounds like a measured fact. Correct the label, not the evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Kwinqaku ngalinye, rekhoda into, oko kwaziwayo, indlela eyaziwa ngayo, umthombo/iimeko, nento ekufuneka ikhangelwe. Cela ozifundela naye akhombe nasiphi na isivakalisi apho ukuqikelela kuvakala njengenyani elinganisiweyo. Lungisa ileyibhile, hayi ubungqina.

english: The learner distinguishes observed, reported, measured, inferred and proposed information, and names a useful next check. More photographs do not automatically mean better evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi wahlula ulwazi olujongiweyo, olubikiweyo, olulinganisiweyo, olukhutshiweyo nolucetywayo, aze abize ukukhangela okulandelayo okuluncedo. Iifoto ezingakumbi azithethi ukuba bubungqina obungcono ngokuzenzekelayo.

english: Is “water always comes from this direction” justified by one dry-day visit?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba “amanzi ahlala evela kule ndlela” luxhaswa kutyelelo olunye lwemini eyomileyo?

english: no. **Reason:** the statement exceeds the evidence. Record the account and seek appropriate observations or assessment.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** ibango lidlula ubungqina. Rekhoda ingxelo ufune ukujonga okufanelekileyo okanye uvavanyo.

english: Evidence guide. Preserve the source with the feature; exporting a picture does not verify the information in it.
isixhosa_draft: Isikhokelo sobungqina. Gcina umthombo kunye nempawu; ukuthumela ngaphandle umfanekiso akuqinisekisi ulwazi olukuwo.

english: A learner moves an existing path on a base map to make room for a proposed bed. What information has been lost?
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi uhambisa indlela esele ikho kwimephu esisiseko ukwenza indawo yebhedi ecetywayo. Luphi ulwazi olulahlekileyo?

english: MAP-A is useful for discussion but lacks dimensions and verified orientation. The learner keeps its “not to scale” label and lists the measurements needed. They cannot claim a new bed fits simply because a small rectangle fits on the sketch.
isixhosa_draft: I-MAP-A iluncedo ekuxoxeni kodwa ayinamilinganiselo nolwalathiso olusiqinisekisiweyo. Umfundi ugcina ileyibhile yayo ethi “ongekho kwisikali” aze abhale imilinganiselo efunekayo. Akanakuthi ibhedi entsha iyangena nje ngenxa yokuba unxande omncinci uyangena emzobeni.

english: Existing and proposed features remain distinct; scale status, orientation status, units and source notes are explicit. Fit is not asserted without the relevant measurements.
isixhosa_draft: Iimpawu ezikhoyo nezicetywayo zihlala zahlukile; imeko yesikali, imeko yolwalathiso, iiyunithi namanqaku omthombo zicacile. Ukungena akuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kwemilinganiselo efanelekileyo.

english: Can a neat exported map turn an estimated boundary into a surveyed one?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba imephu ecocekileyo ethunyelwe ngaphandle inokuguqula umda oqikelelwayo ube ngolinganisiweyo?

english: no. **Reason:** export changes presentation, not the source or certainty of the boundary.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** ukuthumela ngaphandle kutshintsha ukubonakala, hayi umthombo okanye ukuqiniseka komda.

english: One arrow follows a daily watering journey. Another marks a reported wind direction. Do they describe the same kind of information?
isixhosa_draft: Utolo olunye lulandela uhambo lwemihla ngemihla lokunisela. Olunye luphawula ulwalathiso lomoya olubikiweyo. Ingaba zichaza uhlobo olufanayo lolwazi?

english: WALK-A shows containers carried to the existing patch. That supports investigating the care journey. The eastern shade snapshot and TALK-A's water report remain separate evidence. Neither gives enough information to declare a new growing position suitable.
isixhosa_draft: I-WALK-A ibonisa iingqayi ezithwalwa ziye kwindawo esele ikho. Oko kuxhasa ukuphanda uhambo lonophelo. Umfanekiso womthunzi osempuma ingxelo yamanzi ye-TALK-A zihlala zingobungqina obwahlukileyo. Akukho nowodwa onika ulwazi olwaneleyo lokubhengeza ukuba indawo entsha yokutyala ifanelekile.

english: On one overlay, draw actual care journeys and note their purpose and frequency from the household record. On another, show the relevant external influences and evidence sources. Name a place where two needs may conflict. Keep uncertain information visibly uncertain.
isixhosa_draft: Kwishiti enye, zoba uhambo lonophelo lokwenyani uphawule injongo nokuphindaphinda kwalo kwirekhodi yekhaya. Kwenye, bonisa impembelelo yangaphandle efanelekileyo nemithombo yobungqina. Bhekisa indawo apho iimfuno ezimbini zinokuphikisana. Gcina ulwazi olungaqinisekanga lubonakala lungaqiniseki.

english: no. **Reason:** the tool helps organise real activities and care; the site and household determine what belongs there.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** isixhobo sinceda ukucwangcisa imisebenzi yokwenyani nonophelo; indawo nekhaya zigqiba oko kufanele kubekho.

english: The most convenient route to a proposed garden crosses a place where water is reported during heavy rain. What needs checking before choosing that layout?
isixhosa_draft: Eyona ndlela ilula iya kwigadi ecetywayo inqumla indawo apho amanzi ebikwa ngexesha lemvula enkulu. Yintoni ekufuneka ikhangelwe phambi kokukhetha olo lungiselelo?

english: Choose one proposed use. Trace the person's journey, the water it would need and the evidence about its location. List what is known, what could change seasonally, and what must be checked before implementation. Refer to the water, soil and seasonal modules for the technical questions.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ukusetyenziswa okucetywayo okunye. Landela uhambo lomntu, amanzi aza kuwadinga nobungqina bendawo yawo. Bhala oko kwaziwayo, oko kunokutshintsha ngeziqendu zonyaka, nento ekufuneka ikhangelwe phambi kokuqalisa. Bhekisa kwiimodyuli zamanzi, umhlaba neziqendu zonyaka kwimibuzo yobugcisa.

english: Does drawing a swale settle whether it is suitable or safe to build?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukuzoba umsele kugqiba ukuba ufanelekile okanye ukhuselekile ukwakhiwa?

english: The question becomes: “Can the existing patch work better while keeping the route usable?” The learner also keeps relocation and deferring expansion available for comparison. BRIEF-A supports manageable care; WALK-A supports the access concern; RESOURCES-A prevents a claim that expansion is affordable. None of these facts yet chooses the final layout.
isixhosa_draft: Umbuzo uba: “Ingaba indawo esele ikho inokusebenza ngcono ngoxa igcina indlela ingasetyenziswa?” Umfundi ugcina nokuthuthela kwenye indawo nokubambezela ukwandisa kukho ukuze athelekise. I-BRIEF-A ixhasa unonophelo oluphathekayo; i-WALK-A ixhasa inkxalabo yofikelelo; i-RESOURCES-A ithintela ibango lokuba ukwandisa kuyakwazi ukuhlawulelwa. Akukho kwezi nyani okwangoku okukhetha uyilo lokugqibela.

english: Make a decision sheet with columns for the need, evidence reference, implication, possible responses and missing checks. Ask a partner to challenge a response: “What evidence would make you change your mind?” Keep the answer for the concept comparison in D3.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza iphepha lesigqibo elinamakholam esidingo, isalathiso sobungqina, iziphumo, iimpendulo ezinokwenzeka nokukhangela okulahlekileyo. Cela ozifundela naye ukuba ayiphikise impendulo: “Ngubuphi ubungqina obuya kukwenza utshintshe ingqondo?” Gcina impendulo yothelekiso lweengcamango kwi-D3.

english: The learner traces a decision back to evidence, names a trade-off and a reason to revise. The facilitator asks for a fresh explanation if the learner only repeats a principle's name.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi ulandela isigqibo abuyele kubungqina, abize into ekufuneka ayinikele nesizathu sokuhlaziya. Umququzeleli ucela inkcazo entsha ukuba umfundi uphinda ibizo lomgaqo kuphela.

english: no. **Reason:** the components must answer the brief and work together within the site's and household's limits.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** izinto kufuneka ziphendule isishwankathelo zisebenze kunye ngaphakathi kwemida yendawo nekhaya.

english: Compost is placed beside a garden on a drawing. What would make that relationship useful in daily work?
isixhosa_draft: Umgquba ubekwe ecaleni kwegadi emzobeni. Yintoni enokwenza loo nxulumano luluncedo emsebenzini wemihla ngemihla?

english:
A useful connection is more than a line between two objects. Ask what each part needs, what it produces, who cares for it and how things move between the parts. A compost area may receive suitable material and supply finished compost, but someone must sort, carry and manage it. Its position must allow that work and suit local hygiene and site conditions.

Write needs and outputs beside the elements you are considering. Include water, suitable materials, space, access, time and skills. Do not count an output before it is available and suitable for its intended use. A proposed animal system does not provide free fertility: animals also require care, feed, water, welfare and management of wastes.

Look for useful connections, but also conflicts. A convenient position might obstruct a route. One person's useful output might create another person's handling burden. A connection that needs daily attention can fail if nobody agrees to provide it. Keep bought inputs and materials leaving the site in the picture; a neat cycle diagram does not prove that everything is supplied on site.
isixhosa_draft:
Unxulumano oluncedo ungaphezu komgca phakathi kwezinto ezibini. Buza ukuba inxalenye nganye iyidingayo, ivelisa ntoni, ngubani oyinyamekelayo nokuba izinto ziqhutywa njani phakathi kwamacandelo. Indawo yomgquba inokwamkela izinto ezifanelekileyo ize inike umgquba ogqityiweyo, kodwa kufuneka umntu ahlele, athwale aze aphathe. Indawo yawo kufuneka ivumele loo msebenzi kwaye ifanele ucoceko lwendawo neemeko zesiza.

Bhala iimfuno nezinto ezivelisiweyo ecaleni kweempawu ozicingayo. Bandakanya amanzi, izinto ezifanelekileyo, indawo, ufikelelo, ixesha nezakhono. Musa ukubala into evelisiweyo phambi kokuba ikhoyo ifaneleke injongo yayo. Inkqubo yezilwanyana ecetywayo ayinikeli kunonga umhlaba kwasimahla: izilwanyana nazo zifuna unonophelo, ukutya, amanzi, impilo yazo kunye nolawulo lwenkunkuma.

Khangela unxulumano oluluncedo, kodwa ukhangele nokungavisisani. Indawo elungileyo inokuvala indlela. Into evelisiweyo eluncedo komnye umntu ingadala umthwalo wokuyiphatha komnye. Unxulumano oludinga ingqalelo yemihla ngemihla lunokuphoxa ukuba akukho mntu uvumayo ukuluhlangabezana. Gcina izinto ezithengiweyo nezinto ezishiya indawo zibonakala; umzobo wesangqa ococekileyo awubonisi ukuba yonke into ibonelelwa kwindawo.

english: Draw the needs, outputs, journeys and responsible people for the elements in your brief. Circle an assumed connection and name the evidence needed to confirm it. Use the appropriate technical module before proposing a material's use.
isixhosa_draft: Zoba iimfuno, izinto ezivelisiweyo, uhambo nabantu abanoxanduva lweempawu ezikwisishwankathelo sakho. Rhawula unxulumano olucingelwayo uze ubize ubungqina obufunekayo ukuluqinisekisa. Sebenzisa imodyuli yobugcisa efanelekileyo phambi kokucebisa ukusetyenziswa kwento.

english: The learner explains a real connection, its care requirement and a possible conflict, without promising a closed or maintenance-free system.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi uchaza unxulumano lokwenyani, imfuno yaso yonophelo nongquzulwano olunokwenzeka, ngaphandle kokuthembisa inkqubo evaliweyo okanye engafuni kugcinwa.

english: Does an arrow from animals to a garden prove that the garden needs no other fertility inputs?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba utolo olusuka kwizilwanyana luye kwigadi luqinisekisa ukuba igadi ayidingi zinye izinto ezinonga umhlaba?

english: no. **Reason:** amounts, suitability, losses, other inputs and crop requirements have not been established.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** izixa, ukufaneleka, iilahleko, ezinye izinto ezifakwayo neemfuno zezityalo azikaqinisekiswa.

english: Draw alternative concepts on copies of the same base. Under each, write its intended benefit, likely burden, important unknown and what would rule it out. Ask a partner whether both options use the same evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Zoba iingcamango ezizezinye kwiikopi zesiseko esifanayo. Phantsi kwenye nganye, bhala inzuzo yayo ehlosiweyo, umthwalo onokwenzeka, into engaziwayo ebalulekileyo nento eyayiya kuyiphelisa. Buza ozifundela naye ukuba iinketho zombini zisebenzisa ubungqina obufanayo na.

english: Alternatives differ meaningfully, preserve existing facts and are compared on equal assumptions. Sketches remain labelled as concepts rather than build-ready plans.
isixhosa_draft: Ezinye iinketho ziyahluka ngokunentsingiselo, zigcina iinyani ezikhoyo kwaye zithelekiswa ngeengcinga ezilinganayo. Imizobo isaphawulwe njengeengcamango kunokuba izicwangciso ezikulungele ukwakhiwa.

english: One option looks better in a rendered picture. The other better preserves daily access. What should the decision record explain?
isixhosa_draft: Enye inketho ibonakala ingcono kumfanekiso owenziwe. Enye igcina ngcono ufikelelo lwemihla ngemihla. Irekhodi lesigqibo kufuneka lichaze ntoni?

english: Complete a comparison sheet: criterion, supporting evidence, implication for each option, remaining check and decision. Present the strongest argument for the option you did not choose. Then record the household's response.
isixhosa_draft: Gqibezela iphepha lothelekiso: umgangatho, ubungqina obuxhasayo, iziphumo kwinketho nganye, ukukhangela okusele nesigqibo. Nikela ingxoxo eyomeleleyo kakhulu ngenketho ongayikhethanga. Emva koko rekhoda impendulo yekhaya.

english: The choice follows the brief and evidence, acknowledges a trade-off and specifies a reason to reconsider. A principle's name alone is not a justification.
isixhosa_draft: Ukhetho lulandela isishwankathelo nobungqina, luvuma into ekufuneka inikelwe kwaye lubeka isizathu sokuphinda ucinge. Igama lomgaqo kuwodwa aliyisizathu.

english: Can several attractive benefits compensate for blocking the only agreed access route?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba iinzuzo ezininzi ezinomtsalane zinokuhlawulela ukuvala indlela yofikelelo eyodwa evunyelweneyo?

english: not without resolving that access requirement with the people affected. **Reason:** a numerical total or attractive illustration cannot erase a necessary condition.
isixhosa_draft: hayi ngaphandle kokuxazulula leyo mfuno yofikelelo nabantu abachaphazelekayo. **Isizathu:** isixa sezinombolo okanye umfanekiso onomtsalane awunako ukucima imeko eyimfuneko.

english: A proposed bed fits on a sketch. What must be known before saying it fits on the ground?
isixhosa_draft: Ibhedi ecetywayo iyangena kumzobo. Kufuneka kwaziwe ntoni phambi kokuba kuthiwe iyangena emhlabeni?

english:
A concept explains an arrangement. A developed layout must also show whether its parts fit the available space. Return to the base-map measurements. Check the boundaries relevant to the work, the existing features, access and the distances needed to place the proposal. Keep the measurement method and units with the record.

Use a consistent scale for the plan. Check a known distance against that scale rather than trusting how large the picture looks on a screen. Resizing an image can change its printed scale. A dimension label and the drawn geometry should agree; if they disagree, find the source of the error before using either.

Allow for working access and the needs of the selected system. Do not borrow a universal spacing from a decorative drawing. Use the approved technical source for the actual crop, structure or system, including growth and maintenance needs. If the required dimension is unknown, mark that part incomplete.
isixhosa_draft:
Ingcamango ichaza ulungiselelo. Uyilo olwandisiweyo kufuneka lubonise nokuba amacandelo alo ayangena kwindawo ekhoyo. Buyela kwimilinganiselo yemephu esisiseko. Khangela imida ehambelana nomsebenzi, iimpawu ezikhoyo, ufikelelo nemigama efunekayo ukubeka isiphakamiso. Gcina indlela yokulinganisa neeyunithi kunye nerekhodi.

Sebenzisa isikali esingaguquki kwisicwangciso. Khangela umgama owaziwayo ngokuchasene nesikali endaweni yokuthemba ubukhulu bomfanekiso kwisikrini. Ukutshintsha ubungakanani bomfanekiso kunokutshintsha isikali sawo esishicilelweyo. Ileyibhile yomlinganiselo nejometri ezotyiweyo mazivumelane; ukuba aziyivumelani, fumana umthombo wempazamo phambi kokusebenzisa nawuphi na.

Shiya indawo yofikelelo lomsebenzi neemfuno zenkqubo ekhethiweyo. Musa ukuboleka ibanga eliqhelekileyo kumzobo wokuhombisa. Sebenzisa umthombo wobugcisa ovunyiweyo wesityalo, isakhiwo okanye inkqubo yokwenyani, kuquka iimfuno zokukhula nokugcinwa. Ukuba umlinganiselo ofunekayo awaziwa, phawula loo nxalenye njengengagqitywanga.

english: MAP-A is not to scale. The busy-yard learner cannot yet prove that a new bed fits beside the route. They list the measurements needed and preserve the existing path. The correct next step is to obtain a suitable measured base, not shrink the path until the picture looks finished.
isixhosa_draft: I-MAP-A ayikho kwisikali. Umfundi wegceke elixakekileyo akakakwazi ukubonisa ukuba ibhedi entsha iyangena ecaleni kwendlela. Ubhala imilinganiselo efunekayo agcine indlela esele ikho. Inyathelo elilandelayo elichanekileyo kukufumana isiseko esilinganisiweyo esifanelekileyo, hayi ukunciphisa indlela de umfanekiso ubonakale ugqityiwe.

english: The learner uses consistent units, checks fit against evidence and refuses to claim missing dimensions. This task cannot be passed from the unmeasured busy-yard sketch alone.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi usebenzisa iiyunithi ezingaguquki, ujonga ukungena ngobungqina aze angabi nalo ibango ngemilinganiselo elahlekileyo. Lo msebenzi awunakuphumeleliswa kumzobo wegceke elixakekileyo ongalinganiswanga yedwa.

english: Does zooming in on the app make an estimated distance more accurate?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukukhulisa kwi-app kwenza umgama oqikelelwayo uchaneke ngakumbi?

english: no. **Reason:** zoom changes the view, not the measurement source.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** ukukhulisa kutshintsha ukubonakala, hayi umthombo wokulinganisa.

english: Every planned feature fits within the boundary. Is the whole plan ready to implement?
isixhosa_draft: Yonke impawu icetywayo ingena ngaphakathi komda. Ingaba lonke icwangciso likulungele ukuphunyezwa?

english: Walk through the proposed daily routine using the map. Mark a possible conflict, the evidence needed to resolve it and who should help. Check both normal use and a relevant disruption. Refer to the technical modules rather than supplying a guessed dimension or capacity.
isixhosa_draft: Hamba ngomsebenzi wemihla ngemihla ocetywayo usebenzisa imephu. Phawula ungquzulwano olunokwenzeka, ubungqina obufunekayo ukulixazulula nokuba ngubani ofanele anceda. Khangela ukusetyenziswa okuqhelekileyo nokuphazamiseka okufanelekileyo. Bhekisa kwiimodyuli zobugcisa endaweni yokunika umlinganiselo okanye umthamo oqikelelwayo.

english: A map has beautiful plants but no distinction between existing and proposed features. What might the person doing the work misunderstand?
isixhosa_draft: Imephu inezityalo ezintle kodwa akukho umahluko phakathi kweempawu ezikhoyo nezicetywayo. Umntu owenza umsebenzi angaqonda gwenxa ntoni?

english: MAP-A keeps its “not to scale” status in every export. A proposal view must not lose that limitation merely because it receives a polished background. The learner uses separate labels for the retained patch and any future idea.
isixhosa_draft: I-MAP-A igcina imeko yayo ethi “ayikho kwisikali” kuyo yonke into ethunyelwe ngaphandle. Ukujonga isiphakamiso akufuneki kulahlekelwe ngulo mda nje ngenxa yokufumana imvelaphi egudisiweyo. Umfundi usebenzisa iileyibhile ezahlukeneyo kwindawo egciniweyo nakuyo nayiphi na ingcamango yexesha elizayo.

english: Another reader can correctly interpret the plan, and the learner has checked a real export. An export button being clicked is not sufficient.
isixhosa_draft: Omnye umfundi uyakwazi ukutolika isicwangciso ngokuchanekileyo, kwaye umfundi ukhangele into ethunyelwe ngaphandle yokwenyani. Ukucofa iqhosha lokuthumela ngaphandle akwanelanga.

english: Is an AI illustration evidence that the saved plan contains the same geometry?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba umfanekiso we-AI ubungqina bokuba isicwangciso esigciniweyo siqulethe ijometri efanayo?

english: no. **Reason:** the illustration and measured plan have different evidential roles; inspect the actual plan and its sources.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** umfanekiso nesicwangciso esilinganisiweyo zinendima eyahlukileyo yobungqina; hlola isicwangciso sokwenyani nemithombo yaso.

english: Plants have been bought, but the proposed area has no agreed care or reliable water arrangement. Which dependency was missed?
isixhosa_draft: Izityalo ziyathengwa, kodwa indawo ecetywayo ayinalo unonophelo olwavunyelwana ngalo okanye ulungiselelo oluthembekileyo lwamanzi. Kulahlekile ukuxhomekeka kuphi?

english: Make an ordered list with an action, prerequisites, responsible person, readiness evidence and next review point. Ask a partner to find something that has been placed before its prerequisite. Correct the sequence and explain why.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza uluhlu olulandelelanayo olunesenzo, izinto ezifunekayo kuqala, umntu onoxanduva, ubungqina bokulungela kunye nendawo elandelayo yokuphonononga. Cela ozifundela naye afumane nantoni na ebekwe phambi kwento ayidingayo kuqala. Lungisa ulandelelwano uze uchaze isizathu.

english: Is a proposed planting phase ready because the seedlings are available?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba inqanaba lokutyala elicetywayo likulungele kuba izithole ziyafumaneka?

english: not from that fact alone. **Reason:** the destination, suitable conditions, resources and continuing care also need to be ready.
isixhosa_draft: hayi ngokweso sizathu kuphela. **Isizathu:** indawo eya kuyo, iimeko ezifanelekileyo, izixhobo nonophelo oluqhubekayo nazo kufuneka zibe zikulungele.

english: no. **Reason:** zero states a known value; missing information requires a separate unknown and a follow-up action.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** u-zero uthi ixabiso elaziwayo; ulwazi olulahlekileyo lufuna into engaziwayo eyahlukileyo nesenzo sokulandela.

english: A project has an installation team but no agreed person to look after it afterwards. What is incomplete?
isixhosa_draft: Iprojekthi inethimba lokufaka kodwa akukho mntu uvunyelweneyo ukuyinyamekela emva koko. Yintoni engagqitywanga?

english: Make a care sheet with task, reason, responsible person, required resources, evidence-based timing or trigger, backup arrangement and record. Discuss a disruption with the household or practice partner and revise the proposal if its care cannot be supported.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza iphepha lonophelo elinomsebenzi, isizathu, umntu onoxanduva, izixhobo ezifunekayo, ixesha okanye isizathu esisekelwe kubungqina, ulungiselelo lokuxhasa nerekhodi. Xoxa ngokuphazamiseka nekhaya okanye nozifundela naye, uhlaziye isiphakamiso ukuba unonophelo lwaso alunakuxhaswa.

english: The learner distinguishes installation from maintenance, records agreement and shows how care capacity affects scope.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi wahlula ukufakwa kunonophelo, arekhode isivumelwano aze abonise indlela umthamo wonophelo ochaphazela ngayo ububanzi.

english: Can an installation photograph show that ongoing care has been arranged?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ifoto yokufakwa inokubonisa ukuba unonophelo oluqhubekayo lulungisiwe?

english: no. **Reason:** it records appearance at a moment; care requires responsibilities, resources and follow-up evidence.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** irekhoda ukubonakala ngelixesha elithile; unonophelo ludinga uxanduva, izixhobo nobungqina bolandelelo.

english: The busy-yard learner explains why access and care shaped the provisional choice. They show that water and measurements are still unresolved. A claim that the plan is ready to construct would not follow from that evidence, however attractive the presentation.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi wegceke elixakekileyo uchaza ukuba kutheni ufikelelo nonophelo zibumbe ukhetho lwexeshana. Ubonisa ukuba amanzi nemilinganiselo zisengaxazululwanga. Ibango lokuba isicwangciso sikulungele ukwakhiwa ayinakuvela kobo bungqina, nokuba ukubonisa kuhle kangakanani.

english: Does a confident presentation resolve an unknown water supply?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukubonisa ngokuzithemba kuxazulula ukubakho kwamanzi okungaziwayo?

english: no. **Reason:** speaking clearly can communicate evidence; it cannot create missing evidence.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** ukuthetha ngokucacileyo kunokudlulisa ubungqina; akukwazi ukudala ubungqina obulahlekileyo.

english: The busy-yard brief suggests following access usability and care demands. There is no claimed later harvest or success story in the supplied case. The learner prepares an observation sheet and explains what would count as useful evidence; they cannot fill it with invented results.
isixhosa_draft: Isishwankathelo segceke elixakekileyo sicebisa ukulandela ukusebenziseka kofikelelo neemfuno zonophelo. Akukho sivuno samva okanye ibali lempumelelo elibangwayo kwityala elinikeziweyo. Umfundi ulungiselela iphepha lokujonga aze achaze oko kuya kubalwa njengobungqina obuluncedo; akanakulizalisa ngeziphumo eziyilisiweyo.

english: Link each priority to an observation, a source or method, the person responsible and an agreed review point. State what the observation can and cannot demonstrate. Use practice data only if clearly labelled as supplied classroom data.
isixhosa_draft: Dibanisa eyona nto ibalulekileyo nganye nokujonga, umthombo okanye indlela, umntu onoxanduva nendawo yokuphonononga evunyelweneyo. Chaza oko ukujonga kunokukubonisa nokungenakukubonisa. Sebenzisa idatha yokuziqhelisa kuphela ukuba iphawulwe ngokucacileyo njengedatha yeklasi enikeziweyo.

english: The monitoring plan matches the brief and distinguishes planned, reported and observed results. No outcome is claimed before evidence exists.
isixhosa_draft: Isicwangciso sokujonga sihambelana nesishwankathelo kwaye sahlula iziphumo ezicetywayo, ezibikiweyo nezijongiweyo. Akukho siphumo sibangwayo phambi kokuba ubungqina bukhona.

english: no. **Reason:** that claim needs appropriate financial evidence and context, not appearance alone.
isixhosa_draft: hayi. **Isizathu:** ibango elo lidinga ubungqina bezemali ezifanelekileyo nomxholo, hayi ukubonakala kuphela.

english: New evidence changes a placement decision. Should the old plan disappear without a record of what changed?
isixhosa_draft: Ubungqina obutsha butshintsha isigqibo sokubeka. Ingaba isicwangciso esidala kufuneka sinyamalale ngaphandle kwerekhodi yoko kutshintshileyo?

english: Make a revision record with the question, new evidence, affected decision, change and connected records updated. Ask a partner to use the handover pack to explain the next action and what remains on hold. If they cannot, improve the pack and try again.
isixhosa_draft: Yenza irekhodi lohlaziyo elinombuzo, ubungqina obutsha, isigqibo esichaphazelekayo, utshintsho neerekhodi ezidibeneyo ezihlaziyiweyo. Cela ozifundela naye asebenzise ipakethe yokudlulisela ukuchaza isenzo esilandelayo nento esamiswe. Ukuba akakwazi, phucula ipakethe uphinde uzame.

english: The learner explains a justified revision, preserves its reason and produces a usable handover. The facilitator records demonstrated, needs another attempt or not yet observed with evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Umfundi uchaza uhlaziyo olunesizathu, agcine isizathu saso aze enze ipakethe yokudlulisela esetyenzisekayo. Umququzeleli urekhoda ukuba kuboniswe, kufuna ukuzama kwakhona okanye akukajongwa ngobungqina.

english: Is changing only the picture enough when the proposal's material quantities change?
isixhosa_draft: Ingaba ukutshintsha umfanekiso kuphela kwanele xa ubungakanani bezixhobo zesiphakamiso butshintsha?

english: If a learner can repeat the rule but misses the changed record, simplify to two fields and then reintroduce the date. Success requires finding an error in a fresh example, not reciting “check the receipt”.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi unokuphinda umthetho kodwa aphosise irekhodi elitshintshileyo, yenza lula ube ngamacandelo amabini kuphela uze uphinde uzise umhla. Impumelelo ifuna ukufumana impazamo kumzekelo omtsha, hayi ukuphinda “khangela irisithi”.

english: If the learner enters bunches as kilograms, hold up the written unit and ask what was actually measured. Weigh a comparable practice bundle or keep its count in a separate record. No conversion is supplied in this pack. If the learner records all remaining produce as home food, point to the crate that is still present. Remaining stock and food already used are different destinations.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuba umfundi ufaka izixha njengeekhilogram, phakamisa iyunithi ebhaliweyo ubuze ukuba kwalinganiswa ntoni ngokwenene. Pima isixha sokuziqhelisa esifanayo okanye ugcine inani laso kwirekhodi eyahlukileyo. Akukho kuguqulwa kunikezelwe kweli pakethe. Ukuba umfundi urekhoda yonke imveliso eseleyo njengokutya kwasekhaya, khomba ibhokisi esekhona. Isitokhwe esisalayo nokutya esele kusetyenzisiwe zindawo ezahlukeneyo eziya kuzo.

english: Choose one product and a short agreed period. Write the opening amount, unit and how it was measured. Keep source references for additions and destinations. Compare with a separate closing count and list anything unresolved. Do not invent a weight for an unweighed bundle.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha imveliso enye nexesha elifutshane elivunyelweneyo. Bhala isixa sokuqala, iyunithi nendlela ebalinganiswa ngayo. Gcina izalathiso zomthombo kongezwayo nakwindawo eya kuyo. Thelekisa nokubala kokuvala okwahlukileyo uze ubhale nantoni na engaxazululwanga. Musa ukuyila ubunzima besixha esingapimiwe.

english: The download could not be prepared. Keep this page open and try again.
isixhosa_draft: Ukukhuphela akukwazanga ukulungiswa. Gcina eli phepha livuliwe uze uzame kwakhona.
Umzobo onokuskrolwa wesicwangciso segceke seklasi esiyilisiweyo

english: Metres · x increases right; y increases down
isixhosa_draft: Iimitha · x inyuka ukuya ekunene; y inyuka ukuya ezantsi

english: Top edge is model north by classroom convention only
isixhosa_draft: Umphetho ongaphezulu ngumntla wemodeli ngokwesiko leklasi kuphela

english: FICTIONAL CLASSROOM MODEL · VIEW {view} · CURRENT PACK {pack} · NOT A SURVEY OR CONSTRUCTION DRAWING
isixhosa_draft: IMODELI EYILELWE · IMBONAKALO {view} · IPAKETHE {pack} · ASIYO UPHANDO OKANYE UMZOBO WOKWAKHA

english: Teaching frame — model geometry only; not a boundary or land-rights record
isixhosa_draft: Isakhelo sokufundisa — jometri yemodeli kuphela; asingumda wamalungelo omhlaba

english: No physical print scale is claimed

isixhosa_draft: W-OBS: ingxaki yamanzi ebikiweyo kwigceke elisempuma

english: Water reportedly crosses the eastern yard in heavy rain.
isixhosa_draft: Kuxelwa ukuba amanzi anqumla igceke elisempuma ngemvula enkulu.

english: Legend · marks are references to source cards, not proof of suitability
isixhosa_draft: Intsingiselo · iimpawu zisalathiso zamakhadi omthombo, hayi ubungqina bokufaneleka

english: 3 Existing route · E-ROUTE · footprint only, not clearance guidance
isixhosa_draft: 3 Indlela ekhoyo · E-ROUTE · indawo yayo kuphela, hayi isikhokelo sobubanzi

english: 4 Water point · E-WATER · W-OBS does not establish quantity, quality or reliability
isixhosa_draft: 4 Indawo yamanzi · E-WATER · W-OBS ayiseki ubungakanani, umgangatho okanye ukuthembeka

english: 7 Alternative B growing area · P-B-PLOT · W-B
isixhosa_draft: 7 Indawo yokulima yenye indlela B · P-B-PLOT · W-B

english: Agree the task before drawing a solution.
Ask the learner to trace a need to the household brief and a mapped feature to its evidence. A tidy map with an unexplained boundary or no measurement source needs more work.
isixhosa_draft: Cela umfundi alandele isidingo asibuyisele kwisishwankathelo sekhaya kwaye alandele into ekwimephu ayibuyisele kubungqina bayo. Imephu ecocekileyo enomda ongachazwanga okanye engenamthombo wokulinganisa idinga umsebenzi ongakumbi.

english: In the busy-yard case, BRIEF-A requires food, usable access and manageable care. WALK-A records a water point beside the home. TALK-A is a resident’s rain report. MAP-A remains not to scale; there is no verified boundary or dimension pack.
isixhosa_draft: Kwityala legceke elixakekileyo, i-BRIEF-A ifuna ukutya, ufikelelo olusebenzayo nonophelo oluphathekayo. I-WALK-A irekhoda indawo yamanzi ecaleni kwekhaya. I-TALK-A yingxelo yemvula yomhlali. I-MAP-A ihlala ingekho kwisikali; akukho pakethe yomda okanye yemilinganiselo eqinisekisiweyo.

english: Record the agreed needs, who uses and cares for the place, and what must remain usable. Note what is outside this phase. Use roles or initials if you prefer.
isixhosa_draft: Rekhoda iimfuno ezivunyelweneyo, ukuba ngubani osebenzisa aze anyamekele indawo, nento ekufuneka ihlale isebenza. Phawula oko kungaphandle kweli nqanaba. Sebenzisa iindima okanye oonobumba abaqala amagama ukuba uyathanda.

english: What do you know, and where did it come from?
Which base map and measurements will you use?
isixhosa_draft: Yeyiphi imephu esisiseko nemilinganiselo oza kuyisebenzisa?

english: Record the drawing name and revision. Keep existing features, access, boundary status, orientation, units and measurement method with it. List missing measurements. Keep the actual drawing separately with this folder.
isixhosa_draft: Rekhoda igama lomzobo nohlaziyo lwawo. Gcina kunye nawo iimpawu ezikhoyo, ufikelelo, imeko yomda, ulwalathiso, iiyunithi nendlela yokulinganisa. Bhala imilinganiselo elahlekileyo. Gcina umzobo wokwenyani ngokwahlukeneyo kunye nale folda.

english: The watering journey makes care and access worth investigating. It does not prove a new location is suitable. The eastern shade observation and reported rain crossing still need follow-up evidence.
isixhosa_draft: Uhambo lokunisela lwenza unonophelo nofikelelo lufanele ukuphandwa. Aluboniswa ukuba indawo entsha ifanelekile. Ukujonga umthunzi osempuma nokunqumla kwamanzi emvula okubikiweyo kusadinga ubungqina bolandelelo.

english: Refer to evidence about movement, water, shade, seasons, soil and exposure. Distinguish frequency of use from outside influences. Keep one visit separate from a seasonal pattern.
isixhosa_draft: Bhekisa kubungqina bokuhamba, amanzi, umthunzi, iziqendu zonyaka, umhlaba nokuvezwa. Wahlula rhoqo lokusetyenziswa kwimpembelelo zangaphandle. Gcina utyelelo olunye lwahlukile kwiphethini yexesha lonyaka.

english: Turn observations into questions. Explain whose needs each question serves and which options remain open.
isixhosa_draft: Guqula oko ukubonileyo kube yimibuzo. Chaza ukuba umbuzo ngamnye usebenzela iimfuno zabani nokuba zeziphi iinketho ezisavulekile.

english: Compare ways to meet the same brief.
Ask the learner to explain a genuine trade-off between alternatives. More features or a prettier picture do not establish a better response to the brief.
isixhosa_draft: Cela umfundi achaze into enyanisekileyo ekufuneka inikelwe phakathi kwezinye iinketho. Iimpawu ezingakumbi okanye umfanekiso omhle akusekanga impendulo engcono kwisishwankathelo.

english: Concept A investigates care of the existing patch. Concept B considers another location while retaining access. The case provisionally favours investigating A; it does not establish that A is cheaper or B produces more.
isixhosa_draft: Ingcamango A iphanda unonophelo lwendawo esele ikho. Ingcamango B iqwalasela enye indawo ngoxa igcina ufikelelo. Ityala lithanda okwexeshana ukuphanda i-A; aliseki ukuba i-A ibiza kancinane okanye i-B ivelisa ngakumbi.

english: What does each proposed part need and give?
isixhosa_draft: Inxalenye nganye ecetywayo ifuna ntoni, inika ntoni?

english: Which option will you investigate or develop, and why?
isixhosa_draft: Yeyiphi inketho oza kuyiphanda okanye uyiphuhlise, kwaye kutheni?

english: A plan that can be checked
Show what fits, what connects and what is still unresolved.
isixhosa_draft: Bonisa oko kungena, oko kunxulumeneyo nokusengaxazululwanga.

english: Ask the learner to demonstrate fit from measurements and follow a daily journey through the actual proposal. A software placement or attractive export alone does not establish suitability.
isixhosa_draft: Cela umfundi abonise ukungena ngemilinganiselo alandele uhambo lwemihla ngemihla kwisiphakamiso sokwenyani. Ukubekwa kwesoftiwe okanye into ethunyelwe ngaphandle emnandi ayiseki ukufaneleka.

english: The busy-yard case has no measured source pack. A learner should mark the scaled layout as unfinished. The completed drawing and fit check cannot be demonstrated from MAP-A alone.
isixhosa_draft: Ityala legceke elixakekileyo alinayo ipakethe yomthombo olinganisiweyo. Umfundi kufuneka aphawule ulungiselelo olusikaliweyo njengolungagqitywanga. Umzobo ogqityiweyo nokukhangela ukungena akunakubonakaliswa kwi-MAP-A yodwa.

english: Which drawings show the developed proposal?

List the base, analysis, proposal and detail sheets with their revision, scale status, units, legend and sources. Reference the actual files or paper sheets; typing their names here does not attach them.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala amaphepha esiseko, uhlalutyo, isiphakamiso neenkcukacha anohlaziyo lwawo, imeko yesikali, iiyunithi, intsingiselo nemithombo. Bhekisa kwiifayile zokwenyani okanye amaphepha okwenyani; ukuchwetheza amagama azo apha akuziqhotyoshelanga.

english: How have you checked fit and access?
What work is conditional or on hold?
Connect the drawing to feasible work and agreed responsibilities.
isixhosa_draft: Dibanisa umzobo nomsebenzi onokwenzeka noxanduva olwavunyelwanayo.

english: List the phases, their prerequisites and who agrees that a phase is ready. Include checks before spending or starting work. Keep items with unresolved dependencies on hold.
isixhosa_draft: Bhala amanqanaba, izinto ezifunekayo kuqala nokuba ngubani ovumayo ukuba inqanaba likulungele. Quka ukukhangela phambi kokusebenzisa imali okanye ukuqala umsebenzi. Gcina izinto ezinokuxhomekeka okungaxazululwanga zimisiwe.

english: Who has agreed to care for the system?
Ask what evidence would change the learner’s choice. Review a real explanation and revision record; filled boxes do not demonstrate competence or certify construction work.
isixhosa_draft: Buza ukuba bungowuphi ubungqina obunokutshintsha ukhetho lomfundi. Phonononga inkcazo yokwenyani nerekhodi lohlaziyo; iibhokisi ezizaliswe azibonisi ukukwazi okanye azingqinisi umsebenzi wokwakha.

english: What did the household or reviewer say?
Record the date, role of the reviewer, the drawing revision discussed, what they understood and what needs another attempt. Explain how your choices answer the original brief.
isixhosa_draft: Rekhoda umhla, indima yomphononongi, uhlaziyo lomzobo oxoxiweyo, oko bakuqondileyo nento efuna ukuzama kwakhona. Chaza ukuba ukhetho lwakho luyiphendula njani into eyayikwisishwankathelo sokuqala.

english: How will you find out whether it is working?
Choose observations connected to the household’s needs. Record the starting evidence, who agrees to observe, when or after which event, and what would prompt a review. Do not invent results.
isixhosa_draft: Khetha ukujonga okunxulumene neemfuno zekhaya. Rekhoda ubungqina bokuqala, ngubani ovumayo ukujonga, nini okanye emva kokuphi isiganeko, nento eya kubangela uphononongo. Musa ukuyila iziphumo.

english: What changed, why, and what is the next step?
isixhosa_draft: Yintoni etshintshileyo, kutheni, kwaye linyathelo luphi olilandelayo?

english: Your folder is empty. Save your notes before leaving.
isixhosa_draft: Ifolda yakho ayinanto. Gcina amanqaku akho phambi kokuhamba.

The saved folder could not be opened. Its stored copy has not been replaced. You can write here and download a text copy.

english: Keep this work by downloading a text copy. The unreadable stored draft is protected.
isixhosa_draft: Gcina lo msebenzi ngokukhuphela ikopi yombhalo. Uyilo olugciniweyo olungafundekiyo luvikelekile.

english: You have notes to save. Save before following another lesson link.
isixhosa_draft: Unamanqaku okugcina. Gcina phambi kokulandela ikhonkco lesinye isifundo.

english: This saved folder changed in another tab. Download your current notes before reopening the saved folder. This page has not overwritten it.
isixhosa_draft: Le folda egciniweyo itshintshile kwenye ithebhu. Khuphela amanqaku akho angoku phambi kokuvula kwakhona ifolda egciniweyo. Eli phepha alibhalanga ngaphezulu kwayo.

english: Saved for this sample session. Download a copy before ending the session.
isixhosa_draft: Kugcinwe kule seshoni yomzekelo. Khuphela ikopi phambi kokuphelisa iseshoni.
