isixhosa_draft: Vuna amagqabi uphinde uvune — vuna amagqabi angaphandle kwaye isityalo siqhubeka sivelisa iinyanga ezininzi.

english: Thin seedlings early — each "seed" is actually a cluster of several.
isixhosa_draft: Hlutha izithole kwangoko — "imbewu" nganye ngokwenene liqela leembewu ezininzi.

english: Long-season crop — sow into trays in autumn and transplant when the seedlings are ready; this is usually 4–6 weeks in warm conditions and can take twice as long in cold conditions.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo sexesha elide — hlwayela kwiitreyi ekwindla uze utshintshele xa izithole zilungile; oku kudla ngokuba yiiveki ezi-4–6 kwiimeko ezifudumeleyo kwaye kunokuthatha ixesha eliphindwe kabini kwiimeko ezibandayo.

english: Stake or cage plants early; feed consistently once fruit starts to set.
isixhosa_draft: Misa izityalo ngeentonga okanye ngamakheji kwangoko; zondle ngokuqhubekayo xa iziqhamo ziqala ukubamba.

english: The timing, yield and spacing basis is sweet pepper. Start seed in trays in a warm spot; other pepper types may need different spacing.
isixhosa_draft: Ixesha, isivuno nesithuba kusekwe kwi-sweet pepper. Qala imbewu kwiitreyi kwindawo efudumeleyo; ezinye iindidi ze-pepper zinokufuna isithuba esahlukileyo.

english: A smaller, hotter relative of sweet pepper — yield here is roughly half the Peppers figure, not the same number relabelled. Start seed in trays in a warm spot.
isixhosa_draft: Isihlobo esincinci nesishushu se-sweet pepper — isivuno apha sisisiqingatha seso se-Peppers, hayi inani elifanayo elinikwe igama elitsha. Qala imbewu kwiitreyi kwindawo efudumeleyo.

english: Plant certified seed potatoes and earth up the stems as they grow to prevent greening.
isixhosa_draft: Tyala i-seed potatoes eziqinisekisiweyo uze unyuse umhlaba ngeziqu njengoko zikhula ukuthintela ukuluhlaza.

english: Cured 15-20°C/85-90% RH for 5-10 days, then kept dark and naturally ventilated averaging ~15°C or cooler, no sprout inhibitor.
isixhosa_draft: Ziphilisiwe (cured) kwi-15-20°C/85-90% RH iintsuku ezi-5-10, emva koko zigcinwe ebumnyameni zifumana umoya ngokwemvelo kubushushu obulinganisa ~15°C okanye ngaphantsi, kungekho sithintelo sokuhluma.

english: The duration covers butter/head-type uncertainty. Lettuce bolts quickly in heat — sow little and often rather than one big batch.
isixhosa_draft: Ixesha liquka ukungaqiniseki kwohlobo lwe-butter/head. I-lettuce iqhakaza ngokukhawuleza ebushushini — hlwayela kancinci rhoqo kunokuba uhlwayele ibhetshi enye enkulu.

english: Unshelled (in-shell) pods dried to in-shell moisture ~10% or less, stored in gunny bags, mud bins, baskets or a ventilated dry room, protected from pests and damp.
isixhosa_draft: Iipodi ezingaxobulwanga (in-shell) ezomiswe zaya kumswakama we-in-shell ongama-~10% okanye ngaphantsi, zigcinwe kwiingxowa zegunny, kwiibhini zodaka, kwiingobozi okanye egumbini elomileyo elifumana umoya, zikhuselwe kwizinambuzane nakumswakama.

english: Plant individual cloves pointy-side up; a cool spell early on helps bulbs form properly.
isixhosa_draft: Tyala amaqhekeza ngamnye ngomphetho obukhali ujonge phezulu; ixesha elipholileyo ekuqaleni lincedisa iibhalbhu ukuba zenze kakuhle.

english: Give climbing types a trellis; pick pods while still glossy for the sweetest peas.
isixhosa_draft: Nika iindidi ezikhwelayo isixhaso; khetha iipodi zisaqaqamba ukuze ufumane ii-peas ezimnandi kakhulu.

english: Harvest the central head before the flowers open, then side shoots keep coming.
isixhosa_draft: Vuna intloko ephakathi phambi kokuba iintyatyambo zivuleke, emva koko amahlumela asecaleni aqhubeka evela.

english: main heads 1–2 weeks; side sprouts 3–4 weeks longer
isixhosa_draft: iintloko eziphambili iiveki ezi-1–2; amahlumela asecaleni ixesha elide ngeeveki ezi-3–4

english: Keep watering even — irregular water is the main cause of bitter fruit.
isixhosa_draft: Qhubeka unkcenkceshela ngokulinganayo — amanzi angalinganiyo yeyona nto iphambili ebangela iziqhamo ezikrakra.

english: Needs a long hot season and plenty of room to vine out.
isixhosa_draft: Idinga ihlobo elide elishushu kunye nendawo eyaneleyo yokusasaza iziqu zayo.

english: Mild/subtropical leaf-crop guidance only. Coriander stays manual because suitability depends on household preference; it bolts fast in heat and long days.
isixhosa_draft: Isikhokelo semifuno enamagqabi yemozulu ethambileyo/ye-subtropical kuphela. I-coriander ihlala isebenza ngesandla (manual) ngenxa yokuba ukufaneleka kuxhomekeke kukhetho lwekhaya; iqhakaza ngokukhawuleza ebushushini nakwiintsuku ezinde.

english: A KZN winter cover for maize land, not a food harvest in this plan. Sow March-May while late-summer soil moisture remains, then cut or roll it before the next summer staple crop. Nothing is added to kitchen harvest totals.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo sokugquma sasebusika sase-KZN somhlaba we-maize, hayi isivuno sokutya kwesi sicwangciso. Hlwayela kuMatshi-Meyi ngoxa ukumanzi komhlaba wasekupheleni kwehlobo kusekho, uze usike okanye uqengqe phambi kwesityalo esiyisiseko sehlobo esilandelayo. Akukho nto yongezelelwa kwizixa zesivuno sekitshini.

english: Real spinach (Spinacia oleracea) — not the Swiss chard South Africans usually call spinach. Cool-season and fast: it bolts in heat, so keep to the cool sowing windows and pick promptly. Same botanical family (Amaranthaceae) as Swiss chard and beetroot, so the rotation rule treats all three as one family — do not follow one with another in the same bed.
isixhosa_draft: I-spinach yokwenyani (Spinacia oleracea) — hayi i-Swiss chard abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abahlala besithi sisipinatshi. Yexesha elipholileyo kwaye ikhawulezile: iqhakaza ebushushini, ngoko landela amaxesha okuhlwayela apholileyo uze uvune ngoko nangoko. Ngusapho olunye lwezityalo (Amaranthaceae) ne-Swiss chard kunye ne-beetroot, ngoko umgaqo wokujikeleza uthatha zontathu njengosapho olunye — ungalandelisi enye ngenye kwibhedi enye.

english: A traditional leafy green (imbuya/thepe), not the grain amaranth grown elsewhere. DAFF's own spacing figures for this crop conflict with each other and its printed seed rate is too dense to be plausible for amaranth's tiny seed, so treat the spacing here as a starting point to confirm locally, not a verified field plan. No yield figure was found either, so it stays manual.
isixhosa_draft: Imifuno enamagqabi yemveli (imbuya/thepe), hayi iinkozo ze-amaranth ezityalwa kwenye indawo. Amanani esithuba e-DAFF kwesi sityalo ayaphikisana, kwaye izinga layo lembewu eshicilelweyo limxinwa kakhulu ukuba lisenokwamkeleka kwimbewu encinci ye-amaranth, ngoko thatha isithuba apha njengendawo yokuqala yokuqinisekisa ekuhlaleni, hayi isicwangciso sentsimi esiqinisekisiweyo. Akukho nani lesivuno lifunyenwe nalo, ngoko sihlala sisebenza ngesandla.

english: A biennial herb grown as an annual for its leaves. Apiaceae family, same as carrots — avoid repeating that family in the same bed too often.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo samagqabi se-biennial esityalwa njengesonyaka omnye ngenxa yamagqabi aso. Usapho lwe-Apiaceae, olufanayo nolwe-carrots — ungaphindi olo sapho kwibhedi enye rhoqo.

english: A dual-purpose legume: young leaves (imifino) can be picked from three to four weeks after sowing, and dry grain follows later. No yield figure is given because the only South African trial found disagreed twenty-fold between its two sites. No named SA cultivars were found.
isixhosa_draft: I-legume esebenza ngeenjongo ezimbini: amagqabi amancinci (imifino) anokukhethwa emva kweeveki ezintathu ukuya kwezine emva kokuhlwayela, neenkozo ezomileyo zilandela kamva. Akukho nani lesivuno linikiweyo kuba uvavanyo olulodwa lwaseMzantsi Afrika olufunyenweyo lwahlukile ngamaxesha angamashumi amabini phakathi kweendawo zalo ezimbini. Akukho ndidi ziqanjwe ngamagama zaseMzantsi Afrika zifunyenweyo.

english: A very fast root crop, ready in three to four weeks — good for filling gaps between slower crops. No published yield figure was found, so it stays manual and will not drive auto-suggest ranking. Brassicaceae family, same as cabbage and turnip.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo sengcambu esikhawulezileyo kakhulu, silungile emva kweeveki ezintathu ukuya kwezine — silungele ukuzalisa izikhewu phakathi kwezityalo ezicothayo. Akukho nani lesivuno eshicilelweyo lifunyenwe, ngoko sihlala sisebenza ngesandla kwaye asiyi kuqhuba uluhlu lweengcebiso ezizenzekelayo. Usapho lwe-Brassicaceae, olufanayo ne-cabbage ne-turnip.

english: A short-season legume grain grown for dry seed. No seed rate or yield figure was found in any sourced document, so it stays manual and will not drive auto-suggest ranking. The source's own row-spacing guidance is inconsistent (18cm in one place, 75cm-1.2m in another) — confirm locally before committing a full bed.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo se-legume seenkozo sexesha elifutshane esityalelwa imbewu eyomileyo. Akukho nqanaba lembewu okanye inani lesivuno lifunyenwe kuwo nawuphi na uxwebhu olunomthombo, ngoko sihlala sisebenza ngesandla kwaye asiyi kuqhuba uluhlu lweengcebiso ezizenzekelayo. Isikhokelo somthombo ngokwaso sesithuba somqolo asihambelani (18cm kwenye indawo, 75cm-1.2m kwenye) — qinisekisa ekuhlaleni phambi kokuzibophelela kwibhedi epheleleyo.

english: Pod maturity is uneven; up to five successive hand-pickings are typical rather than one single harvest date.
isixhosa_draft: Ukuvuthwa kweepodi akulinganiyo; kuqhelekile ukuba kukhethwe ngesandla ngokulandelelana ukuya kutsho kwiihlandlo ezintlanu kunokuba kube nomhla omnye wesivuno.

english: DAFF describes three successive harvests rather than one continuous picking period.
isixhosa_draft: I-DAFF ichaza ukuvuna kathathu ngokulandelelana kunokuba kube lixesha elinye elilodwa lokukhetha.

english: A fast-growing nitrogen-fixing cover crop, not a food harvest in this plan. Sow October-November once soil has warmed, then terminate before the next crop — nothing is added to kitchen harvest totals.
isixhosa_draft: Isityalo sokugquma esikhula ngokukhawuleza esibambe i-nitrogen, hayi isivuno sokutya kwesi sicwangciso. Hlwayela kuOkthobha-Novemba xa umhlaba sele ufudumele, uze usiphelise phambi kwesityalo esilandelayo — akukho nto yongezelelwa kwizixa zesivuno sekitshini.

english: A winter-rainfall pasture/cover legume for the Western, Southern and Eastern Cape — not a food harvest in this plan. Sow April-May at the start of the winter rains, then terminate before the next crop.
isixhosa_draft: I-legume yengca/yokugquma yemvula yasebusika ye-Western Cape, i-Southern Cape ne-Eastern Cape — hayi isivuno sokutya kwesi sicwangciso. Hlwayela kuEpreli-Meyi ekuqaleni kwemvula yasebusika, uze usiphelise phambi kwesityalo esilandelayo.
